reviews.author: Judith Angulo
reviews.text: The resort was great! The best part was definitely the beach we fell in love with its beautiful turquoise water. The food at the restaurants was delicious, and the buffet was especially enjoyable. I have to give a special shout out to Armando, Pascual at the buffet, Roger at steak house who provided exceptional service. They were friendly, attentive, and made our dining experience even better. We would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Mandy Doy
reviews.text:
I have been coming to Paradisus for 11years.  The last couple of years have not been the amazing experience we had hoped for.  I was nervous to come after the remodel, just not knowing what to expect.  I was pleasantly pleased with the remodel and changes that have occurred.
Rommel was our concierge and he was amazing.  Israel was also so kind and always willing to help with anything we needed.
Cesar, Jamil, Valeria, Julio, Boris, Mike, Hoarcio are all amazing and willing to create an amazing experience for the guests.

Please continue to work on the water level in the pool for the Reserve side.  That is going to be crucial to making sure the guests are happy.

Edgar was amazing at Capella!  Food was delicious and service was even better.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Shannon clark
reviews.text:
My husband and I celebrated our 20-year anniversary at Paradisus Cancun in April 2026, and we had a wonderful experience.

The resort had recently reopened after renovations, and everything felt fresh, modern, and very clean. The beach was beautiful, the pools were relaxing, and the grounds were well maintained.

The highlight of our stay was the staff. Everyone was friendly, helpful, and genuinely seemed to care about making our vacation special. A special thank you to Chris, our Reserve Concierge, who went above and beyond throughout our stay.

If you’re considering upgrading to The Reserve Adults Only section, I highly recommend it. The concierge service, exclusive lounge, premium drinks, coffee bar, adults-only dining, and Bali beds were well worth it.

The resort offers several dining options, including steak, seafood, Japanese cuisine, and a buffet. While the food wasn’t our favorite part of the trip, breakfast was excellent and there was plenty of variety.

We especially enjoyed the live saxophone music during breakfast, the beautiful beach, and the peaceful gym each morning.

Overall, we had an amazing anniversary trip and would gladly return to Paradisus Cancun in the future.

reviews.author: Walisa Dickson
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancún exceeded every expectation.

From the moment we arrived, we were treated with warmth, professionalism, and genuine hospitality. The resort itself is beautiful, well maintained, and offers an outstanding experience, but what truly sets it apart is the people.

A special thank you to Alejandro and Rommel from the Family Concierge team. They were phenomenal throughout our stay. They anticipated needs before we even had to ask, provided excellent recommendations, and always made us feel like valued guests. Their attention to detail and commitment to exceptional service made a lasting impression on our family.

The restaurants, pool staff, housekeeping team, bartenders, and servers were all wonderful. Every interaction was positive, and it was clear how much pride the staff takes in creating a memorable experience for guests.

One idea I would encourage the resort to consider is providing a QR code tipping option for staff members. We quickly learned that cash goes fast when so many people are providing exceptional service. There were several team members we wanted to recognize and thank, but we simply ran out of cash during our stay. A digital tipping option would be convenient for guests and would help ensure outstanding employees receive the appreciation they deserve.

This trip was a special graduation celebration, and Paradisus Cancún helped make it unforgettable. Thank you to everyone who contributed to such an amazing experience. We will be recommending this resort to family and friends and hope to return again.

reviews.author: Diyora Khasanova
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, the hotel made our family feel welcomed and well taken care of. The level of service throughout our stay was exceptional and truly made this trip special for us.

First and foremost — the family concierge service. We were lucky to have Erick Mejenes, who truly elevated our entire stay. He was always available, answered all of our questions, booked restaurants and spa appointments, and helped organize family events like birthdays. His attention to detail and genuine care made everything feel smooth and stress-free.

Second, if you’re traveling with kids, you should definitely choose this hotel for its amazing kids program. Our stay wouldn’t have been the same without the extra care and attention from the wonderful Kidsdom team — especially Maylin, Fernanda, Esmeralda, Alondra, and Vianey. Our son is usually very shy, but he couldn’t wait to go to Kidsdom every day. The program was very well organized and engaging.

Among the extra activities offered by the hotel, we especially enjoyed the Cocoa Ceremony and the cocktail master class, hosted by attentive staff members including Mauricio, Daniel, and bartender Xavier.

Among the à la carte restaurants, I’d highly recommend Kao, Blue Agave (especially the caramel flan ice cream dessert), and Vibra, where we received especially high-end service from a very attentive waiter named Omar.

reviews.author: VLORA CAKOLLI
reviews.text: We had a wonderful dining experience at Capello! The food was absolutely delicious—the antipasti were the perfect start, and the pasta dishes were fresh, authentic, and packed with flavor.A special thank you goes to our waiter, Edgar. He was incredibly attentive, professional, and warm, making sure our family had everything we needed for a perfect evening.We highly recommend this place and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Hajar Lyazidi
reviews.text: Very pleasant experience.  The service we received from Martin Kucan and David Rodriguez @ GastroHall restaurant  made us want to extend our stay. The manager Nayeli  made sure kids are taking care of since they have Gluten Allergy. The best experience ever we will definitely come back here thanks to their assistance

reviews.author: Lou Dempsey
reviews.text:
Omar our butler was beyond amazing, made our stay absolutely magical, always attentive and went beyond with everything for us. The hotel/Reserve section far surpassed any all inclusive accommodations we have stayed in previously. It’s a 10/10 from accommodation, ease of day bed use, ability to reserve speciality restaurants, amenities cleanliness/comfort of the rooms. At no point did we go hungry or thirsty, fantastic food options for celiacs (staff well aware), so much fresh fruit and delicious options. Amazing greenery/plants everywhere, gorgeous tropical vibes throughout the hotel.
We cannot wait to return here again.

reviews.author: Suli Marquez
reviews.text: I loved this resort so much! Javier is the bartender and such a vibe! Mauricio handled prepping the activities like cocktail lessons, Mexican shows, circus show etc lots of cool things to check out. The people are AMAZING! The vibes are chill but can definitely pick up if you want it to!

reviews.author: Miguel Guerra
reviews.text:
My partner and I traveled from Miami and had an absolutely amazing stay at the beautiful Paradisus Cancún, and a huge part of that experience was thanks to our incredible butler, Omar.

From the moment we arrived, Omar went above and beyond to make sure every detail of our vacation was perfect. He was professional, attentive, friendly, and always one step ahead of our needs. Whether it was helping with restaurant reservations, arranging activities, answering questions, or simply checking in to make sure we were enjoying our stay, his dedication to outstanding guest service truly stood out.

What impressed us most was his genuine kindness and willingness to help. He made us feel welcomed, valued, and completely taken care of throughout our entire visit. It’s rare to encounter someone who takes such pride in creating memorable experiences for guests, and Omar exceeded every expectation.

The resort itself is beautiful, but employees like Omar are what make a vacation unforgettable. Thank you for making our trip so special and stress-free.

We will definitely be returning to Paradisus Cancún, and we hope to see Omar again on our next visit!

reviews.author: Maureen Vera Clark
reviews.text: Adriana & Fanny took so much good care of us making it such a special day celebrating our little one. This place is so family oriented and their attention to detail and customer service is world class. Recommended and cannot wait to come back!

reviews.author: Aliza Delva
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience during my stay. Food was delicious and fresh. Many options. The servers at my meal times especially Alejandro, Reynaldo, Hermes and Richer kept the vibes going and we’re on top of getting anything I needed. This will be my go to resort for my trips to Cancun!

reviews.author: Kara Ward
reviews.text: Literally the best meal I had during my stay, and that is saying A LOT. The ambiance, food, and service (thank you so much Edgar!) were all amazing. Should out to my concierge Natalia for both recommending this restaurant out of all the restaurants here (I'm only here 5 nights so I wouldn't have been able to try them all) and for making sure this was my final dinner here at Paradisus. I will be back.

reviews.author: Victoria Silva
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was absolutely unforgettable! From the moment we arrived, the entire hotel staff made us feel welcomed, cared for, and truly on vacation. The resort is beautiful, clean, relaxing, and the service was top tier in every area restaurants, pool service, housekeeping, and guest experience.

But the real highlight of our trip was our amazing butler, Erick Mejenes! He went above and beyond every single day to make sure our family had the best experience possible. His attention to detail, kindness, professionalism, and genuine care made us feel so special. No request was ever too much, and he always made everything smooth and stress-free for us.

Erick truly elevated our entire vacation experience and is honestly one of the best butlers we’ve ever had. Paradisus Cancun is lucky to have someone like him representing their resort!

Thank you again to Erick and the entire Paradisus Cancun team for making our trip so memorable. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Kendri Sabillon
reviews.text: This is genuinely the best resort I’ve ever been to. The attention the staff give you is amazing! They go out of their way to make you feel taken care of and seen. Alejandro and Bernardo at the buffet were so so sweet and they took such good care of us the whole week. I definitely hope to stay here again. (Wish I didn’t have to go back home😭💔)

reviews.author: Kate Grinshpon
reviews.text:
Had an amazing dinner at Kao restaurant. Our server, Daniel, provided top-notch service!

Service by the pool was excellent every single day of our stay thanks to Vianney! Thank you!

Our dinner at Cappella - Italian restaurant - was amazing. Delicious food and great service. Our server, Jesus, was very knowledgeable and provided amazing service!

reviews.author: Zachary Donato
reviews.text: Paradisus is perfectly named - it truly is a paradise. The staff are absolutely amazing and helpful, the rooms are wonderful, and the experience is everything you could ask for. The food is amazing, especially Blue Agave. Their tacos were delightful and the staff were even better. Nathanael the manager and Alberto our waiter were attentive and great to converse with. I highly recommend coming here, you will not regret it!

reviews.author: Charlie Johnson
reviews.text: Fantastic stay at the Paradisus Cancun. All of the staff around the reserve were absolutely fantastic and a credit to the hotel. Jared & Israel looked after me super well. A big mention to Julio on the reserve bar, fantastic service from him. Thank you!

reviews.author: Amanda Hart
reviews.text: Mario was such a great help & waiter at Kao! He made sure our order was correct because my stand is allergic to Avocado and he took time to expect our food before dropping it off! I cannot say enough good things about the employees at this exceptional resort! This is our third time coming back and we love the staff here!! The remodel also looks amazing!

reviews.author: Julia Tighe
reviews.text: We loved our experience here!! Such an amazing experience, went on a girls trip and had so much fun! The staff was so sweet and attentive, we loved Uriel! He was as so sweet and always making sure we had everything taken care of!

reviews.author: Sonja Katanic
reviews.text:
We came to blue agave and had Armando as our server. He was amazing and so friendly! Everything he helped us choose was delicious; we are both gluten free and he helped us through the menu and ensured everything we wanted was safe for us. We felt super welcome!

We also loved the bar in the lobby, and Anahi and Diego specifically there were so lovely! We can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Vicky Chan
reviews.text: Ernesto was very good at servicing us, made sure we liked everything and gave us very good recommendations on food choices!!!! Go to Aqua Marina now! This is the best restaurant in this resort so far. The manager Teresita was very caring too. She invited us to this restaurant and gave us special order to try the seafood and dessert. Thank you! Will be back & definitely recommend this to our friends.

reviews.author: Nick Kravchuk
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at the Italian restaurant in Paradisus Cancun, and a huge part of that was thanks to Edgar!

From the moment we sat down, he made us feel genuinely welcome and taken care of. His attention to detail, friendly attitude, and perfect timing with everything—from drinks to recommendations—made the whole evening smooth and enjoyable. He knew the menu really well and helped us pick dishes that turned out to be absolutely delicious.

What really stood out was how effortless he made everything feel. He was always there when we needed something, but never intrusive—just top-tier service all around.

Edgar truly elevated our dining experience. If you get the chance, definitely ask for him—you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Yesmina Maurer
reviews.text:
Appreciation and recognition for the outstanding service provided by Carolina Guitierrez concierge assigned to us during our stay at your hotel Malia Cancun.
From the very beginning, the attention we receive was truly exceptional. The concierge  Carolina was always kind, professional, punctual, attentive and welling to assist us with every detail we need.
Her warm attitude, dedication and commitment to excellent customer service made our stay enjoyable and memorable.
Thank you !!!  To her professionalism and disposition.
Sincerely,
Yesmina Pulido

reviews.author: Mindy Langley
reviews.text: We stayed for 4 days in May. We had 2 family concierge and they were amazing! Eduardo and Alejandro were great. They went out of their way to make us comfortable. We truly appreciate everything! It was a great experience!

reviews.author: Simran Chandi
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was truly unforgettable. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the exceptional service, attention to detail, and warm hospitality from the staff. The resort is beautifully maintained—everything from the rooms to the common areas was spotless and well cared for.

The atmosphere throughout the resort is relaxing yet vibrant, making it perfect for both families and couples. The staff consistently went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable and enjoying our time, which made a big difference in our overall experience.

The combination of cleanliness, excellent service, and the stunning beachfront location made this trip absolutely amazing. We left with wonderful memories and would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun to anyone looking for a luxurious and stress-free getaway. We would definitely love to return!

reviews.author: Liz val
reviews.text: First time visiting this resort it is so beautiful. The room is beautiful the only downside is our air conditioner did not work but they are on top of it getting fixed. Second day here and we did an activity making a key chain. Jesus was an amazing instructor.

reviews.author: Pierre Galarza
reviews.text: Our butler, Eduardo Mena, went above and beyond during our one week stay at resort Paradisus in Cancun. He was always making sure we had everything we needed. He reserved our dinners for us and any activities we wanted to do. His hospitality towards our family made us feel comfortable and right at home. Anyone that's being helped by Eduardo will have a great experience. We all highly recommend him as a butler.

reviews.author: Ashley Gilani
reviews.text: We really enjoyed Kao restaurant at Paradisus! Daniel was our server and although we don’t eat seafood, he was very helpful in giving us guidance on what to order. Everything was so delicious and it’s a beautiful restaurant! We would love to be back during the rest of our stay.

reviews.author: Areyousingle lin
reviews.text: The Karaoke was funny with the Mc Uriel and the DJ Bryan!! They know made the party!!! The party was so much fun. They're very professional guiding the whole thing and whole grew with a vibe. It's a definitely fantastic night. If I were rayday we'll be 10 out of 10 100%

reviews.author: Ancsa Szepesi
reviews.text:
We recently stayed for 12 nights and overall had a good experience, made memorable by several outstanding staff members.
A special mention goes to Jesus, the wellness instructor, who truly elevated our stay. His yoga and meditation sessions were excellent, and we also really enjoyed his Mexican herbs class, as well as the margarita and tequila tastings; such a great mix of relaxation and culture. We had a great experience on the Sound healing as well with the team, Jesus, Giovani, Uriel, Rogelio and Mauricio.
The mixology class was another highlight, thanks to Daniel, Andres, and Giovani, who made it both fun and engaging.
We also want to recognize Jesus at KAO restaurant for his very good service, and Jesus at Zesty, who was so attentive and welcoming.

A big thank you to Sergio, our personal concierge, who was always available whenever we needed anything, his support made everything smooth and stress-free.

Uriel from the entertainment team and Sommelier Miguel was fantastic as well, they joined us during the Wine & Canvas activity, which we really enjoyed.

Daniel from the entertainment team was another staff member who stood out, always greeting us warmly and taking the time to chat whenever we crossed paths.

Also thank you David for your kind service and the Bali beds with beautiful views, I can't recall the names of your colleagues but they were great too!

One area for improvement would be the breakfast service at Sante. It was inconsistent, on some mornings it was attentive, but on others it felt disorganized. There were instances where we were seated before other guests, yet they were served drinks and coffee well before us, while we were still waiting for something as a greeting from a server. That said, Valeria provided excellent service whenever she was there and made a positive difference!

It's also worth noting that there are currently some improvements taking place around the resort, including painting, hammering and general updates. While this didn't significantly impact our stay, it's something to be aware of.

Overall, we had a lovely stay and truly appreciated the efforts of the staff who went above and beyond to make our vacation special.

reviews.author: Lauren Gaston
reviews.text:
We booked Paradisus for the last 3 days of our trip in Mexico and overall had a fantastic stay. Probably easier to start with the cons as there were so many positives:

- could tell they were rushing to reopen ahead of renovations. Given hotel was closed for better part of 10months due to renovations. There was still some ongoing maintenance, likes of ladders and painters not having finished.
- this sort of bled through to a few of the touches that were missing. We had espresso pods in the room but not coffee machine. Beer and water bottles which required a bottle opener, but no bottle opener. They let us know upon check in that 24 hour room service was available but then once the main buffet was closing and we were looking to order some dinner, the phone line was permanently engaged and once we went through reception, wait time for food was over an hour.
- couldn’t get dinner reservations.

That really is it with regards to cons however. The positives far overruled.
- excellent food variety and drinks.
- quality of food was high
- staff were incredibly helpful and friendly
- amenities were all very clean with a fully incredibly well equipped gym.
-availability of 24 hour coffee in the coffee shop.
- cannot comment on the à la carte restaurants as unfortunately they were fully booked for duration of our stay but they looked very nice.

Our room was beautiful and overall we had an amazing stay and would definitely recommend the hotel and would return if we were to go back to cancun.

reviews.author: Kord Davis
reviews.text:
Juan Carlos and Alondra were attentive from the start. Both of them made it their mission to make our honeymoon one to remember.

Alberto at Kanna Beach is a stud!

Vianney was fantastic as well, she remembered our names and orders!

reviews.author: Kimberly Savitsky
reviews.text:
Great visit, family has visited many times. Renovations improved the hotel room experience, restaurants moved around and refreshed.

Luis and team great at Kanna beach for private kabana

Alberto and Nathanael amazing at Blue Agave, they were so accommodating and gave us complimentary liqueur to end the dinner

Will keep returning! Love this paradise

reviews.author: Diana K
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus in Cancun and the experience was amazing. We ate at the Blue Agave which was an authentic Mexican restaurant and the food was superb. Our waiter Manuel, was absolutely amazing. He was friendly, and provided amazing service. We enjoyed every experience with him. Definitely come see Manuel at the Blue Agave if you’re ever in Cancun

reviews.author: Sarah Mcintyre
reviews.text:
Honestly Jesus from Capella has the best customer service I have experienced at Meliá.  The food and service here was next level.

Fanny & Martin from Gasto Hall are also 10/10.

Thank you for everything!

reviews.author: Ina Grecu
reviews.text: Amazing experience at Aqua Marina! The food was delicious, the atmosphere was beautiful, and everything was perfect. A special thank you to Angel for the outstanding service — so friendly, attentive, and professional. He really made our evening unforgettable. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jeremy
reviews.text: Omar our butler was amazing I've never paid for the "reserve" style upgrades before but everything that was included and the attention to detail was exceptional. Also as a celiac I was able access a lot more menus with confidence. Will be back for sure

reviews.author: roy mohon
reviews.text: Julio did a great job each time he waited on us. Fkora and Olivia were excellent for our pool service. There are more wonderful people i will try to remember all their names and comment later

reviews.author: LaToya Powell
reviews.text: Gerardo in the Gastro Hall was such a fantastic waiter! I saw him every day I was there and he took great care of me. We spoke in spanish and he helped me with perfecting my conversationsl spanish. The food was delicious and I look forward to coming back. Thank you again to Gerardo, the other waiters and the chefs!

reviews.author: Michelle Abro
reviews.text: Rodrigo was great! He provided our family with the best pool service. Our waters were always full and he continued to bring us ice plus anything else we asked for! We would definitely recommend his service.

reviews.author: Karny
reviews.text: We had a great experience at Blue Agave with our server Atilano. He was very friendly and gave us the best customer service. The food was prepared by chef Miguel and he did a fantastic job. All the food was amazing and we would definitely recommend this restaurant to others.

reviews.author: Prema D Souza
reviews.text:
ADAN at the front desk of Paradisus Cancun truly made our stay unforgettable. He went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. His professionalism, warmth, and genuine care for guests set him apart immediately.

He was always attentive, quick to assist with any request, and consistently made us feel welcomed and valued. Whether it was offering helpful recommendations, resolving questions efficiently, or simply greeting us with a friendly smile, Adan elevated our entire experience.

It’s rare to encounter someone so dedicated to hospitality, and his efforts did not go unnoticed. Because of him, our stay was not just comfortable but exceptional. I would highly recommend seeking him out if you’re staying at Paradisus Cancun—he will make sure you have the best time possible.

reviews.author: B Martinez
reviews.text: Loved the resort’s new look! The room we stayed in at the Family Concierge pyramid was spacious, comfortable and the amenities good quality. We loved the food and the service everywhere we ate. Teresa and Ernesto at Aquamarina, Vianney at the poolside Bali, took fantastic care of us. Special mention to the stars at the kids club, Esmeralda, Alondra and Fernanda who made my kids stay truly wonderful!

reviews.author: Marie-Lou Gilbert
reviews.text: Our stay at the Paradisus Cancan was such a great time!! The resort is very impressive and the staff is so nice! We had Fernanda as our concierge. She was very kind and always checked up on us and made sure we had everything we needed :) We were very lucky to have her during our stay. We also met Jesus, The fitness instructor. He had great energy and always kept us entertained! Finally, on our last Day, we had a margherrita class with Melvin who was awesome! This is a place I would want to come back to for sure :)

reviews.author: Alexandra Rodriguez
reviews.text: We loved going to the daily activities, specifically Yoga with Jesus. He was very caring with us and prioritized our experience. My family loved him!

reviews.author: Levon Byrd
reviews.text: Alfredo at Kanna was the absolute best. He helped us and kept the drinks coming. He made this trip so welcoming smd we appreciate him.

reviews.author: Liana Kachakhmadze
reviews.text: Amara and David from the buffet service, Daniel #2 from entertainment, Sabrina from bar management, and Karina from the SPA went above and beyond to make us happy and keep our vacation feeling personal. Keep up the great service quality! And a big thank you!

reviews.author: Sanjana Venkat
reviews.text: We came to Cappela Italian restaurant for dinner 2 times and we loved the food . Jesus was very good and he went out of the way to get us all that we wanted . He even helped customize few dishes because we are vegetarian. Roberto was also a fine waiter who helped us .

reviews.author: Tammy Dunnett
reviews.text: Mikele is a breath of fresh air, attentive and engaging. We have enjoyed his work and time always with a brilliant smile. A big addition to a wonderful experience. It was a pleasure meeting you this week, hope to see you next year! Tammy & Bill Dunnett

reviews.author: Heisam Allam
reviews.text:
Once again, another memorable trip and stay at Paradisus Cancun. First time back since renovation reopening and as always, it was a magical stay!
We stay on the Reserve side and were excited to see the updates throughout the resort but more importantly were excited to see the staff that came back. Our amazing experience is curated by so many of the staff that are always so lovely, they are professional, attentive and caring. Diego, a supervisor there, is hands down one of the nicest people on Earth. Diego is beyond caring and very professional, took care of any of our needs. Diego is the best! The staff at Sante/Reserve Pool, from pre-renovation staff to new employees are all super special and great people to us that show so much care and love. The staff that we know for years need major shout outs, Cesar, Julio, Yamil, Javier, David, and Victor. Everytime we go they treat us with so much care. This time around we met new staff that are cut from the same cloth, professional, sweet, vibrant and attentive. Shout out to Cynthia, Gemma, Valeria, and the new pool staff Mikele. Our concierge Galdino is so awesome, he is knowledgeable of the resort and surrounding areas, he takes care of our every need, he is available to us at all times, he definitely made our stay so much easier and relaxing.
The resort is amazing and beautiful, but the thing that keeps us coming back is the amazing staff.
The special activities/entertainment staff all came on board with the reopening but they fall right into place, as if they have worked there for years. They are very charismatic, fun and entertaining. Jesus, Uriel, and the rest of the staff, definitely set the tone during activities and classes to get everyone involved and have fun. They are awesome!
One of the major changes that happened was that our beloved Nespresso bar moved from being the center point when you enter from the beach/pool side, to having its own location on the same floor a few feet away. While we are bias and loved how the Nespresso bar was the first thing you saw when entering Tower 3 illuminated and cheerful, we do also enjoy that it has its own location along with the addition of the ice cream parlor. Along with the location of rhe old Nespresso bar being right in the middle with the smell of coffee and illuminating the walkway, Alejandro, the barista there is what made every morning with his infectious personality and loving demeanor. Alejandro is amazing and he is surrounded by nee staff that are just as approachable and nice, showing that they enjoy what they do, Norma, Rosalinda, Karina, Perla, all amazing!

reviews.author: Jamie K
reviews.text: Capella at Paradisus Cancun is a must have dinner spot! Snag your reservation here early in your stay! Our server Edgar was wonderful, impressed by their speedy service, ambiance and everything we ordered was delicious! The kids can many things to enjoy here, the Cesar salad, fettuccini Alfredo with chicken, wood fired pizza, tomato soup and chicken Parmesan! Yum! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Darryl Franklin
reviews.text: A wonderful experience! The first time at paradisus and very happy with my choice. Blueagave has a wonderful crew including our waiter Atilano, chef Vanessa, and chef Isobel. Thanks for the experience!

reviews.author: Ashley Caffrey
reviews.text: Miguel, lucas, Teresita and chef Ivan were amazing! Best dinner we had, Miguel went over and beyond for our anniversary. They were so sweet and to the chef, amazing food thank you!

reviews.author: Gillie R
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun after their reopening. We were Family Concierge and our concierge, Eduardo Mena was really great. He waited at the hotel to greet us personally even though we arrived very late. When we got to our hotel room, Eduardo had decorated it with balloons to celebrate birthdays. We also had a bottle of wine waiting for us with fruit and then had a cake sent to our room the next evening. Eduardo was there to help us with anything we needed and also responded immediately.

Overall, the hotel is beautiful but we had some issues with a leak in our hotel room on the last day that we did not know about. The food was also ok… not great. I would 100% recommend Eduardo as your concierge though.

reviews.author: Tyler D
reviews.text:
Our fourth stay at Paradisus Cancun—and somehow it just keeps getting better.
We had an amazing time from start to finish. Having stayed here multiple times (including once on the Family Concierge side), we already had high expectations, and this trip absolutely delivered. The food was consistently very good, the rooms were comfortable and well-kept, and the overall atmosphere continues to strike that perfect balance between relaxing and upscale. But what truly sets this resort apart is the staff—they don’t just provide service, they create unforgettable experiences.
Galdino, our concierge, was exceptional. His attentiveness made the entire trip seamless and stress-free. He handled everything for us—restaurant reservations, Bali bed bookings, and regular check-ins throughout the day to make sure we had everything we needed. This isn’t our first time working with him, and honestly, he’s a big reason we keep coming back. We would only return if we knew we had him—he’s that good.
At Aqua Marina, Juan took great care of our family. He was friendly, attentive, and made every meal enjoyable. It’s service like his that turns a simple dinner into a memorable experience.
Mornings were always brightened by Alejandro and Perla at the café. Their warm welcome each day set the tone perfectly, and they made some of the best coffee we’ve had at any resort. You can tell they genuinely care about guests—it shows in every interaction.
By the pool, Rodrigo, Ana, and Guadalupe were incredible. They were constantly checking in, making sure we had drinks, and keeping the energy fun and relaxed. They made our pool days effortless and enjoyable.
And in the evenings, Flora at the Ginger Bar stood out. She and her team created such a welcoming atmosphere, and the drinks were fantastic. She was kind, engaging, and made everyone feel right at home.
Overall, this was another outstanding stay. We would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun—especially the Reserve side—for any family or couple looking for a relaxing, high-quality, and truly memorable vacation. The people here make all the difference, and it’s why we’ll keep coming back

reviews.author: Jamie McDonagh
reviews.text:
We have had a lovely time at Paradisus Cancun.
Jesus has been great and really looked after us with the activities we have done. He is super friendly, fun, and has always put a smile on our face. Thank you Jesus!

reviews.author: Sam Pedlar
reviews.text: Uriel was the best!! The aqua tonic’s and aqua Zumba was a blast. He brought the energy got the pool fired up and made sure the guests were having a great time!! Can’t say enough good things about Uriel !!!

reviews.author: Jacklyn Asamoah
reviews.text: Alfredo at Kanna was a wonderful server! He was always asking us if we needed anything and provided excellent service. Very helpful and friendly. Great experience.

reviews.author: natalie ivory
reviews.text: Hotel was fantastic, with our two kids aged 5 and 8. The staff were awesome and our favourite meal was at the vibra and Jorge was outstanding, he even managed to get us tge special we had a few nights before even though it was not on the menu. Natalie and Chris.

reviews.author: Carlos Vargas Jr.
reviews.text: Perla & Alejandro @ the Nespresso Cafe are amazing. Super sweet and helpful. Always have a smile on their faces.

reviews.author: Rachel Garcia
reviews.text: Omar our butler was the best ever. He made our first family vacation the most memorable experience. I can’t say thank you enough. Love you so much Omar!!!

reviews.author: Michelle Llanes
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed Friday through Tuesday. We were in room 5006, which was the ground floor on the Adults Only Reserve side. We had a view of the ocean and were steps away from walking outside to the pool area. Our room was large with a king size bed, sofa, table/chairs, walk-in shower, soaker tub, and outdoor patio area equipped with double lounger bed and a table and chairs. The room was clean and comfortable. Our butler, Isle, was wonderful and we utilized WhatsApp to communicate with her. All staff, waiters, bartenders, concierge, we encountered were extremely nice, patient, and kind. We had the perfect weather and ate dinner at the reservation only restaurants each evening (Sal Steakhouse, Cappella Italian & Blue Agave). Only three issues occurred and two were addressed and corrected immediately: the faucet on the tub was not connected correctly and shot off when we turned on the water; maintenance had the issue resolved quickly: at the adults only pool, a guest decided to blare their music on a portable speaker which definitely took away from the calm and peaceful vibes this area markets and we had experienced the day before; we spoke discreetly with the pool manager and the person was asked to turn down their music; the person obliged and we were back to listening to the tranquil ocean waves again. The 3rd issue was on our last morning, we had planned to sleep in and enjoy a late brunch before checking out; well the lawn maintenance staff started with their weed-eater at 7:45 am! And it did not stop for more than an hour. That, was really our only complaint with our stay. Our goal was to soak in the sun, enjoy the beautiful ocean, and relax and we accomplished that 1000%.

Xochilt at Blue Agave was an amazing server today. Service was prompt. She was attentive to our requests, and she was just a very nice person. The food was delicious too!

Roger was fantastic at Sal Steakhouse. Very attentive, informative and patient with us. And he just has a very charismatic personality. The picana and salmon were our favorites!

reviews.author: Adiba shalauddin
reviews.text: Carlos was great, He took lot of patience to take our order. This is our first visit to Paradisus Cancun and Carlos made it really wonderful experience at VIBRA. We hope to come back next year again.

reviews.author: Jason Koontz
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun… our service and stay was AMAZING! So many great people there!! Caro our concierge, ALL of the servers.. amazing!! Thank you for an amazing stay in Paradise!!! We hope to see you soon…

reviews.author: Kathryn Fennessy
reviews.text:
Annabelle was an amazing server and the food was great. Fanny was also great at being available in helping out through out dinner.

Zesty Restaurant

reviews.author: Inna Vichman
reviews.text: We just had dinner at Agua Marina restaurant in Paradisos Cancun. The food was amazing and our waiter Angelos was very friendly and helpful. We had a great time and will definitely be back again.

reviews.author: Jonathan Robinson
reviews.text: Alfredo and Valencia were fantastic at looking after us on the beach at Kanna. Very pleased. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Carol Le
reviews.text: One thing that I love most is how warming and friendly the service people here, especially Daniel from Kao and Mario the receptionist. The place is always kept organized and clean. Will for sure come back here next time!

reviews.author: Barb Dodds
reviews.text: We had a GREAT experience at the Blue Agave Restaurant. Aramando was our server extraordinaire. He had the best recommendations for our food choices. I love his confections smile and eagerness to help.

reviews.author: Amina N.
reviews.text: The whole staff at the Ginger bar was fantastic  from the service, to the quality of the drinks and the music it was all amazing!!  We were there every night before dinner and our night always started the right way that is to the whole staff! Gracias Karina, Dereck,Javier, Jeremy and Bryan.

reviews.author: Lee McLoughlin
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel - great attention to detail. Staff all very friendly and polite. Extremely clean. Food amazing!

reviews.author: Elliot Bonds
reviews.text: We played the World Cup football games by the pool with the entertainment staff, Uriel, Gio, Danny, Miilyn, Jesus and they were fantastic and great fun. Beautiful place and even better staff.

reviews.author: Edgar Velazquez
reviews.text: Mean 10/10 a soon u walk in the service it’s fantastic cold towel any drink u like they take care all for u ,if u show up early u have access all restaurant ,bars every day it’s like this any employee u pass by say word make u fill like king/queen Jenny was ur guide and helper guys she deserve raise fantastic all don’t miss it iam regular traveler and this comment its with all true about my experience

reviews.author: david gathura
reviews.text: Stayed at the hotel for five nights, this is the second time around. Place was perfect, David at the Japanese restaurant gave good service, love everything about it. The service at the other restaurants were really good too. 10/10

reviews.author: Daniel Umana
reviews.text: Jesus de capella explained the full menu, super helpful with my 1 year old. The food was delicious, probably the best out of the whole place. Wife was very content with the service

reviews.author: Jeanne Wang
reviews.text: Karina, Javier, Dereck, Jeremy and Bryan (Dj) from ginger 2 are incredible! So friendly and accommodating. They made sure our whole group including kids were taken care of. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Iskandar Atakhodjaev
reviews.text: Best time at Paradisus! People are so friendly, very open! Special thanks to Atilano who got the favourite ice cream for us in the last day!

reviews.author: Mackenna Smith
reviews.text: We loved Capella!! We literally had one of everything on the menu and Odon took such great care of us. Food was the best we had at Paradisus!

reviews.author: Danny Resendes
reviews.text: Alberto was very quick to bring seat us, take our orders and bring us our food. Very friendly, joked around with our kids. One of our kids broke a glass and Alberto was very good about making sure our kid wasn’t embarrassed

reviews.author: F Alain
reviews.text:
Staying at Paradisus Cancun .
We went to blue agave for dinner
Fantastic service and fantastic food. Armando our server was magnificent. He truly loves what he’s doing.

reviews.author: Quyen Phan
reviews.text: The Mc Uriel was excellent with the Dj Bryan! They know made the party! Thank you for all guys! I hope to see you again! For more Maluma y Marc Anthony

reviews.author: Wenda Moothy
reviews.text:
Great service from Paolo at the Vibra, awesome service from Jose at Kao Japanese restaurant with Chef Marcos
The food at Kao was 7 star from start to finish.

One of the best Japanese seafood we had around the globe.

reviews.author: wendy
reviews.text: Cynthia ,Cesar y yamil were super amazing, the service was one of the most incredible we have had , and we travel alot. Definitely coming back here when we came back to Cancun, Mexico

reviews.author: Maiza cav
reviews.text: The hotel has provided an awesome service, we love the place. We loved Jesus from Capella, Xavier from Gastro Hall, and all other people that provided the amazing service and made our stay the most amazing experience!

reviews.author: Mariana Zvinca
reviews.text: Daniel and Jesus were amazing today. The attention to details and to our kids made a great difference and made our vacation more enjoyable. Looking forward to coming back ! Hasta la vista!

reviews.author: Mark Cooper
reviews.text: We are staying at the Paradisus Cancun. Our favourite place for a drink is the Ginger Bar. Service is excellent. We had especially good and friendly service from Sofonia, Diego, Andres and Anahi.

reviews.author: Wendy Sylvester
reviews.text: The food was fantastic and the steak portion was above average. Staff is very attentive to every need. Highly recommended going.

reviews.author: Joseph Gasienica
reviews.text: Omar was a fantastic butler, provided 5 star service. Very responsive, and accommodated all our needs. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Laura Derry Dismuke
reviews.text:
I had the most amazing service..Gladys  Flora and Antonio were so attentive!!
We will visit again thanks to the kind people here

reviews.author: David Jensen
reviews.text: Our second visit was amazing! Love the activities service was great and food was spot on! Pool service can’t be beat love this place highly recommended Uriel Activites and all the staff

reviews.author: Jadzya Aguirre
reviews.text: Jovani and his animation team was such a good time!! Jesus, Pablo and Chef Eder were amazing too, we took an elote class, bingo and mixology class they made our stay so much fun!

reviews.author: G B
reviews.text: Excellent stay. Food is amazing. Service is great. Italian restaurant must try. Claudio is the best. Very friendly staff. Awesome

reviews.author: Tim Feng
reviews.text:
Thank you to all the amazing staff at Paradisus

Angel at Aguamarina, provided us the best service we could ask for.

Uriel at the activities for pilates was amazing!! Hard working!!

reviews.author: Yasemin Akgül
reviews.text:
Uriel Is one of the best entertainers I’ve experienced so far. Very friendly, cool, and a lot of fun!
And the whole team is just as professional!

reviews.author: Paridhi Bhatnagar
reviews.text: We had a great experience in cappella restaurant in paradisus Cancun! Odon provided exceptional service and made the experience even more worthwhile!

reviews.author: Chris Charles
reviews.text: Atilano our server at Paradisus Cancún was phenomenal. So attentive and served us the best meal of our trip. Definitely look for Atilano when you visit!

reviews.author: Lesley Lopez
reviews.text: Attila no was so attentive and a fabulous waiter at Agave restaurant in the Paradisius Cancun.  The food was amazing! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Zineb Benmoussa
reviews.text: Very good experience with Armando at the Mexican resto. Very attentive specially with my 2 kids and guided us very well according to our menu preferences. Excellent service. Thank you

reviews.author: Léo Deblois
reviews.text: Activity with Uriel jumping feet was awesome! Dude has great energy! 10/10 would recommend! DJ Bryan was great too!

reviews.author: Ivail Pacheco
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Cancún, and I'd like to leave a positive comment about some of the people who served me in the restaurants: Omar and Israel (Vibra) are truly special and very attentive; Rafael, who makes the pasta fresh at the buffet restaurant, is even better than the pasta at the Italian restaurant Capella. Furthermore, I especially want to highlight Armando and Alejandro from the breakfast restaurant; they are magnificent people, very attentive and helpful, and made our experience less frustrating. However, I'll comment on the unpleasant experience we had at check-in: I was literally called a liar by a poorly informed employee regarding a benefit I have as a member of the Melia Rewards club. They didn't listen to me when I arrived to discuss my request, they made light of my needs, and on top of that, I was considered a liar. In addition, the room service is no longer the same; they leave things unreplenished, don't clean properly, etc., and this is because the hotel's capacity is at 30/40%. Another important point is that they offer you dishes in restaurants that are not included in the purchased package and they don't explain this to you, then after eating comes the surprise with the card machine! When I was here in 2022 I was amazed and that's why I signed up for the club the following year, but for me this network is finished…

reviews.author: Mariangel Garmendia
reviews.text:
Overall, an excellent experience; staying at The Reserve is absolutely worth it. We received outstanding service from our concierge, Rommel, and his colleague, Alejandro.

Joshua at reception was also very attentive and always ready to help us.
The spa was magnificent, and the therapists were incredibly helpful. We also appreciated the excellent service at Sante restaurant and the pool. Many thanks to Karla, Gemma, and especially Cinthia for all their kindness and wonderful service.

reviews.author: Denisse Jimenez
reviews.text:
The Mayan ceremony, the sunset activity, and the dance classes by the pool with Uriel were incredible. He's a guy with a great vibe; you can tell he loves his job and enjoys it, and that energy and good vibe is contagious.

Overall, I loved the hotel. It's super zen, but also peaceful, with a lot of friendliness. The customer service is outstanding, as are the food and drinks, which are far superior to other large resorts.
Ernesto the waiter, Víctor, Horacio, Laura, Israel, etc… were all very kind, understanding, and lovely.
Without a doubt, one of the best places to enjoy a relaxing yet fun and very comfortable vacation.
10/10 in everything. I loved it, and I've stayed in some pretty great hotels :)

reviews.author: ANDRES YEPES
reviews.text: My family and I loved Agua Marina restaurant. From the moment you walk in, you feel a lovely breeze, and the staff is incredibly friendly, offering excellent recommendations for the dishes. Everything was delicious, and our waiter, Jonathan, made the experience unforgettable. We would definitely return.

reviews.author: Diana Gomez
reviews.text: The Paradisiacal Cancun hotel is incredible! I visited the Kao restaurant and spoke with waiter David Rosales, who was super friendly, attentive, and provided outstanding service, always looking out for you. The manager, Boris, is an amazing person; they make you feel right at home! It was unreal—they celebrated my birthday and gave me complimentary items. Honestly, you won't find that kind of welcome anywhere else. Thank you so much because people like him make a hotel a quality place.

reviews.author: Juan Olivieri
reviews.text: Excellent hotel. Outstanding service, personalized attention from every employee in all areas. Excellent and varied meals in all restaurants and the buffet. The room was magnificent, and the cleanliness was exceptional. I must emphasize that Vianney, a waitress in the pool area, is charming, helpful, and incredibly attentive. Employees like her make the hotel a more enjoyable place, not forgetting Edgar, the supervisor. Paradisus Cancun is definitely a place to return to.

reviews.author: Elizet Huerta
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was incredible, and a large part of that wonderful experience was thanks to Fernanda Trejo, our concierge.

From the very first moment, Fernanda was incredibly kind, professional, and always attentive to our needs. She made sure we had everything we needed to fully enjoy our stay. She always attended to us with a great attitude, a smile, and a tremendous willingness to help.

Something we really want to highlight is that she went far beyond our expectations. I asked her for help finding cosmetic treatments in Cancun, and she recommended one of the best specialists. She also recommended shopping spots and other places that turned out to be the best options.

Fernanda truly made us feel well taken care of, valued, and welcome. Her dedication, attention to detail, and excellent service made our experience even more special.

We recommend her 10000%. Paradisus Cancun is incredibly lucky to have such a dedicated, kind, and professional person on their team.
Just like everyone else who works at Paradisus, they were the best.

Thank you for everything, Fernanda! You made our stay so much more special.

reviews.author: Hogar Danisan
reviews.text: We spent a week at Paradisus Cancun. Our concierge, Joshua, was very attentive, friendly, and always ready to help. We loved the staff's service and were very happy with our experience. We will likely return in the future. It was spectacular; Joshua was an excellent host. Thank you so much for everything.

reviews.author: Brithany Gyssell
reviews.text:
We thoroughly enjoyed the restaurant; every meal was a wonderful experience, and the staff was always incredibly kind and attentive.

We especially want to thank Jair, who was attentive to every detail during our stay. In addition to his excellent recommendations and great attitude, he thoughtfully prepared a special decoration for us, which made our trip even more memorable. This kind of personalized attention truly makes all the difference and demonstrates the high level of service the hotel offers.

reviews.author: Georgina Gonzalez
reviews.text:
Our stay was perfect! Our concierge, Israel, made sure everything was just right! Whenever we needed something, he took care of it! He's amazing!
At the pool, Yeremi took care of us most days! His service is spectacular; he was always making sure we had full drinks and snacks when we needed them. It was fantastic!
The buffet food at breakfast, lunch, and dinner was delicious. At Blue Agave, Armando is a 15 out of 10! He always had a smile on his face. When my daughter's food arrived and the fries were spicy (because of the batter they were fried in), he took care of changing the whole plate! He made our evening very pleasant.

At Kao, Mario was very attentive, and his service was impeccable too!
At Cava, we received excellent service as well!
The ice cream was delicious!!!
At Kidsdom, Esmeralda is great; she has such a positive vibe with the children!
We left more than happy.

The only thing I would recommend is that you do something to control the mosquitoes. Every afternoon/evening we would come back and kill at least 3 to 5 mosquitoes, and I would still wake up covered in bites 😭 Oh, and another thing, the swim-up bar pool is way too deep! You can't walk around comfortably with a drink in your hand 😅

reviews.author: Ana Cristina Sánchez
reviews.text:
My husband and I went for a vacation to see the hotel's renovations. Everything was great. The first night, Cinthya served us at Aguamarina, providing excellent service. We had lunch at Blue Agave, where Armando served us—a very nice, friendly, and efficient person. We also had dinner at Vibra, where Jorge served us. It's a delicious restaurant with Latin American options.

We stayed at The Reserve, and as always, the service was excellent. Our concierge, Carolina, was outstanding—the best we've ever had. She was always attentive, made all our dinner reservations perfectly, sent us daily activity information, and was always on top of our needs. I highly recommend her. Julio was at the bar, providing impeccable service as always. At the Sante restaurant, Gemma, Javier, Cesar, Yamil, and Valeria served us breakfast—a great team, always very kind.

The pool concierges Victor and Horacio were incredibly friendly, and Jesús from the entertainment service provided excellent and original activities.
I injured my foot and received outstanding care; they were always attentive to my recovery. Diego, the manager of The Reserve, and Farideh from Guest Services were very helpful.
We appreciate the excellent service!

reviews.author: Paulina Boy Galindo
reviews.text:
Excellent experience with Conciege service.
At Blue Agave, we received exceptional service with a great attitude, prompt attention, and extensive menu knowledge.
Alberto was an excellent waiter! Congratulations!

At Capelle, our waiter Jesús provided us with a fantastic service experience. Everything was delicious!

reviews.author: Sara Delgado
reviews.text:
Everything was amazing! This hotel has it all: a beautiful beach, comfortable and well-equipped rooms, delicious food, and a team that truly goes above and beyond in their attention and service. A special thank you to Manuel at reception for his kindness, advice, and for assigning us the best concierge, Alejandro, who took care of planning our entire stay so we could fully enjoy my birthday.
We will definitely be back soon.

reviews.author: Christina Stallinger
reviews.text:
Excellent service.
At Kao restaurant, Aurelio served us; he was very friendly, and the food was delicious.
The following night, we went to Capella, the Italian restaurant, and we loved it. The veal ossobuco is highly recommended 👌🏼👌🏼. We also received excellent service from our waiter, Edgar.

reviews.author: Mariana RC
reviews.text:
Our vacation at the Paradisus Hotel was wonderful.
We had a great culinary experience at several restaurants:
At Vibra Restaurant, the fish tacos were delicious, and Paolo's service was excellent.
Blue Agave Restaurant has delicious tacos, and some of their servers were very attentive.
The facilities are good, and there's a wide variety of restaurants! Plus, there are several pools and activities.

reviews.author: Yeremi Polanco
reviews.text: Honestly, an amazing hotel. The service was excellent, especially the incense ceremony with Jesús and Mauricio. It was fantastic; they are incredibly friendly and fun. It was one of the most wonderful stays I've ever had, and I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Generosa Gallego Montero
reviews.text:
Jesús was exceptionally kind. We knew nothing about Japanese cuisine, and he guided us step by step through each dish and each flavor, making us appreciate all the charms of this delicious cuisine.

At Cappella Restaurant, we enjoyed an excellent dinner. The best Italian cuisine fused with the best international cuisine. The combination of surf and turf was spectacular. Fernando and JJ make an unbeatable team, perfectly coordinating their knowledge and friendliness. Melvin was constantly attentive to our needs and was especially helpful. The preparation of the desserts tableside is fascinating; you can see how they incorporate the ingredients one by one. José offered us a delicious wine and explained the qualities of each sip. In short, a fantastic experience and an excellent team.

reviews.author: Javier Garita
reviews.text: Excellent experience at Paradisus The Reserve. Impeccable service, beautiful newly renovated rooms, a liquor selection that exceeded expectations, and an unbeatable location very close to the airport and the hotel zone with shopping centers and great nightlife. Highly recommended for its value, service, and location. Special mention to Ilse from Concierge, who made our stay very easy, always available to help and coordinate anything we needed.

reviews.author: David
reviews.text: I stayed for 10 days and the service was absolutely incredible, so friendly, the dinners were amazing, and the activities were super fun. The best part was the Gastro Hall restaurant and its staff, especially Martin Kü Can, David Rodriguez, and Captain Nayeli. A really great place!

reviews.author: Laura Elvira
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is always a delight. The location near the airport and the hotel zone, the food, the activities available with Aquaworld, and above all, the service. Our stays are always remembered for the kindness and warmth of the staff. This stay was especially wonderful thanks to César and Yamil, who took such good care of us and pampered us at the pool and restaurant in the Reserve. Violeta, the chef, was fantastic with her food, especially for a pregnant woman craving all the delicious and fresh flavors of Mexican cuisine. At the end of our stay, we felt a pang of sadness at leaving, but also immense joy at having been able to rest, enjoy ourselves, and meet these wonderful people. They work incredibly hard, yet they always do it with love and a smile on their faces that fills the air with positivity. Thank you for everything!

reviews.author: cavosarquitectos1000 Salas
reviews.text:
We loved the hotel. From the moment we arrived, everyone treated us wonderfully. Venecia and Mario at the KAO restaurant were incredibly kind and helpful. The food was delicious and varied, and the hotel offered a wide range of activities.

We appreciated that the Kids Club was open practically all day with a variety of activities.

The rooms were very well-maintained, and the pillows were amazing.

The Kids Club service was fantastic. They were very friendly with the children, and Vianey, along with the entire Kids Club activities team, took excellent care of them.

I appreciated that they always kept the children entertained.

We would definitely return.

reviews.author: Yazmin Monroy
reviews.text: We just got back from our stay at Paradisus Cancun and we're absolutely in love! The hotel and its facilities are a dream, but the service is phenomenal. Our concierge, Sergio, made our vacation a dream come true. He sent us information every day, visited us during the day, and most importantly, made us feel right at home. Thanks to him, we'll be back soon!

reviews.author: JUTESA INCAT S.l
reviews.text: Overall, the hotel and service are excellent, with very attentive staff. They've recently reopened and everything is in excellent condition; highly recommended. We had dinner at the restaurant, enjoying traditional Peruvian cuisine. Jorge served us, and everything was perfect—the service was excellent, and all the staff were very helpful. Come and experience it for yourself!

reviews.author: José Heras García
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed the bao buns, the pork ribs, and the sushi.
Ernesto was our waiter and recommended dishes that best suited our tastes. The service was excellent. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Leah Smith
reviews.text: Armando and Fanny were wonderful. Their attentiveness and energy made our dinner even more enjoyable. The food was incredibly delicious!

reviews.author: Julia Bataglia
reviews.text: My partner and I had a wonderful time at this hotel. Check-in was a bit slow and disorganized, but Rommel's excellent service more than made up for it. He was attentive to everything, gave us a warm welcome, and helped us make reservations at the restaurants and spa. Special mention to Julio at Reserve Bar, who was the best part! We would definitely return.

reviews.author: Mauricio Marchant
reviews.text:
A truly excellent experience and a hotel that deserves all its stars. Special mention to those who took such good care of us every day: Karina, Flor, Humberto, and Javier from Ginger Bar; César and Julio from Sante; Josue, the bartender at Kanna; and Victoria, the bartender at Pool 2.

As areas for improvement, the room cleaning needs to be more thorough and done earlier, and the nightclub closes too early.

reviews.author: Victoria Odette Olvera Herrera
reviews.text:
We ate at Vibra restaurant in Paradisus Cancun. Norma, our waitress, was friendly, attentive, very pleasant, and helpful. Chef Irving delighted us with all his dishes; each one was deliciously flavorful. And with the ocean view, it was a truly enjoyable experience.

This hotel recently renovated its rooms, and regarding the changes, we noticed that its minimalist style isn't ideal for family trips. Most of the new furniture is aesthetically pleasing and would be better suited for business trips where people are traveling alone.

However, we always have a pleasant time at Paradisus Cancun. We've been members for over 20 years, and the staff treats us warmly, making us feel right at home. This includes the administrative staff, Ivette and Veronica, the concierge Martin and Rodolfo, and the staff at the restaurants, pools, and spa.

reviews.author: TORRES VILCHIS BRANDON HERIBERTO
reviews.text:
Blue Agave - Armando
This has been the best service of all the restaurants at the Paradisus Hotel. They were always attentive, even when our food wasn't ready, and they urged the chefs to get it out faster. Very pleasant and excellent service. The kind that brightens your evening.

reviews.author: Daniel Calderon
reviews.text: Our stay at the hotel was wonderful. The hotel, the beach, the service, and especially the ice cream shop made our stay very special. Alejandro, Norma, Alicia, Perla, and Rosalinda delighted us with delicious ice cream and cakes. Thank you so much for everything, and we hope to see you soon!

reviews.author: Braian Curiel
reviews.text:
The best thing about this place is its people!
Excellent service from the moment you arrive. Julián called me by name the first day I arrived and never forgot!
Faridhe at the Concierge helped me print a document, and her service and attitude were 10/10.
Miguel (Lucas)
Gerardo
Seferino
Manuel
Bernardo
Candelario
Everyone was 10/10 in service, attention, attitude, and friendliness!

But Paty and Lupita from the omelets deserve a 15/10!
Lupita's salsas are the best I've had in Cancun! The habanero salsa was delicious, and she even shared her recipe with me!

Thank you all so much!

reviews.author: Andres Galeano
reviews.text: A wonderful experience. A hotel to relax, enjoy delicious food, unwind on the beach, watch sunsets, and relax by the pools. Kao, the Japanese restaurant, was the best of all, thanks to José, who provided excellent service.

reviews.author: José Luciano Carmo
reviews.text: Uriel's Tabata class was excellent, very lively and functional. We're already ready for a super hearty breakfast after burning so many calories.

reviews.author: noemi juarez
reviews.text:
Arce and Daniel gave us spectacular service; the Japanese restaurant was delicious and highly recommended.
They gave us excellent recommendations for trying something different and exquisite.
Thank you so much!
We would definitely dine here again!

reviews.author: Abel Ainsa
reviews.text: The Nespresso Pyramid 3 coffee shop; the service is excellent and the food quality is great too; the staff is very friendly and helpful, especially Perla, Anahi, and Alejandro. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Daniela Hernández
reviews.text: The hotel is very beautiful 💚! My experience with the service has been excellent, especially with Mario from Kao, at the swim-up bar with Erick & Miguel, and at Vibra Mauricio... Overall, the stay has been good.

reviews.author: Liz Covarrubias
reviews.text:
Everything was perfect!!! The service was outstanding; Rodrigo, the waiter at the pool, and Armando, the waiter at Blue Agave restaurant, were all excellent. Gustavo, the waiter at Kao restaurant, made us feel very well taken care of. Congratulations!!!!

My only suggestion would be to make the pool water a little warmer, please!

reviews.author: Fer Morales
reviews.text:
Everything was excellent! Capella restaurant was very good, and Edgar provided excellent service. The tiramisu photo was 10/10.
Kao restaurant is also incredible (my favorite). Mario took wonderful care of us.

reviews.author: Sandra Perea morales
reviews.text: The hotel is in a good location, the rooms are clean and comfortable, and the staff is friendly, especially Rafael, who is always willing to help and provides excellent service. Furthermore, the facilities are very good and offer a peaceful environment for relaxation; it's a very good choice for accommodation.

reviews.author: Luis Aguilar
reviews.text: Excellent place and the food at Kanna Beach Club was delicious! The service from waiters Alberto and Luis was outstanding. I would gladly return; the entire cost is refunded towards your food and drinks. The place in general is very relaxed, the music is great, and everything is top-notch. 👌

reviews.author: Roberto Vaca
reviews.text: Excellent service from Jesús at Capella Italian Restaurant. The food was delicious, and Jesús always recommended great dishes. The tiramisu was simply de-li-cious!! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Brenda Rodriguez Dominguez
reviews.text: I love the activities with Jesus, Mau, and Giovany. I recommend their incense ritual, Pilates classes, and meditation. They offer different activities that help you relax and provide something unique and fun. If you have the opportunity, take all the classes with them.

reviews.author: Lizeth Esqueda
reviews.text: Blue Agave Restaurant is undoubtedly the best for dinner; the octopus tacos were my favorite. If you visit the hotel, don't hesitate to try their variety of food. The service is very good, the people are very friendly, and the tres leches cake is super delicious.

reviews.author: JP Chávez
reviews.text:
This is my second time here. The hotel is renovated, has a great beach, and the service is excellent. I had dinner at the Capella restaurant on my second night and received outstanding service from Edgar.

Thank you so much, I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Samanta Ruiz Tejada
reviews.text:
Excellent service and customer care. All the staff were very friendly and attentive. The rooms were very comfortable and lovely. The waiter (Paolo) who served us was very kind and attentive, constantly asking if we needed anything. Excellent service indeed!

The karaoke with the entertainment team was amazing! We sang our favorite songs. Thanks to Uriel and Avilez, the entertainment team!

reviews.author: valeria santoro
reviews.text: Hermes' service at the beach was absolutely spectacular; he was very attentive to every detail. I would gladly return—everything was perfect!

reviews.author: Nicolas C.
reviews.text: Blue agave. Alberto served us. Excellent service. Very attentive and always on top of things. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: ricardo zamarron
reviews.text:
The hotel is excellent, with a great beach location. The facilities are luxurious, the staff is incredibly friendly, and the food is delicious, especially at the Kao restaurant, where our waiter Jose provided outstanding service—he was very kind and attentive.
I highly recommend it for a truly relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Hector Manuel Flores Gaona
reviews.text:
Beautiful place
Very beautiful and cozy rooms
Delicious food in all its restaurants, especially the excellent service at Blue Agave from Atilano and Natanael
Perla and Alejandro at the ice cream shop
Yair and Alejandro at the buffet provided excellent service
All the bars offered delicious drinks and Vianey provided great service in the pool area
The kids' area is lovely and the children are treated very well
If you have the opportunity to visit, don't miss it
The staff's service is the best I've ever experienced

reviews.author: Oswaldo Alvarez
reviews.text: The facilities are top-notch. The service is incredibly attentive. The KidsDome is newly renovated, and Vianey and the staff are wonderful. They are very attentive to the children and take great care of them.

reviews.author: Ana Flores
reviews.text:
Thanks to Emmanuel and Ignacio for their hospitality at Salt restaurant; the food was delicious and the atmosphere was great!
Excellent service at Kao restaurant; our waiter Daniel took great care of us, thank you so much!

reviews.author: Beny Lizama
reviews.text: Alejandro and Francisco gave us excellent service at the Gastro Hall restaurant in the Paradisus hotel. They were very attentive and quick; everything was excellent. The place is very nice, the food delicious, 100% recommended.

reviews.author: Adriana lopez
reviews.text: More than an excellent experience, in my opinion, the price-to-value ratio is more than fair. Delicious food and wonderful facilities. We booked The Reserve and the service, food, and overall experience were truly exceptional. It was my birthday present and we already want to go back.

reviews.author: María Isabel Arenas Valdés
reviews.text: Fanny and Manuel's service at Blue Agave was excellent. They were very, very kind. Manuel was the best waiter we had; very professional and an extraordinary person. I loved their service.

reviews.author: maria teresa lomeli
reviews.text: Excellent service at Blue Agave restaurant. Armando was very attentive and friendly; he made us laugh and have a great time. He even brought us our carajillo to enjoy with the churros.

reviews.author: Paula Bizama
reviews.text:
Alejandro and Rafael from Gastro Hall are very friendly. The restaurant is very well served with a variety of delicious options for everyone.

The hotel is very pleasant and the staff are very attentive throughout the hotel.

reviews.author: Vicky Vicky
reviews.text: A hotel with excellent quality, location, and price. Javier served us at the Gastro Hall restaurant; he was always attentive and helpful. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Zandy Ale Cruz
reviews.text:
The service at Vibra restaurant during my stay was delicious, and Montserrat was very kind. Her service convinced me to return every day.
The facilities are beautiful, and I'm excited to see the hotel fully reopen.

reviews.author: Mariana Madai Ortega Robles
reviews.text: They remodeled the kids' club and the service was excellent. Gibsy and Maylin, along with the rest of the entertainment team, were very kind and loving with the children.

reviews.author: Brenda Luviano
reviews.text: Excellent service, exquisite food, and the facilities exude a vibe perfect for total relaxation. I highly recommend Blue Agave restaurant; Atilabo provided excellent service.

reviews.author: PDO Secretary
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay with our family (w/ young kids!). Facilities were beautiful and clean! Staff were very friendly and helpful. The highlight of our stay was our concierge, Fernanda, she was absolutely amazing and so helpful. She made our stay feel effortless and was so on top of things which made a big impact on our experience. She was in regular communication and easy to connect with, let us know of resort happenings daily, made all of our dinner reservations ahead of time, reserved us cabanas, set up a special welcome and later a birthday delivery for my husband, took care of everything related to our lagoon sunset cruise, and made sure we were taken care of completely from beginning to end. Our overall experience would not compare without her! She was so easy to communicate with and we saw her daily around the hotel. THANK YOU Fernanda, you're the best!
Some opportunity for growth in the resort: not all of our friends had the same experience. Some of us were given welcome drinks upon arrival, others were not. Our concierge was fantastic, but our friends had the opposite experience and no service from their concierge. Some of us were given a coupon booklet for things around the resort, and others were not. Would be nice for consistent experience for all. The food could also be elevated. We tried most of the restaurants and buffet and it was okay but nothing too great, seems like a lot of the same basic food. We also wished we could take stuff to go and eat @ the pool

reviews.author: Kristina Kamber
reviews.text:
Recently returned from a 5 day stay at the Paradisus Cancun. Upon arriving, we were checked in by Omar who was fast, efficient and very friendly, and greeted with a nice cold signature beverage.

The rooms are great, extremely clean and no issues with any amenities in the room. The beds were comfortable and everything met my expectations.

The grounds are extremely well maintained, from the lobby to the bars to the hallways, the staff were constantly cleaning to ensure a well manicured and clean resort.

We mostly stayed at the kiddie pool, it was warm and clean and  I think a good size for kids 8 and under . During our 5 day stay, there was one activity that my kids participated in and enjoyed. There was always ample seating.

The first day we arrived, we got to the pool snack bar closer to closing time so they didn’t have all the normal options available, we opted for fries and wings and pizza and it did the trick. The main buffet was less desirable the first night we arrived, the foods lacked flavoured ( not what you expect from Mexican cuisine) and it felt like there were more sides vs mains. The buffet later redeemed itself throughout the week with a great variety of fresh foods

I love that no reservations were needed for the al la carte, we tried th Mexican, the Mediterranean and Italian and had a great experience at all of them.

From the poolside staff to the waitstaff, everyone was great. I’m glad we went when it was a little on the quiet side to funny enjoy this resort.

While we didn’t go to the beach , there was very little seaweed and always palapa and beds available.

Overall great resort and look forward to returning

reviews.author: Daryel Rodrigues
reviews.text:
The hotel stay was very enjoyable overall. Guests who book Adult only accommodations get access to a private area, including the pool, lounge spaces, and cabanas, which is a nice perk. Dinner reservations are required, and wait times can be quite long, so it’s best to plan ahead.
The staff were consistently friendly, always smiling, and very helpful. The entire property was well-maintained and kept clean at all times. Service is generally good, though tipping does seem to make a noticeable difference in the level of attention you receive.
Overall, I had a great experience and enjoyed my stay.

reviews.author: Prissi Travels
reviews.text:
Great location, across the street from the Rosa Negra restaurants. Up the street from many clubs.

The hotel was was recently renovated. Rooms are comfy, beach is nice and wide but there was a bit of seaweed, which is normal this time of year. The pool was nice.

I was underwhelmed with the food. Ate at the Asian fusion restaurant and the buffet, and Italian - nothing was delicious. Friends stared the steak house was good, but there was an extra charge.

The resort just opened back up, so maybe the chef needs a few months to get his groove.

reviews.author: Chantal Alain
reviews.text: This place was great expect the resort wasn’t ready and prepared for all the people! Rooms were clean and nice but a bit small. Food was mediocre. But my favourite part of this resort was the manager at the SAL steakhouse  , manager Daniel was excellent and the waiter ignacio. Everything was  well prepared and food was amazing . If it was up to me Daniel would be running the whole resort because he was the only one managing excellently . Buffet was not good and they couldn’t keep up with the people and food , definitely go to the steakhouse it’s worth it !

reviews.author: Shruti Jajodia
reviews.text:
I went with my family and it was our first time in paradisus as well as in Cancun. The hotel is good with good views and lot of places to relax in. The concierge is very helpful. I would like to name Liza for helping us a lot. But the tour operator that they have, Otium tours, is really bad. They have half information with respect to tours. We took the Chichen classic with valladolid as a place to visit. But after boarding the bus, we got to know that Valladolid is not included. Upon asking to compensate, they are making all kind of excuses not to compensate it. Mr  Mauricio from Otium tours has been very rude with us. We are extremely unhappy with this service by Otium.

The thing we loved the most was their restaurants who customised food as per our requirement. We being vegetarians, Kao restaurant provided us with one of the delicious dinner with wontons, noodles, sushi, pizza and dumplings. Marco - the chef, Teresita and Ardiana for their out of the way service. Also Gastro Hall did give us a good service.

The room service was a late back. Had to call three to four times just to get water bottles and coffee mate.. yet they did not provide with the coffee mate.

Overall, had a good experience in the hotel.

reviews.author: Andy Farrell
reviews.text: Great location, service and food was acceptable. Hope you don't mind a hot and humid room because the air conditioning was worthless. Yes, I did bring it to management's attention to no avail. It averaged 96 degrees each day with 98% relative humidity. Good luck sleeping folks. Your call.

reviews.author: Skyler Cain
reviews.text: We have had such a great time! Roger, Melvin, Fernando the chef at the Italian restaurant and Andres at the bar were so nice and great! Made our stay so much better

reviews.author: Rich F
reviews.text: One of the better restaurants at the resorts. We were served by Edgar who was great. Made a great effort in his communication with us. The service was timely and professional.

reviews.author: Angeli Dela Cerna
reviews.text:
