While some areas do feel a bit outdated, we were glad to hear that the company is planning a full refurbishment to make it the best hotel in Cancún. It certainly has the potential.

We stayed in The Reserve area, which we found especially pleasant. Compared to the Reserve section at Paradisus Playa del Carmen, this one is much more peaceful while still offering all the premium services. One thing we appreciated at Paradisus Cancún was the option to decline the concierge WhatsApp service. When we stayed in Playa del Carmen, the concierge service was overly intrusive and felt more focused on pushing for tips rather than genuinely helping us. We were bombarded with unsolicited WhatsApp messages, which honestly took away from the joy of exploring the hotel on our own. At Paradisus Cancún, we politely declined this service, and we felt it gave us back the freedom and excitement of discovery that makes travelling so special.

The highlight of our stay was, without a doubt, dinner at Flora Restaurant. The food was incredibly tasty and beautifully presented — a true gastronomic experience. A special mention goes to Anabel, who was professional, charming, and knowledgeable. She provided excellent recommendations that truly elevated our evening and made our dining experience unforgettable.

We loved every moment of our time at Paradisus Cancún and are already looking forward to returning after the refurbishment. With the planned updates, we’re sure it will become one of the top hotels in the region. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Tonya Cross
reviews.text: The service was spectacular. Uriel and Bryan with the activities were so kind and fun to work with. The coffee bar was one of my favorite places to visit everyday. The room service was complete everyday however the air conditioning barely worked. It was super hot even while sleeping.

reviews.author: Wie Albert
reviews.text:
My experience in this resort was not so bad. The view was great and my kids enjoyed playing at the pool and in the sea. Rooms are quite old and needs to be improved.
But, our stay in ths resort was great thanks to Mr. Jared Osorio. He helped us a lot and always tried to listen our issues. I truly appreciate his effort.

reviews.author: Daria Petrovic
reviews.text:
Wonderful experiences here at Paradisus, 2024 is my family and I’s third time at this resort. We like to try out new resorts however Paradisus has a wonderful hotel, great service and great amenities. The waiters by the pool and the bartenders are all very friendly and they truly work hard to keep everyone happy.
We had ordered three coconuts for drinking and ROBERTO even offered to put a cocktail inside, and leave the coconut water on the side for us!
Great workers, great food, just would love to see the bottled water more readily available. UPDATE: ROBERTO is one of the best poolside waiters- he puts up with us asking for waters always and brought us a bucket of ice and bottled waters as soon as they delivered it to the bar. He is amazing! And so so nice :) always checking in on us, taking our trash and dishes away for us, and bringing us our drinks and food so quickly!

Also, 4 stars for room because after checking in, we got to our room and they had forgotten to put out the outdoor furniture on our balcony, and balcony sliding door has no handle on the outside lol so we have to use our hands on the glass to slide it open.

Good amount of ramps readily available for handicapped persons.

Otherwise all else is well and this is the place to come if you’re able to do all inclusive :)

reviews.author: Rachel Wasilewski
reviews.text:
We stayed the week of June 6 to June 13, family of 4 (2 adults, 2 boys age 10 and 12) in a Junior Nikte "Suite" Ocean View. I quote suite because it was just a hotel room there was nothing to make it a suite. We elected for the 2 full size beds as the boys are still fine sharing. I think in the future, we may choose to do 2 rooms as paying by person vs by room means we get twice the space for the same cost. The rooms themselves are mostly fine, they are showing age but all of our outlets worked. The balcony doors are very heavy and VERY hard to open and close. The balcony is wide and spacious, we mostly used to to dry floats/swimsuits in the evening. The bathrooms are dark and was difficult to get ready. I think there may be power outages in Cancun due to the extreme heat, the resort lost power at least twice during our stay. The rooms do get very hot and very humid (as in condensation on the walls and floors) without power. We had portable rechargeable fans we brought and they helped.

The front desk/check in folks are nice enough, but they do not provide accurate information. When you check in, if your room is not ready, please go and check back with them every hour. Your concierge will not contact you when the room is ready, no matter what they say...probably because they don't tell the concierge. Other than that we were really very happy with service. Our concierge was Daniel. He checked in with us every day. He made sure our requests for room restocking was met (I needed extra waters, I'm marathon training). He gave me suggestions for running routes. We didn't need much but he was attentive, professional, kind, and very efficient.

A few other individuals that deserve a stellar recommendation are Ivonne, DiDi, and Hector at the pool. Ivonne helped us with shade every day (already removed one melanoma trying to prevent more), Didi did not let me go a second without a drink and provided the kids with all the mango smoothies and guac they could consume, Hector was also fantastic and provided great service. The activities crew were so sweet, Itza took all FIVE of my floats day one and had them filled with air. Mary at the omelette station was an absolute joy, she made my son a huge omelette every morning and she had the best smile. My youngest son cried on the day we left because he really just wanted to stay and let Mary make him breakfast every day. The coffee barista had a plain latte for me every day.

Our favorite dinner was Flora, I had a spinach pasta that was amazing, my husband's salmon was perfectly cooked (the only piece of fish all week we had that wasn't over cooked). My kids loved the tomato soup. I asked about the ingredients of the pasta just trying to get an idea of how to replicate the sauce, and the chef came out to speak with us, he was funny and it was a pleasure to speak with him. Lemonfish was a second favorite for dinner. Do not miss the taco guy by the pool...best tacos we had anywhere on the resort.

We were not impressed with Sal, the steak I had was tough. The food was okay at best. The service was slow but professional. We had very good service and food at Cielo and Cappella. Our food was good a Lemonfish, but our server seemed frazzled. We still had an enjoyable dinner. Blue Agave is okay, but seriously, taco guy at the pool is the way to go. Agua marina opened our last day there, we tried for lunch but the power was out, so we went for dinner. They were out of several items, service was slow, and the food was mostly mediocre at best. We were hoping for the coconut shrimp and flan at lunch which we heard were great, so maybe it is better for lunch.

Also noted, we had the sunset cruise around the lagoon as part of the Nitke experience...it left us underwhelmed. They do have a live saxophonist that was neat. My son was singed by sparks from the sparklers at the end (think burnt hair smell) but as no actual injury we let it go. They pass around a tip box at the end, we tipped when we had drinks so it felt odd to me.

reviews.author: Emily Stroope
reviews.text:
Miguel at the pool was amazing!! He was always prompt with drinks and service. He was the BEST!!! Victor, the pool concierge and as also fabulous. Set us up everyday with a great view end towel.
The Reserve was fabulous. Thank you

reviews.author: Shannon Gutridge
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful! If you're a plant nerd like me you will enjoy the various plants throughout. A few minor issues here and there. Highlight for my husband and I was our dinner at Lemon Fish. Food is fantastic! The service we received from Jorge and Miguel was amazing. They truly made it a memorable dining experience. Highly recommended reservations at Lemon Fish!

reviews.author: Richard Davis
reviews.text:
We have found all of the staff amazingly helpful and cheerful.
Victor and the other pool staff have been exceptional. Julio has also been amazing as have all of the bar and restaurant staff.

reviews.author: Yu Wei
reviews.text:
Initially, my husband and I were given a room on the ground floor. Unfortunately, three of the lights outside the room were burned out, making it dark and unpleasant. The room itself wasn't suitable for us, it was too big and dark also none of two bathrooms had hot water. Fortunately, we were able to switch to a smaller room on a higher floor, which was more suitable for two people, had more natural light, and hot water.

The quality of the rooms varies greatly, almost like a lottery—if you get a good room, it's wonderful; otherwise, it can be quite unpleasant. For instance, my friend's room initially had a bad smell, but they were also able to switch to a nicer room. On a positive note, the restaurant was excellent; we especially enjoyed dining at Floras , which offered very good service and excellent food.

reviews.author: Rummi R
reviews.text: About 24 of us family members stayed at this resort and had a great time. Abraham and Salvador are amazing bartenders at the Ginger bar, who went above and beyond for us. Carlos at the nespresso coffee bar always has a smile on his face and gave us the best service. I enjoyed the Italian restaurant and buffet. I would definitely come back to this resort. I already miss it so much.

reviews.author: Leidy Robles
reviews.text: My husband and I went to celebrate our anniversary and we had a blast. This place is beautiful our room view was amazing. About restaurants Malva, and Sante were our favorite I love sea food and unfortunately aqua marina was close it’s suck but Sante have some sea food dishes that are super delicious the service was top Francisco and yoni thank you so much for made our dinner unforgettable. The reason why I can’t give a five star is because I had a bad experience at blue agave and cielo this last one we had to leave because the waiter never  came to our table and then we ask the hosted if we can change table and she moved us to a different one then the waiter came saying that he was going to take long to take our order because we change table and he was busy I won’t probably weren’t live  but he said it with attitud, and blue agave waiters wasn't to nice either both  times , hope they can work on that. About bars some bartenders give you attitude when you ask for a drink not all of them but some. The spa is incredible I got Carmen and ashaty for a massage super good. room service for food suck. Everything else it’s worth it

reviews.author: Emmanuel Samedy
reviews.text:
We had a great experience at this his resort which was perfect for our family vacation. Having several different pools is very convenient. The activities for the kids were great. The staff was very friendly. The rooms were average and we expected better. Our sofa bed was broken.  The staff replaced it with a small bed with a dirty frame which we believe was just sitting outside or in a dirty storage area equipped with an uncomfortable hard mattress.  We didn't want to complain because the staff was so kind and was trying its best for us to be satisfied. The rooms were clean but didn’t have the luxurious touch we had hoped for. Maybe our expectations were too high.
The food at the seafood restaurant was OK but we found the other restaurants to be subpar.  We did enjoy the snack bars near the pools(burgers, fries, pizzas, etc.)
We had an amazing time and would probably go again.

reviews.author: Andrea Valentine
reviews.text: Hotel has the vouw factor from the moment you arrive. Stunning interior , makes you feel like vacation /paradise. Rooms are being upgraded, mine was terrible esthetically but functioned. The ocean access is well thought out& easy. Pool area is well positioned. Drinks are great, buffet is well presented, tastes good, many choices. Various options for breakfast , lunch & dinner to eat at. Seafood restaurant was superb. Constant entertainment , activities . Staff very friendly. Family friendly but not family targeted. Plenty of cabanas/chairs. Towels readily available. Spa was affordable & relaxing. Sauna with plunge pool! Would return with family as I was attending a conference.

reviews.author: Brooke Anderson
reviews.text: Jorge, our server at Lemon Fish was spectacular. Always making great suggestions and big thumbs up for Carlos at the bar!

reviews.author: M.T.
reviews.text:
We just got back from a family vacation from this resort, and it’s a gorgeous resort , HOWEVER, there are some pros and cons regarding this place .
It’s about 20 min from the airport which is convenient, the staff checking us in , concierge , guest services are all really nice .
The restaurants are ok, Mavla the buffet is pretty much the only breakfast spot , the taco place they run out of soup options a lot, and guacamole too! We ate here a lot bc the tacos are good, only had one issue one time and chef David came over to speak to us. We had Dinner at Capellas food was salty, but service was Amazing, Sal steak house was great , food / service was amazing!
Pool area,  flor, Orlando , Julio, yoni, Jorge, hector are all very nice and attentive they were sweet .
Our room was extremely HOT and had to ask for a fan! Called guest services and told them we need a refill on water 3x they finally gave us water, I asked for Plastic bc the glass ones they give us i couldnt Open they don’t provide a bottle opener , asked for towels and no one brought us any..
I just saved the plastic bottles from our cabana we ordered a cabana 2x and it’s not cheap , it came with a bottle and like a seafood tower thing , lobster was over cook super chewy. But it was so hot and people definitely stole our umbrellas / hut even after we had our beach bags on there so we got a cabana instead. It was worth it i suppose ..
Now , the drinks here at the resort tasted water down , and diety like zero sugar mix or something, also there are roaches .. sigh i know It’s a resort but while eating I don’t wanna see it crawling up and down ..
There aren’t many activities to do for both adults or children, the pool area music plays for a bit then stops ..
The adult bar closes at like 11pm . Overall This resort is ok, if you just want to relax and do nothing this is for you. If you want to do more get involved this is not for you ..

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.text:
We stayed in the reserve and our
Acess to our private check in was great to avoid lines but they failed to give us our spa ans upgrade credit. We informed aboit it by another staff member. Enrique our concierge was great ! Miguel was amazing as well.

reviews.author: Damen
reviews.text:
Pros:
-Location is within the hotel zone. It's safe to go around and transportation using the public bus is very easy
-The beach is beautiful. It's fairly easy to find a spot under the umbrella to sit and lay for hours.
-Food is good with enough restaurants to try a different one for a week. The buffet is reliable.

Cons:
-The resort is obviously outdated. The rooms are not in the best condition for a 5 star resort
-Room service was hit or miss. We would have to call multiple times to have towels refilled or to have the room cleaned.

reviews.author: Jennifer Maier
reviews.text: Beautiful setting. Love the style.  There was some "touching up" going on while we were there, but it didn't take away from the ambiance. Great staff.  Good food.  Very tasty cocktails.  Would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Jasmine Sangha
reviews.text:
I had a lovely stay at Paradisus.

The waiter Atilano was lovely in the restaurant Bluealgave and the Chef, Isaias, was a great cook! Couldn't fault the food!

We also loved the waiter at the pool Roberto! He was lovely and always asking if we needed anything through out the day!

reviews.author: T Finn
reviews.text: I had the best vacation I've ever had here.  The staff is so friendly and helpful.  I could have done without the sales presentation, which was optional so that's on me.  The only other thing is the bed wasn't too comfortable.   But the hotel is beautiful, clean.  It has very nice restaurants with wonderful food.  I cannot recommend Giovanni enough.  He was the bartender at the swim-up bar when we were there.  He was outstanding, and he kept his cool with some guests who were more than obnoxious.  I asked him to surprise me with a drink since I didn't know what I wanted, and whatever is was, it was wonderful, so we named it the Giovanni.  The beach was pristine, the water the most beautiful turquoise color I've ever seen.  The atmosphere in general was gorgeous.  I would recommend highly!!!

reviews.author: Silvina Rappi Engelbrink
reviews.text: We had a great dinner at Capella. Our waitress, Gabriela, was very attentive and offered wonderful service. The Spaghetti Carbonara was so good! This was my Bachelorette Party trip and my group of friends and I are already planning to come back again next year!

reviews.author: Jelena Krutaja
reviews.text: Great location, beautiful landscape, nice beach, no seaweed, big waves, loved it. Hotel’s territory divided into few sections - main pool area, where all action happens, load music, pool bar, etc, kids pool area is more quiet, even with kids and adults only area, but one needs to buy Reserve package to get access to it. Food is good, in my opinion everyone can find something they like. Coffee is really good. Alcohol, is not. You have to book restaurants, but most of the time they are able to find a spot for you without reservation. Our room had a lagoon view facing West, so we had a chance to enjoy beautiful sunsets.  There is a renovation happening inside the hotel, very loud and dusty, but that didn’t bother us since we were outside most of the time. Overall great experience.

reviews.author: Barry Cashman
reviews.text: The hotel is only 20 minutes from the airport which is great after a long flight. It sits on a sandy beach with warm blue water!! There are an abundance of restaurants, so many in fact that we couldn’t even try them all during our holiday! We were 2 adults and 2 children (7+5) the kids spent the entire holiday either in the pool or on the beach, they absolutely had a blast!! There’s very little to criticise, possibly our room could have had a revamp, but it was still good. We had a junior suit, Ocean View (the view was unreal) which comes with a concierge service and that’s my second criticism, the concierge service makes things far too complicated, they have to book restaurants etc, but our concierge was pretty poor to be honest. Outside of those points the place is amazing and well worth a visit. Look for Martin and Armando in Cappella Restaurant at breakfast and lunch, they provide a great service and entertainment for the kids, they really make you feel at home!!

reviews.author: Manal Malallah
reviews.text:
The activities with Monse are so fun! We loved making bracelets, painting and pottery. The swim up bar is wonderful. They also serve non-alcoholic drinks which is nice. I do wish they had connecting rooms for families larger than 4, but we were put into rooms next to each other after 3 days.

We loved Azul, Govi, Maria, Nabila in the kidsdom! Our girls had their nails painted and hair braided! It was super cute.

reviews.author: Samudyatha Kaira
reviews.text: The hotel decor is magnificent and the ocean views are just one of the best. The room was good, so were the views from it. One thing to note if you are vegetarian and buy an al inclusive package, there are very very few options for you. Your best bet is the Italian restaurant with few options or the buffet. The buffet doesn't mark any food by allergies as well. You need to ask around, however we found many people don't understand what is vegetarian. So it's a guess game!!!

reviews.author: Isis Hernandez
reviews.text: Very great service and beautiful hotel. Service is great as they each provide and care for each individual in this place. Servers Atilano, Fernando, and Teresa were very good people to my family.  Food is decent wouldn’t say it’s the best, however, the breakfast was pretty good. Some rooms were spacious and some weren’t and it does get humid here and there but overall a a comfortable stay. All I have to say is the beach here is well worth everything in this hotel.

reviews.author: Russell Whit
reviews.text: Great hotel, sad to leave our  Honeymoon destination.  We had 5th floor ocean view which was fantastic, rooms well equipped. Flora and Lemon Fish restarants the best by far. Agua Marina, great setting, pretty food but tasteless.  One criticism would be that we were overwhelmed in a bad way by the attentiveness of staff immediately on arrival and the Melia sales pitchers. British guests tend to want to be left alone unless we ask. Paradisus is an all inclusive hotel or so we thought, we found out it is a part exclusive resort where some parts of the hotel are reserved for "VIP" guests also a large number of sun beds are available for a substantial charge. Counterproductive I feel as most of these beds remained empty for duration of our stay so could have been better used by regular guests. So some regular guests were without sun beds by the pool. Saying all this, it is a beautiful hotel with a gorgeous beach and views if the Caribbean, would highly recommend. Negative comments are more if a nudge to management, the staff are superb.

reviews.author: Ross C
reviews.text:
Before our arrival we were really worried about this hotel due to the mixed reviews. I can confidently say that this is a 4 star hotel at best when staying in The Reserve section, and probably a 3 star if staying in the main section. Most of the 5 star reviews on here are just from people who experienced one activity such as the Kids Club and the staff asked them to leave a positive review. Therefore, this skews the overall rating of this hotel on Google. Also the replies the hotel gives are always copy and paste so best to ignore them.

We stayed in the Reserve adults only section in Pyramid 5. Check in took ages because we had to sit waiting around as only one lady was doing check in for the Reserve, however we were offered a drink whilst we waited.

The rooms of the Lagoon view were poor compared to the ocean view, with little wind on the balconies, the view was mainly of the golf course, McDonalds and a Petrol station. We asked for an ocean view at check in, since our rate was supposed to include an upgrade coupon of $50 and had an upgrade voucher as Melia Rewards Gold members, nothing was mentioned about this.

The rooms were fine but the AC unit was loud, the shower made an incredibly loud noise and the bath tap was leaking all over the floor. Bed was comfortable, take note that although advertised as a “suite” it’s just a large room with a table and sofabed.

The maids were quite good and visit the room twice a day but it was always a bit hit and miss, some days no towels were given and others the minibar was not restocked. Don’t bother using the App to request ice or anything because they take hours to come and they mark the job as Solved even when its not. It took us 3 days and asking many different people to get us a kettle in the room. Rooms were clean and no issues with insects, my friend found one tiny cockroach in his room, maybe this is an issue more in other blocks.

Food overall at the resort was medicore to poor:

Malva Buffet was really bad, food was cold despite going at 6pm opening time, selection was poor and overall best to avoid.
Cielo was awful, food was cold and asked for it to be redone but they just microwaved it. Really give it a hard miss.
Capella was the best restaurant, the Italian one, the carpaccio and the short rib were the best, and Claudio was the best waiter there, very attentive. We went twice.
Sal is the steak restaurant and was also really good, however it’s only for reserve members and you can only go once.
Room service was poor and tasteless, and you can only order it 3 times before a $5 fee is levied.
Sante is the restaurant only for reserve members and the breakfast was OK but the lunch and dinner choices weren’t the best, I had better burgers from the McDonalds across the road.
The pizzas and tacos by the main pool were okay but only available until late afternoon.
The lobby bar in the reserve pyramid 5 also has some snacks and breakfast available so maybe give that a go.

We were allocated a concierge Alan on the first day and was told he would WhatsApp us, we heard nothing despite inquiring at reception numerous times. By day 3 we were told he had quit but Juan would be our concierge from then on, and he was very good, so I think the concierge is hit and miss! If you get a bad one just ask for another, I saw Abel a lot with guests and he also seemed really good. I didn’t have any issues with upselling of the Club Melia or of premium drinks like other people have mentioned.

Staying on the reserve side definitely has its advantages as you have a private pool which is quieter, you are also guaranteed the Bali Beds by the pool for 2 days during your stay, speak to the pool concierge in advance to organise this, his name is Victor and he was really helpful.
Reserve bar inside and by the pool also have better drinks selection such as Johnnie Walker Black label.

If you want a bali bed on the beach it costs quite a lot but there are normal sun loungers for free. Kanna beach bar was also good to hang out at night, Abraham was the best bartender there.

reviews.author: Richard Zießler
reviews.text:
Very friendly welcome upon arrival and we even got a free upgrade to a better room - so that was already great. We staid at "the reserve", which I would recommend everyone. The concierge service is incredibly helpful in taking care of all your needs and the complementary poolbeds are just extremely relaxing.

Food options are very wide and every restaurant we went to was exceptional. Everyone from the servers to the cleaning ladies was doing a great job and was always friendly.

Sadly it's not always clear, what exactly is included in the all inclusive and what had to be paid extra - of course the personnel was always trying to convince you to get the extra products, which was a bit annoying at times.

reviews.author: Amy Randall
reviews.text: It was nice overall but they need a speciality cocktail menu and the food could have been better but it was good. Everything was perfect at Kanna and Sal but those cost extra. The service was fantastic when you pay extra but it was just ok otherwise. The resort itself was beautiful but the pool was a little cold. I'm glad we paid extra for the reserve because that pool was warmer. The plants are pretty and the room service was great but you have to pay extra to have liquor delivered to your room. The entertainment was fabulous but the pool table was small. The indoor market was cool but you have to haggle. Everything is super expensive when it's not included....way more than America. We went to Maico casino and it was beautiful and Red Roja was really fun. Don't go downtown...it's full of people trying to sell you stuff and the Dubai casino only takes pesos...not us dollars. The taxis are very expensive but we had great experiences with them. I think I would have given this resort 5 stars if they had exotic speciality drink menus and fresher lobster. The steak needs to be juicer but it was pretty good. I'm just picky. We had a great time! Overall, everybody was really nice and it was a relaxing vacation. The food at Capella was absolutely amazing and it was included.

reviews.author: Adriana L.
reviews.text:
We’re a family of 4 (two preteen kids), fifth time in Riviera Maya all-inclusives, stayed here for 10 days in mid March 2024. We’re giving this resort a solid 4.5 stars, not the 5-star it’s being marketed as, because of these minor but necessary improvements. Our feedback is more for management, but hopefully useful for guests too.

- Eevators constantly smell like a mix of mud and cleaning solutions. Add wet and sweaty tourists, and it makes for a very unpleasant ride. It totally kills the vibe of the otherwise beautiful surroundings.

- Please employ more servers at the restaurants. Everyone works hard but they’re clearly stretched and too busy buzzing around that there is no small talk and no personalized service. In the past, we’d had regular servers who we know by name, who know our favourite tables, orders, etc. This has always been a cherished part of our vacation memories and is something we’re missing here. Service is good enough, but any special requests are slow to get attended to, if at all.

- Table service is usually what distinguishes a 5-star resort from the rest. At the buffet, servers should provide dessert forks/spoons. You can’t expect guests to wait around for new utensils or, worse yet, eat ice cream with a fork they just used to eat beef stew with. And maybe this is expected at a busy buffet restaurant, but we see the same issues at the a la carte restaurants. All (not just some) servers should know to bring out appetizers before mains instead of all together, that coffee/tea should be offered after mains are finished, that a table should be setup with a salad fork, an entree fork, etc. instead of leaving guests with the awkwardness of saving our dirty forks until the next course arrives.

- Please provide proper takeout utensils. The cafe by the beach entrance has a beautiful display of cakes and pastries but it’s ironic that they handed me a slice of opera cake in a paper cup or a chocolate cake on a paper napkin, and that we had to eat a wooden coffee stirrer. Also, a real espresso machine would feel more 5-star than a Nespresso.

- Food temperature in the buffet ranges from lukewarm to almost hot. Cold water is sometimes cool to almost lukewarm. Getting food/drink temperatures right would elevate the dining experience from good to great.

- Beach chairs with non-adjustable backrests don’t exactly say 5 stars.

- The couches in the Jr. Suite Luxury Oceanview really needs to be replaced and are not acceptable as sofa beds at all.

- Consider having extra umbrellas and chairs that can be setup on the beach when all palapas are occupied. We’ve seen another resort do this.

- There is a number of oddly low couches with sunken and stained cushions in the buffet restaurant.

Now, useful tips for guests:
- You can reserve a hospitality room for no cost on your check-out day for a 40-minute period. It is basic—a toilet, a shower, two sinks, benches, and no AC. But, better than nothing.
- Yes, palapas get taken up but if you go after 2pm there are always empty ones. Leave some personal items (old t-shirts or hats, books, worn flip flops) to “tag” your chairs in addition to towels; otherwise, some clueless folks will take them despite the towels.
- Bring a thermos to keep drinks cool on the beach.
- A la carte restaurants do have long wait lists (30 minutes to 2 hours) but they do tell you the estimated time your table would be ready. So you can step away and return at the time given.
-Downloading the Melia app gives you access to restaurant menus, hours, and dress code. You also get free subscription to premium newspapers and magazines for the length of your stay plus a week.

Now, let’s end with the positive: everything else! Thank you for the beautiful, zen, Bali-themed decor throughout the resort, for the excellent variety of fresh food made from scratch, plentiful grilled seafood and vegetables, consistently good-to-great cooking across restaurants, for the gorgeous beach, helpful staff, and an overall great stay. We will definitely consider coming back.

reviews.author: Penny Rivera
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun lives up to it's name of paradise. Located in the coast of Cancun, one can swim in the beach if you can brave the big waves.

The room was excellent with a view of the ocean. Hotel staff were very friendly and caring.

Food is excellent with a range of options to choose from.

reviews.author: Yurithza Rosas
reviews.text: Carina and Gabby from Ginger Bar #2  were the nicest people from the resort. They were always so happy to take our order and will make sure we had drinks in our hands at all the time and as soon as we walked in the bar the will know our order and ask us to take a seat. Honestly they made the experience way better. My husband and I had a great experience with them. We found ourselves at the Ginger bar # 2 because of them. We even walked up from the pool to get the drinks from them.

reviews.author: vivek kotwal
reviews.text: Jorge and Carlos from lemon fish served some of the best food and drinks we had in cancun.  One of the best offerings paradisus offers apart from breathtaking ocean view from the rooms. With 8+ restaurant offerings, lemon fish is by far the best on the premise.

reviews.author: Lisa Froggatt
reviews.text:
Miguel from Lemon fish was a hit. He was attentive and funny and the lychee pana cotta was amazing.
The beef tenderloin was awesome.
Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lynn Davis
reviews.text: Jorge was our best waiter yet ! He made us feel super special and we loved his dinner recommendations!

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.text: Came to Paradisus for Paradise Blue. While eating at the buffet, Alfredo, Alberto and Enrique took amazing care of us! Our drinks were always full and our table always clean. They also made us feel welcome and happy to see us. I can’t wait to see them again! Thank you Alfredo, and Paradisus for a great time!

reviews.author: Rafael fernandez
reviews.text:
All the restaurants at the Paradisus were great. The food was exceptional and Melvin y el chef Emilio from “Mexican restaurant Cielo” was fantastic. Pool was nice and activities in the pool were interactive.

Improvement : Rooms could be better

reviews.author: K_Cas
reviews.text: This is my husband’s and I second time at this Resort and the second time is just as good as the first. The resort staff is exceptional and provide the best service! On this visit we stayed as Club Melia members and had the opportunity to have Jorge as our concierge! Jorge was Great! He greeted us every morning and made sure our dinner and pool Bali bed reservations were made. He also surprised us with a couples massage that was amazing with Gema and Daniella! The pool staff member Elliot always greeted us by the pool and made sure our Bali bed was reserved daily! The pool servers Flor and Manuel were very attentive to our needs! We would also like to acknowledge Karina at the Ginger Bar! She was Outstanding!!!!!!  She always made sure our favorite drinks were in our hand and always followed up with water for us. She was very attentive and her customer service skills is beyond measure! She would be the reason for our return to the resort! Thank you Karina for making our trip memorable!! As for the food, thought it was just ok.  My husband and I would order a few appetizers and entrees to share and try out. We did find things to eat in each restaurant (not picky eaters) but I do think they could improve on the food.  Also, the drinks need improvement. They were watered down and were way too sugary. I love fruity sweet drinks but thought the drinks were unbearable. Even the margaritas were sweet and watered down. Other than that we had an amazing time! I would also like to applaud All the resort staff for working together and working so hard to prepare us for Hurricane Grace that came through Cancun. They worked day and night to make sure the grounds were safe and cleaned up after the hurricane.

reviews.author: Andrei Mihai
reviews.text:
Staff is very friendly and if you have any questions or problems they are willing to help.
My family and I had an ocean view junior suite , amazing view to wake up , anyway the downside is during the night is quite noisy from the strong wind.
Jaccuzi on the terrace that doesn't work, but you can still use it as a mini pool to stay and relax .
The hotel is quite big and we stayed in pyramid 1 (out from 5 ) and you need to walk a few minutes for the restaurant,  pools/beach which are located in pyramid 3.
One big plus is the water in pools is warm , something which we didn't find in any other hotels , (except the kids pool) , but here all pools are warm. Downside is they don't have slides or any kids pool .

reviews.author: José Pablo Flores Mácías
reviews.text: the hotel is really good in general, one of the things we really enjoyed was the live music specially on Sunday… if I remember good the name is MOUGEL. We loved the show!

reviews.author: Alejandro Mendoza
reviews.text: Great resort. Food was better than some resorts I went to. Most bar and table staff seemed shy. Rooms were nice but unfortunately our AC wasn't keeping us cool for most of the stay. Overall nice experience. The beach looks beautiful here but the entire shore had too much seaweed to swim in this time around. One thing I didn't like was not being able to pay for extra items on the spot. Instead you pay all at once at checkout. No big deal though. Would say, check it out for yourself.

reviews.author: Salvador Jr. Tagle
reviews.text:
The Good:   The hotel itself is beautiful.  It’s very aesthetically pleasing in every way.  We booked a luxury suite and the room was nice including the ocean view.   The food and drinks were good.  Not the greatest but for all inclusive it was good.  They have kids meals at every restaurant.   We stayed in the main tower which was very close to the restaurants, coffee shop, pools and the beach.  They do have several pools including a kids shallow pool at the very end.  Service was good and fast in most places except for the taco restaurant.  The beach itself is beautiful with plenty of umbrellas and chairs if you are lucky enough.  The beach was clean except for one of the days when they seaweed was above average but its still beautiful.

The Bad:
I wish they slowed down on trying to get you to go to a time share meeting.  They are everywhere so just let them know right away so they leave you alone if you are not interested.  We arrived at 7pm and the room we requested was not ready.  We had to wait an additional hour after traveling all day.   The pools closed at 730pm which is very odd.  All the common areas including the entertainment areas do not have AC.  As soon as you step out of the room, expect to be hot and sweaty.  BD experience, the airport to hotel transfer left a bad taste in my mouth.  Upon arrival, they were nowhere to be found.  We had to ask around until we finally found them.  Once found, they said traffic is bad and they dont have a vehicle.  We had to wait 2 hours for a bus to pick us up.  Along the way, we had to stop at two other resorts to drop off others.  The departure transfer was almost the same.  We were crammed into a small van of about fifteen of us.  Make sure you book a private transfer so you won’t deal with the multiple stops.

reviews.author: Traci Laffin
reviews.text:
We celebrated our friends getting married in the states and then all hopped on a plane for their honeymoon.
We were very impressed with the property.  They are updating many areas and it did not interfere with guests.  We enjoyed the food at Malva many times for breakfast lunch and dinner.  Blue Agave and the Sunset Grill were great for fast options.  We were able to enjoy Enso for lunch and it was delicious.
The pool is excellent but very warm due to summer sun.  Our favorite server was MANUEL who worked the pool chairs in front of building 1, the kids camp pool area.  He was so attentive and polite. He made our stay even better.
They are following many covid safety procedures and I felt everything was clean. Overall we had a great time.  4 stars is for lack of air conditioning in the lobbies and some of the rooms in our party , their rooms were not as cool as you would want for summer.

reviews.author: Claudine Lee
reviews.text:
I came here with my family around May for a few days and we really enjoyed our stay. The service was not too bad and they were attentive, it does get a bit slow at times (which is odd as I don't think it was too busy during our stay) but that's understandable.

The resort comes with multiple restaurants and we enjoyed trying all of them.

I think the service could be improved especially with the amount of money we spent.

reviews.author: Jose
reviews.text: The rooms were good, but I advise to reserve your dinners as soon as you check in. The concierge was not helpful at all. The faculty was very friendly. The wait server’s were great. Arnesto was very helpful at the Lemon Fish restaurant

reviews.author: louis orellana
reviews.text:
First time visiting Mexico and decided on Paradisus Cancun for our family vacation. Overall great experience. The weather was fantastic except for one rainy day.  Only gave 4 stars for the rooms because the AC wasn't the best. It was comfortable but if you like it very cold in this hot weather you may be a bit uncomfortable. There is no AC in the buffet restaurant so you end up all sweaty while eating. Again, if you like that no issues. For me and my family is wasn't the best experience.  Besides that, the service is amazing. Very attentive and friendly. They called my kids by name and had our juice and drinks ready when we arrived to the buffet which made up for the AC issue. Great selection of food here for all foodies.
Besides the buffet,, we went to two other restaurants and were able to seat our group of 9. Cielito and lemongrass. Galdino was our guy on the Reserve section and he was the best. Very involved during our stay with reservations and other accommodations.
For my kids (7&5), the swim up bar and frozen kid drinks were the best. Kidsclub allowed the adults to have some fun conversations. But the kids loved the club time, take advantage.   Nightly themed shows by the Ginger bar had everyone dancing. Pool table and Foosball also available.
Enjoy your next vacation.

reviews.author: Ashley Cee
reviews.text: Wonderful resort. The employees are amazing. Super thoughtful and hardworking ( shoutout to Miguel at Sante Daniela our concierge and Oscar at BlueAgave) the beach is gorgeous and the food is SPECTACULAR (especially if you like authentic Mexican cuisine) I am rating it a 4 for two reasons. The entertainment is lacking. Not a lot to do at night after dinner things die down pretty early. The resort is HOT. Other than a couple of restaurants and lobbies having ac its really hard to escape the heat. Otherwise I highly recommend☺️

reviews.author: Rachel Rodrigues
reviews.text: The staff is wonderful, the location is great.. close to the airport (25 minutes) there are a couple of things they could change... first we are travelling with a toddler we need to warm his milk his food and could have really used a microwave in the room.. the other thing their buffet meals are just okay! Again very few options for kids and the food is bland.. but their staffs absolutely amazing!! They follow up they are very thorough and friendly also the hotel is beautiful the rooms however are a bit dated.. our overall experience was good!!

reviews.author: Akshay P
reviews.text: We loved the location and the beach. Rooms were okay. Service at the restaurants were great but they sucked at the Malva Buffet room.  The worst part about the hotel were the concierge, forcing to go for a seminar for timeshare presentation and the salesman for picture, they are pushy and would not upheld to the agreement and would try to sell you more photos.

reviews.author: George Wang
reviews.text: First time here, all inclusive then upgraded to The Reserve. The Reserve is worth the investment. The exclusive pool is not as crowded and you’re able to use some of the sofa tents for free. Couple of complaints though, doesn’t seem to have laundry service; asked a couple of people and was ignored. Also, the pools close so early. In Hawaii, I recall swimming in the dead of night and enjoying the night stars while floating in the pool.

reviews.author: Roger Silva (r8rsrgr)
reviews.text: We stayed in the Reserve area.  Everyone was great, the area is well kept. It has a quiet area on the main floor with snack, coffee and it's own bar that stocked all day long. The only reason it isn't a 5-star, is that when you leave the Reserve tower and go to the main tower to visit any of the restaurants, you notice a significant difference in heat. The other towers are not air conditioned in the public areas.

reviews.author: Mr. Unslackable
reviews.text:
We just returned from our summer vacation, and we loved it here.  The food is not the best in Cancun but definitely worth the money we paid for this all-inclusive resort.

The staff was outstanding and took care of us very well.

The kids club was excellent, and the kids of our group seemed to enjoy being there.

Try to book reservations in their specialty restaurants upon check-in. Food is way better in these restaurants than in the Buffet.

reviews.author: Henrik Østerdal
reviews.text: Incredible staff, nice choice of restaurants and a great atmosphere. Special mention to our waiter, Abraham Cruz, at the Lemon Fish for taking expert care of our group of 5 adults, 2 kids and 2 babies, magic tricks and all included 😁

reviews.author: Amin Yazdani
reviews.text: The best part of this resort is the Beach and the Kidsdom. The staff at the Kidsdom are the best you can wish as a parent. The rooms are okay but the trade of is the spactular beach. The front desk staff are the worse employees at this facility. I would give 0 star to front desk staff. The staff at the buffet and other restaurants are friendly overall. The drinks are low quality and cheap and the biggest disappointment is that the guest service staff try to sell you everything they can. Overall of those things don't bother you, highly recommended for families.

reviews.author: Jonathan Pelayo
reviews.text: LAILA, MAY, DIEGO, DAVID, and JONATHAN made our trip so special from the start. The location and the property are beautiful. The rooms can use updating but for the value this has been a beautiful trip and the service was awesome. Thank you to everyone!

reviews.author: Erica Martinez
reviews.text:
Overall it was a wonderful experience.

Check in-Took about 1hr despite the fact that we arrived past the check in time. The person helping us was not upfront with us when we asked what was taking a long time and he was very moody. We were given a room that was leaking and the snacks and mini fridge were empty. They quickly came to fix those issues and we didn’t have a problem the days that followed.

Food- Finally no more need to reserve ahead of time. You just walk in. A few restaurants had a wait of approx. 20min for my party of 3. The food was good, but not amazing. Sushi restaurant served small portions, like a sushi roll entree consisted of only 4 rolls, but at least they were good. Italian restaurant was by far the worst food, and the Agua Marina seafood restaurant by the pool was a hidden gem. Room service took about 45min-1hr both times we requested it, however food arrived nice and warm which is great.

Pool- Did not like that the pool was 5.5-6ft deep. I’m 5’3ft and would drown if I didn’t swim. Impossible to enjoy a drink unless you were sitting at the swim up bar. There are waiters walking around taking drink orders and they are so efficient. Kids pool is nothing special, just a 2ft pool, no slides or splash pad at all.

Beach- They don’t clean the sea weed, which is very unfortunate because it’s a lot of sea weed and it’s such a beautiful resort. The day beds are $250USD to rent, which comes with a lobster dinner. They won’t rent out the beds without the dinner package which is also unfortunate. Beach also had waiters for drinks only, no food.

Service- staff was great. They are so overworked and understaffed, it is so clear to see, but despite it they work their tails off. Please tip if you plan to visit.

Spa- had a 75min massage which was amazing. The spa did not have a pool or other relaxing amenities beside a sauna room, so I was a little disappointed there, especially because it’s very pricy. I paid around $185USD.

Resort- very beautiful resort, great entertainment at night, and loved that they had local shops set up inside the resort so we don’t have to leave the resort at all. The only annoying thing is how pushy the staff is about attending the 1hr meeting about becoming a member. You can’t ask a question, without them bringing it up.

reviews.author: Lacy Hussey
reviews.text:
Pros
-Keyless access with bracelets
-Renovated rooms
-Staff is polite
-Toiletries were good quality (also with sunscreen/ insect repellent)
-Alcohol brands are mid tier if asked for with drinks (cazadorez, patron, etc)
-Natural decor of hotel is pretty.
-Good water pressure
-Carlos at the Coffee bar
-Pool side service was good for food/snacks & drinks
-Pizza taco and Ice cream bar by pool was good
-Kept luggage and could get items as needed until room was ready

Cons
-Rooms over restaurant smell like the items being cooked(fryer, burgers ect)even with door shut
-Entertainment is not really existent. They don’t have any real shows. Bands play for a bit while DJs play also, it’s not memorable
-Food is just okay. Nothing really seemed to stand out. They had different options at the buffet but nothing seemed to impress.
-The restaurants all seemed bland, the sushi seemed to be okay but I also liken it to good grocery store sushi.
-Pools were large but due to the nature of a long river style, they tended to make all the kids congregate infront of the only swimup bar. They have a kids shallow section at the other end but no amenities near so parents would not want to trek all the way down. They also had the option for the reserve side with its own pool/bar but after looking it didn’t seem to offer anything for music/entertainment. So if you are looking to isolate on the trip it might be worth the upgrade.
-Limited seating options around both pool and beach makes it seem like it’s to steer you into renting a cabana since it like other resorts has guests try to (claim seats early by putting out items or towels prior to arrival) we went down between 8/830 every morning and had no issues
-No real “early” checkin resulting in having to return to see if your room is ready. The other hotels have switched to apps giving updates. Also hotel doesn’t seem to offer any sort of amenities for special events(birthday honeymoon ect) unless you purchase them.

Overall it was a good vacation but have stayed at resorts that have better food and entertainment.

reviews.author: isabel escudero
reviews.text:
Great hotel. You can tell it's been renovated. We had a problem at check-in; they make you check in online before arriving to "save" time, but then you still spend half an hour at reception. Our room wasn't ready yet (even though they ask beforehand what time you'll arrive so they can have it ready), but we were able to use the facilities in the meantime. When we got closer to the time they told us the room would be ready, they still made us wait an hour in the lobby. They didn't give us the room until 4:30 pm. It was a shame because, between one thing and another, we ended up losing almost the entire afternoon, and we were only staying two nights. That first night, we also had to wait an hour for dinner at the Japanese restaurant, and when we finally went, it was practically empty. We specified that we wanted a room with one double bed, and they gave us one with two single beds (they ask you beforehand about that too). Aside from those inconveniences... the Japanese restaurant was delicious. The staff was very friendly, and the buffets were good. The evening entertainment was a bit short. Everything closes at 11 PM.
The facilities are very well maintained. There were enough hammocks for everyone, and they were in excellent condition.

reviews.author: Belle MC
reviews.text:
My husband surprised me this past week by taking me to Paradisus Cancun, where we celebrated our honeymoon. I arrived and was speechless because upon entering, you see those five pyramid-like structures, and it's truly unique. Then, in the lobby, surrounded by lush greenery… I was in love. The check-in staff were incredibly kind, and the place smelled amazing. We stayed in The Reserve (adults only). Our concierge was Sergio, an excellent gentleman—very kind, attentive, cordial, and respectful. One of the things that made the experience so wonderful was Sergio. The restaurants were delicious, and I found Kao to be beautiful, a unique and special space. I was disappointed that I couldn't try the dumplings; they weren't available. The Mexican restaurant was absolutely delicious, and I loved the service, especially since I have allergies, and they took great care of me. The steakhouse was good, although we would have appreciated more attention. They have an ice cream shop, which is super nice. The ocean view is beautiful. For families with children, there's plenty of entertainment for them. The spa staff were very friendly and helpful.

It was a special stay that I hope to repeat, and when I return, I hope Sergio is still working so he can take care of us again. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Maylin Alejandra Ruiz Tejada
reviews.text: I visited two restaurants at the all-inclusive resort, the Japanese restaurant and the Aquamarine. I had a pleasant experience at both; the waiters were good. At Aquamarine, Paolo served us—excellent service, very chatty and attentive. As for the rooms, only the bed smelled a bit odd, but otherwise, everyone said good morning and was in a good mood. The karaoke was also 10 out of 10; DJ Uriel Avilés served us. I would definitely return.

reviews.author: Patricio Eduardo Barriga
reviews.text: I want to talk about the service at Cappella. We were served by Edgar, an exceptionally helpful person. Very kind, and his diligence made all the difference in an elegant restaurant, even if it didn't necessarily have the best culinary quality.

reviews.author: Ivonne Mata
reviews.text:
At Aqua Marina restaurant, all the food was delicious. I loved the octopus and the coconut shrimp. The waiters Lucas and Alfredo were incredibly attentive, Chef Iván's cooking was amazing, and Captain Natsh was wonderful.
Congratulations!

reviews.author: lourdes maricela suarez gonzalez
reviews.text: The dinner was delicious; we had fried fish tacos and a wonderful watermelon salad. The service was excellent, especially from Chef Ivan and waiters Lucas and Alfredo.

reviews.author: Diana Garcia
reviews.text: Excellent service, very friendly staff, Richard was a very attentive and dedicated waiter, very helpful. Regarding the rooms, the only issue was that the vanity light in the bathroom wasn't working. The hallways and common areas weren't heated, which made them feel hot and humid. Overall, the staff's attention created a pleasant atmosphere. Thank you.

reviews.author: Aurea Gonzalez
reviews.text: Having Omar as our butler definitely made all the difference in making our stay perfect! He was very attentive to all our needs, questions, and requests.

reviews.author: JC Vela
reviews.text:
Excellent service from waiter Juan at Agua Marina.
The bad part: The food portions are so small you'll be starving. I ordered a seafood casserole. It had only clams (some were just the shells), and only one shrimp, and even then, only the head... and it was like that in most restaurants. Since you already paid for the "all-inclusive," they take advantage of you.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Jacqueline
reviews.text:
Excellent service and attention from Armando at Blue Agave, and high-quality dishes.

We enjoyed a delicious dinner at Cappella restaurant and the excellent service from Melvin. Congratulations to such a great team!

reviews.author: Jesus Benitez
reviews.text: Everything was great, the best part was the Blue Agave restaurant! Tacos every day, and at night they have even more delicious dishes. The staff—Atilano, Guadalupe, and Natanael—are very attentive, and Chef Miguel is fantastic!

reviews.author: Natalia Moll
reviews.text: Today we did yoga and crafts, and honestly, Jesús is a great employee who makes our vacation very special…

reviews.author: Erika McElhinney
reviews.text: Everything was great! We loved the food at all the restaurants, especially the Italian one, and the service at Kao was excellent. We'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Maria Paula Aviles
reviews.text:
Chef Karen makes delicious sushi at Lemon Fish! Jorge and Miguel at that restaurant provide the best service! I didn't like the room service, but the food at the restaurants is very good! At Santé, order the moussaka, it was amazing!
The rooms are actually very comfortable, but I was a bit disappointed with some things. The lights on the fans or chandeliers didn't turn on, so the rooms were a bit dark. The internet isn't very fast either. But everyone who serves you is wonderful and very attentive.
The service on the beach is incredible! There's nothing better than lying on a lounge chair and having mimosas and burgers brought to you.

reviews.author: Mony Salazar
reviews.text: Mexican acupuncture, a great activity to relax and take some time for yourself. Giovani was very kind and helpful. It was a lot of fun.

reviews.author: J. “José Manuel Nequiz” Nequiz
reviews.text: A very nice, family-friendly hotel, the service is just okay and this is reflected in the hotel management.

reviews.author: Thomas SERRANO
reviews.text:
The entire resort was magnificent. The concierge was very helpful and attentive, truly making my experience enjoyable and relaxing. The food was very good. I would love to return after the remodel; I was impressed! The pools were top-notch.
My girlfriend and I recently had a trip, and the experience was exceptional.
We were very impressed with the service; the staff, who were always friendly and helpful, elevated our experience to the next level.
There were nine restaurants to choose from and about five bars, all amazing, but I was most impressed by Aqua Marina. We've been three times, and the service has always been top-notch, with all the care and advice from Martin, the manager. For bars, we loved the Gingle Bar, with Salvador, Jorge, and Glady, all funny and making sure I was well looked after. Jose Garcia at the Capella restaurant helped us with incredible dinner choices. The food was excellent, and his
fun personality added to the experience.
Abraham at the Ginger Bar is always excellent. His mixology expertise allows us to try new and wonderful drinks on every visit.
I had a 75-minute full-body massage with Guadalupe! It was very well done and therefore very relaxing! The spa had a very zen feel with the water features just outside the spa area. I was satisfied with the experience overall. I wish I had been charged to my room instead of having to pay immediately on-site. At another Paradisus.

reviews.author: Erick Sickta
reviews.text:
I want to sincerely thank the entire hotel team; they are truly amazing!

A very special thank you to Flora Restaurant, where we received impeccable service from Fany and Cinthia. They were so welcoming and made our dinner a truly special occasion.

On the beach, Irina served us with great kindness and always made sure we had ice-cold beer—thank you for your wonderful attention!

At Blue Agave Restaurant, we also received a warm welcome and enjoyed delicious dishes.

Everything was simply wonderful. I am so grateful for our stay at the Meliá Paradisus and for the professional, friendly, and dedicated team who made our vacation an unforgettable experience.

Thank you so much for everything!

reviews.author: Pablo Zaragoza
reviews.text: The Cappella restaurant is one of the best things about the hotel, and without a doubt, Edgar's service makes everything even more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Luis Alfonso Orta
reviews.text: Cintya Ortiz, Agua Marina Restaurant, Veloz, attentive, my, my, my, my, with, a smile, always, thank you very much for your work.

reviews.author: alex goncalves
reviews.text: Flora Restaurant is spectacular, the spinach pasta with almonds and picanha is the best. Waitress Anabel is very attentive and helpful. 10 out of 10. Waiter Didier from the pools is the best, very attentive, concerned with providing good service, understanding and making the menu understood. He works with joy, without a doubt the best.

reviews.author: Ev Vc
reviews.text: The room is comfortable, and the mattress is excellent. The staff are very attentive and helpful, especially Jorge from Lemon & Fish. The facilities are well-maintained, and the beach is fantastic. I would definitely return.

reviews.author: Alfonso Micucci
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for four nights. The location is excellent, with a beautiful white beach right in front that gives way to a turquoise sea. There are several restaurants, including the Malva buffet (not the best food), a steak house (for a fee), a Mexican restaurant, a tapas restaurant, a Caribbean restaurant (the best!), and an Italian restaurant. The sand was generally clean (early in the morning they stir up the sargassum, making it disappear). Obviously, the better options cost extra. The downsides: old rooms in need of major renovations, very, very noisy air conditioning (so much so that you have to turn it off to sleep), extremely slow check-in (there's even no fast track for those who checked in online), very noisy at the pool (where the cabanas are reserved for those in "The Reserve" rooms). Little evening entertainment. Being a family-friendly hotel, it's easy to encounter very rude people who shout, blast their own music, and keep you from relaxing.

reviews.author: Erika Prats
reviews.text: Excellent service from all the staff, from the moment we arrived to the incredibly friendly Venecia's warm welcome. A special mention goes to Cynthia, who served us at Flora restaurant; we loved her suggestions and she provided outstanding service. It's clear she loves her job. We'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Erik Gonzalez
reviews.text:
For me, it was very good. I came in February 2025. The room (junior suite) was fine, except the air conditioning was a bit noisy, but since I sleep like a rock, I didn't find it bothersome.
The buffet food was pretty average; some items were delicious and some were bland and/or cold, but overall, the buffet had a lot of variety and the food was good.
However, they have a serious problem with pool towels. There were never any, and you had to hunt down the staff to get a couple. The room towels were perfect.
Overall, the service from the staff was very good; very friendly, smiling, and sometimes joking. A few were very serious, but never disrespectful to anyone.

reviews.author: Julio C C
reviews.text: Fanny and Alex provided excellent service at Flora restaurant. Overall, the service was good to average, but theirs was particularly outstanding. The food was also very good. My only complaint would be about the upkeep of the facilities, which appear to be deteriorating, and the air conditioning, which wasn't very effective.

reviews.author: Rosaura Mendicoa
reviews.text:
My opinion is about the staff: Roberto Isla de la Playa, who provided exceptional service during our stay. We are very grateful.

Jesús de Capella, a genius. Great service too.

reviews.author: Ananda Delgado
reviews.text:
Check-in was incredibly slow, over an hour's wait, and there was only one family ahead of us when we arrived, and they were already processing our request. 🤨
The hotel is huge and very beautiful, honestly, I loved the decor and the facilities. 😍
The food was quite acceptable, I'd rate it 4 out of 5. 🫠
The pools are spacious; one gets very crowded, another was always very quiet, and there's one just for adults, which is perfect. 👌

reviews.author: Alexandro López
reviews.text:
The hotel isn't that new, but it's worth it.
Good service. But in my opinion, they should have more variety in restaurants.
It gets crowded at breakfast and lunch times.

reviews.author: Tomás Segundo Estrada
reviews.text: This is truly a dream place for any tourist visiting Cancun who's unsure where to stay—this is the perfect spot! The staff's service is incredible; they're always available to help at any time. I also want to give a special shout-out to Alejandro and Ricardo from Nespresso, who always greeted us with a smile and a great cup of coffee each morning! With staff like these, it's always a pleasure to return.

reviews.author: liza romina
reviews.text: I want to highlight the excellent service from Julio at the adults-only bar in Pyramid 5. He's a very kind, cheerful, and helpful person, always attentive to any need. Excellent.

reviews.author: Paola Vargas
reviews.text:
Paola, our waitress at Blue Agave, was wonderful to serve. The food was delicious, the chef's tacos were amazing, and everyone was so friendly!

Daniel, our waiter at Leomon Fish, was fantastic. He was incredibly attentive and served us on time. 🙌🙌

Orlando, the bartender, was also a 10/10—very attentive and friendly.
10/10 🙌☺️

reviews.author: BORJA GARCIA
reviews.text:
The staff was the best, the service was excellent and very polite.
The gym was under construction, which I don't understand during peak season.
The spa always had issues; I didn't get a chance to use it.
The food was okay, you get tired of it, but it's normal; there's hardly any beef.
The rooms were fine but a bit outdated.
The golf course was fantastic.
The service was great and always friendly.
The place is nice, I would return, but there are a few shortcomings for a 5-star hotel. Watch out for vermin in the garden at night!

reviews.author: Josi Daresbach 2
reviews.text: Carlos and Alejandro Nespresso, Baltazar from the pool bar were the best servers! 10 stars for them!!! 👏🏼 Please, they live off tips, so when possible give them something, as they do much more than they should and are excellent at service! Thank you friends!!!! You were exceptional! 🤩👏🏼 The hotel left a few things to be desired considering the convention, one or two grumpy waiters, but for the most part it was very good! However, with so many people, the restaurants were packed! The last 3 days were so-so! The first 4 days were perfect!

reviews.author: Susana Vega
reviews.text:
The Sante Bar at The Reserve has a 10/10 service. Luis is an excellent bartender and provides top-notch service. Very kind, friendly, and attentive! It's definitely a paradise, perfect for an amazing vacation. Thank you!

P.S. My husband and I are with Luis in the photo 😉

reviews.author: Giovanna Lo
reviews.text: I had a wonderful vacation at the hotel. The quality of service was exceptional, and I truly enjoyed every moment of my stay. I want to especially congratulate Oscar from the entertainment team, who made our vacation even more special with his amazing activities. Thank you for everything! I will definitely return.

reviews.author: Hector
reviews.text:
First of all, a big thank you to Captain Guillermo at the Malva buffet. He immediately resolved a problem we had with dinner because we were given the wrong restaurant hours at reception. From then on, he was always attentive to ensure we had everything we needed. He was pleasant and fun.

The hotel was very well-equipped and clean. The beach was the best, and the access to it was excellent.

For those of us who love coffee, the 24-hour Nespresso machine was available!
Thank you so much! Greetings from Chile/Argentina.

reviews.author: ANA GARCIA-TALAVERA ALONSO
reviews.text:
This year, I spent my vacation with my son at Meliâ Paradisus Cancún. We bought a membership last summer and wanted to give the Meliâ group a try, especially because, in theory, being members would have a series of benefits/privileges that, unfortunately, I haven't seen. From day one, I've been experiencing incidents, one after another. I don't know if it was bad luck or simply that Meliâ has a lot of room for improvement; or both. After the experience, I've decided to cancel my membership. I sent the email 10 days ago and still haven't heard back... it gives me a bad feeling.
Regarding the reservation, as I mentioned before, I had one problem after another, and after speaking with a concierge, Alejandra Vilches, who forwarded my complaints to her superiors, I was finally able to enjoy my stay a bit. Although I returned somewhat happy after 12 days, I insist, thanks to her because she was very attentive to making sure my son and I were as comfortable as possible, my expectations weren't met.
I want to highlight her professionalism and empathy because from the very first minute, she connected with me, understood my arguments, and did everything possible to resolve everything. Thanks to her, I was able to speak with up to three supervisors, and I'm sure it was possible because she's a great professional, a decisive person who loves her job, who understands and empathizes with guests perfectly, and who strives for them to enjoy themselves and, of course, want to return. Thank you so much, Alejandra, for everything. I wish you much success. You deserve it, and lucky customers will be those who are fortunate enough to meet you.
That said, I'd also like to highlight the professionalism and friendliness of Alejandro at the Nespresso corner. A kind, smiling, and friendly person, he made you feel special every time you went to order a coffee. And also the rest of the employees in general, all very friendly and helpful, especially the waiters (or bartenders) at the "quiet" pool, which borders the "Adults Only" area.
And I don't want to forget the Kidsdom counselors, who are incredibly charming and affectionate and treated my son wonderfully. Thanks to them, he thoroughly enjoyed himself.
As for the rooms, they're pretty average. The bathrooms need updating, and while the ones with ocean views are a bit better, the most valuable thing is the view, which is spectacular, because otherwise, they look a bit dated.
The buffet wasn't bad, but I missed more healthy options, like sugar-free yogurts and a wider variety of whole-wheat bread, among other things. I give it a 7 out of 10, and the same goes for the restaurants. There are several, and the food isn't bad, but nothing special. The best for us were Lemon Fish and Aguamarina. What I liked least was that several dishes had an additional charge. I understand that there might be one or two with those conditions, but there were several, and it seemed like too much. That's my opinion.
And finally, the pool area is nice. What I liked most is that you can see the ocean, but I think they were too close together, barely providing privacy between them, and they were also a bit uncomfortable because most of them were fixed and couldn't be adjusted. The beach area was better, but the sun loungers were the same. And the beach was spectacular.

reviews.author: Josefina Reyes
reviews.text:
The service is excellent, the staff is very attentive, and everyone is very concerned about the guest's well-being. The waiters are very friendly and helpful.

The buffet is excellent, from breakfast to after-hours room service. Special mention goes to the Blue Agave taco restaurant, Johana Torres at reception is very friendly, the food by Chef Anibal Perez is excellent, and the waiters Atilano Diaz and Oscar are excellent.

I'm giving it 4 stars because our room (having paid for a premium suite) has mostly faulty electrical outlets, the bathroom smells like sewage, and it's very far from everything. Also, it says "lagoon view," but we're on the first floor, with a "view" of the pool area; it doesn't really have a view.

The hotel is very quiet and offers few activities overall.

reviews.author: Ha m
reviews.text:
As expected of a 5-star hotel. Everywhere in the hotel was beautiful, and the cleaning was impeccable.

There was so much greenery that it felt like we were outdoors, which was lovely. At night, the greenery was lit up, creating a magical atmosphere.

Our room had an ocean view and a bathtub. With the curtains fully open, we could soak in the bath while gazing at the beautiful sky.

There was a bar counter and snacks very close to our room, but the food was removed early in the evening, so we only got to eat once. We wanted to have a late-night snack, so it would have been nice if they had food available during the hours when alcohol was served.

Good points:
- An incredibly beautiful hotel
- The buffet had a wide variety of delicious food
- The private beach is beautiful
- You can access the beach easily by going down the stairs from the poolside
- There were sand toys for children in the room as a gift
- The spa was discounted on certain days of the week

Bad points:
- Dinner is almost entirely by reservation only. We couldn't go to the restaurant we wanted to, and the reservation time was too late.
- Childcare is extra.
- No rental of children's inflatable rings or life jackets.

Perhaps we went at a bad time (end of the year), but we couldn't get a reservation at our desired restaurant at all. Moreover, it was after 9 pm every day. As a family with children, we wanted to eat earlier.

We went to the buffet four times, and the contents changed slightly every day and every time slot, which was great. Many items were even tastier than those in the restaurants.

I recommend this hotel to those who want to enjoy a luxurious experience while traveling with children. If you want to let your children have as much fun as possible, a family-friendly hotel with water slides or similar amenities might be better.

Also, if you search for "Cancun family all-inclusive" in Japanese, you'll find many reviews, and it seems that many of the hotels have Japanese guests. We didn't see many Asians at this hotel, which I personally appreciated.

Although I've written about many negative points, overall I'm satisfied. I'm glad we chose this hotel!

reviews.author: Darlyn Otero
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay. The rooms need updating, but the service and the rest of the hotel are very nice. I recommend the Blue Agave restaurant; we received excellent service from Atilano.

reviews.author: vero villegas
reviews.text:
The service was excellent, the staff were very attentive.

The only downside to our room was the jacuzzi, which was very dirty and only partially functional.

The food lacked variety.

The best thing is that it's adults-only.

reviews.author: Miguel Vasconcelos
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience at the Nespresso stand in the Paradisus Cancun Hotel, thanks to Alejandro's exceptional service. He was extremely professional and attentive, always with a smile on his face and contagious friendliness.
A big thank you for your dedication and excellence in service!

reviews.author: Jesús Uzcátegui
reviews.text:
Jorge and Miguel are excellent hosts at Lemon Fish Restaurant, which is the best in the hotel for its food, service, and ambiance: 100 points.
The hotel's architecture is very modern despite being a 90s design; however, it's time to update the rooms.
The beach is very well maintained and offers excellent services.
Breakfast at Malva is fantastic.
You have many options for Nespresso coffee in various areas of the hotel.
They should improve the service and food at Aguamarina for lunch and dinner. Overall, a great experience.

reviews.author: melissa valle garcia
reviews.text:
I stayed from April 8th to April 12th. I really liked the hotel. The best part of my experience was the Pool Bar. The drinks were very good, and the bartenders were very attentive, especially Carlos, Timoteo, Melin, and Josué. They were very nice people, and the service was excellent.
The service at the Malva restaurant was very good, very attentive and helpful.
I went to the Cappella restaurant and loved the food. Congratulations to the cooking/pastry team.
The Blue Agave restaurant also had very good food and service. It was my first time eating tacos, and I had a good experience. Congratulations.

Something that could be improved is the Lemon Fish restaurant. The service was poor, they took too long to take my order, and the food wasn't very nice. I tried the Peruvian ceviche and didn't like it at all. I know it's a fusion, but they need to improve it a lot.

reviews.author: Danusa Farias
reviews.text: The hotel is large and beautiful, clean, and the staff is always attentive to your needs. Roberto Isla, in particular, was very attentive and polite at the children's pool. I expected more from the food service. I found it cold, the meat tough, and unlike other all-inclusive hotels, food isn't always available by the pool; you have to constantly ask for things, wait, and bother the waiters. I didn't like this.

reviews.author: José Orozco
reviews.text:
A very nice place with very friendly people. Many diverse and high-quality food options.
The 24/7 Nespresso station is a must, and Perla was super friendly and attentive to our family.
The buffet is just okay; it's the only weak point. The food is lukewarm to cold; it doesn't arrive at your table hot. During breakfast, the egg and omelet station has a very long line. Only one station has bacon, and it's not replenished quickly. I think it should be arranged differently to make it more accessible so everyone can enjoy different options at the right temperature.

reviews.author: Mai
reviews.text:
Having spent two weeks at the hotel, we had a pretty comprehensive experience and wanted to share a few things to help both other guests/readers and the hotel itself.

To begin, the first thing I want to say is that they should adopt more of the style of other Paradisus hotels. For example, we've stayed at the Paradisus in Punta Cana, and there are shows or some kind of entertainment every night until midnight. At this hotel, it was noticeable that they operate on a different schedule; for instance, the restaurants start closing around 10 or 11 pm, but that didn't bother us. There were some very good artists who came to sing in the bar on the first floor in the evenings. However, not every night was like that compared to the other hotel.
My second comment concerns the first-come, first-served system. It wasn't bad, as you don't have to wait too long for a table after joining the waiting list, unless the hotel is very full, as happened to us on our last night. It would be great if, given these situations, they tried implementing a reservation system like the one in Punta Cana, where your concierge reserves the restaurant and time you prefer. This would avoid any unpleasant surprises or complaints on this matter.
I also have a few quick comments I'd like to highlight, such as the lack of sufficient beach chairs and the fact that they don't fully recline. Furthermore, we had to water our balcony plants many times; we noticed they weren't being watered, even though the cleaning staff came by every day. The bar staff deserve praise for always refilling our snacks, but they should pay more attention to refilling their water bottles. We went days without them refilling our water, which is essential, even more so than chips and other snacks. During those days, we asked the beach attendants for bottled water.
