A big shout-out to all of them; they're fantastic! Now, the rooms are a bit dated, as the hotel is quite old, but we didn't find it to be a problem. In fact, we appreciated that it had a bidet, which we didn't usually find at the Paradisus hotels we've stayed in. We were given rooms 2207 and 2208, which were connected. I've read many comments complaining about the age of the rooms, but I don't think a modernization is necessary right now. They could simply add complimentary bathroom accessories or put shelves in the closets to store more clothes and compensate that way.

Finally, I'm going to talk about the most frequently mentioned topic in the comments section: the restaurants. Our favorites were Capella (Italian) and Lemon Fish (sushi and ceviche). The waiters at Lemon Fish were very attentive; greetings to Jorge and Daniel, who were very kind, and also to Osvaldo from Cielo Lindo. Thankfully, we didn't see any cockroaches, we didn't get sick, and we weren't treated badly. The food at Malba was excellent; the poke bowls were a great idea.

Our only comment on this matter is that the waiters often forgot our orders or took a very long time to come and serve us, especially at the Malba restaurant where we had to get up and go ask a waiter to serve us. Many of the waiters didn't even look at the tables to see if anyone needed a drink. In my opinion, they should set up an area where people can serve themselves, as the waiter system seems to be unreliable and they take far too long, especially when it's busy. We simply ask that they be more attentive when people first arrive to eat, serving them drinks and making more eye contact with the tables to ask if they would like more drinks or anything else.
Despite these comments, we had a fantastic time. The beach is beautiful, the hotel is huge and unique, but I felt it was necessary to mention these things because before coming to the hotel I was quite intimidated by the reviews section, so I wanted to write my own review to help. Thank you very much for reading, and thank you to the hotel for the wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: Jorge Jara
reviews.text:
Baltazar and Rodrigo. The best waiters at the pool bar. Excellent service from these guys. Very attentive and always available to satisfy the customer. I had a great experience with them every day. Very attentive. I felt very well taken care of in a very friendly and pleasant atmosphere.

Cintia from Fiona Restaurant. Excellent service. The food is very healthy and the variety is excellent. Spectacular service.

Abraham and Luis are super bartenders at La Reserva. Excellent service. I feel like I'm at home.

We went to dinner again at Furia Restaurant. Since the first time we had a very good experience, today was the opposite. What a disappointment! We found four cockroaches. Horrible, we lost our appetite. What a shame. They should address this issue.

reviews.author: Francisco Javier
reviews.text:
The Bad:
-The rooms are somewhat outdated.
-The air conditioning was a bit noisy, and we couldn't turn it up or down.
-The Mexican taco restaurant leaves a lot to be desired; the food was bland and greasy.
-In my opinion, the staff (not all of them) is very keen to ensure you leave a good tip, which made me a little uncomfortable.
-The lounge chairs are not included in the "All Inclusive" package.

The Good:
-The beach and the water were exquisite (although we went during the sargassum season, we hardly noticed any of it).
-Most of the staff was very attentive.
-The service from David, the gentleman who greeted us and gave us a tour of the hotel, was excellent; he made our stay very enjoyable!

In conclusion:
I do recommend the hotel ⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Pablo Boggio
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, especially the Malva and Nespresso cafes, the Flora restaurant, and the excellent service from the staff in general. I especially want to highlight the service from Richer, Alex, Francisco, Martin, Javier, Alberto, Perla, Adriana, Anabel, Teresa, and Cinthia. The beach is excellent! I would also like to mention the attentiveness and friendliness of Gaudino and the lifeguards, Manain, Carmen, and Johnny, who were always helpful. One area for improvement is the juices, which are generally very artificial, so the fruit juice drinks aren't very good.

reviews.author: Alejandra Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Blue Agave Restaurant was delicious, especially the tongue tacos.
Paola provided excellent service; she was very kind and attentive to our baby, who needed extra care.
Lemon Fish Restaurant was also very tasty, though the portions were small. Our waiter, Miguel, was very helpful, ordering the right amount of each dish.
Aguamarina Restaurant was excellent; the coconut shrimp and ceviche are must-tries. Our waitress, Paola Krystel, provided outstanding service.
The rooms were very clean and comfortable, but the minibar wasn't working and was never fixed.
We ordered room service, and the hamburger was raw. We asked for another one, and it was cooked through, but it was a minor issue.
Regarding the hotel's location, half the beach is fine, while the other half is rocky. The VIP area with lounge chairs, which is off-limits to regular guests, is the best beach. We couldn't use the other half because the sea was very rough, and the rocks made it dangerous. Only the VIP area was available, and there were no sunbeds.

The hotel is generally very nice and well-equipped, with delicious food and facilities.

reviews.author: Fabian Montenegro
reviews.text: Lemon Fish restaurant is excellent; they have a rib dish where the meat falls off the bone. Arce and my family really appreciated the service; he guided us throughout the meal.

reviews.author: Saylin Carolina Camero Poriett
reviews.text: A pleasant place to spend a vacation. The rooms are comfortable, but I think they need to be renovated and updated. The food is delicious, prepared by chefs Karen and Marcos at the Lemon Fish Restaurant. The dishes are excellent, especially Jorge's service.

reviews.author: Erik Mayerstein
reviews.text:
We liked everything overall; it was a great experience, but there are some small details that are good to know before booking.

The rooms are very comfortable and nice, but the hotel is somewhat old, so the A/C is in the same room, so you can hear the machine. It's not a big deal, you can sleep without any problem, but I think it's something worth knowing.

We love the 24-hour Nespresso bar!

When ordering drinks like fresh water, ask the bartender to stir them before serving. The water comes out a little higher than the bottom, so what settles stays at the bottom, but what comes out is very sweet.

The restaurants are "okay." For example, Lemon Fish has very limited options, although it's very nice.

The Mexican restaurant (I don't remember the name) is like a very fresh taqueria. The food tastes delicious, but as for gringos, if you're a Mexican who really likes tacos, adjust your expectations.

The buffet is delicious, super varied, and excellent! Just keep an eye on the opening hours, as it's not always open.

The bathrooms are "okay" but difficult to find, as they're not well-located and sometimes not as clean as you'd expect at this level of hotel.

The staff is always super attentive and helpful!

The hotel is wonderful overall. I really plan to return, and it's well worth it. The things I mentioned above are things that could be improved, but we had a great time!

reviews.author: ROSA CINTRON
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful, and the housekeeping service is very good. The staff is generally very attentive. Alejandro always greets guests with a smile in the Express area. Ariel, who was in charge of karaoke, was the best; he has so much energy and is super cheerful. He really got us dancing and having a lot of fun, unlike Layla, who was in charge of karaoke the next day and didn't seem very involved; she just wanted to finish the activity quickly. Rodrigo, one of the waiters at the pool, was also very kind and attentive. I have to mention that my family has been part of the Melia Club for over six years, and this trip had some very uncomfortable moments. Our concierge, Pedro, never showed up or was attentive to our needs. We were very disappointed that we didn't have the option to make reservations. We think they should maintain the reservation option for those who plan ahead, especially if they come with large families. Daniel, one of the waiters at the FishLemon restaurant, was super attentive and provided us with vegetarian options that other waiters had refused. Daniel also made sure we had a nice birthday dinner. **** Room 1101 had problems with the air conditioning; it didn't cool properly. We spent the nights feeling hot, and there was a very bad smell coming from the pipes and the bathrooms. This is a crucial issue that needs to be addressed because it was very unpleasant.**** Aside from that, I am very grateful for the work everyone does to try to please the guests, and I do recommend staying at this hotel; it is generally very pleasant. Thank you all!

reviews.author: Miguel Moreno
reviews.text:
We received the best service in the entire property at Sante Restaurant in The Reserves. All the staff—Natanael, Arnulfo, Axel, Miguel, Moisés, César, Joel, Josue, and especially Ms. Estefanie and the rest of the Sante team—made our stay an unforgettable experience. They were all kind, accommodating, attentive, efficient, diligent, courteous, and above all, humble in the excellent service they provide every day. More employees should be like them. They are an example for everyone to follow. They do their work with pride in a job well done, and it's clear at first glance that they do it with pleasure. I also have to thank our concierge, Violeta, for her excellent service. She was always attentive to any needs, even on her day off. You couldn't ask for better service from a person. It's also worth mentioning Lai, Uri, and Bryan from Activities. These three make a great effort to entertain guests with their daily activities, jokes, and infectious laughter. And we must give well-deserved recognition to Victor and Nicole, who were always there to ensure we had our Balinese bed. Thanks to this great team, the few minor inconveniences were insignificant.

This team made our vacation a truly memorable experience, and we take away many magical memories from a natural paradise filled with beautiful and kind people. Room 5406, April 3-9, 2024. And I can't finish without giving a very special mention to Chef José; his cuisine is exceptional.

reviews.author: Angela Peña
reviews.text: It was a very pleasant stay; the food, the service, the beach—everything was spectacular. The rooms weren't my favorite, after being moved three times for various reasons, such as humidity and the air conditioning. However, the important thing is that the staff always tries to help and resolve any issues. The spa experience was well worth it if you stay at a Meliá.

reviews.author: Paula Giletta
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel. Its infrastructure is INCREDIBLE.
THE STAFF IS FRIENDLY AND KINDLY ASSIST YOU. ALWAYS WILLING TO HELP YOU WITH GREAT RESPECT AND CARING.
WE THANK GEMMA from the Resto and PERLA from Nespresso for being so excellent with us. Thank you!!!
The only thing I would ask for is a microwave in the dining room because the food is served rather lukewarm and arrives at the table FREEZING. Not to mention if you have children who have to heat up food and bottles...
That's all!!!!

reviews.author: Gabriel irazuzta
reviews.text:
Excellent service from our concierge Jenny, attentive to every detail.
Very good service at Flora restaurant by Anabell, at Capela by José Garcia, and at Limón Fish by Arce.

0

reviews.author: Victorio Muñoz Vázquez
reviews.text: Traveled from January 11th to 18th, 2024 (relatively low season). The hotel is very nice and right on the beach, with drinks, food, and sun loungers. However, there are few sun loungers by the pool, and the kids lie down at 8 am, when we Spaniards are still coming to terms with our lives. The rooms are worthwhile, starting with the Luxury Ocean View; the lower ones are old and have bathtubs. The food is good, in line with TI hotel buffets. The restaurants are okay, especially the sushi restaurant. The drinks and cocktails are quite good, with good drinks. The staff is quite attentive and pleasant; there are always people who rest on their laurels, as in any place and job. The service from Karina, Abraham, and Salvador at the Kannan Night Bar on the beach was especially good. They provided excellent service and had an impeccable attitude toward life and work. Thanks to them, the stay was much better. I recommend the hotel in general. The beach faces the open sea, and there are waves, but they are even appreciated. Greetings from Madrid.

reviews.author: Mitsue Tanno
reviews.text: Good hotel, although I feel there aren't as many pools as one would expect at a Cancun resort. The room I had felt rather bland, lacking personality. Excellent service from the staff: Gabriela from Capella, Ashanta & Lucero from the spa, and the many gentlemen on the beach and at the buffet restaurant were all excellent. The food was all delicious, but I must specifically recommend Capella.

reviews.author: Marta Méndez
reviews.text: Overall, very good! The food was good, and the rooms were nice too. The best part was the beach and the location near Isla Mujeres and Chichen Itza. I appreciate the excellent service we received from the concierge, Alejandro, who was also Spanish like us! Last but not least, the best service in the hotel is at the pool bar with bartenders Leo and Orlando, who provide very polite and personalized service to each guest. Their cocktails are delicious, and they have a great vibe.

reviews.author: Maricarmen bou
reviews.text:
Nice hotel! Very nice! Needs improvements! The public restrooms are disgusting. They don't clean them. In general, the cleanliness in the pool area is terrible. Glasses everywhere. And empty plates.

Our concierge, Limberth, gave us excellent service. Very grateful to him. Everyone who works at the hotel is very friendly!

I do NOT recommend the airport shuttle service. They choose the pickup time or they don't come at all. I mean, they're in charge! Awful!

reviews.author: Gonzalo Pérez
reviews.text:
A spectacular place, but for the price and the room amenities, it leaves something to be desired. Outside the room, there were leaks that flooded the hallway, which almost cost me a fall, since at the time there was no sign and the water wasn't visible due to the color of the floor. The bathroom—I don't know if it was a stroke of genius by the interior designer or a lack of budget—but the shower curtains were short and all the water spilled out. Later, I checked other rooms where my parents and cousins ​​were staying, and the same thing happened.
The seafood restaurant—both times I went, they apologized for the lack of products on the menu. The food is good, but there are resorts with a better variety of dishes and products.
The evening shows were very good, I think the best I've seen.
It's a hotel more for couples than with the family...
The pool and bar were spectacular.
The best thing is the service from everyone who works there, all very cordial and attentive... and if you're going to get a massage with a hydrotherapy session... I'd think twice before paying $180... Would I go back? I don't think so. I've had better experiences at Riu and Iberostar. But it was a hotel that had to be visited due to the size of its facilities.

reviews.author: Jorge Beltran
reviews.text: My clients liked everything.

reviews.author: Camila Vidal
reviews.text:
The place is very nice. The best thing about it is the dining and drinking areas, especially the Malva and Capella restaurants, where the food is delicious, as well as the main pool bar. There isn't much activity in the evenings, but there's definitely room for improvement. The resort is definitely a place to relax and spend time with the family.
We highly recommend the work and friendliness of the pool bar staff: David, Luis, Jorge, and Leo. And from Capella to Gabriela.

reviews.author: Eva SV
reviews.text: We arrived after a week at Paradisus in Playa del Carmen. Thanks to the somewhat disdainful and indifferent treatment we received from Angie at reception, we were able to appreciate much more the extraordinary involvement of our concierge, José May, during our stay. It was a shame he wasn't there on our arrival day. He did recognize us as Platinum members and went out of his way to make our time at the hotel easier and more enjoyable. Thank you again, José May, for helping us relax after those initial rough 24 hours. At the pool, we wanted to thank Ivonne for her attention and care, as well as Didier and the rest of the team. We also want to thank Armando at Malva and Jhony at Aguamarina for their attentive service every morning at breakfast. All the staff, entertainment, and activities were very attentive. We thank them all for their professionalism and warmth. The staff truly embodies the Meliá brand—it never disappoints.

reviews.author: Criticas Coherentes
reviews.text:
We stayed for a week. The food was very good, the service excellent, and the view unbeatable. The only downside is that there's no drink menu at the bars. They seem to think we're all bartenders who know what we want to drink, and the whole point of going to a place like this is to try new things recommended by experts. If I want beer and daiquiris, I'd rather stay home and watch TV!
The bed was a bit worn; you sank into a bottomless pit! They really should replace it!

reviews.author: Micaela Cuenca
reviews.text:
The most outstanding thing about this hotel is undoubtedly the food. Excellent quality ingredients.
Our favorite restaurant was SANTE, where Chef Esaul cooked everything exquisitely. The drinks by Sofonias were also excellent, and we must highlight the friendly service from Natanael, Axel, and Arnulfo.
We also received a very warm welcome from Estephanie.
The rest of the services are mediocre at best. It's a hotel very much geared towards tourists; they're the only ones they cater to, which I understand is linked to the tips they leave. Finding a sun lounger is a bit of a hassle; they're always occupied, but you eventually manage to get one. The pools are very nice, as is the beach. The hotel lacks entertainment; there's no game room or many activities to do, especially on rainy days. Finally, the rooms are in need of maintenance and are quite old.

reviews.author: Myriam Sandí
reviews.text: The staff is very attentive and always takes great care of the guests. Jorge Sánchez, the waiter at Flora restaurant, is very helpful.

reviews.author: Guadalupe Eusebio
reviews.text: I was a little apprehensive because other people's reviews weren't very good, but I was actually very pleased. The staff's service is excellent; from the moment you arrive, they treat you wonderfully. The cleanliness is impeccable, and it always smells lovely and relaxing. My only complaint is the food; it could use a bit more variety, for example, seafood. Although there is an à la carte restaurant that's free, the portions are small. They should promote the buffets more. The facilities aren't brand new, but they're always mindful of that and keep things updated. The beach is always clean. The drinks are good quality.

reviews.author: Hugo Hernández
reviews.text:
The hotel is nice, although the building is a bit old. There are a few minor imperfections, but they don't affect your vacation. The food and drinks are very good. The only downside is that the shows end and the bars close very early; there's no nightlife at this hotel.

The best thing about this hotel is the service provided by the bartenders at the various bars. They know their job well. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Claudia Garrido
reviews.text: I had a wonderful week! The food was delicious and the rooms excellent! The service was a little slow at times, but they treated us incredibly well! We were blown away by the band Mougel; they put on an amazing show and truly made my trip!

reviews.author: Barrios Martinez Analy
reviews.text:
⚠️Warning - Long text⚠️
I'm sharing my review of this hotel:

In short; it wasn't what I expected.

I stayed 2 nights and 3 days in the "The Reserve" area.
We arrived around 12:30 p.m. and they gave us wristbands to use the facilities. We were given our room at 3:00 p.m., and that's when the concierge contacted us.

I was celebrating a birthday, so I wanted a reservation somewhere nice and comfortable. To make the most of my time, I went to make the reservation myself, but they told me that reservations could only be checked with the concierge. However, since he didn't contact us until the afternoon, when I asked for a reservation, he told me there was no availability for either night. That was the first problem. It's pointless to pay extra for "exclusive" service or more "benefits" when they aren't honored in the end. The second downside was the limited number of cabanas/lounge chairs in the pool area, as reservations are required. So, on two of the three days, we couldn't use them.
The food is good but not exceptional. Some restaurants served it cold, which led to a bad experience, and when I went to Lemon Fish, the flavor really didn't impress us.

Additionally, there aren't many good recreational activities at the hotel. They have a calendar listing some events, but there's no auditorium, which makes the space very cramped, and the shows end up being unremarkable or boring. Aside from that, there's not much else to do at the hotel.

The only things I liked about the hotel were:
°The friendliness of most of the staff.
°The facilities.
°The cenote activity (It's included, BUT they never mention it if you don't request it).

Other than that, I don't think I have any other reasons to visit again.

reviews.author: Alex Jaramillo
reviews.text:
The hotel itself is a bit of a letdown… it's nice and well-maintained, but the staff can be a bit inconsiderate at times. If you don't have the "all-inclusive" wristband, they either ignore you or make a fuss about every request. I found an empty water bottle on the ground floor on Monday, and by Thursday, it was still there.

Their restaurants are very good, but the standouts are Cielito Lindo and Blue Agave. Blue Agave serves excellent tacos, especially the chistorra. I also recommend the gringa de pastor and the cochinita pibil.

The portions are average for a hotel, and the prices are reasonable.

The service at Blue Agave was exceptional, both from Daniel as a waiter and from the manager, Barbara.

reviews.author: Lucilla
reviews.text:
The location was great, the view was great, the restaurant was nice, the rooms were clean, and the staff were friendly.
I also loved the evening program where they handed out earphones with various music.
You could enjoy music and dance together, or if you didn't want to, you could just relax quietly.

However, I took off one star because the rest of the place was so incredibly hot that I wondered if the air conditioning was even working.
I don't usually get hot easily, but it was so hot that I felt uncomfortable. The restaurant staff were all sweating profusely, making it hard to order anything.
If you're looking for a "comfortable and refreshing" experience with the ocean views and all-inclusive experience in Cancun, this is something to consider.

reviews.author: Gerardo rodriguez
reviews.text: It's a very complete hotel, comprised of five interconnected, pyramid-shaped buildings, allowing for easy movement between them. This is very convenient as the hotel is air-conditioned. It also boasts a large swimming pool and is located directly across from the beach, which stretches for 800 meters. The hotel features several restaurants offering a wide variety of cuisines, including Mexican, Italian, Japanese, and more. Customer service is excellent, with several concierges on hand to assist guests and ensure a comfortable and attentive stay.

reviews.author: Andrea Jennifer Flores García
reviews.text: A wonderful experience with the family, the service was fantastic. The hotel has a splendid view, the sea is free of sargassum this season, it sometimes rains but only for a short time. Furthermore, the service at the pool is wonderful; Didier took excellent care of us; along with Eliseo and his assistant at the bar, they provided the best drinks, refreshing us on hot days.

reviews.author: q miro
reviews.text: Lemon Fish is very good, but with the music so loud, it makes it unpleasant. The music is in the wrong place, for a dinner party. If it were for a "drink," it would be fine. Having to shout while dining with the family on vacation...

reviews.author: Nancy Lopez Santiago
reviews.text:
The ideal place to relax

Hotel:
- Everything is impeccable
- You feel and breathe tranquility

Room:
- Beautiful ocean view
- Clean and comfortable beds
- Good air conditioning
- Fully stocked amenities
- The minibar is always restocked

Staff:
- The staff is 1000/10; everyone always has a smile and is extremely helpful. Any questions you may have are answered immediately. I can say that even by the pool and beach, they continue to serve you the same.

Restaurants:
- The food at Cielo restaurant is delicious. We tried the enchiladas and barbacoa, and I can say 10/10.
- Everything at Malva was perfect, with a great variety at all times since it's a buffet.
- The tacos at Blue Agave restaurant were delicious, very tasty and had good portions. The only thing that would be great is a hot sauce option. I understand it's due to foreign tourists, but Mexicans go there too.
- I liked the other restaurants too.

Activities:
- Personally, I feel like more activities are needed. There are several for children, but it would be great if there were two-thirds of them were different. Although the rock concert and the girls' singing are a great show, the show ends and there's nothing else going on, and everyone leaves without anything to do afterward...

Melia App:
- The app mentioned that by checking in online, you could go straight in and skip the wait, which is why it was there. However, upon arrival, check-in took three hours (after the scheduled time) to be given the room. The staff was very friendly, and although we could access the hotel immediately, you have to keep in mind that you're traveling for many hours and aren't even in a swimsuit or the best clothes for a hotel.

And well, I conclude by saying that it's a very nice hotel, but it's really for going to relax while enjoying the amenities, the beach, or the pool. We went for that experience, and it was a success.

reviews.author: María José Miranda
reviews.text: I want to congratulate the hotel for the service, but especially Armando (breakfasts at Malva restaurant), Cornelio and Josué (Balinese bed service at the pool) and Jenny (concierge), who have made our stay wonderful.

reviews.author: Samy Mouhoubi
reviews.text:
Excellent fish and sushi meal at Lemon Fish restaurant. The servers, Miguel and Jorge, were very friendly, and the service was quick and impeccable.

Also, thank you to Guillermo for meeting our expectations, for his availability, and for his kindness.

Thank you.

reviews.author: Nadia Chavez
reviews.text: The food was delicious and varied, and the staff were very attentive and friendly. The only downside is that the alcoholic drinks aren't very good; they don't have flavored liquors for making cocktails. That's the only thing that wasn't great, but everything else was excellent.

reviews.author: Alexa Alejandre
reviews.text: At Malva restaurant, Ivonn is the best! From the first day, she gave us excellent service. Very kind, attentive to everything, but above all, always with a smile.

reviews.author: Andres Covarrubias
reviews.text: Excellent service and very good quality food. Miguel and all the staff always treated us in the best way possible. Did the room smell of grape essence? There were also several finishing details that could be improved; the polished marble flooring is extremely dangerous in humid environments, especially on the stairs.

reviews.author: Fany Guzman
reviews.text: At the spa, the hydrotherapy was incredible, the service was always attentive, Cristina and her partner were attentive to everything from the moment we entered the spa, they offered us water and made the experience something unique.

reviews.author: Simon Flores
reviews.text: The security guard at the lobby entrance is very rude to the staff who go to pick up tourists. I understand that management has a policy of not letting us enter to collect our clients, but this guy is overly strict and borders on despotism. For better or worse, that's the hotel's image: good to the guests and bad to those of us who provide services. On the other hand, a bellboy over 50 years old is the complete opposite. There's no doubt that it all comes down to manners.

reviews.author: Sunhee Jung
reviews.text: The rooms are not standardized. Out of a reservation for three families, one family had no bathtub, no iron, and no hairdryer. The plumbing and air conditioning are outdated. There seems to be a significant disparity between the new wing and the main building. The food is about average for a 5-star hotel. The buffet doesn't have many options. I liked that there are two heated pools. The relaxation area next to the sports bar on the first floor is nice. There is a bracelet-making craft at the sports bar, so I recommend participating. The performance area next to the pool is too cramped. There are many Latin-style performances, which is boring. The staff seem newly hired, as they do not greet you even when you make eye contact.

reviews.author: Jesica Olivera
reviews.text:
Spacious rooms, the staff is incredibly attentive and friendly. The food is good; there are about six restaurants with good quality food. There are activities all day long for the whole family. The location is good, close to shopping centers and the nightlife area. The beach, although beautiful, is a bit rough for those of us who aren't strong swimmers.
Overall, everything was great 🙂

reviews.author: Rodolfo Ivan Casas Clavel
reviews.text: There are cockroaches throughout the hotel. The staff only caters to foreign guests and ignores locals, even though the gringo tips are a mere 16 pesos. It's pathetic. They kick you out of the restaurants, and the menu is limited; the buffet is the most varied option, if you can even call it that. The sea is usually rough at this time of year.

reviews.author: Leopoldo Berumen
reviews.text: This time, our trip was a family affair. We returned with our 8 and 5-year-old children after a long time. Montserrat, Gove, Irlanda, Navila, Rubí, Yami, and Bruno, the hotel's Kids Club team, were fantastic. They were very attentive, always looking after my children and the other kids in the club and participating in activities outside. While the overall service was good, the Kids Club team definitely stood out, along with the excellent service from the pool waitress, Mrs. Asunción, Mrs. Laura, and the bartender, Timoteo. They all deserve special recognition for their outstanding work, and we're eager to return because of their excellent service.

reviews.author: Tammy Alba
reviews.text: The hotel is lovely, the service has been excellent, the beach is beautiful and very close. When you come as a couple and choose the children's side, they ask if you'd like something more private and help you change without any problem. The food has been spectacular.

reviews.author: Laura Sanchez
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, the rooms are very nice, except I would suggest adding a light to the safe or closet, as it's too dark. It would be great if one of the pools had sun protection. It would be nice if they had a jacuzzi, or at least I didn't see one. They should also provide staff to at least clean the sargassum that accumulates during the day. The only thing I didn't like was that the bathrooms near the beach were very dirty, and they don't seem to take care of cleaning them continuously. The staff was very attentive, and the food was very varied, only the sweet bread lacked flavor. The specialty restaurants were delicious. I recommend it.

reviews.author: Melt Civ
reviews.text:
- Staff prefers to serve foreign guests
- Slow waiter service
- Less waste generated when refilling hygiene products
- Beautiful views
- Delicious snacks
- Food geared more toward foreigners, lacks much flavor
- Good atmosphere

I saw the hotel respond, and this is my update:
- I didn't get the hotel right. If the photos I uploaded are from theirs, what other hotel in Cancun looks similar?
- The reservation isn't in my name because it was a family reservation.
- I really think the waiters, especially those in the pool area, are very foreign-loving. Why?
They saw foreigners with their dollars out and served them first, even though we ordered first and tipped them.
Some of my relatives are dark-skinned, and when we went with them, the waiters took longer to serve us than when I went with just my boyfriend. One of my relatives was even denied an activity even though all the foreigners in front of her were offered it without any problems.

I found it a little ridiculous because the hotel has people of many nationalities, and the ones who are being rude are the Mexicans.
The service was very friendly from the "mole" establishment and also from the girl who sings at the taco bar, but the waiters in other places are veeeery slow, especially at the buffet, where they even take a while to bring you your cutlery.
It's understandable when the place is full, but there were days when there weren't many people and you'd see the waiters standing around, not serving you.
I'd also forgotten that the food tray they bring to your room sat at the door for almost two days because they didn't pick it up. They went through the plates and then left the yogurt and napkins lying around.
The hotel is very nice and very comfortable, with a good atmosphere and everything, but they should check the waiters more closely because even though you tip them, they also have salaries and should treat everyone equally and not bring drinks and cutlery until the food gets cold.
I hope they improve that because it is a good place.

reviews.author: Renee Moreno
reviews.text:
You'll find the best service at the Sante restaurant at the Reserves. All the staff: Natanael, Arnulfo, Axel, Miguel, Moisés, César, Joel, Josue, and especially Miss Estafany and the rest of the Sante team will make your stay an unforgettable experience. They were all kind, accommodating, supportive, efficient, diligent, courteous, and above all, humble in the great service they provide every day. More employees should be like them. They are an example for everyone to follow. They do their jobs with pride in a job well done, and it's obvious they do it with pleasure.
Also worth mentioning are Lai, Uri, and Bryan from Activities. These three individuals make a great effort to entertain guests with their daily activities, jokes, and contagious laughter.

reviews.author: Ciro Cocca
reviews.text:
The service at Ginger was incredible, especially from Gabriela, Salvador, and Ricardo. All three were super friendly and helpful. They were always willing to assist customers.
I asked for an adapter for my iPhone at the Concierge desk, and they sent me to Gomart to buy one... when they could have easily given me one.

reviews.author: Margaret García
reviews.text: Everything was very nice, comfortable, and the staff was super helpful. The food at the restaurants was very good. We visited the spa and had hydrotherapy and a relaxing massage, and it was a truly renewing experience. Our masseuse, Carmen, was very kind and gave us first-class service. Thank you.

reviews.author: Daniela Quiroga
reviews.text: The dinner at Lemon Fish was exquisite; the place was spotless, the service fantastic, and the food delicious. Our waiter, Jesús, served us and explained each dish with great kindness.

reviews.author: Edgard Punsky
reviews.text:
Beautiful place, large, great services, several restaurants and bars. The pool with its central bar is the highlight. The beach isn't the best, rough sea, but with little seaweed, which is great.

However, be very careful, don't believe the photos on Booking.com when booking rooms, as they post photos of renovated rooms, which are the best in the resort. Most are much older. We complained to one of the supervisors who was reluctant and said there was nothing he could do. Apart from that, the stay was very good.

reviews.author: SzczecinPirotechnik
reviews.text:
There's a problem with the refrigerator's daily maintenance—I have to call because no one has restocked it. And it's the same every day—every time, an apology, and the next day, the same thing, and it's been two weeks. SCANDAL—is this supposed to be 5 stars??? It's 3 stars at most.

But the rest of the service is OK, very nice and helpful people. At the Malya restaurant, there's a singing waiter named Alfredo—a great guy, thank you so much for such friendly service!

reviews.author: Tiago Oliveira
reviews.text: My experience at the hotel has been more than satisfactory. But I'd like to mention Renan, the waiter at the Agua Marina restaurant. Besides being the best restaurant in the resort in my opinion, the waiter was fantastic! A real standout!

reviews.author: Rafa
reviews.text:
The resort is wonderful, I stayed with the royal service included, where you have access to all the restaurants in the complex by appointment.
This differentiated service leaves you in a tower separate from the rest of the hotel, and because it is a space aimed at couples, they do not allow children.
It's impossible to describe how good everything is, from the smell of the common areas to the shampoos and soaps made by Mugler.
The only thing that bothered me a lot is the tips you have to give to the waiters. If you don't tip, the service gets much worse, in other words, you have everything included, NOT!
So I recommend setting aside some pesos if you want to have better service and not see a sour face, which shouldn't exist in a hotel of this category...

reviews.author: Petita Vera
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun: excellent service. The manager, Ricardo, at Malva restaurant, is excellent; he's welcoming and always available for anything the guest needs, attentive to everything. Agua Marina restaurant is also excellent.

Petita Vera
May 18, 2024

reviews.author: Mariana Muñoz
reviews.text: The staff is very attentive and friendly, the Wi-Fi is excellent, the rooms are clean, and the pool is great. The beach is very nice and has great views.

reviews.author: Laura Rodriguez
reviews.text: Hello! The best thing about the hotel is the Kidsdom. My girls really enjoyed it! Rubi and the rest of the girls are so nice. They offer different activities and workshops every day! They spend the whole day having fun with their friends! They loved the craft and art workshops! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: billinery hurtado
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful vacation at the Paradisus Cancun. The highlight was the customer service; a heartfelt thank you to Asuncion and Charly, two excellent people who were always ready to help us and made our stay very pleasant.
On the downside, the rooms are quite run down and it takes a very long time to clean them. ☹️

reviews.author: Fátima Chamorro Franco
reviews.text: The hotel itself is very well maintained, and the service was excellent overall, especially from Atilano Díaz, Julio, and Víctor (adults-only pool area). They were very attentive and always friendly. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Belen Hernandez
reviews.text:
Great service overall.
Congratulations to those who do their job with passion... Hostess Fanny at Flora, Bartender Eliseo at the pool, and all the staff who care about making sure you have a good experience.

reviews.author: araceli mendez
reviews.text: Richard and Ramiro were kind. All the staff at Malva were fantastic. They helped us with directions and recommendations for places to visit. Cielo Restaurant was very good.

reviews.author: Francisco Jiménez
reviews.text: The guys at the pool bar are attentive, friendly, and make amazing cocktails! Very helpful, especially Carlos, Leo, and Artemio.

reviews.author: Sebastian Marcet
reviews.text:
It's gone downhill a lot since my last visit in 2016. It's noticeably worse now; they charge extra for services they used to provide.
The restaurant reservation policy is a disaster. I tried to cancel at 9:30 AM and was told there was no more space available except at one restaurant. How is that possible? There was a strong smell of damp in the rooms.

reviews.author: Leonardo Ignacio
reviews.text:
I liked the hotel, but there was one thing that bothered me a lot: there were several kiosks and areas that only "VIP" people could enter, which I found somewhat uncomfortable. What I also didn't like was the bar's closing time; they close very early, and since we were with several friends, we always wanted to stay out drinking late, but it wasn't possible, and they didn't serve drinks in the rooms either.

I recommend it for couples or families. If you're going with just friends to have fun, I don't recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Aurora Sedano
reviews.text: Great place to relax. Fantastic beach. Excellent staff service. Special mention to Alejandro at the Nespresso station for his friendliness, cheerfulness, and great willingness to help.

reviews.author: Reynaldo Alonsoz
reviews.text:
Abraham's attention and shared knowledge at Bar Ginger 2 are fantastic. I highly recommend Abraham. The service from his colleagues Gabriela and Karina is also excellent.

The same cannot be said for the other bar; however, I respect their work.

AREA FOR IMPROVEMENT: The hotel's 11 pm closing time doesn't meet expectations. It conveys a sense of incomplete service and availability, as you generally expect to continue your meetings and enjoy a drink, which is cut short at 11 pm.

I must acknowledge the friendliness of the entire staff, who attend to and guide you in everything.

Thank you

reviews.author: daihyun kim
reviews.text: It is a nice place, but the tiles fall off when it rains, and I wish the finishing materials and such would be improved. The food is decent, but I got tired of it after eating it for more than three days. The people are friendly. The swimming pool is nice, but I wish it were kept cleaner. There is some sand on the bottom, and there are many places where the tiles or paint have peeled off.

reviews.author: Juan Carlos Gonzalez
reviews.text:
Pros
Very clean. Despite the building's age, it's well-maintained.
Good service from the staff.
Good mezcal.

Cons
Very "standard" food, nothing extraordinary.
The bar closes at midnight, and by 11:00 they only had beer in the sports bar.
When we arrived, they didn't explain anything, and we lost a night for not reserving a table at the themed restaurant. (TIP: Reserve dinner as soon as you check in)

reviews.author: Brenda C
reviews.text: I would like to mention that our waiter Jorge Ramos from Fish Lemon restaurant gave us one of the best services we have ever received and made our experience very memorable.

reviews.author: Jose Oceguera
reviews.text: The service we received from Didier, Eduardo, and Evaristo in the pool area was beyond excellent. If you come, look for them; the service you'll receive is top-notch. My family had a fantastic time.

reviews.author: gonzalo lamas
reviews.text: Very nice hotel, excellent location. The furniture is in good condition but old; they should be updated, as should the old, uncomfortable mattresses. The food and service were very good.

reviews.author: Paulina Alcocer
reviews.text: My only complaint was that the room I was assigned (4306) needed maintenance. We reported twice that the shower (tub) wouldn't stop running and that a non-slip mat was needed (since a child slipped and fell). They told us that both the water flow issue and the mat would be addressed and fixed within 20 minutes, which never happened. We couldn't even enjoy the shower because the water flow kept increasing and wouldn't stop.

reviews.author: George Lp
reviews.text: Overall, the place is perfect. The service at the Agave Azul restaurant with Atilano, Johana, and Aracely was excellent. There are no complaints about the other restaurants either. The problem was in the room: a terrible "view" of the sea, no hot water (I reported it three times and received no effective response), and some parts of the facilities look neglected.

reviews.author: Arturo Nava
reviews.text: All-inclusive. Excellent service. Food is generally good. Some dishes are very good, while others are unremarkable. Cleanliness is lacking in certain areas. Maintenance is constant. There is an adults-only area, but they should be stricter about keeping children away.

reviews.author: Russell Andrés Vargas Julca
reviews.text: Good infrastructure, average breakfast and lunch buffet (I had higher expectations, but it wasn't what I expected). Excellent beach access, I really liked it—pure white sand with no rocks or seaweed on the shore and turquoise water. What I didn't like about the hotel is that upon check-in, they ask for an appointment to discuss membership and are very persistent, requiring an hour and a half before offering discounts; and when you decline, they keep insisting. The food at the Market Grill restaurant is excellent, but you need to make a reservation.

reviews.author: Yandy Alfonso
reviews.text: Artemio is the best bartender, with great drinks and excellent service at the pool terrace bar. We also appreciate the warm welcome and attention Armando gave us at the buffet.

reviews.author: Rita Vazquez
reviews.text: The hotel is lovely and has many dining options. The food at Yellow Fish restaurant was delicious. Ernesto's service was outstanding. He was very attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: Stephany Cruz
reviews.text: Kidsdom: a great place for children. They have various activities, and the staff are very attentive to the kids. We were asked to make a keychain, and Juno helped us finish it even though the activity time was up. We really appreciated her. Super friendly!

reviews.author: Cecilio Rodriguez
reviews.text: The waiter Abraham at Lemon Fish was excellent. He treated us very well and was very friendly. Great service.

reviews.author: Joannie VH
reviews.text: The hotel is very good: clean, spacious, with plenty of restaurants, and the staff is prompt and attentive. The beach is always clean. However, the policy regarding chair reservations is not respected, and the frequent solicitations for timeshares are exhausting.

reviews.author: Deborah Santin
reviews.text: Annabel from Flora restaurant, excellent service! She took great care of us, and we were a large table!

reviews.author: Fcoart Francisco Castillo
reviews.text: The place is very nice inside, and all the staff are very friendly to both foreign and Mexican tourists. The rooms are pleasant. There's a private section of the hotel. They charge an exorbitant price for the sunbeds on the beach. The activities aren't that great. Overall, it's a nice place.

reviews.author: Luciana Alegre
reviews.text:
Excellent facilities: room, pools, restaurants, common areas, bars. The service from the waiters in each restaurant and at the Toji bar was outstanding. The shows were very good. The beach is beautiful!

The response at the front desk wasn't good when we made some complaints about the room's cleanliness. On several occasions, they asked if we were there for a special reason, but there was no special attention given to our honeymoon, which was a little disappointing.

reviews.author: Alejandro Fernandez
reviews.text:
It's excellent, without a doubt a first-class hotel. Once you check in, you don't have to worry about anything else, just relax, have a good time, eat, and drink. An excellent variety of different restaurants where you can eat whatever you want. Some require reservations for the evening. The best for me was Mole, excellent in every way: service, cuisine, quality of the products, etc. Tempo is a restaurant that isn't included in some packages; it's supervised by renowned Spanish chef Martin Berasategui. The menu is a 7-course meal accompanied by a similar selection of wines. It's interesting, but I wasn't impressed... like Mole, with good dishes, good quality, 100% Mexican food, and Mexican friendliness in the service and at the table. They also have other restaurants that serve grilled meats, another that serves sushi, another that serves Mediterranean tapas, and NAOS, which is open for all-you-can-eat meals on the different islands. You can have lunch and dinner there without a reservation; it closes between 5 and 6 to organize everything. The hotel's offering is excellent. It offers beach service, waiter service for drinks as often as you like, and you can also take your own food. The pool is beautiful with a bar.
The staff is first-rate, attentive, and friendly.
The only thing that frustrated me a little was when all guests were required to attend an informational meeting to purchase vacation time throughout the chain and with Melia partners worldwide. I endured a three-hour meeting where we toured the hotel, including the rooms, which are exclusive and different from the regular rooms when you purchase "time" (they're not timeshares). Everything was fine with Alberto, who told us about the benefits of this option, and I was kind in my attention and listening. But when it came to the main issue, when they offered me the package and I had no intention of purchasing it (it's worth noting that it's an interesting offer), a supervisor named Carolina appeared, who was incredibly intense, bordering on disrespectful, but oh well! Those three hours (or that hour that the young woman came) did not tarnish the rest of the vacation.

reviews.author: Mayra Garcia
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed the food and drinks; it's an excellent choice.
Jorge and Miguel's service was superb, and Kar3n and Marcos's food at Lemus Fish was very good.

reviews.author: רון צרנוב
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel
The meat restaurant is good but there are some bad cuts, we encountered a cut that was not cleaned properly and the overall experience was not good
The prices are very high
It is recommended to take a small cut

reviews.author: Juan Ronderos
reviews.text: Laura, who served us at the pool and pizza area, was very attentive to our children and pampering. The service was truly exceptional. I would definitely return. I highly recommend it if you want to have a spectacular experience without worrying about anything.

reviews.author: J.antonio Loyo
reviews.text: Pleasant stay, average rooms, furniture in poor condition, food and service at "Malva" excellent, Mr. Armando, Ramiro, and Johnny. Cielito Lindo, terrible service and food lacking authentic Mexican flavor; I don't recommend it as a 5-star establishment.

reviews.author: Mariana Preciado Andrade
reviews.text: I have visited this lovely hotel twice. It has a good beach, good food, and I also like its location and the attention of the staff in general, especially the kids from the Kids Club (Irlanda, Bruno, Gove, Yami, Montse) who made my son's stay very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Pablo Duran Ramirez
reviews.text:
Pros:
1. The hotel is very beautiful, surrounded by nature and with a lovely beach (without sargassum). I'm adding photos from November 2021.

2. The service from all the staff in the pool and restaurant area was very good.

3. The Reserve pyramid is excellent, with a small artificial pond and an area for drinks and snacks.

4. The à la carte food is very good, and almost all the restaurants are open for both lunch and dinner.

Cons:

1. The reception upon arrival at the hotel isn't very good; check-in takes a long time, and they don't offer a welcome cocktail, which I consider a nice touch.

2. The beach area is very neglected, and the service isn't very good since they assign very few staff members, which I consider a major drawback because, as a tourist, what I'm most interested in enjoying in Cancun is its beach.

3. Regarding The Reserve package, it's not worth it if you have children, as the package is primarily geared towards adults.

4. The concierge service wasn't good; I only saw him the day I arrived, and I never heard from him again except by phone.

reviews.author: Silvia Cara
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with excellent service, the food is plentiful but of low quality, the shows aren't as good as they used to be, ideal for a family vacation, thank you ✨

reviews.author: Vierik Project (Vierik band)
reviews.text: I love many of the spaces, and the overall design is very elegant and creative! The staff is wonderful! I would suggest a renovation of the exterior, but that might be asking too much these days. The gardens are gorgeous, and walking anywhere is a pleasure. The connection to the beach could be improved.

reviews.author: Lucas Rodrigues
reviews.text: Very nice hotel. Excellent service. Wonderful view of the beach. The beach in front is good for swimming. There are several restaurant options, although most require reservations many hours in advance, sometimes even a day in advance. This is a negative point of the place. It is also negative that you have to pay to use most of the beach bars or pool, except if you are a Royal Service guest, who already pays more.

reviews.author: Karla Rodriguez
reviews.text:
I loved my vacation 🩷 Thanks to all the staff who served us, especially Ivonne and Candelario for the lovely touch at breakfast on our last day.

The rooms were a bit old, and we didn't have a nice view and had poor lighting.

However, that was the only minor issue. I would definitely come back again. 🩷

My 4-year-old daughter really enjoyed the children's activities at the Kids' Club.

reviews.author: David valiente
reviews.text: The best thing about the hotel was the coffee at the coffee bar with Alejandro. The food was 3/5, the activities 4/5, but they charge extra for everything at the beach. As for the room and the hotel itself, no complaints, 4.5/5. It has a very family-friendly atmosphere, perhaps too much so. Overall, a good experience.

reviews.author: woohyun kim
reviews.text: I generally liked Paradisus, but there were some restaurant dishes with flavors I couldn't quite understand. Also, tipping the butler from the start is the way to go! If you do that, they just take care of everything. They provide amenities and clean the room frequently—they're amazing. Keep everything in the safe! In Mexico, if you lose something, you can't find it. Stay at least 5 nights to enjoy all the activities before you leave! We stayed for 4 nights, so it felt a bit short... You need to reserve the Bali bed when checking in and arrive between 7 and 11 pm to use it. In the evening, if you just show up, there are usually spots available, so they'll let you use it. We came for our honeymoon and are generally satisfied. We booked Royal Service, but some reviews say you get discriminated against if you don't, so I'm not really sure. Anyway, thank you so much.

reviews.author: juan david sandoval paez
reviews.text:
Flora restaurant had excellent service and the food was superb! Thank you so much for everything, Cinthia!
Lemonfish restaurant was amazing! Thank you so much, Jesús, for your attention. The best part was the chocolate dessert and matcha ice cream.

reviews.author: Karla Velázquez
reviews.text: The best place to relax, this beautiful hotel transports you to a pleasant sense of calm, like being in a spa. The hotel smells wonderful thanks to its different aromas that harmonize each space. The food, rooms, and staff service were all excellent. The only thing lacking is relaxation and comfort in the beach and pool area, as I find it distasteful that they charge for Balinese beds but don't provide enough lounge chairs and umbrellas for guests.

reviews.author: Maria Luisa Bleicher de Sibilia
reviews.text: Stunning hotel, excellent location, attentive and professional service. Very good food, but be prepared to wait for the restaurants. Since reservations aren't possible at some, you might have to wait up to an hour and a half. Some restaurants and dishes have an additional charge.

reviews.author: Guillermo Lopez
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, but the app for making restaurant reservations doesn't work; you can only make reservations until 6 pm, so you miss out on a lot of the service. Room service is good, but the air conditioning didn't work well. In my opinion, it's not worth the price per night. The location is good, and the staff is very friendly.

reviews.author: Mauro Kenji
reviews.text: Despite some issues with the reservation, the stay was pleasant. The staff is very attentive, especially Ivonn, Ignacio, and Rafael from the breakfast team at the Malva restaurant.

reviews.author: Jonas Santos
reviews.text: Jonathan from Jinger Bar is exceptional, practically only he and Mellin, who works at the pool bar; I can't offer the same opinion for the others.

reviews.author: Leticia Balderas
reviews.text:
Excellent service, a big thank you to Jesus and Franco. Congratulations on your highly trained staff!
Always with a smile and great charisma.

reviews.author: Antonio Moreno
reviews.text: Great place and beach, the food could be much better but everything else was excellent. The service at Kidsdom was very good, my son had a spectacular time thanks to Irlanda, Gove, Azul, Nabi, Yumi and Montsende Kidsdom and to Miguel Guest Concierge

reviews.author: Lizbeth Moreno
reviews.text: There's still sargassum. But you can swim in the sea without any problem. Service for drinks is slow while you're on the beach or by the pool, but they're very friendly. It's a shame the Balinese beds have to be reserved, because they might all be booked within the next two days. The butlers are very attentive and always ready to answer any questions. The spa's whirlpool is absolutely delightful and is open from 8 am to 8 pm. Enjoy!

reviews.author: H.A Rodriguez
reviews.text: I loved the hotel. Even though the facilities aren't very modern, my family and I had a great time. The service and attention were excellent! The best thing, without a doubt, was the beach, quiet and clean. We went with the family concierge service and were served by Gloria and Rodolfo. They made everything even more special. Their attitude was perfect for making our stay easier. The only thing that needs improvement is the nightly show; it's very simple, good but simple. Thank you, Paradisius.

reviews.author: Wy C.
reviews.text: The views from this resort are beautiful and Atilano from Blue Agave provided the best service, thank you!

reviews.author: Jacopo Scrivanti
reviews.text: It was a wonderful experience: very friendly and helpful staff, nice rooms, and excellent food in the restaurants. The only flaw is that the building itself is a bit cramped, but overall, it was an undoubtedly positive experience. Highly recommended for families with children.

reviews.author: Jayen Yang
reviews.text:
This is an all-inclusive hotel located in the Cancun Hotel Zone.

I really loved this hotel, from the entrance to the staff service. True to its name, everything is included, and you can eat and drink anytime, anywhere, whether at the beach or by the pool. I had a wonderful stay.

reviews.author: Silvia Torres
reviews.text:
Lemon Fish Restaurant is excellent!
The food was delicious, the dessert was amazing, our waiter Daniel's suggestions were perfect, and the service was very friendly.

reviews.author: Wicho Fernández
reviews.text: Very nice place, although the facilities could be better, but I like it... The service has improved a lot, and I gladly leave tips even if I'm on an all-inclusive plan. Beautiful location and excellent views!!! They just need to clean up the beach area, as there's trash left under the palapas by careless people who don't have the habit of cleaning up their space after using it. I'd like to return and see improvements!

reviews.author: Philip Mccleary
reviews.text:
Pascqual and Armando at the buffet were amazing. Very helpful.

Overall the resort has changed. We have been to Paradisus 4 times and this time the overall quality was just average. The food quality and variety was not good. It was the same food every day, salty and bland. We love the staff, but overall we are not happy with the hotel and will not be back.

Outside the hotel we also noticed the people were not as warm, inviting or friendly. It’s not the Cancún we remember and love.

reviews.author: Nophar Haimovitz
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel. Incredible beach. But everything else? Not great.

We arrived opening week and even though we knew there will be some kinks it was just not a good stay. And since this is not a new hotel I don't think it has anything to do with the reopening.
•	Dinner buffet was empty!! (multiple nights) with a huge line.
•	Almost no food during the day (no fruits and one snack bar)
•	Breakfast okay, lunch mediocre
•	Restaurants are hard to book and very slow in service
•	Zero!!! vegetarian options (I barely ate all stay). I had to beg for veggie food every night. They literally have nothing. And I saw a guy asking for a veggie burger and getting meat because the lady didn't understand).
It's ridiculous that at a hotel in Mexico there are very little unripe fruits (I mean no avocado no mango) no rice and beans. Really low quality food at the buffet.

Service was frustrating:
•	Everything had to be asked for multiple times
•	Drinks were warm (no cold beer or cold champagne)
•	No coffee capsules in the room (they were out)

Our Room issues:
We had a huge leak and while they fixed it (yay strangers in my room during vacation for 2 days) we were offered to move to a smaller, worse rooms instead of a real solution bc "we get what we paid for" (we paid a hefty sum!).

Most concerning:
Our 8-year-old got injured at the kids club and fractured his elbow. We spent a day at the local hospital and No follow-up, no real response from staff. No one cared.

Only reason this isn’t a total 0:
Our concierge Alejandro (and Josmarie) were amazing and genuinely tried to help. Without Alejandro this vacation would have been really bad.

There is potential here, the property is beautiful, the Italian & Asian restaurants are good, and the spa was excellent.

But right now? Would not recommend,  especially for families or vegetarians.

reviews.author: Daniel Bazzo
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun and unfortunately had a pretty disappointing experience overall.

On our last night, we found multiple roaches in the room, which was extremely unsettling. The nightlife also ends at 11pm, which makes it difficult to enjoy a proper evening out.

There are some positives, there are decent amenities for kids, and the upgraded slides were a nice touch. The beach itself is beautiful, but seating is very limited. There are not nearly enough umbrellas, which is a big issue when you have kids who can’t stay in the sun all day.

The resort is still under construction, which really takes away from the experience. On top of that, there were two conventions happening during our stay, making it nearly impossible to book reservations. It felt like everything enjoyable required extra money or becoming a member.

We were especially disappointed that we couldn’t enjoy a proper steak dinner as a family because kids aren’t allowed at certain restaurants. For a family resort, that doesn’t make much sense.

There were also safety concerns, tiles in the main pool were broken, and someone actually cut their foot. For a hotel that recently went through renovations, the quality of work seems questionable.

Management was another issue. We had reservations for 15 people at Kow Restaurant for my mom’s 70th birthday, but they split our group up. The same thing happened at the Italian restaurant, where they initially couldn’t accommodate us even though it was empty. After some back and forth, the manager Daniel stepped in and allowed 8 of us to sit at separate tables. He did make an effort by bringing out a surprise cake once he learned about the birthday, which we appreciated, but only 4 of us were actually able to share that moment together.

The staff overall were friendly and constantly asked for reviews, and while they do deserve recognition for their effort, it doesn’t reflect the overall condition and management of the hotel.

Vianney was absolutely incredible. We came in having a pretty rough day, and she completely turned the experience around for us. From the moment she greeted us, she was warm, attentive, and genuinely caring. She went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, and her positive energy made a huge difference.

Balthazar also did a great job. He was attentive, professional, and made sure everything ran smoothly throughout our visit.

It’s rare to come across a team that can shift your entire mood like that, but they did just that. Outstanding service and an even better attitude, they truly made our day. We’ll definitely be back because of them.

Between being understaffed, poorly executed renovations, and constant limitations unless you pay extra, I would not recommend this resort unless you’re okay eating buffet food daily and spending more for basic experiences.

reviews.author: Peter Williams
reviews.text:
Miguel is an awesome waiter and Lemon Fish is a beautiful restaurant with lovely food. Small portions but very delicious. Need to know what to order here.

The other restaurants also have some issues and I will write a longer review of the whole hotel after leaving. It is being renovated in June and not a moment too soon!

reviews.author: Julia Blazejewski
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I stayed here for 4 nights in early March 2025. After reading many five star reviews prior to arriving, we were surprised to realize that our stay did not match other guests’ experiences.

The room we received was in definite need of an upgrade; the bathroom was pretty run down, and the couch in the room had stains on it. We were not expecting a fancy room by any means because we knew we booked the most basic option. However, we were still expecting the room to be in good condition. Also, when booking, I was told I would receive a $200 credit to be used for a room upgrade. When we arrived, we found out only $50 of the $200 could be used for a room upgrade, which was not nearly enough. I had called the resort a couple months prior to clarify the credit, and even then, no one had informed me of the full terms of the credit. This felt very misleading.

We didn’t have any issues getting reservations at the restaurants, but the food was not good and not up to par with what should be served at a four-star resort. The service was not that great either. Some of the servers came off as slightly rude, and nobody really checked up on us. At Lemon Fish, we waited almost an hour for our server to take our order and bring our meal out. We also did not appreciate that the servers occasionally tried to up charge us by trying to sell the food and drink upgrade options, but not telling us they would cost extra unless we explicitly asked. The food at the buffet was alright, and was honestly a better option for dinner than the restaurants. The dessert options were bad; the ice cream by the pool was delicious though and one of the highlights of the resort. The drinks were good, but watered down which is to be expected at an all inclusive. The best drinks were at Ginger bar.

The resort is beautiful, and the beach and pools are perfect. I recommend waking up at 7-8 am to claim seating by the pool or beach, as it fills up pretty quickly. The resort also had nightly entertainment, which was nice.

All in all, if food and service are important factors for you, I would recommend staying elsewhere. I imagine that booking at The Reserve could make it a little more worthwhile though.

reviews.author: Sam Michlig
reviews.text:
The hotel is saved by it's fantastic hard working restaurant and bar staff. Every morning for breakfast (and often lunch) we relaxed on the outdoor terrace at the Buffet restaurant and were looked after by Alberto and Joni who were an absolute pleasure to talk to and excellent hosts. Thank you also to them from our 2 young children who were treated just as well as the grown ups.

We also enjoyed Aqua Marina where we were looked after by Erick, Wilbert and Sergio during the lunch service and Roberto in the evening.

Jesus at Capello, Melvin at Cielo and Daniel at Lemon Fish also are fantastic waiters.

For the people above, and for many more incredibly hard working staff around the pool and beach - they are working at 5 star standard all day long. Management need to look to themselves for areas that are making global review scores lower - and take the pressure off their employees.

The issue here at management level is greed. On the run up to the stay there was frequent contact from concierge services but only with a view to selling room upgrades or experience packages. Simple requests like a room on a higher floor or in a quieter area were squarely ignored once it was clear that no further cash could be extracted.

Fending off regular approaches from the 'circle club' sales team to attend seminars - not what I want to do on holiday. Some staff are clearly under pressure to sell upgrades for wine or 'chefs specials' and the daily rounds from the Spa and watersports excursions team. It can all lead to the need to say no thank you 10 times a day and walk around not making eye contact to avoid sales approaches.

The big problem with our stay was the room we were allocated on the first night. It was actively dirty with blood on the vanity worktop. Light switches were cracked, lamps didn't work and I killed 5 cockroaches in the bathroom. It was an extremely unpleasant environment and to top it all - incredibly noisy. This room was in dire need of renovation and shouldn't be in use currently for paying guests.

The response from reception was very disinterested - they processed a room change request which required me to return to reception at 0900 and again at 1500 to move room. Very disruptive to the holiday and absolutely zero concern about the state of the room. The reception team even suggested the next room might be in the same condition so there was no point moving. No apology was ever offered either.

The complaints process was dissatisfactory and I have since received a refund via my credit card company for the night spent in a dirty room. The hotel refused to refund but offered an upgrade voucher for a future stay which i declined.

The hotel itself occupies a huge amount of beach front and as a result has stunning views from all around the pool areas and lots of the dining and drinking areas. The building is old but there is a constant effort being made to maintain improve and re-paint areas. The food was excellent. Drinks selection also fantastic and the bar tenders in the mixology bar made incredible cocktails. Kanna Beach Bar is the perfect spot for the final drink before getting ready for the evening.

reviews.author: Mrs. Muñoz
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here for 5 nights. We loved the hotel and location. The decor and atmosphere is beautiful. The view of the beach is breathtaking.

The service unfortunately is not up to par and this is what didn’t make it the best experience we were hoping for.

Alondra who checked us in at The Reserve was very matter of fact, rude, and unwelcoming.  She didn’t welcome us with a smile when we arrived and didn’t even ask about our experience when we checked out. It was very revealing of her character and lack of professionalism.

Some of the employees who work at the other restaurants and buffets can also be very disrespectful with their actions and lack of professionalism. There was an employee who worked in the kitchen at the Malva Buffet who ignored me and rolled her eyes when I kindly asked where the omelets were being served, and had a bad attitude when I asked to speak to the person in charge about her actions.

On a positive note, I do have to say Gerardo who works as a server at the Malva buffet is very kind-hearted and cares about making your experience memorable. He went out of his way to always make sure we were cared for. Fernando at Blue Agave also stood out from the rest with his heart of service. Ismael at the spa was also patient and kind with us.

There are some kind employees there~ but it’s honestly a hit or miss.

They need to be consistent with their service and I hope they take this review as an eye opener to coach their employees  about the seriousness and importance of quality customer service.

reviews.author: Shanell Spann
reviews.text: Probably wouldn't choose this hotel again as there was a lot of wear/tear, but the grounds are wonderful for photos

reviews.author: Laura Hudson
reviews.text:
We purchased ocean view room and was given a room on the 0 floor that had no view. The air conditioning sounded like a jack hammer and the shower drain smelled horrible. We asked for a new room and was given one the next day on the 3rd floor. View was incredible. The next issue was we were above the lounge area so there was music bumping until 11pm.
Long wait lines checking in.
Room service food was always cold.
Food and service at the pool were the best.
Staff very friendly.
Beach was great.
Our last night they had some kind of sewer break or leak in the buffet area. They tried to stop it and clean but kept bringing people in to eat and the smell was horrible.
We will not go back.

reviews.author: mahtab ghafoorian
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at paradisus Cancún and overall had a nice time, but I was very disappointed with how a check-out situation was handled, especially considering the level of service I expected.

My flight was early, so we checked out at 6:15 AM, well before the official 12:30 PM check-out time. Breakfast was supposed to be served at 6:30 AM, and I kindly asked if we could enter the buffet 10 minutes earlier, just to grab something quickly before heading to the airport. The staff member (Henry) refused, which I understand might be policy — but what upset me was the dismissive attitude and the lack of willingness to even hear our situation.

Worse, after we checked out and our bracelets were cut (which the front desk said was fine), we kept our bracelets in our pocket, as we were still within our valid check-out time. Henry said we couldn’t access the breakfast buffet without a bracelet and would have to pay extra — even though we were still entitled to full service. When I explained this, he refused to speak respectfully or offer any help. I ended up going to reception to report the incident and ask for the manager’s contact.

The 24-hour Nespresso bar is a nice touch, but the pastries weren’t great, which is why I wanted a proper breakfast. I truly expected better customer service — especially in how staff communicate with guests in a rush or under stress.

It’s really a shame because, before this situation, I was very pleased with the resort and had a great experience overall. Unfortunately, the poor interaction with staff (Henry) has made me reconsider recommending this resort or returning again.

reviews.author: Paul Peterson
reviews.text:
The service was not good. Lines for food, for reservations. Room service tacos were terrible. You have to get your beer and bring them to the room. The restaurants meals were not good. There are not enough shaded areas around the pool. If you did not get a chair by pool by 8 am you are not getting one later. Our package included transportation from airport was not available so we were out $300 to make arrangements at the airport. We tried to upgrade to the adult side the reserve but no vacancies. The noi
se from the loud music outside and the noise inside the lobby area made it impossible to have a quiet rest. I could go on and on, by far our worst experience. The entire time I was washing we could check out and got  to Aqua Live.

reviews.author: Anthony Dinse
reviews.text:
The location is convenient especially with the aqua world directly across the road for some activities. The resort is beautiful in general especially the main lobby area. The service was usually pretty good with friendly wait staff across the resort. The food at most restaurants is average at best with little flavor. As many other posts noted you can probably stick to the buffet each day and have the same or better experience. The room was showing signs of its age. Fridge was broken and when they “fixed” it, while now cold it started making loud noises. I will say they acted promptly when it was brought to their attention. Most frustrating part of the stay as other also mention is the pool/beach seating situation. They allow other guests to place 4,5,6…etc towels on all the chairs in large sections at 6:30-7am. Those guests then sometimes don’t arrive to the pool/beach until 3-4 hours later since they “claimed” these seats. If you show up after 8am good luck finding a spot anywhere. And typically once they leave half the time they leave their towel instead of placing it in the bins so 80% of the chairs appear taken when someone left hours ago… pretty crazy situation every single day. Seems like a simple fix, but from other reviews they refuse to address it so it continues…
The service was spotty as well. On average someone would come by once a hour to ask for drink orders… sometimes more sometimes less. lovely resort and people but probably wouldn’t return due to the just ok food and the terrible pool/beach seating.

reviews.author: Elaina Prakash
reviews.text: Service review : Fantastic. The service of the reserve staff - Gabriela, Miguel, Luis and Victor at the Reserve was impeccable. Gabriela and Miguel, specifically went out of their way to make us comfortable at the Reserve pool. They were incredibly attentive and genuinely happy to be helping us. We didn’t even have to ask for drink refills. They were so attentive and made our time at the pool very fun and relaxing.

reviews.author: Ramiyan Sujeeve
reviews.text: The resort was alright... The view and pools were great, but the beach was off-limits (seaweed). Rooms were alright but renovations are needed. Overall a pretty solid resort.

reviews.author: Salena Navarez
reviews.text: Edgar in Capella restaurant was amazing. Best service the whole trip

reviews.author: Tim Rolfe
reviews.text:
This is a review of the Fahrenheit pool
Bar only, where Roberto and Juan Manuel are absolutely excellent. Really quick and attentive service. They represent only very few of the staff members that actually understand service. I would hire them!  Fuller review of hotel and experience to follow….

reviews.author: Vanessa Huang
reviews.text:
I spent 7 days in this resort and want to share my honest opinion.

Starting off with pros:
- We got a crib for our 1.5 year old in our room on the day we arrived with no extra charge
- The staff, especially the servers are kind, enthusiastic and accommodating. The servers in the restaurant were super accommodating and made special meals for my 1.5 year old, which I appreciate so much.
- The entire resort is very clean and pretty
- There is a kids club where you can drop off your kids and they have activities to keep them entertained

Cons:
- We found out that the corn in the buffet was spoiled a couple times
