Only white peoples are served well was noticed in our entire stay for a week so none white peoples think twice before booking. Restaurants reservations is a big scam as they only give you those that are not working with you times.

reviews.author: chiaowei yu
reviews.text:
Our experience at Paradius Cancún was far from what we expected. We paid extra for a package that included airport shuttle service, but the ordeal we went through was incredibly frustrating. Despite providing our booking information well in advance and attempting multiple follow-ups via email and phone calls (which included getting hung up on twice), we never received confirmation. Upon arrival, their shuttle company couldn’t locate our reservation and suggested we take a taxi and get reimbursed at the hotel. However, when we reached the hotel, they outright denied any reimbursement, claiming we hadn’t arranged the trip—even though we clearly had.

While the restaurant staff were pleasant, the core customer service left much to be desired. At check-in, we asked for an overview of how the hotel operates, including dining options. Shockingly, the front desk staff couldn’t provide answers. We later found out from other guests that except for the buffet, all other restaurants required reservations, which could only be made at a specific desk with unreasonably long lines every single day.

This was the worst experience I’ve ever had at an all-inclusive hotel. Guest services were not only unhelpful but downright rude. One staff member even mocked our attempts at speaking Spanish, which was both disrespectful and unprofessional.

To make matters worse, the quality of the accommodations was disappointing. Both our room and our friends’ room (who paid extra for better service) had issues. Our power went out, and our door was so poorly maintained that it let in noise all night, making it hard to sleep. The hotel itself gives off a nice impression initially, but everything feels poorly maintained, as if held together with glue.

It’s unfortunate because this hotel has potential, but the lack of upkeep.

If you’re looking for a luxurious experience with worry free services - this is not the hotel you’d want to spend your vacation at.

reviews.author: Pratibha Gaglani
reviews.text: We went over the new year break, paying higher than normal rates. Our room wasn't given to us until 3 pm! We were there an hour or so early. One of the days the rooms did not have water for several hours!!! Although the location is awesome, food is pathetic..like a 0.. booking a restaurant and finding a table was so difficult and painful. On new year eve restaurants charged 50$ per head or 90$ for the party. Anything of interest had an extra price tag. Money minting tactics. Disappointed beyond the location!!!!! Never again.

reviews.author: Info TJG
reviews.text:
Food was mid At the buffet.
Lemon fish and Sal are only upgrade restaurants I recommend with good food.  (unfortunately there was a roach in our plate.)
Location  is excellent
Lobby was excellent
Reserve manager aelissia not great.
Enrique our concierge as many others on reserve were not super helpful and was becoming difficult and argumentative when we notified of our poor experience.

reviews.author: mohit bhatia
reviews.text:
Disappointing Start to Our Stay at Paradisus Cancun

I'm writing this review after our first day at Paradisus Cancun, and unfortunately, it's been a disappointing experience so far. We arrived at the resort excited for our vacation, but the check-in process was a nightmare. The queue was incredibly long, and it took us over an hour to get checked in. This was not the welcome we were expecting.

Once we wait for our room, we were looking forward to exploring the resort and trying out the food. Unfortunately, the food was just average, and what's worse, there was no allergy information label available with food, it’s either missed or wrong label. As someone with food allergies, this was a major concern for me. It was very difficult to identify which foods were safe for me to eat, and we had to rely on the staff to provide us with information, which was not always accurate.

Overall, our first day at Paradisus Cancun has been a letdown. We're hoping that things will improve over the next few days, but for now, we're disappointed with the service and amenities.

*Rating:* 2/5 stars

*Recommendation:* If you have food allergies, be prepared to ask a lot of questions and take extra precautions. Also, consider arriving early for check-in to avoid long queues.

I hope this review helps others who may be considering staying at Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Evelyn Lu
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful and the facility is nice  although you can tell it’s dated. Staff are nice to your face , however , when we arrived , we gave a big tip to our concierge , only to find out later on that she was not really our concierge and was only leading us to our room. When she greeted us, I asked point blank if she was our concierge for our stay until the end. She said yes, and that was a lie. Our real concierge still has not added me on WhatsApp , as front desk mentioned he would. So be cautious of staff not being truthful on some occasions

reviews.author: S. M.
reviews.text:
received an injury in the room and the hotel management extremely elusive when I tried to bring up a safety concern.  Eventually I was able to reach an understanding with the general customer service but it was a bit of a cat and mouse game for something that was straight forward.

I wasn't happy with the experience overall. I would stay here again. the area in general looks good. The beach is clean and amazing. would consider trying near by properties like the Marriott

reviews.author: Chuck Leisinger
reviews.text: My first all inclusive experience. Rooms were dated and worn, holes in sheets, fixtures seemed rickety. Food was plentiful and some of it was quite good but most of it was not very good. I would say there is 1-2 standout options at each themes restaurant and if I could have gotten things a la carte from each place I would have given the food a solid 4 stars. Some staff were above and beyond helpful and some were clearly so so so unhappy with their work and with tourists. Different areas of the hotel had a foul smell but some of it smelled heavily of the air fragrance. The pools closed at 7pm, way too early! The coffee station frequently out of ice, out of milk, only one person working. Never enough towels out in the pool area and the only way to get towels is to talk to the excursion hawkers. The plants and fountains inside were really nice and made for a charming atmosphere. The convenience store inside had very limited options for purchase in terms of snacks and beverages and always seemed to have issues with the point of sale system.

reviews.author: DeAndra
reviews.text:
I honestly think giving two stars is being generous. I stayed for my bachelorette trip and was extremely disappointed.
1) the room we booked through the website did NOT look like the room we were in. It was super outdated and the room on the website looked more updated. We booked the Premium Suite Sunset View.
2) there was baby roaches in the room!!
3) we got back to our A/C leaking so bad it was flooding our room by the front door. We went down stairs to let the front desk know. Came back to it still leaking. Called the front desk again letting them know it was still leaking but would be gone for dinner however we didn’t care if they entered. Came back again STILL leaking. I’m assuming a worker was waiting for us because he happen to scare us. Due to the language barrier, we really couldn’t communicate. He did tell us it’s leaking because of the a/c… as if we didn’t already know that and that management would have to fix it. Why didn’t management fix it the first time? Overall very frustrating.
4)  The other sliding door would not shut all the way, almost like it was stuck. It didnt really bother us bc we were sleeping in the other room. It ended up getting really hot in that room. We later found out if the sliding door is not shut correctly the a/c will not turn on. Yet, another broken thing in the room.
The overall resort was beautiful buy our room was giving super cheap. So i say it was waste of money, would not recommend this resort or stay again.

reviews.author: Ushasrireddy Devireddy
reviews.text:
We had an Ok experience at this resort. Resort looks beautiful with tropical vibe however the air conditioning is very poor in all the areas except your rooms.We were there in January, and this is our experience imagine the situation in Summer. Rooms are outdated and during our stay the bathroom started to look and water started dripping, however room service was responsive and addressed the issue. There was a big cockroach in the bathroom on our last day at this resort, I didnt care to complain since we were leaving anyways.

Food is a night mare at buffet, dont even attempt. Driest desserts and cold food. If you are a vegetarian, except for salad, some potatoes there is nothing much.Food is better in the restaurants but you need to reserve them for dinner and only two are open during the day for lunch. Pizza place is ok.

If you are travelling with younger kids, there is nothing for them to do except the pool.

reviews.author: Jasmine Cano
reviews.text:
I’m going to write a very honest review. I stayed at Paradisus in 2016, and I had such an amazing experience. It truly felt like a resort. Fast forward to 2024 my impression on the hotel has completely changed.
Here is my review:
- If your stay consists of any rain, then your room is at risk of water leaking into your room. My sisters room completed flooded & mine leaked with water. I had to put a bunch of towels by the window to prevent water from going everywhere.
- Hotel is old & you can see paint coming off the walls, looks like it has not been renovated in years.
- You will see towels randomly on the floor in the atrium due to water leaking inside building.
- Food is okay, nothing special. Pizza bar by the pool was good.
- Staff is nice and helpful, but only when you tip good.
- Towels have been downgraded from 2016. They are cheaply made now.
- Buffet gave me a really bad stomach bug

Overall, I would NOT stay here again.

reviews.author: Khamsang Kai
reviews.text:
We stayed here for a week and had a mixed experience. On the positive side, the food was fantastic, and the beach was beautiful—definitely the highlights of our stay.

However, there were significant issues with the room. When we checked in, we found a drill and several nails left on the sofa.On the balcony, we faced a more alarming situation: my two-year-old found a cigarette butt and put it in his mouth. Upon inspecting the area, we discovered numerous cigarette butts scattered on the floor of the balcony and deck—an obvious safety hazard for young children. We were too exhausted to request a room change after our journey.

Also there was cockroach on one of buffet section. !!!

reviews.author: Nicholas Gingras
reviews.text:
Just came back from my trip there.
Pros : Nice beach, the hotel public spaces are beautifull, staff members are very friendly and food is always available and you can always find something to eat.
Many mant activités for kids. Okay rooms, good A/C.

Cons : You will never be allowed to swim in the ocean at the resort. On a day with little to no wind flag was still red and lifeguard running after you if you go into the water. You can always go swim to neighbor resorts who were yellow most of the time.
There is not enough chairs at the pool/beach and people are fighting over it. Not sure if its on purpose, but you can rent a cabana for 250$ USD per day if you want to make sure to lay down somewhere other than the ground.
So many things at the other are only available to their elite members (somewhere to lay down at the pool, some restaurants, many meal choices at the restaurants, etc.)
We made sure when we booked to call the resort and ask if it was possible to get adjacent rooms since we were travelling with a baby and parents to make it easier. When we got there they told us it wasnt possible to put us on the same floor.

reviews.author: Milena Quintana
reviews.text: i came here for a wedding and not only did our coordinator not show up to the rehearsal but showed up late to the ceremony leaving our guests waiting for 30 minutes past the excepted time. and we payed for the “elite” wrist band or package whatever, we were denied access by the workers to the stuff we should have been granted. constant bug and leakage problem in the rooms. the chairs by the pool do not recline at all and are at a very uncomfortable angle. there is also some loud music somewhere late at night, no matter the location of your room. waited 1 hour for room service. to add, at the end of the wedding the bride and groom wanted everyone to jump in the pool next to the reception, and right as we jumped in the coordinator finally did her job and yelled at us to get out. the poolside service was pretty good, special thanks to dirdir and jose who showed excellent efficiency.

reviews.author: mariam caceres llorente
reviews.text: We had the family concierge ocean view room. We are a family of 4, bathroom doesn’t have door, the pillows smelled rotten, in general the cleaning was okay. Snack bar was poorly stocked on daily basis, in my whole one week stay shower cap was never replaced. No soap bars, gown and slippers are provided upon request that’s not what you expect from a 5 star pricy hotel. We did enjoy every o however will not recommend. The hotel is way to pricey for its quality. Also the family concierge main desk no body is ever around. Trust me at Thai resort you are not getting what you paid for.

reviews.author: vivekjs s
reviews.text:
This a review to the OTIUM desk at Paradisus Cancun resort specifically. An agent works for OTIUM called Miguel met us in swimming pool. We booked coco bongo ticket from him with the promise that he will give us coco bongo Souvenirs for the general admission  fee of $87.
He was supposed to come and give the Souvenirs next day. Even after multiple follow up s and asking other agents at thr desk, he was keep lying saying he will come and hand over. Until we left the facility he never showed up. There is no advantage of booking through them. You get the same price at the coco bongo entrance itself.

Be careful with this guy Miguel if at all you are booking any activities with him at Paradisus. We are ok even if there was no souvenirs, but the way he was keep lying about it and make us wait for him to arrive was not acceptable and unpleasant experience.

Paradisus is a great resort. No complaints about the resort. We had great time at the resort.

reviews.author: Amanda Adamic
reviews.text: I wanted to like this place, but I just hated it. There is not enough outside seating for guests and no shade. The umbrellas were few and far between. The beds and covered cabana areas they charge $250 per day, trying to hock it like the champagne is worth it. The inside is nice enough but a little maze like. Food and drinks were just okay. We were in a room directly by the smoking area and music would be played loudly during the day. There were private events with an entire pool area shut down for the day so the very limited space became even more cramped. There are nicer, larger resorts to choose for the same price. Also, you have to use an app to order room service- which is an extra charge. For an all inclusive, that should be included. Spa prices are high. Edit: The cost of sunblock is $50 and the additional costs of the restaurants that are not included are ridiculously expensive. $300 for 2 people to have steak.

reviews.author: ST
reviews.text: By far the worst "all inclusive" resort I've ever been to. WAY too few beach and pool chairs, to the point where we had to spend minimum 30 minutes hunting for chairs every day. The food is pretty bad, and I also got food poisoning (don't eat the fish if you do go here). Lots of upcharges for basics at a supposedly "all inclusive" hotel (better meals at the restaurants, better drinks at the bars, room service, etcetera). Tons of salespeople constantly trying to sell everyone crap all over the property. The bed in our room was very uncomfortable and made it hard to sleep well (and worth mentioning for reference, I normally sleep particularly well). To give them credit where it's due, the service at the beach and pool bars was good, most of the staff is very friendly, and the beach is very nice.

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I went to Cancun for new year’s and had a lackluster experience at Paradisus.
TLDR: not worth the price, many inconveniences, could most likely find much better service for the same price somewhere else

We’ve never done an all inclusive but wanted to go to cancun for a relaxing trip and spend our time in the resort. We stayed for 3 nights. The staff was very friendly and spoke/understood english. However, there were many inconveniences that did not make this place worth it. The most annoying thing was the power would go out in our room periodically. At first we called the front desk and they said it was a breaker issue. However, it kept going out and for some reason we would have to open our door and then close it for the lights to come back on. Not sure what the issue was but it was definitely inconvenient. Also I know it wasn’t the lights being motion censored because the power for the outlets charging my phone would stop working as well. Secondly, you have to make all dinner reservations in person. We waited in line for an hour on our first morning to make a reservation for new year’s eve dinner. Their NYE special dinner event was $90 per person and we did not think that was worth it considering the food we had thus far wasn’t great. There was no big NYE celebration for guests unless you paid for the event. It was frustrating that we wasted an hour waiting in line for this.

My boyfriend had called ahead of our stay and booked a massage and facial for us. However when we went to the spa for our appointment, they couldn’t find it and said they were booked up for the day. They were able to get us a spot for the next day but it was inconvenient since we had planned our morning/day around the spa appointment we thought we had. The spa experience itself was nice but it was quite expensive, over $300 for the both of us for the hydra therapy (which was “free”) and a 50 min massage. The massage was nice but I’ve had better in NYC for less than $100 for an hour long treatment. On our last night we ordered room service and were told it would take 40 minutes. After over an hour our food hadn’t arrived and we had to call to make sure we would still be able to get it.

We tried to make transportation accommodations to the airport but were told it was only for guest who stayed 4+ nights, otherwise it was $85 which was quite expensive considering the drive was only 30 minutes. We ended up booking a shuttle through a separate company for $45

The only good thing about this place was the pool service and private beach. However, we had to wait 30 minutes to get towels on the first day (we went out around 12 pm). I understand we went at a busy time of year and the place was likely very booked but things like that just did not make this place worth it for the price. The next day we went out at 10 am and still weren’t able to find seats around the pool or beach. And any resort in cancun would get you the same kind of pool/beach service so it wasn’t exactly special.

reviews.author: Allie Katz
reviews.text:
I don’t typically leave reviews, but my experience of Paradisus Cancun was NO WHERE near what I hoped or expected, especially given the cost.

By no means was everything awful. The public spaces in the resort were largely quite lovely and pleasant to be in. The resort was large and didn't feel overly crowded, though around meal times the parts of the resort where most of the restaurants were could get quite busy. The spa was small but nice and the massage therapists were fantastic. It felt like certain staff members went above and beyond and some of the food was quite tasty.

But that’s kind of where the pleasantness ends. The whole resort in a lot of ways felt like a bait and switch. We bought into the premium all-inclusive package, or The Reserve, as they call it, which supposedly included access to an adult only area in the resort, premium alcohol and food, and a private concierge. The adult only area was fine, though not particularly large, and the private concierge was helpful, but even though we were lead to believe that we would have access to everything as part of the Reserve, we would discover later that premium alcohol was only included within the sectioned off parts of the resort, and that large chunks of every restaurant were an extra charge. Not just a supplemental charge, but paying full price. This felt like a huge betrayal of the all-inclusive mentality, and the constant up selling of these extra charge items felt quite inappropriate. God help you as well if you AREN’T part of the Reserve, because then they really slap you with extra charges for everything. Bali beds by the main hotel pool cost around $225 for the day. At least we got those included in our private section of the resort.

The resort itself is quite run down and in need of renovation. We had to move rooms because our first room was full of broken things, like door handles and towel racks. Our second room was better, but still had a broken toilet seat and holes in the walls where stuff used to be. You can find things in poor condition all over the resort if you look. The rooms themselves also felt sparse and plain compared to the photos where the walls were painted and the room was smartly decorated. I’ve stayed in worse rooms, but given the cost of this place, I expected a lot better than this.

Service in the resort was a mixed bag with both extreme ends of the spectrum. Some staff were incredibly helpful and attentive and seemed to want to create a nice experience, where others were very checked out, or seemed untrained and confused. The people walking around upselling excursions or asking to come listen to a 90 minute presentation selling their 'exclusive membership' (think time share but maybe worse) were also a bit much and not what you want when you're trying to relax. I feel bad because clearly some folks are trying really hard, but on the whole their effort is not enough to make up for all the short comings of this place.

There's just a pervasive cheapness to this place that feels like it goes hand in hand with all the upselling. The lack of physical menus anywhere, QR codes that lead to broken web pages or apps that barely function, and cheap plastic cups instead of glassware everywhere but the nice restaurants. Menu items would arrive missing ingredients, if they were available at all. Corners seemed to have been cut everywhere, and it's not what you should get when you're spending as much as you are to stay here.

Tldr: this place is pretty on the surface, but it’s run down and not a true all-inclusive resort in the end, instead it’s one where only half of the offerings are actually included and you’ll get pushed towards spending more money at every turn.

reviews.author: Karla W
reviews.text:
We were really looking forward to stay in this hotel but it was not what we expected.
Before checking in, we called the hotel to confirm our reservation, we got transferred to front desk but they never picked up.
My husband emailed the hotel a couple of times hoping to set up a birthday amenity since we were coming in to celebrate my birthday, they never responded. No big deal.
When we checked in, front desk people were not the friendliest. We ask if there was any ocean view upgrades available since we were there for a celebration, they could only offer a lagoon view for extra $200 per night so we opted out on that one. After checking in, we had the worst room possible. EXTREMELY outdated. We had a parking lot view. The bed was dirty, when flipping the blankets there were chunks of hair. The tub was falling apart and so on. Also, they did not replenish the mini bar for a couple of nights which we had to ask multiple times every day. We called the front desk to ask if there was an opening on any other rooms but they never picked up so we had to walk to the front desk and ask. When we got to front desk, there was no guests and they were not busy at all and just talking to each other. When my husband asked for the room, they just straight flat out said no.
This place does not care if you are there for a celebration or what. Not even a greeting when mentioned not that it mattered but it would have been appreciated at least.

Restaurants-
Buffet was not the best food.
We had upset stomach on one of the nights we stayed
Lemon fish was a long wait. We got in at 9:30pm and about 15-20mins we got our food they told us it was already last call. Sushi was awful.
BLUE AGAVE was the only restaurant that was really good. Tacos were 👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻

Drinks- almost all the drinks we ordered were watered down. Not strong at all. We liked hanging out at the bar area at Kanna Beach Club because the view from the bar was amazing but the Bartenders are not the friendliest either. Looks like they are always hassled when you order.
There was one bartender there who worked at night shift named Salvador I believe who was really nice.

Ginger bar was the bar who had a nice bartender named Christian. He made our martinis really good and down to the tee. We were impressed because he was not like the other bartenders from the other bar who just hands you a drink full of ice.

Paid ton of money to stay at this resort only to be getting mediocre service.

We loved the beach front of Paradisus though. The beach was Phenomenal!

reviews.author: Rukhsar Nadeem
reviews.text: Don’t come to this resort if you’re planning to be relaxed and enjoy your vacation. Everything here comes with some issues, and nothing is smoothly done. They call it “all inclusive” but there’s tons of things that are excluded from their so called “all inclusive” resort. For instance, the pool cabanas are only given to you for free for 2 days and after that you have to pay for it. The cabanas on the beach are 250+ dollars for one day. They have completely misunderstood the concept of “all inclusive”. It’s a literal scam. Another issue is how outdated the resort is, it needs massive repair and renovations. The walls are leaking, doors are falling apart and bathrooms are never cleaned consistently. Me and my husband came to Cancun last year and stayed at “live aqua” and it was the best experience ever and therefore, we decided to come back to Cancun and since this time we were traveling with family, we decided to stay at paradisus. Overall, very inconsistent, rude service and overall unpleasant experience for us.

reviews.author: Tom Hong
reviews.text:
I could tell the place used to be nice, but the way it has aged the building is falling apart.  You could see a lot of spots in the complex that were leaking.  Including in our room when it rained there was water leaking into the room and all they did was mop up the water.
We advised several times that the mini fridge was broken and they didn't do anything about it.
The only good thing was the food, which was okay.  We tried all the restaurants (except for the steakhouse) and they were all good along with the service.
Restaurants would not change my opinion in coming back to the facility.  An aged resort that really needs major face lift.

reviews.author: Lukasz Jagiello
reviews.text: Super outdated hotel and not very clean. It’s my 3rd stay in Meliá property and by far it’s the worst one. Super crowded, line to get to breakfast was 1.5h+, dinner at buffet at 9:30 was still with a line for 15min. The staff completely don’t know what to do with the chaos. Food wise everything is not seasoned, dried, without any taste. Really horrible experience but if you’re going to pay extra $270 for cabana suddenly the food is good again so they just don’t care about regular guests.

reviews.author: Ryan Rahim BA e-PRO ABR and PSA
reviews.text:
Where do I start? We had a 2 hour wait time to check in. We were promised an ocean view room and they said no to that because they had a convention and did not have the original room for me. Then they gave me a room on the bottom floor that faced a grass hill that smelled like mold in the room. I told them that I could not stay in that room because the mold smell was too strong they knew about this and agreed. They were able to accommodate finally after the day was over. Our new room was OK and had an ocean view. I was happy for the moment. Till all the problems begin. The toilet handle broke 3 times and the toilet got stopped up 1 time. Our wrist bands did not work 4 different times and we had to go to the lobby to get it fixed multiple times and we were in the farthest tower. They overbooked this hotel and have 1.5 hour or more wait time for restaurants and do not allow you to reserve them. The next option is to go to the buffet, which the food was ok. There were multi leaks throughout the various towers/ building. They do have pros to this hotel... the pool/beach is amazing, the staff is overall very nice. The main pyramid was nice. Overall pictures in general and what you think you are getting are a little off. I would consider a newer hotel or better brand. Will not visit this brand of hotel again. Wish I could tell you differently.
P.S. As I was being asked to listen to an hour presentation of the hotel there were leaks and a garbage can collecting the water right next to the sales person thought that was hilarious.. What a sales pitch. LOL!

reviews.author: Jenna Grounds
reviews.text:
I contemplated writing a review but I wouldn’t want anybody to experience what I did.

Pros - Lily, she is one of the most accommodating and responsive associates I came across here. She is the reason why I didn’t leave on my second day here.
The food is okay, it’s not terrible.
The beach area is beyond kept and beautiful, the waves are rough here though so if you like to swim at the beach then this isn’t for you.
Amenities are good
The smell of the reserve area was everything
The sunset cruise was included free of charge
This hotel is aesthetically gorgeous.

Cons -
We arrived early to check in (11a) and were told to wait 4 hours for our room…… requested a Manager and never talked to one, I practically had to get up and find one… never found one, I then met Lily and expressed my concern.
The quality of food and food options.
There are up charges all throughout the hotel which negatively impacted my experience. We were incorrectly charged for 2 drinks at Cielo, which was about $55. (Picture below)
The staff basically ignored us at the pool area
The pool is very WARM and low in elevation
The drinks are not top shelf, just full of sugar. They have bars with top shelf but will charge you about $20 per shot. They have coconuts at the Beach and charge you $10 for these and only have coconut water????
My room was so HOT (80°F precisely), we called on maintenance 4 times throughout our stay and had to request fans. We couldn’t even leave our window open.
The property could use  updating
The adults steakhouse has minimal options with subpar food, the best food was honestly the pool restaurant and Mexican.
There is no beach attendant??
They advertised cabanas to be included with The Reserve but this solely means pool cabanas and They must be reserved 24 hours in advance, the beach view are $160 and you have to buy a food package… at a resort?? ALSO they have 6 whole chairs that lay flat for tanning, the rest are permanently adjusted at an angle.
The towels in the bathroom are ROUGH
Oh, also transportation is not included as advertised on their website so expect $100+
There was an issue also with my room upgrade, I requested and paid for an ocean view with 2 beds. I was then emailed and quoted a lower price by their in house reservation team and they did not offer a refund or credit for the difference I paid.. instead I was charged for the upgrade a second time upon checking Out and They practically held us and held our transportation until this was resolved. I showed the emails, receipts, and conversation but was treated less than human.

I mean I could go on for days.

Overall, I would not stay here again or recommend it. There are hotels that check boxes of all necessities needed to enjoy your stay. (This is coming from someone who’s traveled to Mexico over 20 times). Expect a bill at check out… even though this is a all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: Luciana
reviews.text:
This hotel does not offer the same quality and service than in the past. The favorite word of the waitresses is “there is no more” . They constantly run out of simple food like avocado or salmon. I cant believe that a 5 star hotel doesn’t have basic foods and they constantly run out of stuff early in the day. No avocado in the morning at 9:00 am and no more salmon for lunch at 13:00. Food tastes average or disgusting. They dont offer good quality licors. If you ask for a cocktail with a good vodka they are spiking it with a low quality alcohol behind your back (i found them doing this). The majority of the waitresses treat you like they are doing you a favor. We are in the adult section paying higher prices and its simply not worth it.
Save yourself your money and dont come here. Price quality NOT WORTH IT.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Burandt
reviews.text:
I am 75 years old and spent my first visit (Christmas Eve 2023) to Paradisus Cancun cold and uncomfortable on a pull out sofa with no sheets, blankets, or cover of any kind. I called three separate times, even spoke with a supervisor,  to ask for covers.  Each time I was told they were coming.  They never came.  I had to get towels from the bathroom to cover up.

The next morning I asked the maid why there were no covers in the room already for the sofa bed and she said it was because they didn't know if someone would be using the sofa bed.  This makes no sense because we booked the room for 3 people.

I complained to everyone in person the next day and was told they would make it up to me by delivering an amenity, a bottle of champagne, to my room. This was hardly sufficient considering I got little sleep.  They didn't deliver champagne--only a bottle of Merlot-- which none of us drinks. I complained to many people over the five days we were there and NEVER received anything different.

There were very several large leaks in the hallways that we had to step over the whole time we were there. There were 3 or 4 bathrooms next to Sal, the very nice restaurant, and not one of them had any toilet paper. I had to tell the restaurant manager.
There were 5 empty plastic cups outside our room for days.  I finally threw them away myself.

The restaurant situation was EXTREMELY frustrating.  They do not accept reservations at the inclusive restaurants which is ridiculous. On  2 nights we bought the all inclusive pass and could not get a seat at any restaurant--we tried them all-- without a 2 hour wait. One of these nights we ate at the buffet out of desperation--never again. The food was inedible--overcooked, tasteless.  When we complained we were told that it was it was the Christmas holidays. Surely hotel management could have planned for this. We ate at SAL (pricey and not included)two nights and while expensive, the food and service were outstanding.

My impression of this hotel was very bad. Everyone paid "lip service" to wanting to exceed our expectations.  No one actually did anything to meet our minimum expectations.  Sheets are really not too much to ask.

I don't ever want to go back.

reviews.author: Ellie Booth
reviews.text:
We recently traveled here with our kids during Spring Break. I have some positive feedback and some  not positive feedbacks. First off we have stayed in other paradisus before, this our first time in this Cancun hotel. It was a beautiful hotel, Beautiful beach and fun pool atmosphere for the kids. Although getting up at 630 daily on vacation to get chairs at beach and pool was quite frustrating. I know this comes with the timing.  We upgraded for Nikte service. Daniel was great to work with and he did every request we asked of him. By day two he really stepped it up.
I can’t imagine what our days would’ve been if we did not have him. Luis at the pool was also awesome in helping us with cabanas daily! They get 5 stars. We unfortunately can only give the food to one star. We honestly struggled with this food as we have been to Mexico over 10 times and this is our first time where we really couldn’t find food that we liked for us in our family, ( minus the pizza bar) we would fill up on this as was only really confident option for us.
my husband actually got food poisoning at the Buffet the first night eating raw  fajitas Unfortunately has been treated for a parasite and been sick for 12 days
The buffet was just so inconsistent, and seems like they brought in the garbage for spring breakers.  The Italian restaurant was rough on service and served raw pizza.  We we’re definitely disappointed with the food so unfortunately will not recommend this location. My son was charged as an adult at 15 and so we spent a lot for a full week and we all lived on pizza.  I have much more to say. But if you a foodie, I wouldn’t choose this location

reviews.author: Ashley A
reviews.text: The service at this hotel made up for everything being a bad hotel experience. We attended this hotel with 3 other groups and each of them had a problem with their rooms. The AC would leak a lot of water, AC would feel hot and cold, one of the rooms had a roach, & the lights would stop working at a certain time. We also paid extra for an ocean view just to realize our door wouldn’t open properly so we couldn’t open the door the whole trip. The looks of the pictures and the price we paid did not meet our expectations. This was the most we have ever spent on a hotel and can say we have seen way better. The food from the buffet (being all inclusive) could have also been WAY better. Paying the amount of money we did, we had expected the food to be very good.

reviews.author: Abolfazl Ghazi
reviews.text:
The restaurants had very long wait time, we waited 2hrs) for dinner especially on the weekends. The telephone line in our room was not working and despite our request and follow up it got repaired 1 hour before our checkout. So we couldn’t use room service during our stay and for any question we had to go downstairs. We were given late checkout for 1hr instead!
The towels were taken the day before departure so I had to go and find someone to get some towels!
We saw two cockroaches right in front of our room.
Most importantly, in the Ginger bar there were some big open windows almost 1ft above floor with no guard, It is really dangerous for the kids if they are left unsupervised for a moment! Picture attached!
Rooms were clean and spacious, bars were good and almost all staff were friendly.

reviews.author: Mike's Garage
reviews.text:
This was the worst vacation I've ever had in Mexico.
First, it was a double room, although we booked it for two with a child. They brought a folding bed for the child. When they put my daughter to sleep on this bed, she started crying. I tried to lie down on this bed and thought I was lying on a torture bed. There was mold in the bathroom. The mirror in the bathroom looked like it was 500 years old. The air conditioner was making a terrible noise. I don't even want to talk about the dust on the fan and the peeling ceilings.
On the second day, my child got food poisoning from a super cocktail near the pool. In the dining room, you couldn't find anything to drink yourself, and the tea was poured with some kind of sediment, then I saw that the teapots were peeling off and falling into the cup.
The choice of food in the buffet was poor.
The sea is opposite the hotel, complete crap. The pool is the only thing that was good in this hotel, it is big and deep, but the water is cool. The evening show was in a small room where there was no place to sit, stand, or dance.
The restaurants had good food.
A year before that I was in RIO Dunamar and everything was much better there!

reviews.author: Lenny
reviews.text:
First let me say the resort is architectural beautiful the way it is design. However there were a couple of things that were problematic for us. We arrived to the hotel and receive our room which was a Junior Suite of the Ocean obstructed by tall
trees. No biggie. The couch in the room was stained. We brought to the attention of the main desk and it took two hours to be resolved for a room change. We received a room which was much better.
The food at the Adult buffet is always cold even though it is on warmers. Dinner was very limited and not a lot of choices. We ate breakfast which was slightly improved but again the food was always cold. The specialty restaurants are all very good. Please have your dates ready when you get to the resort so you can select the restaurants. Now the Steakhouse(Sal’s) was delicious. Ribeye melted in your mouth. The bill has a service charge which we viewed as an additional tax, tip or cost added on. The fuzzy explanation of the service charge and the expectation denoted by the box marked tip was really confusing. We left a tip anyway. This service charge should come off the bill. If I am paying for a meal and tipping why is there a service charge? Make it make sense.
The staff throughout the facility was very nice and attentive. In the adult buffet hats off to the staff they were great. The bartenders were ok. Whiskey Sour and Lemon drop should be pretty easy to mix and not a 50/50 dice game. We stayed in the Reserve. Other than the room issue initially we had a decent time. Based on other resorts I have been too, the food issue here needs to be seriously addressed. Making waffles and pancakes is not rocket science and keeping food warm/hot should not the remaking of the wheel. Shout out to the staff!!!!

reviews.author: Katherine Matta
reviews.text:
Pretty shocked to read such positive reviews, as we had a completely different opinion.
We arrived and our room was not ready until about 4PM. The blow drier in the room was not working and three lights in the bathroom went suddenly went off. The hotel itself is big, but there is not much to do at all in terms of entertainment. We were actually pretty bored especially at night. We also found a cockroach trying to enter our room, thankfully we killed it before it was too late. The AC in the room is extremely loud and goes off every 5 minutes literally! Also, be prepared to be awake at 6AM as the music outside you can hear it in your room bright and early. There were barely any reservations available for the restaurants so we did not even end up eating at any of them during our stay. We walked by them and they were NOT full, so this was a huge disappointment. Also, I had a simple request since my bracelet was not working and the line in the lobby was about 20 minutes since there was only one concierge working. Would I come back? Absolutely not.

reviews.author: Micki Withers
reviews.text: The service at this hotel is average at best. We are staying during  a rainy week and water was all over our room floor from the leaky door.  The restaurant service at lemon fish was horrible. I called multiple times needing extra towels for the wet floors and got none. This hotel is overpriced for the service.  The pool bar is excellent, so I guess we will just hang out there the whole time.

reviews.author: Shanell Amazing
reviews.text: NOT a 5 star resort. The rooms + property have extensive water damage. I noticed a roach walking the halls. My first room had a gnat infestation and mold. After showing photos, I was upgraded to be better room that still had minor water damage. The best restaurant is Aguamarina and the buffet. I ordered room service, and gnats came flying out of my nachos. LOL, I will NEVER book here again ..... Incredible beach & views tho.

reviews.author: Md Al Mamun (Mamun)
reviews.text:
First, it’s important to acknowledge that no all-inclusive resort is perfect. However, there are certain standards that must be upheld for a resort to truly be considered "all-inclusive." These include:

- High-quality food
- Top-notch hospitality
- Inclusive access to amenities without hidden charges

Unfortunately, this resort fell far short of these expectations.

Here are the main issues we encountered:

1. Food Quality: The food was either too bland or of subpar quality.
2. Reservation Hassles: Getting a reservation at restaurants was a nightmare. Even with effort, you’d often miss out on decent dining slots.
3. Poor Hospitality: The staff seemed more focused on upselling and making money than ensuring guests had a pleasant experience.
4. Late Reservations Penalty: Arrive 15 minutes late, and you’re pushed to a buffet that offers a variety of dishes with questionable quality.
5. Lack of Beach Chairs: Finding a beach chair was nearly impossible unless you were willing to pay $250 USD for an upgrade.
6. Concierge Package Disappointment: Even with the concierge package, we were offered poolside beds instead of beachfront ones, which defeated the purpose.

It felt like the entire system was designed to extract as much money as possible rather than providing a genuinely enjoyable experience. Everywhere you turned, there was another upsell or disappointment.

That said, the beach itself was breathtaking. The water's color and the sand were the highlights of our stay. Additionally, a few staff members, such as Messro Atilano and Ayudonte Xochilt, went above and beyond to improve the experience, but they were exceptions rather than the rule.

Overall, while the beach was stunning, the rest of the experience was deeply disappointing. I’ve visited many other all-inclusive resorts, and this was by far the worst.

reviews.author: EL L.
reviews.text: Disappointed with this place. Overall people seemed nice and helpful but alot of issues from outdated rooms and broken furniture. Damaged room equipment.  Even the coffee machine in room didn't work. Food was ok. And buffet ran out of food often. The beach has virtually no hospitality and the elevators were a nightmare. They often didn't work or had issues. We got stuck 2x and on one occasion while going up,  it dropped down as if the emergency brakes engaged. After a while it began to go back up again. It was terrifying experience. I was told this place is going to close next yr. Save your money and book elsewhere. Only perk is the location.

reviews.author: Taslim Reza
reviews.text:
**Bad Experience Review
I recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun, and while the beachfront location is stunning, the hotel itself shows its age. The property feels quite dated, and this is especially evident in the rooms. The decor is backdated, and there are very few electrical outlets, making it challenging to charge devices.

One of the more frustrating aspects of the stay was the need to make reservations for every restaurant for dinner. This added an unnecessary layer of hassle to what should have been a relaxing vacation. Additionally, the food options were quite limited, which was disappointing.

Overall, the experience of the stay was bad. Don't be fooled by the exterior look; the outdated facilities and the inconvenience of dinner reservations detract from the experience.

reviews.author: Armiss Kerman
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancún is a beautiful resort. It has great amenities, friendly and helpful staff, decent food quality and in our first impression did appear like a piece of paradise.
The resort has a major and fundamental problem though. The capacity and number of common areas including the pool amenities, restaurants and buffet are vastly disproportionate compared to the number of rooms and population it accommodates.

As a result there is constant tension and struggle in trying to access amenities.
On our first day, we went to the pool and tried to find a chair before 8am and were very surprised that to find out there was none available . All the chairs by the pool were occupied by those who had left their towels very early in the morning to claim the seats. We then had no choice other than getting up before 6am to place towels to be able to use the pool. For the entire stay, I had to wake up at the sunrises!!

Even after holding the seat, then there is still struggle with finding an umbrella. There are simply not enough of them.
At the restaurants there is always a huge line of people trying to get in. Same with the buffet. There are evening entertainment but again struggle to find seats.

These all result in creating some tension between the guests and a very unpleasant experience, exactly contrary to what one might expect from a relaxing and headache free vacation in an all inclusive resort.
In a way, at the end of our trip I was quite relieved that the rat-race finally had ended.

I would not go back to Paradisus Cancun again.

reviews.author: Adiyan Shaikh
reviews.text: Me and my family went to this resort over the summer, and it was not as shown in pictures and videos. First of all, when we went, the room had no ac. We told them, and luckily they had good customer service so they upgraded us to a nikte room, which is the higher end. Still, the resort just isn't it. It's dirty, not air conditioned, and has no good food or drinks. Also, the second night we were there, the power in the whole resort went out randomly for like 2 hours. There was no ac or light during that time. The ocean is full of seaweed and the pool is dandy for some reason. I would not go back.

reviews.author: Amanda Criswell
reviews.text:
We stayed in the reserve, our family concierge Galdino was very accommodating and informative.

The first room we were given had construction going on below it, as late as 9pm and as early as 7:30. We were traveling with our children and the noises were waking them up. We requested a new room at the front desk, showing a video of the LOUD drilling and hammering into the wall and the guy tried to blame it on our air conditioner saying they didn’t have any idea what the sounds could be. It was very obvious construction was happening on the two floors below. But we were eventually given a new room 8 hours later. Huge thank you to Galdino for helping us get a new room, if it weren’t for him who knows how long it would have taken to get a new room or get one at all.

ORLANDO at the swim up bar was incredibly rude every day that we were down there. We would go there so the kids could swim and mom and dad could sit at the bar, but ruined every time by his attitude and blatant disregard for patrons of all ages. Picking and choosing who he would serve, and ignore everyone else, children included. Should not be working at a “5-star hotel”.

We called the front desk one evening for a request and the man hung up on me. Did not catch his name. Again not “5-star hotel” behavior.

For the price we paid, the service was not worth it.

reviews.author: Chez MOMOE
reviews.text:
Garbage property with roaches, mold, leaks, old rundown rooms, and garbage food.
$255 cabanas per day.
Untreated pool, especially kids pool.
Cracking sharp pool tiles that caused injuries to two different people.
Molded bathroom ceilings due to lack of ventilation. Front desk is helpless.
Owners don’t seem to care about this rundown property as long as it still brings money.
This is not a family oriented resort.
Elevators break down.
Room phone line not working which leaves you unsafe in the case of an 🚨.

reviews.author: Claudia Cato
reviews.text: This was my second stay at the  Paradisus. I think it’s important for people to know that ownership:management has changed. I think it’s better. So first off, most of the staff are wonderful. George was our concierge and he is amazing. For most of our stay on the pool area, Eduardo was the absolutely best. Also Irina. All the others rush, give attitude, roll their eyes because their shift is about to end when you ask for something. I am here with my children, and they can only have bottled water. I think for the amount of money we spend at this hotel, I should not be denied bottled water. Sergio Cerrielo at the bar in the aqua marine hotel told me said to the waiter in spanish that he was only give me one and no more. You should tell your staff not to speak spanish especially when you don’t know who speaks or understands it. Reyna at the pizza hut had nothing but attitude. When you order pizza, she orders you to wait on the other side. In a nutshell, the staff needs to be trained to be kind to their guest, bc apart from the ones I named as being great, those are the only great ones. So much more to say but I will leave it here.

reviews.author: Fahd Khan
reviews.text:
Good facility but bad management, would not recommend

I have been going to beach resorts in Mexico with my family since 12 years, and this year we decided to go Paradisus in Cancun managed by Melia. After this experience I will prefer never to stay at a Melia property.
First let me cover the positives and then explain why I would not recommend this hotel and never go there again myself.
It is a good size hotel, gives a good impression upon arrival and has a massive swimming pool. The lobby area and restaurants look nice and overall the hotel has a nice vibe. There were shows every night we were there and they were fun. The waiters in the restaurants were friendly and accommodating offering special dishes for the kids.
Now to the negatives. Two main reasons.
1. Condition and Maintenance: Upon arrival we were assigned a room which was not in best shape, the shower was damaged and dirty, the couch was broken and walls were damaged (pictures attached). When I complained about it to the reception, they first shoved it off saying it’s a renovated room. Then I went and took the pictures and showed the staff, their response was that we will send house keeping. At this point I pushed stating this is not just a house keeping issue, I want to change room, which they did but clearly the lady at reception was not happy about it and did not provide any apology for assigning us a damaged and dirty room. In addition to this, the swimming pool is not very clean, there are dead insects floating around, we even saw a dead cockroach in the pool!
2. Too Commercial: The deal breaker for us is how commercial this place is, they are trying to upsell you things at every point. Upon our arrival a concierge member approached us stating that given that we are visiting from Europe (most visitors were American and Mexican) we are entitled to a free massage in return they request us to promote the hotel to our friends and family in Europe. When we requested the coupons for the massage he pushed us for attending a 40 minute description about their loyalty program. I clearly told this person, if this is about a time share or any kind of investment, I am not interested, to which he responded saying no nothing like that it’s about our Melia loyalty program and its benefits. So we went for it, it took more than an hour and it was a pitch for investing into a time share, exactly what I told them that I was not interested in. When I was clearly stating that I am not interested and will not make any investment decision during my holiday, the salesman (Mathew) even tried mocking me hinting that I am lying that I don’t discuss investment and work during holidays. Really unpleasant experience. But it doesn’t end there, the concept of all-inclusive is that you don’t carry around your money, in the all-inclusive hotels I have been to in Mexico before this one, the servers don’t expect any tips either as you are supposed to be cash free. At Paradisus Cancun this was not the case, every bar counter had a big tip jar in front of you and the kind of service you received from them and servers at pool area differed if you were tipping or not tipping. Then you have all these tour operators and water sports activities people walking around the hotel trying to grab you at every corner to try to sell to you. In the restaurants for several dishes you have to pay additional. Even during a massage, they tried to upsell using a better quality oil for the massage! Absolutely absurd.
The room experience gave it a bad start, the lie about timeshare left a bad taste overall and the constant dodging of people trying to sell you stuff did not make us feel relaxed. This is why I would never go back to this hotel and overall avoid Melia.
On top of all of this, Cancun is absurdly over priced. My last resort break was in Puerto Vallarta, I would rather recommend to go there instead of Cancun.

reviews.author: George Koskinas
reviews.text: Arrived at 10 am .met the rude receptionist that with attitude told me that the room will not be ready before 3 pm. I m coming in this hotel with my family for the past 3 years. You just lost my business.  . Never again. All the other times I was able to check in at 12 and 1 pm .today the flight was early. It s extremely hot and no access to our belongings with a 3 year old plus the tiredness.  The hotel is half full from what I see and there is no point to make people suffer waiting to go 3 pm .

reviews.author: Sanam Kazemi
reviews.text: We just arrived here a night ago. The beach is amazing and clean. But the most problem i have is the service. I had to ask 1000times for 1cup of hot water. If you have a baby or kid I really don't recommend this hotel because i have a baby food and I can't warm it up and there is no microwave or kettle in the room even when i asked nobody answered at least after 2hours they brought the fancy kettle got water🤦‍♀️ i asked for the high chair in our room but they didn't provide. The room is not fancy as we expected but the hotel and outdoor and entrence architecture is beautiful. For next time i wont choose this hotel.

reviews.author: Daisy Chogllo
reviews.text: This place is beautiful and has great service! However you have to make reservations for 80% of the restaurants here which leaves you the buffet and 1 other restauran which is a little annoying. I am also unhappy with how the staff handled an encounter i had with this man yelling in my face claiming he reserved a beach chair when the rules state you can NOT reserve chairs. The staff favored the angry couple and rewarded them for their nasty behavior. This put a bad taste in my mouth for this place. I no longer feel safe and relaxed.

reviews.author: Sathish Kumar
reviews.text: "My stay at Paradisus Cancun from April 7th to 12th was by far the worst resort experience I've had. The property is outdated, poorly maintained, and feels more like a budget hotel. The service was disappointing, with almost no engaging activities for kids and no evening entertainment. In contrast, my recent stay at Iberostar, though slightly more expensive, was significantly better in every way. Avoid Paradisus Cancun until they complete renovations—and even then, their staff service needs a major overhaul.

reviews.author: Ash Dakwar
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from August 8-16-2022, it was our third visit to the hotel with the most recent one just before Covid. I gave the hotel 2 stars only because the hotel needs a major remodeling and cleaning. It’s way overpriced for what the hotel offers or it is in reality. They sell you Luxury Suite and it’s not even a one star small crowded room.
We planned the trip and book 3 rooms in March 22 to celebrate a family member’s birthday. We booked the Luxury suite Ocean view all inclusive. My only request to the reservation team is to keep the rooms close to each other since we have a lot of excited children, so they added my request to the notes and we expected that.
When we got to the hotel all the troubles started, we weren’t given rooms close to each other and not even at the same floor, they said if we upgrade the room for 90$ a night per room they will find us something close to each other. So basically they could’ve done it but they didn’t want to. I mean they wanted me to pay almost extra 2000$ on to of the 10,000$ we already paid, that was ridiculous.
When we got into our room the room was crowded with furniture, the ceiling paint falling off, the doors won’t close properly, the shampoo holder broken and the biggest thing for me was mold in the shower. After talking to a manager we were promised a better room on day 2 and we switched rooms, the new room was in the reserve section which is slightly higher end of the Luxury but we found the same issues we had in the previous room on top of that the shower/restroom has no door, I didn’t accept their offer to install a curtain and we switched to Room number 3. The only thing different was the air conditioning worked fine but we encountered the same issues of the previous rooms plus broken mirror in the bathroom.
I decided to talk to a manager and Marisol was aware of all our fiasco and disappointment so she offered us a one bedroom suite at the reserve in tower 5 which supposedly it’s the signature tower of the hotel. We did switch but honestly it was just the same issues of broken items and mold of the previous rooms but we got tired of moving so we settled in that room until the last day.
I did express all my concerns to the manager and how disappointed we all are from the quality of the hotel and it’s rooms.
Not only the rooms though needs a major cleaning and remodeling but the gym the restaurants, the hallways the pool etc…
The food was ok nothing fancy to justify the all inclusive price. No vegan options, also they use a lot of syrup and paste in their cooking, nothing fresh or exceptional.
The only reason I gave the hotel 2 stars and not 1 star it’s because of the employees, they are really polite and nice.
Bottom line it was a huge disappointment and I won’t recommend this hotel to anyone. At least not for the published price. I personally won’t go back there again.

reviews.author: Jason R
reviews.text: If your idea of vacation is listening to dance club music literally all day while you try to relax at the beach/pool then this place is for you. At first glance it's impressive, with a central open lobby with real vines hanging from 7 levels of floors. The service staff was amazing and friendly, although some tease you when you turn down alcohol. Most of the food is better than I expected for all-inclusive, but make sure to reserve days in advance for dinner or you'll miss out on the better stuff. Luckily the buffet is mostly good and always open. At closer inspection however, this place is falling apart and obnoxious. There's chunks of wall missing in various places inside, both my wife and I got locked in the bathroom and had to be broken out by maintenance, who didn't fix the problem either time, and we weren't offered any reparations for this. There's a LOUD fountain in building 3 that is very audible in the lower rooms and runs most of the day. The room doors are shingle style not solid so you can hear everything outside, including the obnoxious techno music coming from the hotel store all day. We had to run the AC constantly to drown out the noises. We only had one relaxing morning on the beach when they finally turned the music down from the stupid Cocos pay-huts that no one uses and a sad DJ tries to have fun by himself. This place ruined my idea of resort stay and I'll be very careful to avoid similar places in the future.

reviews.author: Dante Isy
reviews.text: Bugs, cockroaches every night at the room or restroom. Concierge none existent, have to find our way buy asking other employees. Couldn't take or find out about all of the Nikte advantages if they were any, they gave us a contact at day 4 but it was more like if we had any questions. Some of the shows or activities were not always in the app, specially for kids, we missed few of them. Others started earlier than what in the app said. Small water leaks from the ceiling, slippery floor causing my daughter to fall down, no issues. Maintenance,  stairs demo, had trouble catching up on my sleep that day.

reviews.author: Laura Sanchez
reviews.text:
This hotel is “ok”. We were here 4 years ago and loved it so we came back only to be disappointed.  The staff seems very unhappy, customer service is definitely not a priority.  Our check-in was extremely slow despite making every effort to making our needs known prior to arrival.  We were a group of 18, and were celebrating our parents 50th wedding anniversary, but we felt like an inconvenience the entire time we were there.  We arrived at 3:00pm, one of our rooms was not ready until7:00pm the other at 9:00pm.
This is a large hotel and not friendly to people with mobility issues.
Two of our groups rooms had no AC!! Imagine being at the beach with no AC, we made multiple requests to have it fixed but it wasn’t addressed until the second to last day we were there.
Our mini bar was only restocked if we asked, it was automatic before..
The biggest disappointment came in terms of the food.  The Buffett had options but few were “tasty”. If you waited to eat at 7:00pm you were sure to wait at least an hour before you were able to sit and eat, this is just the buffet.  The food almost seemed recycled, if you ate at the “Italian” place, the food was prepped at the buffet, etc.  there was nothing special or unique at the various restaurants as they all tasted and smelled the same.  “Agave” was an exception, this is a taco place, their food was good, however, at times we waited at the table for an hour to get served.
Service at the beach was minimal, the poor staff really tried, but it is impossible for 1-2 people to serve everyone on the beach.  I tried to get service at the pool but as soon as I told them I was sitting at the beach, I was redirected to receive service down there.
Cancun is a beautiful place to visit, and given the opportunity I would not return to this hotel.  I found myself going out to eat many nights and spending on edible, enjoyable food when I had already paid for an ALL INCLUSIVE experience.
Sad to say this hotel is no longer focused on quality, or their staff, this directly translates to not focusing on their customers.

reviews.author: Pooja Patel
reviews.text:
We are here right now and while the bartending staff is amazing, I cannot say the same for the front reception. They wasted half of our entire first day in checking in despite asking for early check in via phone and filling out a form via email. The front desk to activate our keys was run by one person who was completely rude and unwelcoming. We wasted our entire first day here in just trying to get to our rooms.
I am here with my family of 5 and there are basically zero food options for vegetarians. You can’t even get a simple bean and cheese enchilada or burrito in Mexico? This is ridiculous to the point we likely have to leave the resort to feed ourselves for the next 5 days. The staff did nothing to help with this issue either.

reviews.author: Louis Kuntz
reviews.text:
Many, Many problems with the room some of which were never resolved.  Am a handicapped guest and my repeated requests for a shower chair were ignored. As a result I fell 2 times. No hot water etc.etc.  Numerous requests to speak to the Hotel General Manager Alicia were denied saying she was in a meeting or too busy.  It is a shame for management to ignore guest issues when the staff tried very hard to resolve problems.  Great staff in Victor and Emmanuel.

Usually stay at RIU when in Cancun but wanted to try this place.  Guess we will go back to RIU.

reviews.author: Dominic Lovelock
reviews.text: Pretty pour experience. Check-in took a very long time, the hotel is looking like it needs a revamp as it's looking pretty tired in a lot of places, the rooms are pretty small, you need to book restaurants before you even arrive at the resort as they're all fully booked most of the time and you get pestered from people selling tours and activities. The food however is very good if you can get into the restaurants l, the breakfast brunch we though was excellent.

reviews.author: Maria Rivera
reviews.text:
Staying at the hotel right now. The staff at the reception are all so lost and uninformed. They give different prices for upgrades, different information to different guests. It really seems like they never got training, and they treat better the guests they prefer. Even if we ask for the manager, they never come out to help.
Regarding restaurant reservations, you meed to make one for everything except the buffet but they never have reservations available, and when you pass by the restaurants they are all empty.
Great pool, beach and beach bar.

reviews.author: Nayaab Khawar
reviews.text: Honestly was expecting so much more. The hotel is stunning but the check in was a nightmare. The  front staff were rude and col. We requested double beds close to each other many times in email and received confirmation of the request. When we were checking in the front desk made it very difficult to honor this request even with conformation.  There are no pool or beach chairs. People leave their towels on these chairs early in the morning and don’t come back for hours. You could barely get a seat and the pool staff was very unhelpful. The buffet staff during breakfast from the hostess to waiters were also not unhelpful. It Took hours to get coffee or anything from the bar. The rooms were not updated and have wear and tear. The views were great tho and the activities group was the highlight of the resort. Shoutout to activities ppl santa Mariel ilse and Samantha you guys rocked

reviews.author: Alexander
reviews.text: Don’t be fooled by the 5-star rating. Apart from the prime location and beautiful property, this has been my worst experience at a resort of this caliber. It is almost impossible to flag anyone down by the pool/beach to order food, a good portion of the workers were unfriendly and seemed annoyed every time I asked for something, and I waited 10 min+ every time I ordered a drink at the extremely understaffed pool bars. The food was extremely average. Even the “fancier” restaurants such as Lemon Fish were extremely disappointing; limited menu, lack of variety, and poor flavor. The rooms were constantly under-filled with bottled water, and it was a huge hassle to order more from room service. Two times I ordered room service and no one showed up. If your only priority is a nice property, Paradisus Cancun is a suitable all-inclusive. But if you care about not being ignored, and eating good food at a 5-star resort, save your money and find a different resort to stay at.

reviews.author: Kyleene Bridges
reviews.text: Service is great. But this place is falling apart. Literally the definition of lipstick on a pig. The walls are all cracking. All the rooms ac barely work. Our ac broke and flooded our room. They weren’t even gonna give us a different room they just wanted room service to clean it up. We went to the presidential suite to party and the hot tub literally doesn’t even work. Non of the tvs you can connect to. Elevators are all breaking. We won’t be coming back to this place

reviews.author: Gabrielle Orozco
reviews.text:
The service here is Sub-par. My husband and I are members of Melia and it didn’t even feel like it. The person, from Melia, who booked our reservation, Henry, incorrectly booked our reservation. We were supposed to have two free nights as a welcome gift for becoming members and it wasn’t given to us, to our surprise upon our arrival. When we got here, nobody could explain to us why we weren’t getting our two free nights although we had proof of this. Roberth and manager Jonathan were the ones we were dealing with and they couldn’t make it make sense. In order for us to check in, we had to pay an extra $500+ for the nights that were supposed to be free. We had to wait until Monday to get this resolved. When we called Melia they told us they would get this resolved and someone would call us back that same day. That did not happen. On top of that, my husband and I complained about this issue to multiple people at the resort and not one person showed an ounce of care or compassion. Noe at guest services said his manager, Valeria, would call me to discuss my experience. She never called me.
Additionally, the food is terrible. I have had way better food than this in Atlanta GA, including the tacos. I’ll never come back to this hotel and I’m speaking as a member of Melia. I’ll probably be cancelling my membership as well.

reviews.author: Brandon Sterling
reviews.text: Me and my wife go to lots of resorts and this place is the worst one yet and it was the most expensive. Definitely more negative and the positive were just okay. We heard loud music during our sleep from 11pm to 4am. We asked the staff to fix our shower 2 times and still wasn’t fixed. All staff were constantly expecting tips. Oh and make sure you tip the  cabana people so you get bumped to the top of the line.

reviews.author: Rylie Oborn
reviews.text: I have not been impressed while staying here. We looked at other locations prior and thought this was the best one. I have never been more wrong. I will start with the AC unit. Room was blowing around the warm air. I asked 4 times to have it fixed - when they “fixed it” it was 2 degrees colder IF THAT. The power in pyramid one has gone out twice - finally got another room with actual AC. Whole hotel is warm 90% of the time. Beach is full of seaweed. Food isn’t that good & not much to do. Weird entertainment. Only cool thing is the inside of the lobby. Don’t recommend. Bye!

reviews.author: Stephanie Gutierrez
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, but a tad underwhelming in other departments considering the price. The food was lacking, and there weren’t many activities inside the hotel. In my opinion, there are much better all inclusives. In addition, I had 50 dollars stolen from my room by house cleaning, and when I told concierge I would like to write a report, they told me to wait in my room and security would be right up. I waited for 2 hours and no one ever came up. I’d recommend staying Elsewhere.

reviews.author: Catie Ross
reviews.text:
Upgrading was impossible upon arrival, the check in staff barely communicated what room they were putting us in even though our whole wedding party was on the opposite side of the hotel. We were told we had to add extra days online which I don't understand why the staff couldn't help us with that. And then they made us switch rooms and while we were waiting no one even offered us water. Something is wrong with their air conditioning and many people woke up with sore throats. Our room kept leaking water in from the patio into our room because of poor design. Overall it felt like an overpriced 3 star hotel. Reservations for restaurants were impossible so we ate at the buffet most the time. But since the buffet is not always open we felt hungry a lot. The staff was amazing at the bars and pool side and the rooms were clean at least. I'm mostly upset at paying so much and not receiving 5 star treatment, I've stayed at Hampton Inns who made me feel more welcome and accepted. They would not upgrade us to the reserve even though most of our wedding party was on that side so they kept trying to kick us out of that side even though we had been willing to pay the extra.

Edit: The response from the owner that they couldn't find a booking under my name is the exact reason we will never stay here again. Your booking system is completely messed up and you blame it on us, the guest. I was part of a wedding there that has my last name... you know who I am. Don't treat your guests as second class citizens when we are paying thousands of dollars. I'm staying at a $33 a night hotel in Cozumel and have already received better service and room than the $500 a night. Either lower your price or provide better service at the front desk.

reviews.author: Shamir Patel
reviews.text: The location is nice but is under renovations. Rooms are different in different towers, be sure to stay in a updated room.  One of our outlets didn't work and refrigerator never got cold.  Service is poor for large parties. You MUST reserve in advance before 5pm in the restaurants, you can't casually dine in unless it's buffet.  I wish I knew this prior to booking. Its all inclusive but it doesn't feel that way.  Somewhat underwhelming experience.

reviews.author: Henrry Perez
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and the food was delicious, I was asked by the hotel to check in online and asked the reason of our stay. I clearly disclosed that we were coming for a bachelor getaway.  Our first day we waited for a room until past 4:00pm and we never complained, the electricity was out in the entire hotel and it was hot and humid. We still wanted to make the best of our trip and never complained.  On our second day our group was in the pool in front of the Lunch Box restaurant and we had a small speaker playing our music, we deceived to stay there as the main pool had a lot of families. There was a couple next to us, bothered at the fact that we were speaking Spanish, and playing Latin music.  We were minding our business, and having a great time,  when all of the sudden a manager came to us and asked us to keep it quite and not disturb the couple next to us. I was  so disappointed  as it was unfair, this hotel has an adults only pool, but we were not allowed to go in since we didn’t had a gold bracelet.  I felt discriminated for being latin and  for the fact that we were celebrating a LGBTQ bachelors getaway.  We paid for our stayed as they did, the manager didn’t even bothered to hear our side of the story, he believed and catered to their request.  It was embarrassing, I felt harassed.  So for those thinking to stay here, heads up.  Nice hotel, great food but only great service by management if you are blonde, blue eyed and definitely not from the community.

reviews.author: Gabriel Solorzano
reviews.text:
The lobby and Central patio of the hotel are impressive as you arrive, high level of service from staff who provide you a cold towel and a fruit drink while you check in.
Staff is friendly everywhere.
Room is spacious with a great balcony, ours overlooked the lake.
But things go downhill from there. The room has only one available outlet on a table, none on nightstand.
There is a step into the bathroom that can be a killer for midnight runs to the restroom. Mirror is rusted. There is a fridge with lots of water and beer bottles. One member of our group drank the chocolate milk from the refrigerator and got very sick, later found it had expired.
Sir conditioning never dropped below 78°F even at night.
Breakfast buffet is great, but the other restaurants had great presentation but poor quality of food. Meat was so tough I had to return my meal at every restaurant I ordered meat. Stick to chicken.
The conference area is spacious and well equipped, except that no outlets are easily available. Conference Rooms are kept at very warm temperature. Many attended were fanning themselves to keep cool.
This hotel saw its better days in the 80's and needs major remodeling .

reviews.author: Sam Poulson
reviews.text: Resort was beautiful. But inside was just as hot as outside.
