The buffet was pretty bland and something made my wife and I both very sick on the 3rd day of our 7 day trip here, no we didn't drink any tap water. Don't bother eating at the Italian restaurant or Japanese unless you enjoy sweating profusely while eating. Our room was big, nice ocean view. But our a/c was pretty weak. Whoever did the electrical wiring for our room had no idea what they were doing, we couldn't get the lights to work or ceiling fan to work a majority of the time. And to top it off the same guy probably plumbed both showers in our room because we had no warm water every shower was a cold unenjoyable experience.

reviews.author: tarang shah
reviews.text:
I recently had the unfortunate experience of staying at Paradisus Cancun, and I must say that I was thoroughly disappointed with the level of service provided. From start to finish, it was clear that the resort failed to meet even the basic expectations of hospitality.

Firstly, upon arrival, the check-in process was incredibly slow. Despite having made a reservation well in advance, I was made to wait for an extended period before being assigned a room. Even after that, I was given the wrong room keys, which added to our frustration.

Upon entering my assigned room, I was met with a scene of disappointment. The level of cleanliness was subpar, with noticeable sand all over the room and on the bed. It was evident that the room had not been properly cleaned or inspected prior to my arrival, reflecting a lack of attention to detail and poor housekeeping standards.

Most frustrating was the lack of functioning air conditioning. The AC would not cool our room below 82 degrees Fahrenheit. Despite numerous requests for assistance, the issue remained unresolved throughout my stay. This made the room unbearably hot and uncomfortable, severely impacting my ability to relax and enjoy my time at the resort.

The concierge and room service (we booked the "Nikte" experience) were shockingly unresponsive and inattentive. Requests for assistance or inquiries were consistently met with disinterest and delayed responses. We had to ask for water every day, and it would be delivered after a few hours.

Even though it was an all-inclusive resort with premium liquor included under Nikte, we were never served premium drinks. Not only that, coconut water cost $10, and all other drinks were watered down.

Despite my attempts to escalate my concerns to the management, there was a complete lack of response and accountability. It became clear that the management team failed to prioritize guest satisfaction and address the issues plaguing the resort. Their disregard for guest concerns only compounded the disappointment and highlighted a significant flaw in their commitment to providing a pleasant experience.

The poor service, lack of cleanliness, and overall indifference from the staff left a lasting negative impression. I would strongly advise potential guests to reconsider staying at this resort, as there are far better options available that prioritize customer satisfaction and provide a truly enjoyable vacation experience

reviews.author: Maya Chami
reviews.text: The customer service is great! Everyone I’ve encountered have been kind and accommodating except David the guy at the check-in, he wasn’t too approachable nor welcoming. The beach is beautiful and the pools are well maintained but lounge chairs are so old, they simply removed the adjustment brackets, you can’t change the reclining position (see photo). On another note, I would like to understand why are speakers blasting and so loud until 12 am!??  This is supposedly a family-friendly resort? My kids can’t sleep because of how loud the speakers are in the lobby. I’ve been to so many resorts and usually there is a theatre where loud music is contained within, here the stage is in the middle of the lobby surrounded with guests rooms!! The rooms are outdated and the air conditioner barely cools the room, there are no coffee makers in rooms and would have to dress up, get out of the room to get a simple cup of coffee.  Food is mediocre at best. I am so disappointed, we’ve been to paradisus playa del Carmen and cabos and our experience was so much better. This was supposed to be a birthday trip and I hate it. We’re still here until Monday and I absolutely can’t wait to return home.

reviews.author: Valentine Gibson
reviews.text:
The customer service is not on par with the physical property.  We travel often and make it a point to heavily tip the wait staff and pool concierges to show gratitude and  also ensure good service:). The pool staff...Luis, Yvonne, Didier and Jesus were amazing!!!  The pool and cabana service were the best part of the trip...now for the bad parts.

We stayed at the more exclusive "Reserve" and were assigned a personal butler who was not as attentive as we had hoped.  Dinner reservations were also tough to procure and we often had to request towels, rags etc.

We were also extremely disappointed by the events surrounding our last night.  We dined at Enso to celebrate our father's 70th birthday. The staff failed to recognize his birthday as requested (no huge deal). Unfortunately, at the conclusion of dinner the waiter informed us that he could not charge the room for the bottle of wine we purchased secondary to a "system issue."

I did not have cash or credit cards on my person as we had previously reserved a card for the room and had used it without incident throughout the trip. Thirty minutes went by as the waiter and manager kept making phone calls and asking us if we could give them cash or if they could charge it to another room.  Eventually, I had to get up and go to my room, with the waiter and manager following me and return to the front desk with previously mentioned credit card to take care of the expense.

As the manager and the front desk had copies of our passports, our room number and a credit card on file... we were perplexed as to why they couldn't have spared us this great and embarrassing inconvenience and resolved things the next day prior to us leaving.

I spoke to the manager the next morning, he echoed my sentiments and swore to redeem the poor service with vouchers etc.  Sadly, he did not follow through with this.

All in all, decent place, but poor customer service especially when you paid for one of their high end rooms.

reviews.author: aaron campbell
reviews.text:
Starting with the cons. Arriving at the resort was not welcoming whatsoever. My gf and I were sent into a reception room that reeked of cleaning chemicals because the check-in clerks were not available for us. After 20 min or so they guided us to the check in lobby. Only having to wait another 40 min behind others. They had ongoing construction that they failed to mention located in the middle of everything. Falsely advertising a golf course connected to the resort. Could only use a wedge and putter, very disappointing and misleading. All cooking staff never used gloves when handling food. Directly touching, moving, chopping food with bare hands. Food was bland and mediocre. Charged me an additional 900 dollars when I checked out because they had messed up my booking rate upon arrival.
For pros.. it’s a great location on the beach. The restaurant staff are very friendly and helpful. Great service from the wait staff. Make strong drinks and have a great pool area.

reviews.author: Breanne Baldermann
reviews.text: I personally didn’t enjoy. Maybe I went at the wrong time of year. I don’t know. The staff didn’t seem very accommodating. I tried to order room service and they were very much NOT wanting to take the order but did it. The ac kept going out over and over and the outlets didn’t work , they had to put us in a different room which was nice bc it was upgraded. Food was decent but you had to make a reservation at every single restaurant other than two(buffet and a taco place). Everything and I mean EVERYTHING costs extra. Be prepared to pay $25 for a Covid test. The app barely works. No one explains anything to you so you don’t really understand what the hotel offers, what exactly you get if you’re reserve or not, etc. One of the worst parts to me is the presentation people. They nag and nag and nag and promise you gifts that you really don’t get. They say you have to stay for at least 45 minutes and don’t have to buy anything and still get a gift for sitting in. We went to the presentation and we’re there for an hr. My boys started fighting and were hungry so I had to leave. The presenter lied and said we were there less than an hour. Unfortunately for him, I had a feeling he would do that so I took a picture of myself inside of the “circle” time stamped. The fact I had to do that.. is garbage. I will never go back.

reviews.author: Alla Gazit
reviews.text:
Very low maintenance of the room.
Here is the list of all our problems in the room.
Safe stopped working
The drawers were very dirty
Panels not finished
Leak under the sink
Nespresso. machine wasn't working
The switch between the rain shower and the handle wasn't operating.
AC wasn't working well. Was very hot.
The room door is broken and not closing properly.

All rooms have two double beds for adults.no king size for the standard rooms however their website stays otherwise. They tried to convince us to upgrade and pay an extra over 300 dollars to have a king-size bed in the same room category.

The rooms in general are very small.

Not much options for lunch. No restaurants are open between 12 to 1 pm and nothing is kids friendly.  Need to order room services or by the pool to have lunch.
Should be told at the beginning of our stay so we can plan better.

No kids facilities/pool. No playground.
In general, I would not recommend families with kids to stay here.

reviews.author: Reza Asadikia
reviews.text:
Our family of three, consisting of a couple and an eleven-year-old, from Toronto, Canada. We travel regularly to destinations in the sun.

Our recent experience at Paradisus Cancún left us with mixed feelings. While the resort boasts a picturesque setting, we encountered numerous challenges during our stay, ranging from limited amenities to poor management decisions.

Check-in, Staff, and a Safety Incident:
The check-in process was slow and poor, lack of staff authority, requiring constant referral to higher management for even basic requests. Despite generally friendly interactions, the staff seemed not motivated to address guest needs promptly or even to listen and show a basic level of empathy, demonstrating a lack of understanding of the basics in the hospitality world. We did, however, witness a commendable response from management during a safety incident (hair dryer was so old that it caught fire while being used).

Amenities and Swimming Pools:
Despite the resort's sprawling size, it fell short in providing essential amenities commensurate with its capacity. Access to necessities like towels and showers was often accompanied by long queues, with inadequate seating and umbrellas causing further inconvenience at both the pools and beach. All these easily manageable to address, however, no sign of any willingness to help and or even trying to improve.

Night Entertainment and Dining:
Nightly entertainment offerings were underwhelming, lacking quality, adequate seating and a designated stage area.

On the culinary front, while the food quality ranged from acceptable to good, the constant upselling of additional items excluded from all-inclusive and the exclusion of certain restaurants from the all-inclusive package left much to be desired.

Drinks and Rooms:
While the resort offered a decent selection of beverages, the frequent extra charges for certain items detracted from the all-inclusive experience. Any wine other than house wine, cava or Sake are all extra! Even Coconut juice is extra!!!

Room quality varied inconsistently, with multiple relocations necessary due to maintenance issues and inadequate bedding options. Air conditioning units are located in the ceiling of the rooms as individual units.  Very noisy and hardly able to control the temperature and humidity in the rooms.

In conclusion, our experience at Paradisus Cancún left us dissatisfied with the overall value for money. The resort's shortcomings in amenities, service, and room quality overshadowed its scenic beauty. We have no intention of returning and would advise seeking alternative resorts in the area offering better value and more guest-focused management.

reviews.author: Feizan Chaudhry
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for seven nights from January 30, 2023. This was our 5th trip to Cancun but first to Paradisus Cancun. I have conflicted views about this resort because it has several redeeming qualities but also a lot of flaws. Two of us were vegan.

Pros:
Check-In:
Once you enter the main lobby you will be greeted by an impressive atrium-style lobby and bar.  The sheer size of pyramid 3 will hit you once you see the main atrium. There is lovely vegetation draped from the ceilings and it gives off some lovely tropical vibes, however, if you prefer open concept and airy environment, then this is not the resort for you.
Restaurants:
Given the scale of the resort, you would think the Paradisus would have a vast food selection, and it does, with 5 ala carte restaurants. The food was quite good for an all-inclusive, however, you could taste and feel the mass-produced part of their culinary offering at times. They should also offer a variety of more vegan-friendly alternatives.
Staff:
There was an exceptional staff member in guest services, Cristian Morales! This young man deserves a promotion! He went above and beyond to correct the wrongs we were experiencing.
We had the worst room experience, and after a two day battle with back and forth with check-in and guest services.  (Cristian … Thank you so much, and we hope your mother is doing well. You won’t be forgotten.
Also, a special thanks to the following members of staff who went above and beyond to improve our stay:
•	Chef of Capella restaurant, Arturo – He personally came to greet us and made sure we had the chance to sample some of his vegan dishes. Although vegan cheese would be ideal to have on a pizza.
•	Manager of Capella restaurant, Carlos Chay – In addition to introducing Chef Arturo, he went above and above to ensure that our requirements were satisfied.
•	Manager of Lunch Box restaurant, Rafael – Rafael is beyond amazing and great; he deserves a promotion or some sort of acknowledgment. During our dinner at Lunch Box, he brought a cake as a simple gesture of gratitude.
•	Chef of Lunch Box restaurant, Christopher – Rafael introduced Chef Christopher who made dishes that were not on the menu. Chef Christopher – thank you for making the delicious vegan dishes for our group.

Cons

Hotel:
The hotel requires a MAJOR INDOOR construction or renovation; the entire pyramids 3 and 4 are falling apart. The railings in the corridor on the seventh level are disintegrating. I unintentionally walked in a pool of water in the corridor of Pyramid 4 due to the passageway had constant leakage from overnight rain.
Rooms:
Our junior suite rooms which overlooked the lagoon, were seriously outdated like from the 80’s and in need of major renovation. Our rooms (4410 and 3629) had unclean mirrors, peeling bathtubs, faulty air conditioning, counter edges that were falling off, water dripping from our balcony and into our suite and no hot water for two days. Prior to leaving for the beach, we contacted the front desk, sadly no one arrived to mend repairs until the next day. The decor was all over the place and didn’t flow together. It looked like it was designed for a 4-year-old with cheap Ikea furniture.
Charges:
Although this resort is advertised as all inclusive, there are a TONS of extra hidden fees from resort costs, cabanas, drinks, dining establishments, room service, etc. We anticipated that there would be extra fees for deluxe amenities, however, we have never seen so many fees for what we view as “standard”; at other all-inclusive resorts, especially in comparison to our previous visits to the Bahia Principe Luxury, Royalton Hotels, Sandos, Riu Group of Hotels, Karisma Hotels & Resorts which is genuinely a 4.5-star hotel.

Overall, we had a great time here. We made an effort to ignore the drawbacks and focus only on the fantastic setting and exceptional service, however we will not be returning to this hotel.
Rooms 3629 and 4410

reviews.author: Ernesto Guzman
reviews.text: Avoid enso restaurant, it is absolutely disgusting. Salad bar is left out in the heat all day and the lettuce was always dirty. Avoid any desserts as they are left out in the heat all day( we were sick for almost 3 days of our trip due to the desserts). When we asked to talk to a manager about it we were told he would come up to our room to talk and never showed up. Hotel was partially under construction but very little to no noise but some restaurants were closed because of it.  Positives, the beach is beautiful, Blue agave restaurant is very good, the staff are very friendly. Save your money and avoid this place, go to a Riu instead. Also, they will harass you about the sales pitch for their club membership, after politely declining to go to their sales pitch breakfast 3 times I eventually lost my patience and had to be rude to them so they would leave us alone. Don't go here.

reviews.author: Prashant Patel
reviews.text:
We visited this resort in Nov. 2019 along with our kids (toddler & an infant). We went there with very high expectations, however, those expectations started shattering right at the check in. I will describe it later in this review but the REAL TROUBLE we faced was at the time of check out. The person whose name was RAFAEL told us that he will to appropriate person and get the luggage from our room to the lobby. However, even after 30 minutes, our luggage was not brought. Meanwhile, the transportation company was there to pick us up. He was not willing to wait more than 5 minutes as he had to pick up other passengers on the way to the airport. On this side, myself and my wife are shouting about our luggage (my toddler is crying ) but all the service personnel ignored us. Nobody was even ready to listen us. When we asked the person who checked us out (Rafael) he LIED on our face and said "I never said that". We had to beg to the driver to wait. Poor driver had to wait 25 minutes instead of 5 minutes (as per their policy) for out luggage to come.

On the day of check in, We did not get the room that i had requested at the time of booking (King size bed). After a long fight with the receptionist finally assigned a room which had a king size bed. at the time of booking i had an option to select 2 queen size or single King size bed. Even though this option was available, i was told that it depends on availability.

I am definitely not staying again at this resort.

However, after all this i have something good to say about the resort as well.
They maintain the resort very well. The essential oil aroma through the resort is just amazing and takes you away in a different world.
The waiter service at the restaurants is awesome but management could be much better.
Kids Zone activities are awesome.

reviews.author: Kimberly Knox
reviews.text:
My husband and I arrived after hours exhausted after a full day of travel. However once we entered into the lobby, we were super excited about what was to come. The lobby smelled very fresh and was beautifully lit. The lobby also was covered in lush greenery hence the name Paradise. Although esthetically beautiful, the lobby was rather warm. Luckily the front desk was in an enclosed area which was much cooler.  It took a short while before someone could assist us due to lack of staff working at that particular hour. Because we arrived later in the evening we were informed that all of the restaurants were closed. However we could order room service, but we would be charged a fee with every call to room service. I was a bit disappointed because in all of my travels, we have never been charged an additional fee for all-inclusive. The resort is rather large and because of that we wandered aimlessly until we found our room only to find out that our room has not been upgraded to a newer system. Luck for us, a security guard was nice enough to let us in. The room was subpar, but I really was upset about the room decor or lack thereof. We noticed that it was not really that cool. The room service took about 45 minutes only to arrive cold. We ate it because we were starved and exhausted. In the morning we were pleasantly surprised by our ocean view balcony which sort of made up for the evening before. The beach was amazing, the restaurants were okay, the drinks were watered down, but the staff was amazing.

Now the worst of it all- The Covid test

We all are aware that we take a risk coming to Mexico as we need a negative Covid test to return to the USA. I tested negative while my husband tested positive. We had discussions as to what we would do prior to us going. At the end of everything, we felt as though we were given the run around. Testing done and emails not being sent, causing you to miss flights and paying for additional nights to stay because you have no other choice. Having to pay for each additional test. I read another review with almost identical stories. Thankfully, we are both back safe in the States. We plan on returning to Cancun, but we will stay at another resort.

reviews.author: Christian Martinez
reviews.text: It was a little over rated to be honest. Some hotel staff definitely went above and beyond expectation other staff was not helpful at all or just rude by not even acknowledging you. It depends on the day and how busy it is and who helps you out. The reserve side isn't much different then the general area side. Pool is warmer and no kids allowed that a plus. But the canopies are always already pre reserved days in advance and me being of brown skin person I felt like I was being ignore and if I was more of a white skin I believe my service would have been different sad to say not even a Mexican in Mexico get treated right. I asked for a canopy and they told me that it was reserved and they would try and get me one. I was at the pool for 2 hours nobody showed up. On the 3rd hour I was told I can take it after it had been sitting there empty. I didn't get any service or a server until 30mins after being at the pool, at that point I had already started walking back and forth to the bar since I was tired of waiting the bartender was great by the way. The next day I went over to the general pool side and got a canopy and a server right away with great service. Make sure you have reservations for dinner if not they wont attend you or even give you a bottle water. My wife asked someone they said they could only attend people who had reservation. Check out was also a pain in the butt even though I had prepaid and already had packed my own bags I couldn't leave without a checkout ticket I wish there service and attention to customer was like this through out the whole hotel and not just at checkout. I found myself standing in front of the front desk a couple times with people not even attempting to help me. I've been here twice once 5 year ago it was great and most recent this month. I made the best of it but wont be going back that for sure. I am a very patient person and have worked at a hotel myself for many years so I never complain or lose my patients. So for me to complain about something its not just because of one little thing it needs to be one after another after another. Beds and room was clean and comfortable so it was all bad. Food was okay Italian restaurant has the best food all the other places are ok.

reviews.author: Andre Reis
reviews.text: I just got here in the resort and they have the worst service I have ever seen for a 5 star. It is definitely not a 5 star … it is close to a 3 star. I arrive with my family and they don’t have 1 room with a king bed available. They made my family worst experience possible. Thank you paradisus after this 7 days we are obligated to stay we will never come back.

reviews.author: Marta Anna
reviews.text:
First time in Mexico with my mom (I'm 23 and she is 46). We have been to a few all inclusive resorts before so we have a good idea how it works.

-First impression: being dragged into a 3 hour sales pitch for a timeshare at 9am the day after arriving. It was a nightmare, and the sales people are RUDE AND NAGGING. They will call your room, promise you breakfast, and have you walking out hungry and pissed off, with no restaurants open at noon.

- WAY TOO MANY KIDS. We were aware this was not an all adult hotel, however end of September we figured it wouldn't be too bad. We were wrong. 7am we were woken up by screaming children outside our door. Not to mention mothers breast feeding at the pool, dirty dippers under the bar and kids sitting on tables. The kids ruined our vacation.

- The restaurant and bar staff are very nice, prompt, and VERY appreciative of tips. Also, they more staff see you tip, the more drinks you will get brought to you without ordering. However, the sales people are very rude, make sure you say NO to any offers.

- The food is okay. I didn't get sick so no complaints here.

- if you decide to leave the resort like we did, be very careful, and be ready to get swarmed with more sales people. Other than that, it wasn't scary.

reviews.author: Zack
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancún
One of the worst all inclusive experiences we’ve had!!!

This hotel is 3 stars at MOST !
There are absolutely no greeters, no one welcomes you. You enter the lobby expecting to have cold air? Forget about it. No AC, This building has AC only in certain spots. Check in was relatively painless. But the heat in this building is unbearable.
We got an ocean view “luxury” room on the 6th floor. You will see from my pictures what luxury means at Paradisus. (Broken mirror, disgusting bathroom trashcan, rotten floors, trims falling apart, broken furniture, etc.).
One day they turned off the water without notice. When I called the front desk, they asked me if I wanted to take a shower ?
All pools are in need of major renovations. Pebble is falling apart, tiles broken and missing, water is disgusting dirty, murky. Water jets blow water sporadically.
Some parts of the building are being renovated, so expect to smell oil based paint fumes everywhere.
Palm trees are dying, half of the palms are dry and sick.
Customer service by the pool is below average. They approach and forget about you for hours and hours. (even if you tip them good).
Customer service at front desk (Diego) is BAD. We asked to extend our checkout for only 1 hour, because our flight was at 6PM, he flat out refused to accommodate at all, without any sympathy.
The pool site food is bad, I mean bad, the French fries tastes like old used up corn oil. Chicken nuggets are terrible. The only OK food is chicken quesadillas and the ice cream.
The beach is full of seaweed and no one cleans it.
The cabanas by the pool and at the beach are $250 (yes, US dollars). Never have I seen that price tag, not even in a 5 star hotel like Hyatt Ziva a few miles away.
There are no fun activities and shows if you are looking for that. The only OK show was the magic show. If you are with children, they will be very bored.
Overall the food was bad at this hotel except the steakhouse and the buffet.
We got couples spa package, Oh man it was the worst we’ve ever had. Unprofessional massage, and cold massaging lotion.
I honestly feel bad writing this bad review but I felt like I owe it to people who want to visit.
I will never visit this place.

reviews.author: Liz Sepulveda
reviews.text:
Booked at Paradisus twice.
The onboarding staff both times were not pleasant. The second time we booked the hotel booking stated they would provide rides from the airport on arrival & departure—neither happened & because we needed a taxi from the airport the day of because Paradisus didn’t book our taxi we had to pay $75 to get to the hotel from the airport on arrival. Lesson learned, don’t trust the hotel to be honest. When we had to leave they didn’t want to book us our taxi unless we paid them another booking fee for the taxi, so we just ordered once again another taxi last minute for $30 to get to the airport on departure. They will not credit your account either for their mistakes.

We also booked The Reserve which is an up charge & it states you’ll have a butler to help with restaurant reservations & anything else you need—there was no one in person. It’s someone that messages you over WhatsApp letting you know that the restaurant you wanted doesn’t have reservations available. All our reservations were given to us at 7pm at night for the week & by the time we got to the reservation the restaurant of the evening would tell us what was sold out already. Meaning that food selection at restaurants was subpar. We met other people that were not impressed by the food availability considering we paid for the reserve & expected better customer service. Be prepared to eat hamburgers & chicken nuggets because that’s what was mostly available for us. It’s not an impressive food experience if you’re planning to not leave the resort like we did. You’re better off paying for a less expensive hotel in the area & dine out at restaurants is what we & other guests decided would be the best option, or just try a different upscale resort in the area & hope the guest treatment is better by staff at other resorts. The Reserve pool staff is 💯 great, no complaints there. They definitely were better than the concierge & guest check in staff at The Reserve.

We gave them two opportunities to be great & we just regret spending our weeks at Paradisus, we look forward to exploring other resorts in the area for our future travels.
Fool me once Paradisus shame on you; fool me twice & shame on me for believing you’d try to do better—not trusting you again.

reviews.author: Oanh Nguyen
reviews.text: This was my second time there and it had certainly gone down hill.  We was not able to make any reservations to any restaurants we wanted (sushi and tapa place) Bc they said they were fully booked for the next three days.  So we ate at the buffet and the women who greeted you there were never nice.  Only the men who were servers were pleasant to talk to.  The pool ran out of towels and bartenders at the swim up pool seems to hate their jobs.  Not to mention our room just looks old and musty.  I was really embarrassed that I wowed about this place to my gf who came with me because I been here in 2019.  I’ll will be trying a different resort next time

reviews.author: Lan C
reviews.text: Pretty much all the restaurants require reservation. The process is long and tedious. The front desk doesn’t do them and makes you go to some particular concierge on the ground level. The wait is awful and overall just a waste of time. It took 30mins of wait just to reserve dinner.  Book another place.

reviews.author: Charita Roman
reviews.text: I booked my clients here to celebrate mother/grandmothers 82nd birthday. after a 2.5 hour shuttle, they checked in and were made to upgrade to be on the same side of the resort. Choices were to put an 82 year old woman on a roll away bed or upgrade to get the 2 beds they requested. And $90 plus tax per night for upgrade. Didn’t expect to have connecting rooms or even on the same floor. However, expectation would be to have people on the same booking to be in at least the same vicinity. Received complaints from clients and called hotel. Dialed back in 3 times after being passed around and then hung up on. Won’t be recommending this chain to anyone. They leave in a few days. Unfortunately, I couldn’t get the resort changed as they already checked in and grandmother is too tired to move. Clearly they don’t care.  They have her card now for the upgrade. Never again.

reviews.author: John Socom458
reviews.text: Don't try to use the website or call them direct from the states and when you do the language barrier is very bad so then ....It All started at check-in. We requested an upgrade because we heard that the rooms were old and he looked confused,when we asked him this question....He only gave us one option for upgrade which was an additional $700 for 7 days. We agreed to do that and it also came with a gold bracelet which we still don't know what the magical golden bracelet does. He said the problem is it comes with two beds. We said that's not going to work with us so he said there's nothing he could do for us .... The place was not very busy and there's a lot of rooms there so I didn't understand why he couldn't do it but apparently they couldn't so we told him to give us our original room which was an ocean view king bed. He put us in building one at the very top. There's no air conditioning in any of the lobbies. Barely any inside of the restaurants so you don't get the nice Caribbean breeze in the lobby. It's a stale musty smell from all the plants that they have grown in the lobbies It's pretty to look at but doesn't do anything for comfort. The staff there, the workers, the maids, the pool boys, the waiters and waitresses were absolutely wonderful. But the hotel is definitely run down old and visible water damage throughout my room and in the walking area on level one and zero. They're doing construction so two of the restaurants are shut down. Another one is usually randomly shut down for dinner or lunch throughout the week.... The lobby is full of dust and omg I can only imagine the noise in the rooms facing the main lobby.... They did not explain how any of the cabanas worked. What your bracelet got you into? He did tell us we got a free COVID test for the return trip home. We only were able to reserve restaurant seating for dinner three times out of the seven nights we were there. We had to eat off the resort for dinner 4 nights..   room service we were told was free on the web site. They did not explain that it comes with a $5 delivery fee which we didn't find out till after 5 days of being there. A lot of this mix up and issue could have been solved at check-in, but the line in the TV couldn't have been solved at check in The refrigerator that never got cold, Couldn't have been solved at check in.... The fact we paid for ocean view room and the concrete balcony and more green plants truly obstructed your beautiful view but you could hear it lol. But anywhere in Cancun that we went the people were wonderful... Just next time we will choose a different hotel

reviews.author: August Chianese
reviews.text:
We (my wife and I) really, really loved this hotel from our last two visits here, so once travel started opening up again (COVID), we were excited to book another trip back to the Paradisus. Not quite the same this time.

Let's start with the positives:

1) The resort is still a beautiful place, inside and out. The design of it, the decor in the main areas, the insanely impressive atrium with all the live plants and cool lighting.

2) The pools are still the same as we remember and equally well maintained.

3) You get a free antigen test (for COVID) as part of your package (at least for now).

4) They're responsive to any requests to refill the mini-bar.

That is unfortunately the end of the  positives. Now, on to the negatives:

1) We paid for an ocean view room, one of the recently refurbished units. The new rooms have a greenish/yellow wall, plus a lot of white, white furniture, and...that might be it. The bathrooms are still old and brown, not to mention VERY dark. Our mini-fridge has a loose gasket around the door which keeps falling off, and the door latch catches against the wall when closing it, leaving your door ajar.

2) The pillows in the bed are made from some kind of material that smells so god awful it makes us want to vomit. I'm not exaggerating, they're terrible.

3) Got here while it was raining. Had a puddle of water in front of our room's patio door. Talking 2ftx4ft. Called maintenance. They mopped it up and dumped the water on to the patio, the same place its been blowing in through the door from. They left a towel on the floor, and after 2 hours, it was soaked and we had an even bigger puddle. We were on our way out. Came to much more water in the front of the room, close to the door! Went to the front desk to complain and was told "it gets wet in the rooms."

4) They added a $5 surcharge to any and all room service orders.

5) There's this new Melia app you're supposed to use while you're here for doing things like making restaurant reservations and ordering room service, but I only knew this from one email from Melia after we booked. Useless, and don't bother using it to check-in; they still do it the normal way at reception regardless wasting 30min.

6) And the person checking us in was as dull and uninterested as he could be. He was silent most of the time, and when he finished up, didn't bother to try and tell us about any changes to the hotel.

7) They didn't explain how they're handling COVID when we checked in, but saw they never enforced mask wearing on guests.

8) You're supposed to wear wasteful plastic gloves in the buffet to use the tongs to pick up your food since they don't serve you (like other hotels are doing right now).

9) Service in the restaurants, even in the buffet, is mostly atrocious. Slow, uninterested.

10) You need to get purple towels from outside for the pools. We, and other guests, had to go inside the hut ourselves, open up plastic bags containing fresh towels, and take them for ourselves. I have no idea when staff show up to hand out towels but its after 8am.

11) On our 2nd day, while it was lightly raining, people were enjoying the pool anyway, and we decided to do the same. They somehow ran out of towels?

12) The air conditioner in our room doesn't cool the room below 71-72 degrees and leaves it super humid.

13) Room service. We had one good experience, one bad. The guy today on the phone was the rudest, most ignorant member of staff we've encountered here. Room service food is usually cold and small portions, too.

13) Zero entertainment here - boring.

14) The food. Not much good to say here. We went to Enso, the international restaurant, and neither of us could finish our meal. My wife had incredibly rubbery octopus, and I had ribs that the knife almost couldn't cut through.

15) The dumbest thing we've seen this time: they modified ALL lounge chairs so they cannot be adjusted.

reviews.author: C. Mendoza
reviews.text: Nice rooms, I got the reserve experience.... nothing over what you would expect over just paying the regular all inclusive.  They have activities for reg. Customers and supposedly different ones for reserve members.... lie! Reserve activities were not being done.  I ended up walking around looking for the activities cause the Staff was nowhere to be found.  Then I would be told the activity was at the regular area ( with the regular members.... a different activity 🙄) at a different time.  I'm spending my time walking around looking for the "planned activities"  schedules not being followed on time either. I paid for the reserve cause I wanted to feel special, expected extra mile service.... not the case.  Jets and bars at the reserve pool not turned on/open.  Had to try to find help or get my drinks myself from different areas on the resort. Came celebrating anniversary, expected to relax and just enjoy.... I end up having to help myself around the resort and go on quests to find the so called activities for "reserve members".... ending up getting the activities for regular members. 😑 if you decide to come.... just get the reg. All inclusive.

reviews.author: Richard Borg
reviews.text: The food was very bad, me and my girlfriend both left loosing weight on this trip. Drinks were not special, with the bartender a majority of the time just blending ice with some juice and any alcohol they choose. Pool hours were terrible, closing at 7PM with no hot tub. We had a Bali bed reserved for a whole day and had it taken over by someone else, when we were reassured multiple times that if we arrive prior to 11am and occupy it no one else can take it. Check-in took a long time, and I had requested a room upgrade prior to arrival through email which was confirmed. On arrival, they were not aware of this and made me show them an email to prove this. For this price there are many other resorts to choose to stay at in Cancun, and I would recommend that you do.

reviews.author: Fran Bee
reviews.text:
Nice location and hotel is beautiful. Up on arrival there are staff members charging you with questions trying to figure out if you are married to do the timeshare tour. You are asked this numerous times throughout your stay!
There are 9 restuarants on this resort but you can never get reservations. Not even booking 2 days out. I was disappointed with the level of service and how they were not doing to accommodate on dining options.

reviews.author: Peter Cheng
reviews.text: Paradise with poor process flow and management on the facilities and room. Stayed here Aug, 2022. Room was definitely outdated, dirty floor and broken hair dryer after entry the room. Pool area is beautiful but lack of consideration of flow. One side of pool is not really convenient to go to other side. Make you walk to get towel and drop towel. Small and sketchy elevators. Lack of toilets, not really convenient to access just few of them. Lots disappointment during the stay!

reviews.author: Peeyush Jain
reviews.text: The reason i am giving 2 star is because of the poor service. Our first two days were fabulous but when hotel was fully occupied, service just went down. 30min lineup to get omelet, restaurants are small and hard to get reservation. Line-ups everywhere, no prior information about daliy activities, at least provide hotel map. Very minimal vegetarian options to enjoy. 3 days my room has the same dirty glasses, no management to review. It is a huge property but definitely not 5 start.

reviews.author: Katlyn Lovelady
reviews.text: Let me first say that the ONE person who saved our vacation was SAL at the pool bar! This man is amazing! I give him 5 stars because if it wasn't for him then our trip would have been ruined. When I first got there I asked him for a mix drink called a Grasshopper. He explained to me that the liquor for that drink isn't very popular so the resort doesn't carry it. On my 3rd day there, Sal and I kept joking with each other and every drink he handed me he said it was a Grasshopper. Shortly after this man left the bar for a bit. I just figured he was on a break. Little did I know that this man was out tracking down the liquor needed to make me my favorite drink. The next drink he handed me he told me it was yet again another grasshopper, except this time it WAS! That man was the only man in this entire resort that made us feel like we were welcomed and that he cared if we were having a good time. SAL deserves everything amazing this world has to offer him, he was a god sent! Now....to the rest of the stay.   Ugh where to start. This was my first time ever doing an all inclusive resort and I was so excited. We had a group of four coming from all across the USA to meet at this resort for a reunion. When we booked our rooms we were told that the first group that was going to get there at 8am would be able to get their bracelets and get access to the amenities ASAP. When they checked they did get their bracelets and they took their luggage and told them to come back at noon to get their rooms. They were also told that their room request was met and that we would have 2 rooms right next to each other, and that the second group coming to check in later in the day would have no issues checking in! We wanted to verify this because the second group coming in would have no way to contact the rest of the group once they landed. They came back at noon and of course the check in line was busy, so they were told to come back at 1. At 1 o'clock they were told to come back at 2. At 2pm they were given a temporary room where they could hangout and relax for a bit. When they walked into the room there was blood on the floor. They called the front desk and the workers came to clean it up and confirmed it was in fact blood. At this time they asked for their luggage to be brought to them so they could shower and change. They were told they couldn't find their luggage. At 3pm they went to check in again and were told there were still no rooms available. During the time that they were waiting in line, we heard countless people switch their room set ups....asking for a different view, different bed configuration, different floor, different side of the hotel....ect. Every time the staff accommodated them. At close to 5pm the second half of our party came in and was told they couldn't check in, and there was nothing they could do for them unless the rest of the party was there. Finally around 5:30 we found each other just by chance, then the nightmare of getting a room started. They tried to put us across the hotel from each other,  different floors, and incorrect beds. We kept asking to speak to a manager and no one would listen to us. As we were standing there and they were "working" on our issue, they asked us to step aside so they could help other people. At first we did, then after standing there for about 30 mins we realized they weren't helping us. That's when we had to get aggressive and refuse to move until we had room keys in our hand. Even though we had booked our rooms 4 months ago, we didn't get the beds we requested, or the room accommodation. They still couldn't find pour luggage and it was close to 7pm till we got it. The first 12 hours of  our vacation was spent in the check in room. The rest of the trip kept going that same way. Making dinner reservations was a joke, getting anyone to help you was like asking them for their first born,  the food was good, but the service pretty much ruined everything. Thank God for Sal!

reviews.author: Aline Carone
reviews.text: I am here and constantly irritated at this resort. Ever since we got here it’s being upsetting as only to check in we were waiting in line about 15 minutes. Every single time I come to the reception for anything it takes a long time to even be helped. I try to change dólares to pesos and every time they don’t have it and ask me to come back later, but the other side of the resort has them... when I go to the other side to change money then I need to take my passport or a copy because the two sides apparently don’t communicate. The room gets hot in the middle of the night and the AC can’t keep up. I swear at night and I have complained multiple times and nothing gets done. One time someone came over and re set the thermostat system and then the other times I complained nobody even came or followed up with me. The beds are comfortable and they did upgrade us to a bigger room since it was 3 adults and 1 child, but now every time I am asking for something or not satisfied with something they make sure to mention to me we were upgraded out of the goodness of their heart, as if I should be grateful and quiet. They did try very very hard to pressure us to pay $500 for the upgrade and I told the we had already spent so much money and I just couldn’t. Let me tell you that I spent over 3000 dólares in airfare and hotel for me and my 5 year old son for 6 nights, then we added my brother who met us here from Brazil for $142 a night and also we added my boyfriend for 2 nights for another $142 a night. We get here and everything is either for “Royal” or “family concierge”. Basically we are not paying enough to get the vest service you know. We go to the bar at the pool first night and it was 6pm. The bartender tell us he is only serving “royal” at that time. I was very upset because basically he was telling me I was not paying enough at an all inclusive resort to get a drink at the pool. Now I know also that the bars at the pools close at 5pm which is absurd to me. The beach is full of sargassum a type of nasty algae and just not good at all, but even if it was, they offer a special area for people with family concierge upgrade with lots of comfortable. For the regular folks only some not so comfortable metal chairs and tables and umbrellas. Also not many chairs, umbrellas and tables at the beach or pool. I asked for reservations at the 4 restaurants allowed to us regular folks with no upgrade. I received only 2 reservations. I was upset because my boyfriend was only staying two nights and I really wanted him to try one of the restaurants. I complained but nothing was done except the next day I received one new restaurant confirmation, however we left the room for the pool at 3:30pm not returning until 6pm. The reservation was put under my door for 6pm. Like really? The buffets have some good food and it tastes very good, however there isn’t much variety from day to day so it’s the same stuff you are eating unless you are blessed to get reservations at the restaurants. A lot of people say on the reviews they experienced some amazing service here. A lot of people are very polite and friendly but a lot of them are also not trained well and don’t know correct information to give. I was told when we got here that they didn’t offer any beach umbrellas or chairs unless we upgraded. I was furious and then the guy asked around and informed me that they do offer that service. The reception has this very very strong soapy smell which gives me a headache every time since I always have to wait for help there. All in all I am just not happy because I spent way too much money to be served like this.

reviews.author: Jr Lopez
reviews.text: First off the hotel is beautiful the staff was both great and some rude. Armando in ENSO was amazing he always greeted my family and I and his partner as well. We got bugged so many times to go to this timeshare type breakfast in our first four days we got asked 6 times too excessive. Our room was in an area where is was being painted it smelled terrible. The food was not too good but was not too bad either it was ok to get by. Dinner was a mess you have to make reservations for the good spots and you are not allowed to walk in. There was one day we weren’t allowed to have breakfast in the ENSO due to a private event. There was no communication about this whatsoever! We stayed there Oct 14-20 I honestly don’t think I’ll return to this hotel again it did not meet our expectations of Quality what an all inclusive resort should have the house keeping lady was amazing she would give us fresh towels everyday and would go out her way to fix our girls stuffed animals and their little things in a very welcoming way.

reviews.author: Lisandra Maldonado
reviews.text: Still at the property. Hotel is good, looks nice and clean. Too much people and just a few servers at the pool area. Don't pay for the reserve, is not worthy. You should have access to a private pool just for the reserve guests, but here you cant if you have kids. Reserve pool is just for kids, some of the lady's that do the check in at the Reserve not really friendly. At the pool the service is really slow, on kids area is just 1 guy for all of them( not server fault) the buffet is not really good, I just like it on breakfast time. Im not trying to get a luxury stay but Im my opinion mot the best on Cancun. For me Paradisus Playa del Carmen, the best. Reserve stat will make you feel in really paradise.

reviews.author: angel antonio espinosa gaucin
reviews.text: The quality of the hotel  is far from 5 stars.  There's many other better options for the same price or even lower fees. Food is fair, the climate was not working, the sink in the bathroom was clogged. Theres no guide to amenities.  Service is very basic even at the "The reserve"

reviews.author: Yasar M
reviews.text: Let me start off by saying the staff is very freindly. The hotel is pretty clean but not really updated in terms of furnishings. First room they put us in had a huge water leak, 2nd wrong beds, 3rd the cold water used for hand sinks and toilet was cut off for 3 hours. Wifi constantly dropped starting our 2nd day. For the amount of money they charged us for 3 night stay all inclusive I was expecting better food. Food was mediocre at best. For example the pizza for my kids from any location was on some dry bread and the cheese resembled and tasted like cream cheese. The grill cheese was barely toasted bread with unmelted slices of cheese.  The soft tacos were over cooked and turned hard but I ate them anyway which ripped the roof of my mouth but they were good. The chicken tikka from one of the restaurant was so bad I took one bite and spit out. I looked to her and said all these restaurants taste like airplane food that's been dressed up. The tiramisu was all creme and maybe 5% cake, the list goes on..   I guess to the average person trying this for the first time everything is good but for us we ordered  food from every restaurant to be disappointed. It would take maybe 10% more effort and cost to make it really good. Would I stay again? No!

reviews.author: David Tatham
reviews.text:
I mean really it was just ok....the adult area was very slow, quiet, super hot and most off all boring.. the adults pool gets no activities.. the food was sub par and the open "lunch" buffets was the same meat and cheeses... the steak house fat shamed my wife 3x...2x in once visit by asking her if she wanted a special chair or on a bench seat. The taco place was probably the best. Rooms cycle AC so be ready to be hot at night.. the "red" room is like a hot box and doesnt get moving till 10 problem is no one knew if was there so unless your a dedicated club dancers its empty. Maria the butler and that staff I would give a 5 star to cause they were just awesome!

The bartenders were all just ok except for the mixology guy he was good.. the rest pretty much gave ya crushed ice drinks...

We originally went here cause our normal place sun palace was being renovated...I was hoping to find a second spot to go but sadly I'd prefer to sun palace hands down.

reviews.author: Carmen Reyes
reviews.text: I dont think this hotel deserve a 4.5.  I would give them a 4.  I just came back from vacation July 31st.  I was not pleased at all, some of the server were rude, if you ask them for a fork you have to be on your spot.  My refigerator didn't work, water was coming out from the bottom, my bathroom mirror was all dirty.  I feel the workers just wants to complete their job and does not gives lots of costumer service.  I would not recomend paradisus.  The buffet, everyday was the same food.

reviews.author: Sarah Creeden
reviews.text: We stayed herein October for our honeymoon and our experience was just OKAY at best.  When we weren't being constantly pestered to attend meetings about a time share, we were constantly being bombarded about add-ons at the spa or other activities that cost more like parasailing and some night club downtown.  We just wanted to relax.  It took me awhile to decide whether to write this or not be decided I should.  The property was beautiful but the amount of targeting we received from staff was a HUGE downside when we were just there to relax after our wedding.

reviews.author: Elise Afrahte
reviews.text: People constantly go in and out of your hotel room! The butler, the housekeeper, the mini bar service, the towel service..Sometimes even without knocking! So when there was stolen from our room, impossible to know who did it. We kept our valuable things in the safe of course, but you don't put chargers and electrical toothbrushes in your safe, right? Those people are not ashamed to steal even those silly things. It was a bitter end to our stay

reviews.author: Janior
reviews.text:
Stayed from 12/8/19 to 12/15/19. Overall we had a good time, OUTSIDE the resort. I'll break it down by category to make it easier.

Check in: It was long and they try to get you to sign up for some timeshare presentation that they call a "club membership" where you earn "points" by paying a yearly fee that if you don't use you lose. We fell for it before doing research on it and gave them a $20 deposit.  When we realized what the real intent of the presentation was we decided not to show up. I wish I could say that was the end of it but it wasn't. A couple of hours after we skipped the presentation a woman called our room asking why we didnt attend. We simply stated we weren't interested, much to her shock.  Then two guys, Victor (who we originally signed up with for the presentation) and Alfonso, kept harrasing us when they saw us, asking us to do the presentation and earn extra "discounts" on various amenities throughout the resort. It took us having to be stern with them for them to leave us alone. Victor took the hint but Alfonso didn't get it. At various times he would shout our last name and run towards us as we were going about our business trying to enjoy the resort to ask why we wouldn't attend the presentation and what he could do to get us to attend. When he realized he couldn't sweetened the deal for us he began insisting that we go collect the deposit.  When a day or two passed and we didn't go because we knew this was their final attempt at trying to lure us in for the presentation, Alfonso kept bugging us everytime we walked by (literally every time). We skipped the presentation on Monday & on Thursday this guy sees us yet again and gives us the same rundown but this time stating that if we went to collect our deposit we would get 5 times the amount back. Jesus..

Room: Nice, except for the fact that there were two problems;
1. There was a German roach in the room and 2. The room was located literally right above the night club where they blast music at late hours of the night.
Now the second point wasn't that much of an issue because it's a night club & we get the purpose is to enjoy and dance, it's just that the room was in a terrible spot to be right above a nightclub. They changed our room to the other side and that was nice of them to be able to do, however the roach was disgusting & it was never addressed by them. They simply notated that we were moved due to the noise of the night club.

Food: Severely underwhelming. I've been to other resorts on the hotel strip and this by far was the most underwhelming food I've ever had. Everything was bland. Nothing had taste except for 1-2 things on the menu or at the buffet. Not to mention, that the buffet menu was literally the same every day except for 1-2 dish variations. Also, we couldn't eat at all the restaurants offered. We tried to make reservations the day we got there but we were told they were already booked days out, so we didn't even get to try all the restaurants. Overall the food was plain and flavorless. We resorted to eating outside of the resort for dinner almost every night which is a shame considering this was supposed to be an all inclusive.
I will say that Cristian at the Blue Agave restaurant was AMAZING!! Very friendly guy, cheerfull & always made sure we were taken care of! He also provided local recommendations for things to do. Seriously, one of the highlights of our trip at the resort.

Amenities: When I booked the resort there was no mention about there being different tiers of all-inclusive stays like royal service, family concierge, and main. There were certain amenities that we couldn't use. For example, I really wanted a resort with a game room that had billiard tables and such. I saw this was an option in the resort and was one of the reasons I booked it. When we attempt to use it we couldn't because we're not part of the family concierge. Also, the pool did not have enough seats to accommodate the amount of normal traffic they

reviews.author: El Ay
reviews.text: Rooms are okay, not top quality; service ok, location great but hard to get up/down stairs for beach access. To get a chair by the pool or the beach you have to get up early. Bottom line this and all Zona hotelera hotels/resorts in Cancun are a Money Hasle Business from the Moment you arrive at the airport until you are back at the airport. You have to negotiate hard people or paid the high price plus give tip and pay an eco tax when you arrive at your stay. Enjoy vacation

reviews.author: Michael J. Fowler
reviews.text:
This is a HUGE resort and this was my third time visiting, but it is in real need of a facelift. A big time renovation top to bottom. Plaster was chipping and there were water leaks in the ceilings . The junior suites rooms have not changed since my last visit in 2003.

The buffet (Malva) is decent with great service and a variety of food but the atmosphere is chaotic at times. Unless you have Royal Service you have a tough time getting into the ala carte restaurants, you can't get into the best restaurant in the property La Palapa.

Blue Agave and Mole serve basically the same menu. Bana was the best. Enso, an Asian fusion restaurant was nearly deserted. Fuego has turned to a sandwich bar. If you can get a good price it's still worth going for the bars, pools, beach and the sensational people watching. Coco's beach bar was awesome. Fabiola is an awesome server. Red Velvet lounge was being used as a dressing room for the live shows. The pools are beautiful. The beach was awesome.

The workers and service are excellent. Still if Melia wants to charge $2500 for a week, they need to renovate this hotel and fix the a la carte restaurants, the crumbling plaster and water leaks and renovate the junior suites

reviews.author: Alexa Ortega
reviews.text: My Husband and I arrived from Nee York City on Friday and wanted to have the experience of staying in two different hotels to compare our stay , fist we stay at Gran fiesta Americana Coral beach 🏖 it was awesome .. they gave us sparkling white wine Fruit 🍉 in other words the attention was great . the minute we got to this Paradisus hotel nothing of the things we have requested was given. Ocean 🌊 view for Us is a Big plus not the best view the have a room hidden all the Beaty .  So as for us not a good experience.

reviews.author: Anez Narayan
reviews.text: For a hotel that claims to be all inclusive, it is anything but inclusive. The hotel charge over $100 per day to use the cabanas by the ocean & pool. They have a golf course but they charge to use the equipment. Some restaurants are not included in the package. The food at the restaurants was subpar. The only good food was the buffet for breakfast lunch and dinner as there was a variety of fresh food at each meal. The staff were attentive & room service cleaned our rooms twice a day. There are better all inclusive hotels in the area.

reviews.author: Luis Gonzalez
reviews.text: Organization is a mess. Had to move to 3 different "front desks" to check in while waiting for more than 30 min. Then I realized I wasn't given the cards needed to exchange for towels so had to go back and wait again because they ran out. Finally when I went to get towels so the family could get out of the pool, I was told they also ran out of towels! Had to wait for another hour to get some... The place is full of helpers but they just stand and walk all over the place not helping much.

reviews.author: Meghan Wensyel
reviews.text:
Curious as to what scale is used for determining the quality of a hotel. I was so excited we were going to a 5 star resort. 🙄 My expectations were obviously too high. 🤷‍♀️ There have been a few members on the entertainment team which have been gems but everything else can be described as subpar.

I forgot to add that the ceiling fell down in our bathroom during the middle of the night our first night here. The spot that they patched is already starting to crack again.

reviews.author: Aaradhya Tumsi
reviews.text: rooms were terrible. 8 roaches found in the room. bathrooms were disgusting i was so grossed out. view and restraunts were good but room was awful. service was terrible. they did nothing to help the bugs.

reviews.author: keith lancaster
reviews.text:
I was highly disappointed when my initial check in didn't honor the king bed request dispite prior email to ensure we would not have hassle of checking out to check back in due to a separate reservation.  After the first night and a bad review, Miguel from the Quality department upgraded us to ocean view in royal service pyramid which seemed great until you realize he did not clarify you do not have access to any facilities or amenities of a royal service guest. What a sham of an upgrade!! Not to mention that room is small and mediocre. Lastly, I had to sign a waiver for this upgrade.. guess joke was on me!

In response to management's comment:
I want to reiterate that the upgrade was appreciated but it appeared to defeat the purpose since staff DID NOT clarify everything regarding limitations to first time guest. Please note for future guest.

reviews.author: Nikki S
reviews.text: We just had our second vacation to Cancun and stayed again at this hotel for the second time. I have to say the first time around was amazing, the second time will make me probably not return. Upon check in we got a double bed room over the club (requested a king room), there was music and drunk people that could be heard till 2am. When I went to change rooms the next day they gave me push back till I asked for a manager then all of a sudden a room was available. There used to be snacks stocked in the in room fridge, there was nothing, also never restocked the soda and water, I had to call for more and it took almost an hour to get it. When we arrived we knew we had to make reservations for dinner and could not get one for two days?!?! Why am I paying "All Inclusive" if I can't get in any place to eat but the buffet? Buffet is terrible, bland foods and quality has really gone down hill and they were constantly out of items. The wait staff by the pool no longer bring you food unless you rent a cabana ($130-$180a day). Also upon check in I was harassed by a concierge to sign up for a time share and constantly confronted by her every time I saw her to sign up! When I would see her and go the other way. I should not have to do that while I am on vacation relaxing. There use to be shows inside that were amazing, they have now moved them outside and they are very boring also super windy and no drink service outside like there use to be when the shows were inside. Towels by the pool are always out and when you go to get one when there are some they keep them behind the shelf so they can bug you about buying some add on package. Needless to say if I do go back to Cancun in the future I will be looking at other places to stay since new hotels are being built. Buyer beware, hotel is cutting back and being cheap but still charging the same cost!

reviews.author: Arnyce Adams-Tilghman
reviews.text:
Paradisus exterior and public interior is picture perfect. My experience there was a nightmare and their customer service sucks. I was there for 5 days , in my 5 day stay I had 4 different rooms all steming from same type problem. Room 1- they were going to give me a upgrade 3 rooms down for $200 more same room no upgrade, room 2 - woke up in middle of night bathroom flooded, room 3- nice room, started out door water pouring out of light fixture like a waterfall. All issues were report to the front desk with a promise the the problem would be addressed, Needless to say nothing was done in either case which is why they had to keep moving me. each time I would come back to the room the watter was still were I left all over the bathroom floor with the same towels I had put down in order to use it. I finally asked for a manager, who went with me to room 3 and saw the conditions and took pictures and after 3hours gave me room 4. When I asked them how was I going to be compensated, I was advised that they would give me 3 chocolate covered strawberries and a bottle of liquor. (even though I advised them I didn't drink) and I would not be in the room because I would be at my granddaughters wedding. So they offered me $30.00 USD to spend in their gift shop, still I refused. So when I asked for some money back for my room and being inconvienced for 4 days I was told because I booked through a travel agent and not them directly they could not do that.and the last room they gave was an ocean view so I should consider that as conpensation. Lol
they have a plumbing and customer service issue that they need to address and put something place to address these issues. In order to keep you 4 1/2 star rating the above issues need to be addressed.

reviews.author: Aracely Magallon
reviews.text: Rating this 2/5 due to the unprofessionlism and unresponsiveness of the resort employees. I booked for a large group and paid over 2k as a deposit which the contract stated I would receive within 3 weeks upon checkout. It’s been over 2 months and the accounting team only answers my emails after several follow ups and keeps making excuses as to why it’s taking this long to reimburse me. Each time I write, I receive a different answer. Not only is this unaccepatable but it’s also illegal. Steer clear from this resort if you wish to book for a large group.

reviews.author: Ornella R
reviews.text:
Royal service offers you two people called mayordomos, they will be in charge of all your reservations per your request. However reservations are supposed to be made on the same day for the guest convenience (Paradisus Policy). With us wasn't the case. People had reservations made with the priority of days, so we were not able to enjoy restaurants under reservations. We had a last minute call for a reservation in a restaurant, my moyordomo knew about my food allergies and he made a reservation on a restaurant that wasn't for me at all. Service was not the best to be honest. I paid for a luxury service that it wasn't worth it. I arrived to Paradisus Cancun after being a week in Paradisus Playa del Carmen, and WOW! Playa del Carmen's service was completely different this is why I am giving a low rate to this location.

Plus when I arrived to the hotel, our room had old towels by the balcony doors, the towels had MOLD!

Day care was good, but the rooms smell was away too strong because the hardwood floor was new.

The spa was also a little dirty, and the relaxing area was not the best.

I came from another franchise whose service was 5/5 for everything. This place is no bueno for the price.

reviews.author: Charles Alicia
reviews.text:
I don’t even know where to start with this review, I usually do not write many reviews but I will this time because I don’t want customers to be fooled and be sold something that’s not worth what they are paying for.

For starters this is supposed to be a five stars hotel, apart from the waiters good customer service I don’t know where else this fits in the category.

Starting with the check in, the receptionist named Yuli was the slowest receptionist I have ever encountered! It took about an hour to get us checked in, and at the time of our check in (3pm) 3 of our 4 rooms were not ready. We also had to come back to get our keys and where inside the room by 4pm.

When I booked this hotel it caught my attention because of the “many different restaurants this hotel has” but don’t be fooled, we were not able to eat in any of these restaurants because they were always “full.” We even tried booking two nights in advance and still had no luck. Some of their restaurants were closed, and I saw that their restaurants do not hold the capacity for the amount of guests they have in this hotel. We had to eat at the buffet Naos every night and the food wasn’t even good, not many varieties either. I would give it 2/5.

Unlucky for us the weekend I spent here rained everyday none stop, on the last day my room and my friends room were flooded due to the rain, I called reception and they told me I wasn’t the only one, that every other room in the side of the hotel we were in were having the same problem, but if they know this why don’t they fix this?

Also a lot of the common areas had water on the floor and water dripping from their roofs. The rooms are old and not very clean. They charge you $5 if you want room service and alcohol bottles are not included in your room.

The receptionists were not very helpful at all. For any inconvenience I had to call a couple times before they helped me do anything.

Overall for the price of this hotel I do not recommend this hotel. DONT BE FOOLED!!! I have been to other resorts in Cancun and this is such a disappointment.

reviews.author: José Roberto Luna
reviews.text: Overall Paradisus hotel offers good quality services, however they don't get more than 2 stars because they have a classist system offering service, segregating people and discriminating based on colors of bracelets.  Definitely I don't want to come back to a discriminatory system.

reviews.author: Pardeep Singla
reviews.text: When we booked the room, they mentioned reserve vip rooms are best and they asked to pay for the best rooms . And when we reach room was very small, we booked Jrdeluxe reserve suite. Reception service was very poor, we waited fie one and half an hour to get our room. It was pretty annoying to paid that much and get this type of service.

reviews.author: A G
reviews.text:
The lobby is gorgeous... But that's all.
Check in lady is very unfriendly  (belive her name is Karen )charged us twice for the room, even though we told her we've already payed.
The ROOMS are very outdated, and smells like mold.
The materass is old and uncomfortable,
The toilet is inside a closet
the tub/shower is very old
The KIDS/BABY zone is very dirty and unsanitary.
The BEACH  is not stroller accessible.
NO KIDS POOL
The servers are very nice and polite, that is the only reason why I'm giving 3 stars otherwise I would have given 1.
ABSOLUTELY NOT A 5 STARS RESORT! MORE like A 3 STARS RESORT.

reviews.author: Dawn Murphy
reviews.text: Don’t bother getting the preferred package, the view may be beautiful, but the entertainment is zero the services. OK, the family side looked so much more fun.

reviews.author: R.
reviews.text:
Not for sure the best vacation ever.
Nothing to look forward to regarding entertainments.
Restaurants: after trying them I would not go back ever. The buffet is ok when it is not crowded.
Nothing to expect from Melia Club, of course because we already are victims of this club. I hope no one else makes the same error to become Melia Club members.....unless you are prepared to pay more and more and to be fooled without any rewards back.
Only the staff was great!

reviews.author: Oskar Dez
reviews.text: Rooms are outdated,AC hardly works in each room,check in is about an hour long waiting,room service was a chore,and you hardly had access to all the pools. FYI,the person that checks you in,will offer you a free room upgrade in secret,if you tip him. DONT DO IT! Room is still going to be outdated with a bad view. I rather stay at Xcaret Hotel again.

reviews.author: Ann
reviews.text: Be prepared not be able to sleep. Extremely noisy. They have some lounge playing loud music with drum every night until 2:30am! Complained to the front desk, but no change. The walls and our bed are still shaken with the drums!

reviews.author: Mitch Berglund
reviews.text: I just stayed at the Paradisus the past five days in Cancun. This was my third time staying in Cancun, the two previous times staying at the ME Cancun.  Who happens to be co-owners or owned by the ME. I just wanted to take the time to let those know that I had a poor experience at the resort. The food was terrible.  The management at the hotel / workers were lazy and didn't seem to be of help.  My iron didn't work, elevator wouldn't come to my floor, food was very poor, and hotel service was awful.

reviews.author: Emanuel Davila
reviews.text: I just arrived and i am really not impressed and frustrated,  we get in and then they keep trying to sell you upgrades for an hour when we are already tired and annoyed.  After the hour of them forcing us to buy somethimg at 530pm the room is not ready yet when check in is supposed to be 3pm. Very, very anoying place.

reviews.author: Martha Rojas
reviews.text:
Service too slow when checking in. The information they give is confusing. A/C in rooms doesn't work properly, dirty rooms. When you call to get something they take hours to take you what you need.

Only the waiters give you excellent service.

Not the best experience, will not stay at this hotel ever again.

reviews.author: Mehul
reviews.text:
Abraham is the best in Ginger bar..
The overall resoer experience is not so welcoming, however Abraham made it all us felt welcomed

reviews.author: Anisha Hindocha
reviews.text: I was incredibly unimpressed by this report. It was shabby and rundown, not particularly kid-friendly, the nights could be loud with the club and the food was underwhelming.

reviews.author: R. Lindsey
reviews.text:
They kept trying to charge extra for laundry and they kept accusing African American of smoking weed! They kept bothering the black people. Also in the All inclusive they also was saying there was a limit on drinks which was a lie.

I'm NEVER staying here AGAIN!

reviews.author: Laverne Lomax
reviews.text:
We paid for butler service Margarita was no help at all two days we didn't see or hear from her the food was awful
The other staff were exceptional very clean outside staff Bravo.beautiful clean

reviews.author: DZM
reviews.text: This hotel is recomended to go if you want to party like in springbreak. In general, the hotel is too warm, specially the main lobby cause there is no air conditioning. It is an old hotel so it needs some remodeling and it is a very big property.

reviews.author: D Ec
reviews.text: How can you go to an all inclusive place and be hungry all day? The food is complete garbage. Service and everything else was great but the food is junk

reviews.author: BES
reviews.text: The best part of our experience was Renan, Javier and el pulpo at the Aqua Marina restaurant! Gracias!!

reviews.author: Daniel Porras
reviews.text: They treat white people better than their own and will have us pay more. Discrimination not coming back nor should you plenty other options for better go to my YouTube I will give you plenty

reviews.author: Dhanraj Solanki
reviews.text: Though service at the resort was bad, Abraham at ginger bar was the best bartender at the resort

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: Definitely not worth it. Service was terrible and the reserve is a joke. Advertised as adults only but they will keep you in pyramids with kids.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.text:
Worst experience ever
Never gonna come back again
Don't waste your time and money
I think this is a 3star hotel

reviews.author: Shai Patel
reviews.text: Beach was nice.     Rooms were clean.   Concierge that we upgraded for was not worth it

reviews.author: Rene Pena
reviews.text: There buffet is the worst, the people that cook the breakfast eggs they don't know how to cook them. They are all burnt

reviews.author: Vitek Gula
reviews.text: Nice hotel but with staff which in my opinion really don’t like their job . 🤷🏿‍♂️

reviews.author: J Xu
reviews.text: Food was worse than tailgate food, rooms were pretty nice overall, staff were only ok, and amenities were lacking

reviews.author: Vinay Panavala
