After they verified the upgrade, she asked if we would be needing the room all day because the “upgraded” room would be near construction from 9 to 5. At this point I was exhausted and my son had woken up from his short nap crying. I gave up on the upgrade and asked her for a room. She placed us in an “ocean view” room right next to the door where we can see guests go back and forth between the hotel and the pool. I wonder if our original room would have given us more privacy. What horrible customer service. It didn’t help that our dinner at Bana last night was pretty bad. We like visiting Cancun, and luckily there are many other hotel options. I don’t think we will be back here again.

reviews.author: Bao Hoang
reviews.text: I stayed here for ember shores music festival early December for my birthday. I paid a $200 deposit and was given a deposit receipt that was to be returned at checkout to receive my deposit back. I returned the receipt at checkout and was told 3-5 business days to receive my deposit. I never received my deposit back and tried to contact Paradisus but they were no help. I filed a dispute with my bank and now Paradisus is trying to argue that I was never supposed to receive my deposit back. Very poor service. Would definitely not recommend going here. I’ve had other festival goers going through the same experience

reviews.author: Yasmin Alsmadi
reviews.text: CURRENTLY staying at this resort and in all honesty it’s not worth the money. We originally was supposed to go to Moonpalace but changed it last minute because of everyone “hyping” this resort. Tip: if you pay extra to stay at The Reserve make sure ur room is on the top floor. Only a small part of it is Lagoon view. Because of the lay out, you don’t really pay for the view unless you’re lucky. Some rooms also do not have a door closing off the bathroom so you cannot open the front door without someone seeing into the glass shower. That’s another thing the bathroom is in the corner with a large window. If it’s a family staying in the room then you can not shower comfortably Bc u can literally see the person in the shower. The food honestly wasn’t that great and not many options. Requested multiple times for extra amenities and I had to speak to a supervisor for them to respond finally. All in all I would never come back to this resort. Should’ve used the money towards something more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Juan V
reviews.text:
My trip to this resort started from bad to worst. I never review unless it was an amazing experience or quite the opposite, as the latter is the case. I booked my trip thru my credit card rewards site (which I always do and never had a problem). I received email confirmation of my stay for a luxury junior suite for 5 guest (my wife and 3 children), yet when I arrived at the hotel to check in, they only showed 1 regular room for 2 adults. I went back and forth with them for 4 hours!!! At the end of it, I had enough and I had to pay for a new reservation for 5 guest for an additional $300. They honestly just gave me a small basic room with a street view. Definitely NOT what I paid for initially. They tried to switch blame to my credit card service but the issue was with their reservation department. They tried calling them but no one picked up.

While in the hotel, the food was subpar in the restaurants, reservations took a long time although their Concierge did try to help as much as she could. They have an additional charge for a cabana, and for their steak house. They really should remove the "all-inclusive" they claim.

And whoever was the genius that design the entertainment stage in the middle of the hotel with super loud speakers should be fire immediately! Super loud in the rooms when you're trying to sleep. I stayed last year in their Playa del Carmen hotel and enjoyed that stay, I was expecting better from their cancun location but sadly not the case. I WILL never stay with them again.

1 star for hotel upkeep. The beach was infested with seaweed as well, other cancun hotels have much better up keep in their beach. Also, it took them 30 min and 2 calls to their front desk to get extra sheets and pillows. Needless to say but I'm super disappointed at the current stay... and I still have 2 days left in my stay.  SMDH!

reviews.author: Matilda Beqiri
reviews.text: There were definitely pros and cons!                 Pros: the resort is beautiful, food and the waiting staff were very good! Cons: the rooms were very old and dirty! They only dusted the tv stand, but the closet door and bathroom door was covered in dust! The bathroom sink was plugged all our stay. We had to call every day to bring us drinking water, and we stayed there for two weeks! We bought something in the inside stores, but they don’t accept dollars, so they told us to either pay with pesos or charge it to the room! We charge it to the room without knowing that we had to pay extra for not paying it on time! So, something that costed $15, we ended up paying $37! Also, my baby got sick, and when I asked in the middle of the night about the doctor, they said that the doctor comes at 9am. When we saw the doctor, she said that they have a doctor 24/7  in the resort!

reviews.author: S
reviews.text:
Worst all inclusive resort I’ve stayed, least friendly staff, and overpriced for what’s available. The food is awful unless you make a reservation, which none of the staff seems to be on the same page about. Also, check in process was a nightmare. We were there for a festival but had to house friends of ours in rooms that WE paid for just so they had a place to sleep because of the resort’s incompetence. More of a spring break hotel than a Mexican resort. While I do believe the quality of the stay was tainted by the arrival of the festival, we stayed extra days beforehand and we’re equally unimpressed. Would not recommend this resort to ANYONE.

EDIT: The replier wants to make it seem like nothing was brought to anyone’s attention. The staff was well aware of the problems and neither the event staff nor the hotel staff seemed to care and continued to lead everyone on with borderline lies and no updates. Also it takes a simple stay at almost any other resort in the Playa/ Cancun area to realize that this is no more than a glorified hotel. Better service, better food, more options, nicer staff, etc. The list goes on. Again, we stayed before the festival multiple days also and it was also absolutely nothing to write home about.

reviews.author: Miriam Mickel
reviews.text: The resort was NICE! The views were so awesome. I enjoyed my stay at paradisus cancun for the most part. However, one bad apple does spoil the entire bunch. We stayed May 31-June 5. The cooks that were at Sunset Grill on that Monday and Tuesday were very MEAN! I did not get their names however, I did get the name of the drink server who was also mean. He would not ask us if we wanted anything to drink. He skipped over us every time. His name was Luis. He was an older guy. He made us feel like we were "different" especially watching him ask other people what drinks they wanted. My kids should never have had to experienced that! I don't care what "kind of person" the sunset grill cooks and drink server preferred to wait on. The cooks were not nice at all! When we asked for food (wings) they would tell us that we could not get any. The last time I checked, we paid for an all inclusive vacation so why where we denied food? The resort was great! If it wasn't for these two incidents, I would give the resort all 5 stars.

reviews.author: tanya vi
reviews.text: This is one of the worst hotels I’ve ever stayed. Wanting peace and quiet we asked for a quiet room multiple times, emphasizing that it’s our ONLY request. We checked in at about 5pm, checked the room (it was quiet) and guess what?  At 9pm some weird concert started right under our windows with MARCHING band and screaming. Imagine listening to repeating drum roll for 2 hours. I went back to the receptionist (it was the same one that checked us in) and she pretended we never asked for a quiet room... people here don’t give a heck about your comfort. On top of that food is just terrible, everything is greasy, unhealthy and over sweetened. And when they gave us door keys they didn’t work after 10 tries, so we had to run back to the reception, then back to the room (receptionist claimed we didn’t use the key right, that’s why it wasn’t working), then wait for the “technician” to fix the door lock for us (still standing with our language near the room) for 25 minutes...

reviews.author: K W
reviews.text:
We are here now and had $$$ stolen from our safe. Trying not to let it ruin our vacation but they are doing nothing to compensate us. Very upsetting, we have been melia club members for 20 years, typically go to Dominican Republic and never had any problems.we made a hand written report to security personell and then spent days chasing down a response .
Sadly the resort is beautiful , the staff is excellent. So we are not happy to have to make this review. We are vacation club members and after securites "investigation" was complete , it was basically decided ," oh well ".
The door jam in room 1214 is damaged and you can tell it's been forced in the past. Even after showing this they still claimed they couldn't reimburse us . They gave spa credits in the amounts of $100 not nearly the $450 that was stolen.
Most of the $$ stolen would have gone out as tips !! .
We will update as we continue to hold paradisus , sol melia and their vacation club accountable . The rest of our stay I carried our important documents , Nikon camera and anything important w us in a backpack . To be clear , we are not drama people and have NEVER. Made a theft claim in our 30 years of

reviews.author: Katie N.
reviews.text:
I'm writing this review with the intention to let other up-coming guests to learn my lessons so they have a more pleasant vacation. We paid for the highest package (Reserve) but what we received is absolutely not what we paid for.
1. They promised you butler services but you don't see him/her unless you ask for them. So don't wait, ask for them right away at the check in desk. Many rooms in my group never met their butlers. You mostly need the butler to book restaurant reservations for you because you cannot book it through their app. Most of the time there is no reservation available on the app. If it does, there are only 2 or 3 seats available. If you go in a group, it is very hard for you to dine together. What's the point of traveling together but cannot dine together? You can try to call the reservation line to book but you don't have a record of it. (You have evidence if booking through the app or texting butlers.) The reservation representative booked a reservation for my aunt and uncle but when they went to the restaurant, the restaurant didn't have their reservation, and my aunt couldn't prove it to them. So my aunt and uncle had to leave to eat at the buffet. My aunt was so upset because on top of that, they hadn't been able to dine together with us. Things like this can totally ruin your vacation, which you paid high price for. Restaurant managers should accommodate guests who tell you that they have a reservation. I'm sure this doesn't happen a lot.
2. Some adult families in our group who were also Reserve guests wanted to stay in building 5 (Reserve building) but no room was available. They asked for building 4, also no room was available. They ended up in the noisy and a lot of traffic building 3. Paradisus should check back on their guests if they are still wanting to stay in building 5 when rooms are available.
3. Food is OK, not great. There were a few dishes that were too salty. Mixed drink is pretty plain and hit and miss. I only see one restaurant that is great, which is the La Palapa, but this restaurant is only for breakfast and lunch and for Reserve adults only. We cannot take much advantage of it because we have our kids with us. Be careful when you're eating sushi and drinking water. Half of our group got diarrhea from eating at ENSO. You need to buy diarrhea medicine from their store, the front desk doesn't have anything for you. They have a medical office but the doctor will charge you $100-200/visit.
4. There is too much seaweed on the beach. I don't know if they attempt to clean them but there is lots of it on the beach. You have to step on it to go to the water. If you dream of a beautiful Cancun beaches, well it's not here. The next door resort had a big net out in the sea and when I walked early in the morning, I saw them cleaning seaweed so their beach was clean and white. Paradisus should do the same.
5. If you are Reserve guests, when you arrive, ask the luggage guy to show you the way to building 5. If not, you will wait in line for 30-45 minutes at front desk of building 3 (main entrance) then they will tell you actually you need to go to building 5 to check in for Reserve. Normally 30-45 minutes wouldn't be a big deal, but it would when you just spent a whole day flying, being tired and hungry.
6. If you decided to take professional photos, schedule with them as early as possible, because they need time to edit and print or making any photo books for you. We received our pictures 10pm the night before we leave, and we leave very early the next morning.
7. If you decided to do scuba diving, don't eat at least 2-3 hours before you do it. All the guys in our group threw up badly because the boat was very shaky. My husband stayed in bed one whole day to recover. Paradisus's instructor should advise their guests about this.
8. Don't think that you can just walk in to buffet to eat when you want to. At peak hours, the wait could easily be 30 minutes.
If you're reading until this point, I wish you a great vacation!!

reviews.author: Luis D
reviews.text:
Never ever

The trim very old and bad maintenance
The service very rude and impolite
I put the towel of the bed and one men said why did u put a towel on the bed I said where o have to put it, maybe on the floor!?
Everything too much old! I told them several time to guest service and reception

reviews.author: J
reviews.text:
All included right?!? Parts of menus (extra charge) some restaurants not included. All full of surprises! Ah and not forget the initial "green tax" the one your agency always forgets to mention.
Pay attention to all the small letters around here. You have been warned.

reviews.author: Mark McQueen
reviews.text: Went on a trip 100% paid for by work. Absolutely the worst resort me and my wife have ever stayed at. Mattress was spring from 1960's, fridge did not work, both sink and shower drain were plugged and shower head leaked causing drywall to start falling off the ceiling and paint to flake on you while showering. That was only our room......Whole building smelled like a hippie shop from incense everywhere and was hot. Service was mediocre. Drinks were a hodgepodge of whatever they wanted to throw together and weak on cheap liquor. Then there was the food.....THE WORST FOOD I HAVE EVER HAD!!!! If you are wanting to go on a diet, this is your place because you will get sick trying to eat that stuff. We ate at the market cafe one night and that was actually pretty good. Other than that, nothing and I mean NOTHING was even edible. We would of been better off walking across the street and eating Mcdonald's every day/night. Never again will I stay at another Paradisus resort.

reviews.author: Kevin Gagnon
reviews.text:
Technical issue with the website where I was booked for 2 rooms on the same night (only needed one room). Immediately called hotel to rectify the situation and they refused to refund me. (again - minutes after the technical error occurred). When I showed up in person I spoke with the manager and again they refused to refund me and told me to "speak with my bank".
No common customer service/business sense.
Resort was fine, nothing special.
I ended up at the Moon Palace Resort about 20 minutes away - nicer, bigger, more activities. I'd recommend going there in the future.

reviews.author: Kee Crawford
reviews.text:
I would not book here again nor recommend to a friend.

My best friend and I purchased the highest package available to attended a festival hosted here. Our concierge seemed nice when showing us the facility and getting us in our room and then after that he was pretty much non existent and very delayed in responding to messages. We booked our stay for 2 days prior to the festival and 1 day after. On the 1st day of the festival access to food became extremely difficult as most of the restaurants turned into reservation only and room service was no longer allowed. There is absolutely no benefit in purchasing upgraded packages because everyone is treated the same. There was no ability to reserve cabanas even with an upcharge or vip seating/access Which is typical for Vip packages at festivals. This by far was the worst resort/ festival experience I have had and I do this many times over in the course of a year. Guest services called our room and had us meet with them to bring some resolutions to the issues we had. They offered us 15 dollars off of a massage and a new concierge, that was the ultimate slap in the face I have never been more dissatisfied and disappointed in a place.

reviews.author: Frank Ortiz
reviews.text:
I hope you will reconsider your stay here, after reading  my horrible experience.
Check in/out only 1 person working. The Hotel tells me what restaurant am I going to eat at every day and the time, so it was their choice and not mine. They only have 1 person answering the resetvation for the guest. I was holding for over 36 minutes till I walk to 4 difrent employees till finally I was able to get with someone and only to tell me what, where and time. It was a take it or go to the buffet.
Bell man never show up to help us with luggage. This Hotel has lots of potential to have clients like me to come back again and again. But they just dont care how much you complain, they just wont do nothing to make you happy! Is a take it or leaved. Other Hotels in Cancun will sit with you to plan your stay for the next 7 days with people on at least 4 difrent desk to help you plan you restaurant experience memorable.
Beautiful loacation and ocean view. Too bad they have no idea what customer service is all about. Its simple MAKE YOUR GUESTS HAPPY!

reviews.author: erik stengel
reviews.text: Had a great stay until we checked out and got charged a 100 dollars for a deep clean when one was absolutely not needed. Also the room above us threw all their cigarettes on our balcony every night and nothing was done about it. Besides us getting over charged!

reviews.author: Lash 'n Brow Haven Studio & Academy
reviews.text:
This one star is for all the servers. They are nice and friendly. The rest of the experience are horrible. I have no idea how they have so much star. I went for a wedding and they promise the rate will be the best for us if booking through their website. Well, it's not. I check on orbitz later and all other site offer better deal if you book a package with air fare. It's super expensive and all restaurants need 24 hr reservations. They are not flexible in appointment time for these restaurants at all and they only serve dinner.  Well, they make it super hard to reserve any restaurants and during our stay, We can only eat at the buffet and small snack bars. The food are horrific and disgusting for a 5 star resort. Seem like the food are soak in lime juice for a day, SOUR and Rubbery way over cook and left out for hours!!! Please hire better chefs.  The buffet food in a normal US restaurant will be way better than Paradisus.  My aunts are lucky enough to get to eat in one of the asian fusion restaurants but she said the food are just like buffet food, nothing good.

Oh and the air conditioning....horrible!! it is super hot and there's no ac in lobby or restaurants area. Our room is cooler but still not cool enough and the rest of the resort is like an oven. This makes the entire stay even worse. The reason I have to stay here in the first place was that if we stay somewhere else, they will double charge my cousin for the guests that come in for her wedding.

The workers and servers here work hard and friendly. I do like them a lot, they seem to be overworked by the management. The resort itself, no thank you. Never ever come again or recommend to anyone.

after 2 days staying at Paradisus, I can't take the heat and the food anymore I have to go to a different resort (GR Caribe Deluxe). The experience is totally different like heaven and earth. Food, service, AC, and no reservations needed for restaurant are all excellence.

reviews.author: Rachana Patel
reviews.text: Paradisus is the worst place to stay. The hotel is under construction when I booked it was not written that the hotel was under construction. The management does not even help you as you walk in my husband and I was standing there for over two hours just to check in the AC is not working in the whole entire hotel it’s very uncomfortable you’re there to relax you don’t even feel any type of relaxation. The restaurants they said nine restaurants online only six were operating, even as we complain to management nothing is what they stated online and management did not care at all the manager came up in the front and told me he’ll take care of some thing and he took care of nothing. He seem not to care of what we said . And the woman that checked ask and I’ll also said there was no manager over and over then finally he came out . Overall I give this hotel a zero. Worst vacation ever I’ve had and I went with my whole entire family thanking will have a nice vacation. I wish I chose a different hotel.

reviews.author: Gelnn Lau
reviews.text:
Buffet closes at 11:00am - 12:00 noon and other restaurants open at 11:00 am. However, although they seat you at 11:00 am and say kitchen will be ready in 10 minutes, staff are busy to clean up buffet and not able to return to work at the other restaurants and nothing can be ordered before 12:00 noon. As a result, you will be starving in the an all inclusive hotel everyday from 11:00 - noon. Furthermore, all the restaurants need to be reserve for dinners. Idea is good since you don't need to line up to wait for dinner. The problem is that there are not enough spaces for the guests and you have to race with other people to make reservation everyday. If not, you need to eat dinner at 10:00pm for the latest bookings or even nothing available. Eventually you may need to have buffet for every single meal.

NEWLY ADDED: Since I cannot response to the "Response from the owner" below, I edit my review here: I think "another restaurant opens for lunch" is talking about Feugo. Feugo was the one that seated me at 10:55 am and told me that the kitchen would be ready in 10-15 minutes. But I still could not place any order at 11:45am because the kitchen was still not ready. As for "the snack bar next to the pool", officially it opens at 11:30 am but the staffs start preparing foods, veggie, pizzas, etc at 11:30am. They will tell you that they need 30 minutes to get the burgers/hot dogs ready, and 2 hours for the french fries, which is ridiculous. For room service, I don't think people will want to hide in the hotel room to eat in lovely sunny days. I will prefer to go across the road and go to McDonald even I need to pay there.

This is the fifth time I have been to Cancun in past few years and I have no issue in staying at other hotels such as Grand Oasis, Hard Rock, Moon Palace, etc. The only reason that makes me try Paradisus is that Paradisus is the closest hotel to Acquaworld which I need to go there almost everyday. However, I will stay away from Paradisus since I want to have more dining choices everyday except buffet after enjoying my water activities.

reviews.author: Cassy Valentino
reviews.text: Very underwhelming and not worth the money. When we checked out, we were charged over $150 for using the palapa service which we never used. We almost missed our shuttle to the airport trying to get these charges resolved. We were told that they needed to put a card down before we left but that they were going to work on getting it removed. We were then told to call them the next day to speak with customer service to make sure the charge was dropped. We did just that except when I called customer service, they had no notes or any idea of the issue that had occurred. The man that checked us out charged us the $150 and did not work on getting the charge removed like he said he would be doing. Customer service questioned me why I didn't get this resolved when I checked out and I told them that I was going to miss my ride to the airport. They still havent been able to help me/do not believe me when I tell them we did not use the palapa service.  We gave this hotel a TON of our money, from using one of their photographers & buying photos, paying for a beachside dinner, booking all of our activities, paying for massages at the spa, going to Sal restaurant (which is not apart of the all inclusive & also gave me food poisoning btw). The system is flawed because the only information they ask for is your room number and then all of that adds up onto your tab that is paid when you check out. I could give anyones room number and they would be charged. It makes no sense. It is extremely disappointing that after the thousands we spent at this hotel, they try to charge us for even more money that was 100% not us.

reviews.author: Kristy Frost
reviews.text:
Cancún is wonderful. If you’re planning a trip, go for it, but think twice before you book with Paradisus Cancún.  We have had issue after issue with this place. The servers have been wonderful but the hotel itself and the way it’s managed and ran leaves much to be desired. We came for 7 nights with our kids and a family of our friends. 10 people total. Our friends have had a whole list of problems with their room but I will only speak of our experiences. Here is the list of what they need to fix before we will EVER consider spending $10k+ to vacation there ever again:

Wasted half our first day because they kept telling us to come back in 30-40 minutes and our rooms would be ready then we’d come back and they had put us in different buildings etc. We kept telling them all 3 rooms needed to be in the same building and not across the entire building from one another (we have kids with us and wanted them close)

Finally get to our room where it smells terrible like bug spray and the drawer to the dresser won’t even close

Had to call the concierge or track down employees to get our fridge restocked on 3 different days

Had bath towels replaced each day (although some days there weren’t enough) but never received any other towels (floor towels, wash clothes, hand towels after the first day and had to walk to the first floor and take them from the bathroom so we’d have them.

App has been consistently wrong. Says restaurants are open when they’re not: tried to go to Enso twice bc it doesn’t require reservations but it was closed.  Tried to make reservations at Market grill several different nights and it was closed 3 nights. We were only able to get reservations one night of the 7 we are here. We tried to make reservations a couple days in advance and were told they couldn’t make them that far in advance and to call back one day ahead. Every time we did that they would say they were booked and couldn’t get 10 people in.

The quality of the food in the buffet is definitely less than par!  Every single one of our group of 10 people was disappointed with the quality and taste of the buffet food. The restaurants have been pretty good, however, we’ve hardly been able to get into any of them.

App has also been very wrong about shows etc. several times. Just one example beyond the restaurants is when we planned on going to a “silent party” at the Red Bar. We planned our evening around it and then we get there and it’s canceled and the club is closed.

A whole row of bricks fell off the pool side while my son was in the pool and hit his foot. His foot was extremely bruised by the next day. When our friends told the manager about it she wasn’t even concerned for him.

We were never notified that there were two days of our trip that are “dry days” and we wouldn’t be able to get alcohol. When you’re paying for an all-inclusive and they can’t include what you’re supposed to be entitled to, that’s pretty bad business. Some of our money should be refunded.

The people who are selling for you guys are being dishonest. They’ve been trying to sell us a “bar hopping” trip that we almost booked for Saturday or Sunday. They told us that it was open bar at all the locations and the drinks were included in the price. Now, we’re hearing from other people that went that they couldn’t even get drinks because of the dry days. I’m glad we didn’t book and pay over $500 for 5 of us to go but I’m still rather angry that we were deceived by your employees.

reviews.author: Joern K
reviews.text:
Biggest disappointment in my life. Although the servants do their best to serve the guests, the Administration of the hotel is terrible. Breaking all safe distance rules, closing 1/2 of the pool and pushing guests to get even closer just to charge $1,500 dollars on top of the all inclusive charges for one bottle of moet and supposedly safe distance during the new year celebration. In the mean time folks left and right complaining about the lack of each beach  chairs. They are supposed to be at 30% occupation. By the looks of it they are well over 60%.
Additionally, there is no wheel chair access anywhere!!. Rooms are not well maintained. They clearly fired a lot of personnel and are now filling up the few restaurants they have open. No way to keep safe distance. Long lines in front of the buffets, no organization what so ever to get food and the few restaurants that serve via menu are fully booked and days in advance.
First and last time at melia resorts. They really give cancun a terrible reputation. I come to cancun 3 to 4 weeks every year. Never ever have I been so upset at any of the other great resorts I have stayed in.
IF I WERE YOU, I'D CONSIDER STAYING IN ANY of the many other resorts in the area.

reviews.author: Kap Papino
reviews.text:
We were welcomed with over 30 min of wait in the lobby to start check in procedure, no refreshments while only 2 people were working in thereception. 5 hours after arrival, my luggage was still not in my room. I called front desk, hour later, still waiting for my luggage. I ended up picking up my luggage personally , i got the general "sorry senor" .
In comparison to other paradisus hotel that I previously visited, this one didn't have toothpaste, a tips, robe, shoes....the only thing that bathroom was equiped with was soap, towels, and tissue. Bathrooms were old with excessive caulking around appliances.
Food: One of the reasons i picked this hotel because we previously had gread food experience at paradisus in playa. Cancun paradisus food was extremaly disappointing.
I will start with good; Lunch taco place was very consistent and always delicious, the only bright start of that establishment. Buffet was actually decent too. Probably the worst food experience was at " Japanese" restaurant. You get same sushi rolls that are served during linch time, and Fried rice, and some beef and noodles, more like your cheap Chinese takeout menu. "Enzo" restaurant would follow Japanese in quality. Summarizing, no white cloath on the tables, no specialty drinks, NO steakhouse, no food presentation other paradisus was know for - just poor.
Drinks, oh only 3 beers to chose from: Heineken , dos equis, and some other B grade beer. Not even corona or models. Shame. Mixed drinks tasted diffrent at every bar, it is obvious they don't have oncologist just random guys pouring drinks with hope that it will work. So, if you would try to forget about bad food, or poor experience it was impossible because drinks were mixed poorly, and beer was just bad.
Good things: for the most part staff is friendly and hard working, it just seems like there is lack of lidership and executive decisions / oversight . Beds were comfortable, TV, although not HD,  has a lot of chanels to watch. Finally, beech and ocean is beautiful but no thanks to hotel.
In general, i don't write reviews, but consider money spend, and extreme disappointment with false 5 star hotel i took couple minutes to warn people of this pseudo paradisus hotel.

reviews.author: Nadja Huskic
reviews.text: This is actually my first day here, and the first time I’ve ever written a review. The first thing I didn’t like as soon as I came into the door was them trying to convince us into a timeshare meeting. We kindly tried to say we’re tired and have had a long flight and are hungry, but he took an hour to “just explain” things. Second, we go to check in and get offered a king room or a double bed. It’s me and husband here for our anniversary so obviously we choose king. No one mentions it’s in the basement, had a parking lot VIEW, and there’s construction going on next door with loud banging. I go to the front desk and kindly ask if there’s anything they can do, she apologizes and says they can switch us to the double room. We agree because I couldn’t stand to be in a basement. We come up to our new room expecting a little better, but I’m very disappointed. From the pictures & reviews I’ve read, this is FARRR from “luxury” and 5 star. It’s old, outdated, the bathtub doesn’t have a shower head you have to hold the handle, the lagoon view is whatever, the tub takes forever to drain, and the “master bathroom” is so small, 2 of us can barely move in there (has 1 sink). I received a coupon book for booking 7 nights & asked if I can use the upgrade 2 nights coupon. She says no you have to buy a whole week. Let me remind you this was NOT a cheap vacation. I understand “you get what you pay for” but that’s not the case here, so I don’t want to spend more money just for a better view. The supervisor was next to her and kept his head down when I tried to look/address him. The whole check in desk was very rude. Didn’t mean to write this long but thought others should know before booking!!! Will update on everything else.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.text:
Do not get married here! Unless you want a complete disaster OR if you want your wedding gifts stolen...

Still waiting to hear from Jose (Wedding Manager) to issue a refund for all the services we paid and did not receive. Jose didn't want to provide contact information to his boss.

reviews.author: Wladimyr Duarte
reviews.text: We had the worst experience ever. This hotel is like a two stars hotel. we were over charged at the check in; the hotel is super hot everywhere you go; they reuse and wash by hand the plastic cups when they pour your drinks (pretty disgusting); .... First and last time with this Hotel...

reviews.author: Lilli Rask
reviews.text:
WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE EVER.

I booked a trip with some friends in December of 2020 to go in June 2020. Due to the pandemic, the hotel was not open in June, so THE HOTEL cancelled my reservation. They will not issue me a refund of the TWO THOUSAND DOLLARS I paid them. They say the best they can offer is a $2000 coupon that I never wanted in the first place??? The friends I booked this trip with received a full refund but I can't? I booked through Expedia and they have offered almost no help either. The best part is I spent $150 on travel insurance when I booked my trip but apparently that means nothing now and I am out 2 grand.

reviews.author: Louis P.
reviews.text: There is no quiet spot in the entire hotel complex. Loud music is played on Kanna Beach, the bass disturbs the entire beach.  There's always a party at the main pool.  Events are constantly taking place at the second pool. You can be lucky at the children's pool and maybe get a 30-minute break when the construction work with jackhammers is on hold. Even in a hotel room you don't get to close your eyes until 1 a.m. at the earliest. The room doors are so thin, you can hear the crying children from floor 0 even on the 5th floor (behind the closed door). Every evening there are loud parties in the hotel lobby and the noise gets into the hotel rooms.

reviews.author: Francisco Ortiz
reviews.text: I arrived to this hotel last night. We reserved the lagoon view deluxe junior suite. We did not get what we asked for, because it was “fully booked” they gave us ocean “view”… all I see is the building next to us. Nothing has been done about it. How is this an upgrade???? Super disappointed. Do not waste your time in coming here.

reviews.author: Andrea Moore
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice and and the workers were all friendly and great. But the FOOD WAS THE WORST I HAVE EVER HAD.  The need more food choices that stay open. Even by the pool side you have to pay. They should be coverage all day for your guest that should be free. The hotel was very hot . Would not stay again. was not worth the money. Bring a fan!!!

reviews.author: M H
reviews.text: If you have family and kids stay away from this place. I gave this place 5 stars 8 months ago. They changed their policies and reservations category where if you have kids they will not let you in the higher category where you can't get to many restaurants or cabanas . No Matter how much you pay you can get to one or 2 restaurants and go to the pool or beach but NO cabana . If you have kids they treat you less of human beings. Please don't come here if you have family

reviews.author: Didi Clinton
reviews.text:
I made a reservation for my family of 8 that included 2 older people and 3 kids. First, there were 2 rooms in one floor and the 3rd in another. I understand not being all together as I requested, but on separate floors??? The wait for checking in was long. After that, 2 of the  rooms were not ready until around 8pm. There was construction going on in the middle of the hotel and  there was no disclaimer online about this, no warning at all. Additionally, I had called before my reservation and asked specifically if any of the restaurants were closed. (Thinking of covid). They said no. However, one restaurant that I was looking  foward to going to, was. The shower broke the first night. I complained to the
Manager about all of this  and Aiko was the most responsive even though she was not a manager. I did not want to stay but decided  bc I had 2 older people w me and 3 kids like I explained earlier and the last minute move proved to me more complicated that I initially thought. There is more but I think all of this is enough. I would not recommend this hotel. If I was the manager and given these valid complaints I would have done something to make us feel better, acknowledge, apologize and at least offer a day bed by the pool. Something. But that was not the case. Hotels have the duty to disclaim if there is construction going on. They also have the duty to be transparent so when asked about the availability of all of the restaurants the right thing to do would have been to disclaim that they were not all open. At that point I could make an informed decision as to whether I want to stay there or not. This  is my 3rd Melia visit and my last.  I will not return to any Meliá.

reviews.author: Tanya Rollins
reviews.text: Let me start by saying I’ve been to Cancun at least 9 times. This by far has been the worst experience. While the hotel is beautiful and rooms are nice and clean, the communication is hugely lacking. We booked through the hotel and received a promotion. If you spend at least 1,500 you get free transportation to and from airport and 3 course meal at Tempo (the only restaurant in the hotel you have to pay for). It was like pulling teeth to try and book the transportation. When I would email where I was told to (I was directed to 3 different emails), no one knew what I was talking about or I would receive a standard message, one you automatically get when no one actually reads for your email. So needless to say, we paid for transportation. We were to have a personal butler who was to give us their number so we could be in communication. Our butler never gave us her information. We made reservations at Tempo, it was confirmed in person. Once we got there they said we didn’t have reservations and the couldn’t seat us bc they didn’t have space...even though the restaurant was empty. They didn’t offer to make it right and see if they could make us reservations at a different restaurant either.

reviews.author: Victor Bozhuk
reviews.text: Good day.  My family and I stayed at the hotel for a few days.  When settling from the card blocked $ 158.  Since we did not use additional services, when we checked out of the hotel we promised that the money would be returned, but for the third and third week nothing comes.  The friends who had a rest with us received money almost immediately ... For all attempts to call the hotel, the employees promise to consider the situation and call back, but never did so.  And last week it is impossible to contact at all.  Emails are also unanswered.  Keep in mind when choosing a hotel ...

reviews.author: Arsham Hatambeiki
reviews.text:
Update on day 4: with added food poisoning, shower head literally falling off, lines for food at breakfast, this is simply the lowest quality we’ve seen in an all inclusive or otherwise. Lowering to one star.

Day 2 of an 8 day stay and the experience has been well below average, many negative interactions with staff unwilling to help, although we’ve certainly had some pleasant experiences. Overall,  below average food, and service.

reviews.author: Scott Huntley
reviews.text: Have to say we were saddened by our second to last day. We thought we might say again with this company but it will never happen. We can’t support a company the pushes scams. We almost agreed to terms with Melia Circle. Don’t take the time. Thankfully we came back to our room to get our IDs. This saved us from a painful bad decision. Read up on the Circle. Shame on the individuals trying to sell a scam. To us they represent the entire company. No integrity, no goodness. Don’t stay at a. Place that supports scams.

reviews.author: Sirous Jafarian
reviews.text:
We are from Canada and we spent a week in this resort in early March 2020. Let me first start like this: “It’s dangerous to go here.” Why am I saying so? Some professional marketing people are coming to you, presenting you aggressively, keep you and your family in a room for hours, and force you to sign a scam agreement. I am telling you this because me, my wife, and our 1 year old baby were kept in such a room by CirclebyMelia team and they did not let us go until we sign a crazy time-sharing contract in Dominican Republic! The whole value is $12,000 With an interest rate of %8.9 for something that if we ever use, we still need to pay $90 per person per day. You can easily book the same resort for a week as a package that includes your flight much much cheaper through Expedia, Sunwing, Credit card rewards, etc. We were told by the lady who presented the scam agreement that we can terminate the contract whenever we want since nothing is actually sold to us. That was a relief of mind because we thought we would have time in future to figure out what the details are. But when we tried to terminate the contract in May, after paying $1200 down payment and our first monthly fee, we noticed that the only way to terminate the contract is to sell it! This is my honest honest advise to you guys: don’t go here; it is not worth it. Go google the scam contracts by Melia group and read yourself the horror stories of people like us.
If you go to this resort please never sign the contract especially if you are not local. I myself am reaching to Canadian media to enlighten people about Melia group and their unethical approach to tourists.
Anyhow, the resort itself is a very average all inclusive. The food is fair in buffet. The Japanese restaurant invented a food and called it sushi; the worst sushi I’ve ever had in my life. Obviously the chef has no idea what sushi is. The one A La Carte Mexican restaurant is really good; the only restaurant I can recommend you to go. The hotel itself is pretty old. I once saw a cockroach in our room. You can smell chemicals and perfume all the day all around the hotel. It is really annoying. I hope you are not wasting your money like us.

reviews.author: Ashley T
reviews.text: I have been to various Cancun resorts (15 or more) over the past 5 years, Paradisus included, and this has been hands down the worst experinece to date. Food is horrible, absolutely horrible. Of all the all-inclusive restaurants advertised on their website, only two are actually open and both require reservations which are impossible to get. Even calling at 7 AM on the dot when the reservationist gets in they're booked solid. I have literally eaten rice and potatoes from the buffet for three days because that is the only thing that looks even remotely edible and I am not a picky eater. We finally landed a reservation at Lapalapa only to be told upon arrival that it wasn't in the system and they turned us away. At breakfast we were told they couldn't accommodate a group of five -- FIVE. We've been to the front desk twice and it's very apparent they could care less. Additonally, we arrived a day later than what we booked and we were told both rooms would be ready upon arrival since we had paid for the evening prior even though we couldn't make it. At check in we were told one of the rooms wasn't ready. This was completely unacceptable. Despite complaining we were told they would have to call us when it became available. I'm not sure if they're under new management or what but in a years time this place has plummeted. Will not return or recommend. There are plenty of other resorts that fit all budgets that have far better service and food - Hyatt Ziva, Live Aqua, Iberostar, Fiesta Americana, Riu Palace, Riu Cancun, etc..

reviews.author: Rooted Family
reviews.text:
Seems more like a 2-3 star hotel.

Cons:
- COCKROACHES!! Absolutely disgusting that we’ve seen them running across our dinner table, bedroom, bar and one almost fell on my head while grabbing coffee!!
- Check In process sucked: they did not give us any towel cards, they did not give us our $550 promo book because “they ran out”
- they gave us a view looking at a building when we paid for the lagoon view! What’s up with that?!
- we booked a family reunion here and were supposed to have our rooms close together but we got separated
- how do they never have any towels at the beach?! We would get there early and check back six times
- Food is just okay
- Rooms are not that nice
- Had a lizard in our room
- Some areas of the hotel smell like sewage
- Apparently there’s different level of service here: royal, standard etc.

I’ve been to Cancun several times before and this was by far the worst experience. I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Kristen H
reviews.text: Would have given it 0 stars if possible. It is a total scam. DO NOT BOOK HERE. I traveled with a group of girls and we booked 5 rooms ahead of time and when we got there they said they didn't have our reservation and tried to get us to pay $8000 again. We called Chase who confirmed that our original payment was sent to the hotel. Then we confirmed with Paradisus corporate offices that they received our original payment but the actual hotel said they didn't have the payment from corporate so we couldn't stay there. We ended up having to stay in the hotel next door, which was much better anyways.

reviews.author: Natalia McCann
reviews.text:
The day before our departure we were scheduled a COVID test. This was held in a tiny room crammed with at least 20 people. Nurses were taking test after test, not changing gloves, and stacking the exposed test trays. We were told we would receive results by 5pm same day. 6pm rolls around - our flight is for 11am next day and we have not received an email. We go to the guest services desk asking for an update - they took down our email to forward the results. Ultimately, our tests came back positive for COVID but we did not feel any symptoms at all.

We expressed to the hotel that we felt our tests might be compromised and requested a retake. We were told to stay in our room until 9am next day to be tested again at the same location - except now we had to pay $35 each. Fine. We get back to the room and I realized we were not given any procedure as to what happens if we can’t make our flight (no negative test=no flight home). I called guest services and was not able to reach them until the third call. This man is now telling me that we have to extend and pay the “current resort rate” of $95 per person per night. To stay isolated in a room. Amazing how I would not have been told this information if I had not asked.

9am we report to the testing location for a second test and are told “it doesn’t work that way” and we could not be tested twice. Back to guest services - now they’re claiming they have to request a separate lab take a new test and we have to stay in our room. We asked how long this would take and nobody knows, just “later in the day.”

I start asking guest services if there’s ANYWHERE else I can be tested and have rapid results. NOBODY KNOWS. Hard to believe locals are not aware of any testing locations off site. Around 9:45 we decided to walk down Kukulcan Blvd to find a testing site. Lo and behold there’s a medical center literally across the street from Paradisus. We paid $50 each for antigen tests and had results within 20 mins. Negative.

Now we had only 1.5 hours until boarding and had to book it to the airport. Luckily, the airline accepted our test results and we made it back to the states safely. Upon reflection, it feels as things went one of two ways - A) there is an extreme organization and communication problem between guest services and the testing center. Very hard to believe considering we’re 2 years into COVID and workers are acting as if this is the first time it’s happened. Or B) the hotel falsified positive test results to force us to pay an additional $200 a night while we would have quarantined. Mind you, each test during our quarantine would have run us $35 per person because apparently only the FIRST COVID test is free at the hotel.

We strongly feel like it’s option B, sadly. We are two 23 year olds but we’re not stupid. Luckily we thought of testing offsite. Otherwise, we’d be stranded in Mexico dropping an additional thousands of dollars.

Be careful traveling abroad. Upon doing further research I’ve discovered this is a recurring instance for travelers.

reviews.author: Areli Chavez
reviews.text:
Terrible Vacations. I came 5 days ago.
Hotel Interior- No AC. in the middle of the summer. Hard to breath, specially when you are coming from the beach.
Elevator- Small little boxes without ventilation and stinking.
Rooms - no storage space no drawers except 2 little ones in the night table.
Beds- mattresses are hard like a rock. Good if you need extra firm one. In addition, the pillows are old, little and even when they change the  pillow cases every day, they are smelly. I requested 3 additional ones and they are all the same.
There are flash lights flashing over your head all night long.
Bathrooms- OK but the towels feel like sandpaper.
Food- Many restaurants but portions are small. The buffet restaurant is ok but very hot as well. Food was acceptable but I had much better at other hotels in Cancun (casa Magna).
Staff- Excellent service everywhere. Very hardworking and pleasant people. Must tourists don't tip them but they deserve that you give them a reward for the tremendous effort to make you feel royalty.
Would I recommend it? Mist definitely NO> And obviously I will never go to another Meliá ever!!!!

reviews.author: Mayan Ruimy
reviews.text:
THIS PLACE IS A SCAM! DON'T STAY HERE!

SCAM #1
When I first booked this hotel, I booked under the refundable rate which charges you upon arrival. When I checked my bank account a couple of hours later I noticed I was charged in full. I reached out to the hotel to try and get this resolved because it was for a group of 15 of us and some people hadn't decided if they were coming yet. The response I repeatedly got from the hotel was that they can't tell what I clicked and since it is nonrefundable there is nothing they can do about it. At this point, I was already very upset and weary with the hotel.

SCAM #2
A few weeks later, I got an email from the hotel that they didn't receive payment and that my reservation would be cancelled if I didn't wire them them money immediately. After a couple of weeks of back and forth with the parent company and their accounting department they were able to locate the money that I had already paid a month prior on their end. I was reassured that my reservation was in good standing and would be fine upon arrival at the hotel.

SCAM #3
Fast forward to the trip. 15 girls from across the US arrive in Mexico. When members of my group arrived earlier than me, they were told that the reservation was not paid for and that since it was not under their name THEY HAD TO WAIT OUTSIDE ON THE CURB FOR 4 HOURS UNTIL I ARRIVED. Once I arrived, I was told that the reservation was not paid for and that we would have to pay for 7K in full again or we could not stay.

I explained to the manager of the front desk and his supervisor that I had paid and it had all been sorted out with the accounting department already back in January. I showed them printed out copies of the emails and my bank statements, I even called my bank and allowed them to speak to the hotel. Showing complete and total proof that I had paid.

The hotel could not find the money within their own internal systems and could not show me any evidence that they didn't have it. The words I was repeatedly told was if you don't pay now, you cannot stay here. After 8 hours of arguing with no food or water or any accommodation for us 15 girls we came to a compromise that I would pay for the first night again while they sorted out the issue and refund me the money in the morning. I asked for this confirmation in writing and was told that they couldn't give it to me in writing. I was weary to trust that this would actually happen, but 8 hours had gone by and we were in a foreign country with nowhere to go so I reluctantly agreed.

I'm not sure why as a customer with complete evidence backing up payment I was the one who needed to provide the payment while the hotel tries to find the money within their own system. As a large corporation, providing us a few rooms while they sort out THEIR OWN ISSUE would have been the more appropriate way to handle the situation.

Scam #4
When I showed up the next morning to sort out the rest, the men I was working on this with hid in the back room and told the guy at the front to let me know if I don't pay again we can't stay.

So we left to the hotel next door hoping that our bank can resolve the issue and get me money money back.

OTHER ISSUES WITH THE HOTEL
1. They ran out of clean drinking water
2. The bars all close at 11
3. All restaurants require a reservation to get seated, even if they are empty, You can't make a reservation until after checking in.
4. Personal belongings were stolen out of a girl's room
5. The hotel is now flagging our reviews for removal and responding to them saying this situation never happened to try and cover up their seriously gross misconduct

I HAVE NEVER EXPERIENCED SUCH POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE IN MY ENTIRE LIFE! I spent the first 24 hours of my bachelorette party crying and stressing over a horrific situation.. DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND STAY FAR AWAY FROM HERE.

reviews.author: Alex Vuong
reviews.text: A nearby resort is 10 times better than this.  There is no AC outside of your room.  Everybody is sweating.  Food is really bad.  Seriously.  Do Not Come Here For Food.  4.6 stars?  No.  I suspect they must have hired people to put up phony reviews.  No special bonus for nice view from my balcony and nice staff because all resorts along the hotel zone have nice staff.  On our way out back to the airport, we noticed that there was a McDonald's across the street.  I would have eaten at McDonald's everyday instead of the food they serve at Paradisus.  Yes, the food at Paradisus is that bad.  I want to drag the owners of the Paradisus here and make them eat the food they serve.  To the people who got turned away from the 5 nearly empty restaurants that require reservations, you didn't miss anything.  The food at the "reservation" restaurants were not any better than the same less than average buffet they serve everyday at Naos.  Stay away from Enso at all cost.  This restaurant was worse than my kids' school cafeteria food.  One bite of the food at Enso, you will realize you chose the wrong resort and that your dream vacation would have been better staying home.

reviews.author: XN He
reviews.text: BED BUGS!!! I never think I would have the bed bugs issue with this 5 star luxury resort. I stayed there for 4 nights. During the entire vacation, I stayed in the resort. After the 3rd night, there are a couple of bites appeared on my hand. I didn’t even think about bed bugs. However after the 4th night, there are more bites cluttering on my back. I realized those are bed bug bites. My room was #3357. And I already left the resort last night. But today there are more and more bites appeared on my body. I just realized the bed bug bites will be delayed showing. Yesterday when I told the staff at checkout about bed bugs, he’s questioning me why I didn’t repot during my stay. It’s difficult to realize it when those are just showing. Right now I have all the work to do just in case taking any bed bugs back to my home. That all came from this thousand dollars vacation at Paradisus Cancun. Horrible experience!!!

reviews.author: Stephanie Millar Clemente
reviews.text: I am thoroughly disappointed with my stay at Paradisus. My brand new Iphone 13 was stolen by one of the workers on the beach. They have turned off Find My Iphone after gaining access into my phone so I can’t locate it or turn it on lost mode. I now have to pay the 900 left I had owing while paying for a new phone. I can’t call the police in Cancun without international calling and the hotel doesn’t have a toll free number for me to contact either. I thought the resort was great at first but I was blindsided, not to mention our room safety deposit box was broken and would not work. DO NOT GO HERE!!

reviews.author: Melissa Griggs
reviews.text:
I had planned a trip here in October. However, it was right after the hurricane and the resort was closed. They offered to move us to another hotel but we decided to stay in the U.S. instead.

A week ago, I was charged 1 night’s stay at the resort, even though they could not host us during this time, and hotels.com had performed the cancellation for me, after I confirmed multiple times that I would not be charged as the resort was closed.

Not only was I charged $265, but I was also charged a foreign transaction fee of $8 on my credit card. When I called them (which involved downloading Skype and adding credit to that account for foreign calls), I was told this needed to be handled through hotels.com, and they gave me an incorrect email to use for follow up with the resort.

Well, Hotels.com has been emailing this resort for the last week attempting to get my refund without success. Please stay wary - the fact that my card was charged 1.5 months after a cancelled trip during a time they closed their resort is really weird - they shouldn’t have had access to my card information still - and they need to provide a refund as their resort was unavailable for my original reservation.

reviews.author: Tyler Beard
reviews.text:
Update:
After leaving the hotel. They double charged us for a fee and they will not refund us. We have tried to work with them and no one seems to care to help resolve the issue. If you stay here. Pay only in cash and make sure you get receipts in English only or your preferred language or they will double charge you.

We will not be coming back to this hotel when we return to Cancun.

This is must Read Review!
First off if you are going to book this hotel you need to book on the Royal service side. The service is phenomenal. The food at the hotel was okay. It wasn't bad but it wasn't great.

Here is what went wrong during our stay: the hotel hires on a group called OTIUM Transportation so you can have transportation to and from the airport and book excursions while you are there. The Manager of OTIUM named George will take advantage of you. We booked an excursion and it was a huge let down. When we spoke to George he began to lie to us and tell us he never sold us a specific type of excursion. OTIUM is in business for money and not client satisfaction. My recommendation is DO NOT WORK WITH OTIUM for any EXCURSION. Specifically with GEORGE, he has zero integrity and will make you feel horrible. If I could give a zero star to this company I would since they ripped us off and lied to us.

Again, if you book this hotel book with Royal service because they were phenomenal to work with. They made our stay pleasant. Just make sure not to work with OTIUM.

reviews.author: terra edwards
reviews.text: DO NOT I repeat DO NOT stay at this property... the royal service is a joke ! We never saw our butler, our bath tub broke, we ordered room service and it never came.... we spent 50K at their sister property in playa de carman and it was amazing ! They told us to come to Cancun for honeymoon and we would be treated like queens and kings just like the last property because they knew we got married and spent a lot of money.... when I went to speak with the manager he did not care... he told me to book another room and try again! I said NO !!!!! I will never be back and will be escalating this to corporate this is not how you treat guest who spends thousands of dollars

reviews.author: DJEnesSTL
reviews.text: Disgusting, old and full of mold. The check in process was a nightmare. They take you to a tiny room full of people. Its very hard to breathe throughout the hotel. No AC anywhere fully. Renovations everywhere you go, even while eating lunch, workers were outside changing pipes with their behinds out. Worst place ive ever stayed at. Do not waste your money.

reviews.author: Matt Enssle
reviews.text: This place is a paradise of garbage. Awful food. Even worse service. I stay in hotels 100+ nights a year and this takes the cake for WORST hotel or hospitality experience I have ever run across in my life! I’d rather sleep in the sand and get caught in a riptide than get caught paying a single dollar to end up here! Oh did I mention we are staying in “Royal Service” wing of the hotel? Just please do yourself a favor and check in at any other hotel in Cancun.

reviews.author: Urooj Najm
reviews.text:
Worst experience ever!! First of all the front desk guy didn't know how to check us in and after spending 30 mins takes us to a different check in line and asks us to wait in the line again ! Ridiculous! And they are checking us again around 2:15pm and asks us to come back again at 3 pm for the room keys activation cuz thats the time can't even give room access 45 mins earlier and then we stand in the line again for 30.mins to get the room keys activated , and we booked 2 full beds and they gave us 1 king.instead on the main floor , its 9pm at night and the music is so loud that we can't sleep , after a long journey we get this with loud thats ridiculous,  they have no manners that ppl with kids shouldn't be given such rooms
Would never come back here and nor would recommend it to anybody else

The food is awful
The hotel rooms is good , and the hotel us clean but food is very bad
We went to Mediterranean restaurant and food wasnt even cooked. So mich had to wait to get the food in lemon fish !!!we couldnt even find the server
There is no shows! No activies like other hotels !!!!!very dead ,

reviews.author: Amy Elizabeth
reviews.text:
My husband tried to do a nice thing and book this hotel for my 40th birthday as a surprise. Well, he booked it without realizing that our daughter had a medical procedure taking place on one of the days we would be away. I tried to call the hotel so that we could move the trip to the following weekend (NOTE: I DIDN'T WANT TO FLAT OUT CANCEL, I WANTED TO RE-BOOK FOR THE FOLLOWING WEEKEND!) and even provided the medical documents proving our dilemma. THIS HOTEL DENIED ME NUMEROUS TIMES. I CAN NOT BELIEVE THAT AN EXCEPTION CAN NOT BE MADE. It's just unethical. I don't care how gorgeous this hotel is or how many great reviews it has received. It is shameful that they aren't flexible. Even the airline is willing to change my flight! You may not care, Paradisus because in this messed up world it's all about the almighty dollar, but shame on you!

And to the manager who tried to sell me some BS reason in response to my review on TripAdvisor, don't bother! That is a lie! Even Travelocity whom I booked with couldn't believe your hotel would not accommodate me. I submitted the documents through them as well as called your hotel personally! Travelocity was so shocked they gave me a $200 credit to use on my next hotel stay! I will NEVER stay at your establishment and will hope that I can dissuade any others from doing so as well!

reviews.author: Lori Carnaghi
reviews.text:
I  paid in advance in November 2019 for a trip March 18- March 26, 2020. As COVID increased I contacted the hotel and asked if the trip could be refunded or moved to a different date. I was told they don't have a problem and there are no refunds or vouchers for different dates. So we showed went. Fast forward to Friday, March 20th when another guest informs me that the hotel is closing Monday, March 23. No letter under my room door, no phone call from staff, nothing. I go to the front desk and they confirm this and tell me I can go to another property in Playa Del Carmen or get a voucher. I said no, I didn't book a room in Playa and I don't want a voucher, I paid you in November in full and I want a refund for the three unused nights. He tells me that Playa and Cancun are the same city and I have to talk to someone else. Then he blames the Pandemic. I said look, you wouldn't let me cancel or reschedule so I'm here and now you are closing and kicking us out. I then have to convince him to give me something in writing and another contact person. I repeat the same information to Mendez Perez, Paulina <paulina.mendez@melia.com>; de la Cruz Martinez, Joel <joel.delacruz@melia.com>; Camacho Chavez, Miguel <miguel.camacho@melia.com who on March 27th email me and agree to a refund, but the refund will be up to 90 days. It's now 60 days and nothing. I'm working with my credit card company for a refund and the hotel won't respond. My friends received vouchers with numerous restrictions. The place had 21 guests when they kicked everyone out, the restaurants were closed, and one of the pools was broken the entire time we were there.

Do not book with these unreputable people.

reviews.author: Aigerim Zhorgenbayeva
reviews.text:
Worst hotel ever!
Never go here, don't think, because it's too old and dirty! Especially with kids! Nothing to do, stupid kids club, stupid strict rules! I have two kids, 4 and 8 years old and they are used to play and be together, but only in this hotel it turned out to be impossible at all! Before we were in Finest Playa, Royalton riviera hotels and everything was ok, they met us halfway. There are no activities, no waterslides, no theater for shows, no kid's buffet, no spots in the beach. Food is same everyday. Now I don't know how to choose hotels because I'm not going to believe to internet. It's said 5 stars hotel, but it is only 3.

reviews.author: Jeff Cooper
reviews.text: Very poor service.  Over an hour to check into a 5 star hotel!  They are very unfriendly.  Most of the food is garbage.  I would not recommend this to anyone I like and probably not ever the people I don't like.  Way over priced!

reviews.author: Monique R.
reviews.text:
Unethical Management Staff

My family and I had a reservation to visit this hotel on April 11 but due to COVID-19 the reservation was cancelled. It is now May 28th and I am just getting a response that they will not be doing any refunds and giving me other dates this year where they will honor the rates. This cancellation is due to COVID-19 so why would they hold customers money which is theft and unethical when their reservation was cancelled. The country is still not fully open and there is so much up in the air with people’s lives and this is the unethical customer service treatment that I have received. I will never recommend this hotel or even want to visit there anymore. This is very unethical and theft if you ask me actually criminal to hold a customer money when visit was not completed due to an issue completely out of my control. No star is deserved as that was the only option in order to post this comment.

reviews.author: Gerald Leavitt
reviews.text:
Avoid this resort. When we booked through their website it booked the wrong dates and they were not willing to correct the booking so we changed our travel arrangements to match the incorrect dates, and then when we got home we realized that they charged us twice (double). Check your credit card activity.

Update: Notice that the incompetent organization did not address the double (i.e. DOUBLE) charge for this booking in their response. Buyer beware!!!

reviews.author: Lisa Patrick
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful  BUT their website has not been updated for 3 years.. no red bar or half of what is listed... only bar available after 8pm is the lobby bar 🙄🙄 I would give a negative review due to this.. I would not recommend

reviews.author: Ottoniel Portillo Urdaneta
reviews.text: This by far has been the worst hotel I have ever been for such a high price I paid. As soon as they gave me the room I opened the door and the room was not event cleaned up, the smell of the room was like Hell, when I went to talk to the managers about it they did not even care about that, then it took them 1 more hour to give another nasty room, and I say nasty because the 2nd room they tried to give was dirty as well, actually the AC did not work at all and I made the claim and they did not care about it...they just dont care about you after you paid......IF YOU DONT WANT TO LOOSE YOUR MONEY DONT COME TO THIS NASTY HOTEL.... And by the way the service is the worse you can ever find in hospitality...,

reviews.author: Ethan Nand
reviews.text: Seriously! Me and my family went here in June this year and was so bad the food tasted half cooked service was terrible plus in our room the drawer fell down twice hitting my moms leg both times

reviews.author: Olina Hao
reviews.text: A five-star hotel in Mexico can't even drink a single coconut!  The room is really old, and the service is not five-star level.

reviews.author: Paulette Agakhanian
reviews.text: So I am here at the moment on a family vacation but can't wait to leave...the hotel looks nothing like it is portrayed to look like on their website...it's old and dirty...THERE IS NO A/C in the lobby or in the hallways...we leave every evening after dinner to the non all inclusive hotels next to ours to escape the hot and humid temperature in our stupid hotel...there is construction going on 1 or 2 floors below us starting at around 7/7:30 am...I don't know why they are putting people in these rooms with all this noise going on...put in a complaint yesterday but no one has done anything about it or even gotten back to be...would not recommend this hotel at all!!!

reviews.author: Aj prince
reviews.text: Worst Hotel I’ve ever been at, food wasn’t good at all, they never cleaned our room and never restocked the fridge unless we asked too, I would recommend staying at any hotel besides this one.

reviews.author: Faina Shpiler
reviews.text: Terrible service. "Ocean view" room = time with a view on construction. 2-hour wait to get a room.
