- I called room service to ask for something as simple as drinking water, they told me they would come in 10 or 20 minutes and they never came. The attention is very bad, every time you ask someone something they send you to talk to another person.

reviews.author: Jose Luis Cristóbal
reviews.text:
It's a very nice hotel, in my opinion too big and very crowded, we already knew that, but we were traveling with our 14-year-old son and wanted him to have a good time.
The problem with the room was immediate upon arrival; they gave us two small beds for the three of us. It was supposed to be a Junior Suite, they told us that's how they were there, but the bathroom couldn't fit two people... it was just a regular double room!
They changed it and we had to pay an extra €1000!!!
Then we booked the "18+ Area," which was a complete waste of money! Our son couldn't even go near the pool; they were constantly telling him off (I understand, it was an adults-only area), but they could have told us and we wouldn't have paid... The problem that ruined our vacation was when we booked excursions through the hotel, specifically with the agency OTIUN INTER Mexico Dolphin Team, which has several offices in the hotel. We booked a tour to Isla Mujeres with dolphins and snorkeling. We went on the Victoria catamaran on August 2nd at 9:30 am (they picked us up from the hotel at 8 am). The driver had to stop at several other hotels to pick up other people… After snorkeling, as we were getting back on the catamaran, my son dropped my iPhone into the water. It was brand new, only a week old, an iPhone 14 Pro that I had received as a gift.

I asked them to please help me snorkel and get it. My son was snorkeling, trying to retrieve it. I wanted to jump into the water to get the phone, but they wouldn't let me. They just stood there, completely still! What's more, they told the other people in the water to get back on board and that it was our problem if we had dropped it!

I couldn't believe it. It was a dark-skinned, very rude guy who wouldn't let us go get the phone. I got angry with him, and he told me to talk to the captain, but there was no captain, no one was doing anything, and I seriously doubt there was even a captain! They were just standing around with a microphone, acting silly to get tips. They brazenly said they were passing around a collection box so everyone could put in whatever amount they wanted! Put in jewelry, watches, rings, whatever you want! Absolutely shameful.
The guy completely ignored me, yelled at me, and told me he wouldn't let me on his damn boat again, and that he couldn't wait to dive because he was already four minutes late. None of the crew bothered to jump in the water and try to find the iPhone. If it had belonged to one of them… things would have been different! They told me I should have given him a tip under the table, secretly, and then YES, they would have gone looking for him. There were even people who wanted to help us with their snorkeling gear to find him; they didn't leave anyone alone!

“I'M SORRY, MA'AM, you're responsible.”
I would have been furious, so frustrated… a bunch of jerks who don't know how to treat people, they only know how to get them drunk on tequila, they were shoving the bottle straight into everyone's mouth.
The dark-haired guy was wearing blue mirrored sunglasses. I have his picture, the picture of the Victoria catamaran, the registration number, and the names they gave me of everyone (under the tip).
I'm going to file a complaint against the hotel and against them. Of course, the agency is to blame for hiring people like that. I hope the hotel removes that agency from its premises, as I've heard about several bad experiences and many irregularities… I doubt the agency had insurance, I doubt there was any safety on that catamaran. I only saw one life preserver, and there were over 60 of us. They were all silent among themselves, and I'm sure that if someone had fallen overboard, they wouldn't have stopped to rescue them. There were no life preservers to throw out; they wouldn't have jumped into the sea to rescue anyone, and they're always late! The whole "man overboard" thing doesn't apply to them!

Well, if you tip them, you're all set.) Very, very regrettable. A hotel like this ruins its reputation because of people like this.

Thanks to a wonderful receptionist who helped us use her own iPhone to find out where the agency was and block it. Even so, a supervisor approached her and reprimanded her! The girl was very, very kind.
The best thing to do is book a private excursion outside the hotel. It's more expensive, but it's always worth it.

reviews.author: Angela Barone
reviews.text: Hello, I'm writing because last year I wrote a very good review of the hotel. We liked it so much that after 6 months we returned, this time with the whole family. When we arrived, they gave us rooms in tower 1, which were quite old. I explained to the receptionist that it was my second time at the hotel, and that the first time they offered me a room in tower 5. He said it was a courtesy, and this time I had the same package. I showed him last year's reservation. My mother-in-law, seeing how old the room was, paid extra to have it moved to tower 3 and paid for two wristbands. And that's when the ordeal began. The air conditioning didn't work in my in-laws' room in tower 1. Their room wasn't cleaned for two out of eleven days. The jacuzzi was leaking. In my room, the sink was clogged, so we called to have it fixed. Every day I had to call room service because they cleaned the room but didn't leave water in the refrigerator, and being pregnant, I had to take my medication. The service was over an hour and 45 minutes late; I often had to call two or three times. After my mother-in-law paid extra for two wristbands that included drinks, they gave her some green olives. Every day it was an ordeal to get a sunbed at the pool because the beds cost $250. There were more than 10 empty beds and not enough sunbeds and umbrellas for everyone. People were starting at 6 a.m. grabbing sunbeds. What kind of 5-star hotel does that happen? There are many classifications among the blue, green, and brown wristbands. Not counting our experience with Yuli, a girl who insisted on giving us a talk at all costs. When I told her I had already given it last year, she took it upon herself to call all the rooms. I very politely explained that I had already given the talk, that my family already belonged to the club, that I had enjoyed many Melia facilities around the world since I was a child, and that I wanted my sister-in-law and mother-in-law to attend. I explained that we had local friends, that we wouldn't be spending much time at the hotel facilities (there weren't even sun loungers at the pool), and that we had to get up early. Our friends were going to take us out, and she asked us where our friend worked for an agency, if they were going to take us to another hotel—a lot of personal questions. She suggested that, to avoid enjoying the hotel facilities, I stay in a B&B, to which I replied that I would spend my own money and stay wherever I wanted. She called again, and this time my husband answered. He asked her not to bother him anymore, but she said she wanted to speak to the lady, not him—a total lack of respect. The hotel facilities have declined in quality; there were water leaks everywhere, the water in the indoor pools where the bar is located was green and had a very bad smell, so my husband suggested they please add chlorine. The next day it was a different story. My sister-in-law's birthday was on the 13th, and they called to tell her they would send a gift to her room, which never arrived. My sister-in-law also told them she intended to celebrate at the Rosa Negra, and they said they could get her a good table and make the reservation, which they didn't. We had to call that same day to make the reservation ourselves. Last time, they gave us rooms in Tower 5 with all the premium drinks, even though we had the same package this time. I hope my review helps improve the hotel's quality, as it's a shame it has declined so much in six months. We had recommended the Paradisus to all our friends, especially to some close friends on their honeymoon, but this time it left much to be desired, and we made our dissatisfaction known at reception every moment. I left a copy of last year's review. It truly is a paradise. The drinks, the food, all the staff are incredibly friendly, especially at the Malva restaurant. Be sure to ask for the waiter Samuel Sosa; he'll make you feel like family.

reviews.author: Saul Castellanos (CompartirNoCuesta)
reviews.text: Terrible hotel in every way. I stayed for 15 days and during that time I noticed the hotel's poor infrastructure. Old, broken facilities, and even the pools smelled bad. I had a Reserve (VIP) wristband and they still charged me for everything, including room service. I couldn't access the Reserve area because I had a baby (but they didn't tell me that when I upgraded). They charged me an extra "government" tax upon arrival, but they wouldn't give me an invoice for it. The staff's service was awful, the food was tasteless and greasy, and they made everything conditional. First and last time I'll ever stay at that hotel. By the way, it's way too expensive for what it offers.

reviews.author: Karine Tremblay
reviews.text: The hotel is infested with cockroaches. There were even cockroaches in my room and in the lobby, which is surrounded by restaurants. The food at the evening buffet was very mediocre, the same quality as in Cuba. The pools were very dirty. There was a lack of chairs at the pool and on the beach; you have to pay $250 per day for all the empty beach or pool loungers. The photos of the rooms on the websites don't match the reality at all. It's very old and everything is broken (door handles, balcony door, etc.). A very outdated hotel that doesn't deserve its 5 stars. I had to quarantine all my belongings to avoid bringing cockroaches home. The only positive points are: the staff come to see us every 5 minutes for drinks, the beach is superb, the lobby is very nice, the coffee is good, and the evening entertainment is good.

reviews.author: Rafael Camargo
reviews.text:
The room did not match the images on the website/Internet, and the service, both on the beach and in the restaurants, was very poor. There were huge lines for check-in, check-out, the restaurant, and the poolside snack. We complained about the room and the service, and nothing was done; you're just another guest there, and they make no effort to please the guest. We went on our honeymoon, and it was disappointing. Luckily, we went to Playa del Carmen beforehand, to a hotel that saved the trip.

In my opinion, don't go to this hotel; change hotels. Go to a hotel where they value the guest and treat you as you should be treated, not just as another guest.

reviews.author: S R (Haifisch)
reviews.text: Terrible experience with this hotel. Upon checking in, I told the gentleman at the front desk my full name and told him about my reservation. He said it wasn't in the system. I asked him to let me in to check on the situation at the front desk, and he said he couldn't let me in. I'd have to sort it out over the phone or online. I told him to call someone so they could guide me to the front desk and sort it out. He left for two minutes and when he came back, he said he was sorry, but due to occupancy, no one could come to help me. Such terrible service and zero customer service. I obviously canceled and will never return to this hotel.

reviews.author: eva esteban
reviews.text:
Honestly, it was crazy to come here.
The pool is crazy, the music is super loud, unpleasant, the sunbeds are taken all day, if you go down at 8:30 in the morning, there are none left! It doesn't matter if you talk to any of the staff, no one pays attention to you. We had to go down at 7:00 to put down towels and get sunbeds... very harsh when you're on vacation (you're supposed to come to rest and enjoy yourself), but even so, when you weren't looking, you wouldn't have them anymore. I thought of complaining to a guy at the pool area, and he said, "You do the same," take whatever you want and take it from someone else... a cockfight over a damn sunbed with an umbrella! There aren't enough!!! A girl who looked like she was half in charge of the pool area, completely covered up, with white socks, white pants, a white long-sleeved shirt, a white hat that covered her neck, head, and face... horrible! She completely ignored everything. I don't understand how they have people like that working. That girl is the most unfriendly person I've ever seen. I think she's at the pool to scare away guests, and her colleagues are the same! There's one super nice person who realizes the situation and helps you, but can't do anything...
The pool is full of people, the water is boiling, people are eating everywhere, even in the water! The drinks are the same, people are holding glasses in the pool... at one point there were nacho and margarita remnants floating in the water...
If young people come and don't care about anything, it's the perfect place. If you want to relax, you have to pay for the adult pool, but the sun loungers don't have umbrellas.
In short... the pool is a disaster.
It's overcrowded, and there's no oversight over the insufficient sun loungers or the pool staff.
I have to say that the best thing by far, and I won't tire of repeating it, was the Balinese massage we got this morning. It was very expensive at €230 per person, they give you a discount, but it was so worth it... I've never had a massage like that before, incredible. I don't remember the girl's name, a very slim Filipina, but with fantastic strength and hands. My husband got one from his partner, and it was also spectacular, in a cabin for both of us at the same time.
I wish these girls were in Spain!! They are so worth it. They have power in their hands, they work magic on your back, they are polite, super friendly... I'm going to repeat it before we leave.

reviews.author: Valle
reviews.text: This old hotel with outdated facilities doesn't offer services befitting a 5-star rating, nor is it justified by its price. The service was appalling; we complained numerous times about the noise and the poor condition of the air conditioning, which made our stay extremely uncomfortable. It's a shame that a company like Meliá doesn't respond adequately. The food is not up to the standard the hotel chain offers at other locations. I will not return to this hotel and I advise against it, as the area is full of hotels.

reviews.author: Evelyn DM
reviews.text:
I stayed at this hotel for a conference. The customer service was terrible and the place was very disorganized, but the worst part was when I returned to my room on the second day and found an entire family carrying suitcases out. To my surprise, they had assigned the room to someone else, and the bellboy had entered my room and, despite seeing my belongings, left the suitcases there.
When I complained at reception, they confirmed that my room had indeed been assigned to someone else, and according to them, I had authorized a room change, even though they had left the checkout slip with the correct date in the room, despite the "Do Not Disturb" sign. Security was also terrible; anyone could enter your room at any time.

reviews.author: Eliane Negri
reviews.text:
First, they gave us a room with single beds, even though we had requested a double bed in the reservation. After being held up by a presentation about misleading package deals, we missed lunch and were denied a table at any of the five restaurants for dinner. The employee who takes the luggage to the room, when asked to leave it in the room without our presence, failed to do so, perhaps thinking he wouldn't be rewarded with the "tip".
In conversation with Mr. Ismael, a representative of Management, I requested the possibility of offering a massage for my wife to compensate for the discomfort of arrival. After two days, upon signing a document releasing the Hotel from any liability, a 25-minute massage was offered, when the shortest massage at the hotel is 50 minutes.
Since I'm not begging, I declined such generous compensation.
What a nightmare!

reviews.author: Iván Noé Campos Castrejon
reviews.text:
Good afternoon, I just wanted to say that I absolutely DO NOT recommend this hotel. Please don't go there. The service at reception is terrible. They assigned us the wrong room, which delayed our check-in. A cockroach flew into the room during the night, making it impossible to sleep. There are no towels in the pool area. I had a stomach bug for two days; I only ate there, and I'd already been at the hotel for two days. The hotel staff gives incorrect information about the activities and tours offered by agencies located within the hotel, and then they just pass the buck, and nobody helps you. Hotel staff recommended we attend a presentation about the same services they sell there in the CIRCLE area. We said it would be good and asked them to schedule us. We went to the appointment as agreed, and they told us the appointment wasn't available and that they would reschedule it for the next day. We canceled activities to make time to attend, but they didn't care. It's very difficult to get a manager or leader at the hotel to help you. The customer service manager said that the CIRCLE issue wasn't her responsibility, nor was the information provided by the hotel's concierge staff. The concierge herself only said she was very busy because there were so many guests and it was impossible to provide good service. The customer service was terrible.

I had already read bad reviews, but unfortunately, I didn't pay attention to them.

This hotel is barely 3 stars.

A vacation nightmare!!

reviews.author: Karla Yuri Mendoza Muñiz
reviews.text: Terrible reception service, restaurant reservations were difficult to obtain, the infrastructure is in ruins—it leaks and floods everywhere—the lobby is wrecked from renovations, there's a lot of noise from the tools, they don't warn you before booking, and they treat you badly. I definitely don't recommend it; the price doesn't match the quality, they discriminate against national guests and give priority to foreigners. Rude waiters—in short, what can I say? A terrible experience. (Photo of me mopping up the water from my room with towels)

reviews.author: Carlos Brilhante
reviews.text: The rooms were very old and infested with cockroaches. The shower drain was clogged, and the air conditioning was dripping water and wetting the floor. Aside from the room problems, the staff service was very good and the food was good. I do not recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Jaime Avalos
reviews.text:
The waiters at the buffet get angry if you don't say good morning before speaking to them.

The person at the cafeteria outside the buffet speaks rudely to you if you order two things at once. The facilities are really nice. Everything is very clean, but the service is the WORST I've ever received in any hotel I've been to.

reviews.author: Vivían Ramirez
reviews.text: I came in February 2025 and in my opinion it's the WORST hotel I've ever stayed in. The food is terrible, the service is awful, the waiters are completely inattentive, room service takes ages to answer, and when they do, it takes over an hour to bring the food. I will never recommend it and I would never come back. DISGUSTING

reviews.author: David Szwanczar
reviews.text:
We are very disappointed with this hotel.
Today we were told 3 times by guest service that we need to clean the room, change the towels, replenish the minibar, bring slippers and 3 different people confirmed that it will be done, and it did not happen. I do not know if they are joking or are incompetent. The hotel has a pleasant food and drink regime and the staff in the restaurants is very nice. Everyone chooses, for this they deserve praise. Unfortunately this hotel needs to invest in the rooms, which are already very used, and the furniture is in poor and neglected condition. We will definitely not recommend this accommodation in Cancun. The beach service is a mistake, when it comes to ordering drinks, it was a big problem to find a free sunbed, the interest in solving this situation was minimal. The hotel is very large, the number of sunbeds is insufficient.

reviews.author: Mami Rodriguez
reviews.text:
The transportation system was awful; I have no words to describe it. We waited an hour, they didn't pick us up at the airport, and then they tried to charge us for the return trip. It's a mafia run by a guy named Víctor and the taxi drivers—a disgrace. The lack of decorum in the dress code was appalling, whether we were going to the beach or out to dinner. And I'm sorry, but I thought Meliá was something else entirely.
The food... Ugh, and that was supposed to be on the good side... The menu was short and repetitive.
A round of applause for the staff; they're the only redeeming feature, always polite and attentive.
But I won't be returning, nor will I recommend it. It was a terrible experience, and we've been frequent visitors to that wonderful country, Mexico, for over 30 years. It's a shame they're willing to do anything to fill the hotel. It's shameful.
Regards, Manuela

reviews.author: Violetta G.
reviews.text: This hotel definitely doesn't deserve 5 stars. We didn't get the room we booked. After complaining, we were given the same room on a different floor. The rooms are run-down, old, and damaged. The bathroom was a disaster, and it was disgusting to wash there. The double beds were at most 1.30 meters wide. They claimed they had no other beds in the hotel. Our room was in the main pyramid on the 8th floor. Sleeping at night was almost impossible because the noise from the lobby penetrated all the way up. Unlike other hotels, the music and casino nights weren't held outside, but inside the lobby. It was impossible to go to sleep with children before 11 pm. Music with a strong bass blared from somewhere until late into the night, certainly until 3-5 am. For 14 days, we had to force ourselves to sleep like that. The rooms are cleaned sloppily. The balcony wasn't mopped for 14 days, and the floor in the room wasn't mopped even once. The bed linen wasn't changed until... After complaining at reception, the shower curtain was replaced after 10 days. It was terribly moldy, and I had to ask for a new one. The bathtub was definitely not cleaned with any cleaning products, but only rinsed with water; sand residue remained in the corners for days. The hotel grounds and pool area were equally run-down and damaged. Ventilation vents blew directly into the pool area, and everything smelled of sewage. The tiles around the pool and on the pool floor were all moldy. The pool was never cleaned; grass, sand, and drink cups were in it 24/7. The sun loungers weren't cleaned, for example, in the evening. In the morning, the tables next to the loungers were still dirty with food scraps and fruit from the cocktails. There were far too few parasols; on one side of the pool, there were only 5 parasols for 30 sun loungers. On the first day, we had to sit in the Mexican sun with two children without a parasol. When we asked if they could get one for us, we were simply told that none were available. Now I have to get up every morning at 6:30 a.m. to reserve shady spots for my children and myself. This worked until the day a pool staff member gave our loungers to someone else. Loungers are only reserved once you've placed a personal item on them; apparently, a beach towel doesn't count, and you'll have no other option than to reserve a shady spot early in the morning, otherwise you won't find one during the day. Ordering drinks or snacks by the pool is just as nerve-wracking; a one-hour wait is normal. You're only seen if you're tipping. The buffet was clean and always offered a good selection. However, all the plates were invariably dirty. You also have to queue in the restaurant to get a table—20 minutes for breakfast or dinner. The staff can't keep up with clearing the tables, so sometimes four tables of four people each are empty but still uncleared, and it takes at least 10 minutes before they react. The queue outside is getting longer. The hotel staff constantly tried to sell us things, and we were intercepted in the breakfast queue, especially at the pool for family photos. I don't see why I should have to pay extra for everything at an all-inclusive hotel. We wanted to go swimming in the cenotes on our own with the rental car and asked at reception for life jackets. The employee was completely overwhelmed because no one had ever asked for them before. Of course, they didn't have any life jackets and advised us to buy some. The same employee couldn't even get us four umbrellas for an excursion. There was only one umbrella per room. He just left us standing there. We didn't book any excursions through the hotel because they charge exorbitant prices. Activities and excursions, like Chichen Itza, which the hotel doesn't offer, are spoken of negatively. One employee literally told us: "We don't need to see it, it's boring."

reviews.author: Ep GV
reviews.text: The hotel impresses at first glance. We booked rooms for three families, and upon arrival, they initially refused to accept IDs or passports. This issue was resolved, and they subsequently gave us a room while the other two were being prepared. We understand that's the standard of service. Afterward, we hired an additional person, but when you mention it to reception, they don't provide a price for the extra person, and there are no prices displayed. The most popular restaurants should allow reservations, and they should also extend their hours by at least one hour. The mini-fridge in one of the rooms wasn't working. After insisting through various means, it worked somewhat, but then broke down again and stopped cooling. The sheets we received were dirty. They had appeared to be clean in one of the restrooms, but we realized that the sheet was the same one from the previous day because there was a stain. We don't know if it was from an iron or one of the suitcases. Our experience went from pleasant to horrible. I hope other guests have a better experience. And the uncleaned sargassum on the beach... ugh, so much more to say.

reviews.author: Isabel Domingo
reviews.text:
My husband and I came to the hotel for a few days, and from the very beginning, everything was chaotic.

Before arriving, we asked the hotel for help getting a taxi from where we had left our rental car, but they were unable to sort it out. So, we went to the hotel to see if they could help us in person, but after sending us around for 30 minutes, they told us they couldn't call us a taxi because they didn't know any taxi services, and we had to figure it out on our own.

Upon arrival, despite having priority check-in, we had to wait over an hour in line to get into our room. While we were waiting in line to check in, we saw hotel staff approaching families and guests to offer them drinks and assistance. At no point did they help us or offer anything. Two days later, we learned that all guests have a concierge assigned to guide you through the hotel and answer any questions about restaurant reservations, what's included, etc.
The only time our supposedly assigned concierge helped us was to sell us the Meliá "Club Circle," even offering to give us a tour of the hotel two days after our arrival.

Aside from all this, the hotel overall is a complete disaster.

Restaurants: poor quality of food, poor service (the first night we had to eat three times until we found a dish we could eat - we're not picky eaters, we'll get a bit of anything). The only exception is Agua Marina, with excellent service and food.

Reservations: On the first day, we were told we didn't have a seat at any of the restaurants because they were full, even though we checked in around 2 PM (earlier than expected). The next night, there was only one available at the restaurant...

Activities: None started on time, so it's difficult to organize your day around them with meals or outdoor activities.

Note: With the exception of the pool and Nespresso staff, the rest were unprofessional, bordering on unpleasant.

NOT All-Inclusive: many additional extras in restaurants, pool/beach loungers or beds, cocktails or drinks, and certain areas/restaurants of the hotel.

Facilities: Very old hotel, looks like it's 40-50 years old - even in supposedly renovated rooms.

Check-out: forced to wait 1 hour. Waiting in line to obtain an unnecessary "exit pass" risked delays getting to the airport.

In short, a very poor value hotel, far from the quality expected from a 5-star hotel. A disappointing experience. NOT RECOMMENDED.

reviews.author: Edgar Miguel
reviews.text:
A great hotel years ago.

Now it's falling apart, lacking maintenance, and the food is mediocre.

The staff doesn't make an effort to make you feel at home, there's a shortage of food service staff, and the hallways are dirty.

The air conditioning only goes down to 21 degrees Celsius (70 degrees Fahrenheit).

It's terribly hot.

URGENT ATTENTION NEEDED

I'm revising my last rating. Besides trying to cover up the terrible service, they set unrealistic standards.

You're better off looking for other options in the Palace area.

reviews.author: Renata Safra
reviews.text: People wake up at 5 am to get chairs and umbrellas and fight amongst themselves. Terrible. There's not enough space for everyone.

reviews.author: Samuel fonseca
reviews.text: Four pieces of meat and a tortilla, and they call it a taco? I thought I'd find better Mexican food here than in the United States. The buffet is pathetic, and the pasta and pizza are reserved for a separate restaurant. 😒

reviews.author: Solainy Beltrão
reviews.text:
I would like to know the status of the problem that occurred on November 14, 2021, in room 2201, when US$150.00, BRL 1,400.00, and a Technos Rose Gold watch were stolen.

On the day of the incident, we spoke with Ms. Fabíola and Mr. Aurélio who, after inspecting the room, asked us to provide an answer within 72 hours.

On check-out day, November 17, 2021, we still hadn't received an answer, so we spoke again with the hotel's security department, as well as with the person in charge, who identified himself as Francisco and even spoke a little Portuguese. He asked us to wait until Friday, November 19, 2021.

It turns out they haven't contacted us and haven't told us how they planned to resolve the incident.

We suggest refunding the amount to the injured guests, regardless of how the hotel determines who is responsible for the theft, since the hotel is responsible for the safety of its guests and must take legal action, and the guests are responsible for reimbursing the amount paid.

To demonstrate the regularity of the dollar purchase, I am sending the purchase receipt in reais (Brazilian currency), showing that the total amount was US$200.00, of which only US$50.00 was used, and the rest disappeared from the hotel room.

Furthermore, I request a refund of BRL 1,400.00 and the amount corresponding to the stolen watch.

Regards!

reviews.author: Ivonne García
reviews.text: The day pass service was terrible. The company selling it doesn't explain what it actually is. There were seven of us and only one lounge chair. The credit you have left for drinks and food can't be used in the restaurant; it's an extra cost. Honestly, other hotels offer better service. I'm definitely not coming back. ❌ Only the waitress who served us, Miss Laura Cervantes, was kind and helpful, even going out of her way to get us another lounge chair and try to improve our stay. Truly awful.

reviews.author: Rachel Brunette
reviews.text:
If you're in Block 1
Run for your life!!
Dust
Mold
Original Jacuzzi built into the balcony

The beach was beautiful!

As for the food
Meh!! Look at the picture of my purple pasta!!

The pools are dirty

reviews.author: Gabriela Fraga
reviews.text: The staff were very rude, the food was cold, tasteless, and of poor quality. There were cockroaches in the room, and it was very noisy. There were mosquitoes throughout the hotel.

reviews.author: Oscar Ornelas
reviews.text: Unfortunately, we couldn't sleep well for several nights during our stay due to the noise generated by the businesses across the street. The hotel has no solution for this and says it's external to them. So, unless you're not sleeping on vacation, this is a good option... or get a room with an ocean view!

reviews.author: Leysi Blandon
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice but the service is terrible, especially reception. I wouldn't recommend it to my friends and family. It was a bad experience; they make you wait too long for your room, which is especially bad for someone traveling abroad. Not recommended at all 😌sorry.

reviews.author: Mordo Cartoon
reviews.text:
I'm giving it one star because it's required to leave a review.

Even with the Royal Service package, it was a bad experience. From the moment I arrived at the lobby, I asked about the bathroom, and when I went, there was no toilet paper, it was dirty, and the two towels were dirty too.

You feel like you can't breathe because of all the plants and the muffled air conditioning. The lighting is poor, and everything is turned off by 10 PM. If you walk around, you feel like they're telling you to go to bed. They offered me a room in one area and gave me one in another, but thanks to an extra $200, I got a better view, and it was also part of the Royal Service package.

The buffet food didn't have much variety, just fruit and tacos. The meat was salty, the lemonade was sugar-free, the disco has carpets that make it hard to dance comfortably, and they tried to charge me for a drink once.

If you've never been to a hotel, you might say this one is good, but having been to so many, I'd say this is the worst.

And one more thing I forgot to mention is that when you arrive at the Cancun airport, don't waste your time talking to the tourism staff there. I assure you, you'll lose a whole day while they invite you to visit a supposed hotel and offer you free, excellent food, when what they really want is to practically force you to buy a condo there.

Besides that, you can't brush your teeth with the tap water because it's not safe to drink. You have to use bottled water for everything.

That's just a little bit of my bad experience. 😺👌🏻

It's a hotel for meditation or for feeling like a prisoner...

reviews.author: Daniela Ruiz
reviews.text:
Terrible service.
The hotel is understaffed and it takes ages to get a drink.
They're not helpful or friendly; everything is a problem for them. They don't smile; they seem angry.

The hotel is filthy, the bathrooms are dirty, and the outlets in the room don't charge.

This isn't a Diamond Hotel; they should remove that rating. The hotel is very old and poorly maintained.

reviews.author: Javier Lazo
reviews.text: The worst part of arriving to relax and celebrate an important occasion is wasting hours waiting in line to check in. The process is terrible. I've never been to a hotel where the process was so slow, and to top it off, there's only one girl serving the entire hotel. It's illogical. But oh well, I had no choice but to wait patiently.

reviews.author: DRACXVS dracxvs
reviews.text:
I thought it would be like the one in Playa del Carmen. I booked Family Concierge (which never existed). Money wasted. Terrible service. There's a musty smell in the hotel. They're very dirty; they don't clean the common areas or the rooms properly. I don't recommend it.
The good points: nice beach and a good view (nothing you can't find at any other hotel in the area).

reviews.author: daniela velez
reviews.text: Very poor service and attention. On July 7, 2022, I was robbed. I was staying in room 1615, the members' room, and 500 USDT and some emeralds were stolen from the safe. We filed a police report with the hotel, but they refused to take any responsibility. Very poor treatment and negligence because I am from Colombia. A bad experience, bad service, poor attention, and we were robbed.

reviews.author: josue roman
reviews.text:
Poor training of the reservations staff.
A child under 6 was charged much more than an adult in the same room.
Poor service to visitors who are not staying at the hotel.
Prices are listed in dollars. By law, they must be quoted in pesos.

reviews.author: Catalina Posada
reviews.text: It is a hotel, although with old facilities, it is very nice, with a spectacular view, good restaurants, very friendly waiters. However, the biggest flaw that takes away all the stars is the admission of large groups (we had a group of 900 doctors) with terrible behavior that made it impossible to enjoy the hotel, neither the beach nor the pool... drunks all over the hotel. The worst thing is that the hotel employees themselves are afraid of such large groups due to the great lack of control and difficult management of them. The difficult thing is 1. It is not a family hotel, much less if you go with children; the pools are very nice but very deep, all 180 MT, and the children's pool is only 40 cm deep. 2. The acceptance of large groups, forgetting that they have other guests who paid for a break in a 5-star hotel with wet areas, pool and beach that cannot be enjoyed. Let's hope the manager reads it and gives a response... watch out, they have another event scheduled in December.

reviews.author: Julio C Hernandez
reviews.text: The rooms are neglected, the beds smell bad, the air conditioning doesn't work anymore and leaks water. I reported it, but they got upset because I didn't want to sign their famous Timeshare Program. Be very careful; they made me waste almost four hours insisting I buy it, and in the end, they get really annoyed because you don't sign. At first, when they talk to you about this famous presentation, they're very friendly, they really lull you to sleep, but I'm telling you, be very careful. They tell you it's 90 minutes, but those 90 minutes turn into 4 to 5 hours of pressure. I won't be back; there are better options. Now it turns out you gave me something for free? Hahaha, I didn't even stay to finish your presentation. Check your system carefully and see what you gave me for free.

reviews.author: Felipe Arriagada Subercaseaux
reviews.text: When I booked, the salesperson lied to me to get me to rent a higher-priced room, saying I was more likely to get two connecting rooms, which was false since connecting rooms weren't available in that room type. Once at the hotel, they closed both main pools one afternoon for an event, and some of the bars were also closed. It was impossible to be on the terrace of the main restaurant. The hotel offered no explanation or solution to my complaint, even though I was in the family concierge area, which is supposed to be more concerned about its guests. The hotel showed zero explanation or concern.

reviews.author: Arnulfo Cardenas
reviews.text: We made a VIP reservation with a beach view, paid a fortune for 8 days, and were given a room on the first floor with no ocean view. And the reservation was for a beach view! It's a great hotel, but be careful where they put you. I wouldn't go back because they weren't able to find a solution and completely ignored us.

reviews.author: Jean Marques Terra
reviews.text: I definitely won't be back. I understand they're environmentally conscious and all, but I'm a smoker and I can't smoke in the hotel facilities, including the beach. The room isn't the one I booked. I don't know if it's the agency's or the hotel's fault, but a little information before booking would have been good because, knowing what I know now, I wouldn't have come. I'm still at the hotel and I really don't want to stay. The food leaves a lot to be desired. Regards.

reviews.author: lour lou
reviews.text:
Very bad, noisy room, temperatures above 27 degrees Celsius, and an old, very noisy air conditioner that didn't cool the room. The shower had curtains, the bathroom was from the 80s, and the sink didn't reach the floor, flooding the entire room. There was construction on both sides of the room. They refused to listen to our complaints or offer a solution from the first day until the seventh day, almost forcing us to leave.
It doesn't live up to its 5 or 4-star rating. This is the first time this has happened to us at a Meliá hotel, as we stayed at Atlanterra in Cádiz a month earlier, and there's a world of difference. They lack coordination from management to all administrative departments. They really ruined our vacation.

This hotel does not live up to its advertised category. They failed to consider that when there is construction, customer safety should be prioritized.

reviews.author: Julia Bov
reviews.text:
This isn't Europe. Their 4-5*** hotels are equivalent to 3* in Egypt. The hotel is appalling. Mold is everywhere, and its smell permeated everything, right down to the suitcase. If you're allergic to penicillin, be prepared for all the "pleasures." The bedding is synthetic and constantly damp. It took me six months to recover. Swimming in the sea is impossible due to the location: even a good swimmer gets swept away by the waves, even in the so-called calm. The coastline is constantly changing. One good thing: the excursions, albeit expensive. There are few excursions in Russian.
I won't go there again.

reviews.author: TATIANA ZAPATA JIMENEZ
reviews.text:
Terrible service. I had an incident in the shower because it was poorly cleaned and no one accompanied me. They showed no interest in helping.
The service on the beach is extremely poor.
The staff are very rude.
They are definitely not top-notch.

reviews.author: Libia Escobar
reviews.text: Terrible service. I've been here for 20 days and they still haven't sent me a receipt. No one at the hotel could tell me where my room was; I was given the wrong directions three times. Check-in and check-out were incredibly slow. The restaurants were extremely slow and the food was nothing special. I absolutely do not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Micly V
reviews.text: I was there from September 9th to October 3rd and it wasn't my best experience. This is my fourth time in Cancun, and this resort has nothing to offer. There are no activities; it's only for those who want to eat. The restaurants have average service, but they aren't friendly. Everything shuts down at 11 pm; after that time, there's literally nothing to do. The music is terrible; it's definitely the worst. The DJs keep updating. To top it all off, there's nowhere to charge your phone. They need to update the lights in the room. ☹️☹️☹️

reviews.author: Osiris Bustamante
reviews.text: Terrible service at reception, they gave me the room 2 hours later, they never explained to me what the package included, what I was entitled to or not, they never gave me the registration form with the Internet password, if you are on the beach no waiter ever helps you, very old facilities and terrible service at reception since first they charge me, they say at 3 and deliver it at 5 and they don't even answer well, I requested an invoice that has to be requested by email because they don't do it, I sent the email and they didn't even have the attention to answer anything

reviews.author: Mabel
reviews.text: I found this hotel to be a rip-off because it's not all-inclusive. To use a lounge chair, I have to pay an average of $173 per day. The number of guests far exceeds the number of lounge chairs. Alcoholic beverages are not included in the room, and the food is not varied at all. It's very expensive for what it offers.

reviews.author: Paula Bastos
reviews.text: I'm surprised to see such good reviews because, for us, this hotel only deserves one star. I booked an all-inclusive package (The Reserve). When I arrived, we didn't have a room (with our reservation... "The Reserve"). We weren't given a tour or any explanations... I spent the day feeling homeless, without a room Monday morning (from around 9 am until around 5 pm). After that, they gave me a room in the basement where I paid for a sea view, but I got a garden view... well... not good at all. On the other hand, the hotel staff are all very friendly (restaurant, bar, pool), they are impeccable. A big thank you to Victor, our concierge, and to Frida (because we didn't get an apology or explanation from their managers). Well, I can't tell you everything. However, it's a hotel that isn't worth staying in (in my opinion), and I've traveled a lot. Writing more would be a novel, so I'll finish. I forgot to mention the food, which was very good and deserves 5 stars. (I did have a cockroach outside my room door, an armchair you couldn't sit in, and the hotel should be cleaned more often (it wasn't very clean)... and... I can't write everything. The espresso (24-hour coffee) was incredibly good, but the cakes and other breads... there are always little mosquitoes (I don't know the name)... you don't feel like eating at all.

reviews.author: Karen Ruiz
reviews.text: We had a terrible experience. The hotel is extremely neglected, the air conditioning is terrible, the communal bathrooms are disgusting, and the staff is completely untrained and incredibly rude, acting like they're doing us a favor. There are leaks in the hallways, the facilities are poorly maintained, and the hotel is ancient! We went to Paradisus in Playa del Carmen, and it's nothing like this. This hotel shouldn't be a Diamond hotel; it's awful, better suited as a 3-star hotel.

reviews.author: Francisco Ledesma
reviews.text: If you want a nice experience, this isn't the place. Compared to RIU, BARCELO, and LIVE AQUA, it's miles behind in terms of the quality of service it offers as a hotel. The employees are miserable (and this is a consequence of their working conditions).

reviews.author: Alexander R
reviews.text:
Old and poorly maintained hotel.
Rooms are old and smell of mildew.
It was recommended by the travel agency but it's very bad.
The worst thing is the rude staff.
We still have four more days here, it's awful!!!

reviews.author: Michel Rabadán
reviews.text:
If you're planning a convention, avoid this place. The service and attention are terrible, especially from the Events and Conventions Manager, Mauricio Baez. It seems his job is to promise and commit to spaces you can't use for setup later—even with scouting, emails, confirmations, and so on.

If you don't book with their in-house agency, prepare for a disastrous experience.
Mauricio Baez, you're unprofessional and lack manners. However, if your job is to promote their in-house agency and block external ones, then congratulations, you're doing a great job.

reviews.author: Alex HUANG
reviews.text: This time it wasn't very pleasant...😕, because at a five-star hotel (supposedly), some employees are using their cleaning time to steal guests' belongings... We spoke to the cashier, and she told us to wait 72 hours for an answer, but after 72 hours, she still hasn't given any explanation to the guest whose belongings were lost in their hotel room. How outrageous! 😡

reviews.author: Ramón Almendro Hodgson
reviews.text: Instead of fostering a relaxing and enjoyable experience, they focus on aggressively selling their timeshare apartments. Through deception, they made us lose almost an entire day of our five-day stay. A terrible experience.

reviews.author: Merlin Diaz
reviews.text: Terrible customer service; very few staff members provide decent service. I was completely disappointed. Everything depends on how much you tip, and the entertainment is awful in the evenings. Beware, don't buy the VIP package; it's a complete lie. The buffet menu is tiny, with lots of tables but no variety of food.

reviews.author: Patricia Duarte
reviews.text: I'm here now, I'm a Circle Melia member and it's been awful! The rooms are destroyed, the air conditioning sounds like a jet engine, we couldn't get a spot by the pool, the all-inclusive doesn't have everything they advertise, you have to pay for everything here, the service is terrible, the worst trip I've ever had in my life.

reviews.author: Lia Abrego
reviews.text: Because they called me at 9 am to sell me other things, because the hotel smells like a bathroom, and because I asked them to cut my pizza into 8 slices instead of 4 at the pool and they acted like I was asking for something impossible—a killer look 😳—and the food... 2.5... nothing special...that's why.

reviews.author: Jorge Javier Salgueiro Prieto
reviews.text: Very bad experience. They changed our hotel from Paradisus by Melia Cancun to Paradisus Playa del Carmen. They didn't refund my money, not even a portion of it. They told me the hotel wasn't open due to a recent storm. The hotel they transferred me to is nothing like the one in Cancun. The service was terrible. All the common areas were in poor condition, the restaurants had many restrictions, and the hotel's location was awful. In short, a very bad experience.

reviews.author: Hernan Lopez
reviews.text: The food was terrible. I've been to several Meliá hotels, and this one is nothing like what this hotel chain is known for. The evening shows were awful. The night waiters were always in a bad mood.

reviews.author: dayro naranjo
reviews.text: It seems things aren't the same as they used to be. My family and I came here to relax since my wife was having surgery. The room service is terrible—it takes three and a half hours for a single dish. The buffet is awful if you don't leave a tip. The waiters don't attend to you, and the security guards treat you like you're nothing. For me, right now, it has the worst service in the entire area. I've been visiting Cancun for two months, and this is the most expensive hotel I've paid for, and it has the worst service. The butler they assigned me hasn't even made contact with us, and we've already been here for four nights. I'm sorry, but I really hope they can improve the treatment and service a bit.

reviews.author: Angeles Ramírez
reviews.text: Terrible customer service. I only called to ask about a Day Pass, and Christofer at reception answered only to put me on hold for half an hour. I called back, and they hung up on me. I called again, and they muted the call and hung up again. If you're busy, at least be kind enough to ask me to call back later. If this is the service at reception, I don't even want to imagine what the rest of the staff is like!

reviews.author: Diego Parra
reviews.text:
Honestly, I was completely disappointed with the hotel; it was nothing like Paradisus La Perla in the Riviera Maya...
When we arrived, we found the balcony full of sand (we were on the 3rd floor).
The room cleaning was poor... when we arrived, there was a bad smell... the staff wasn't helpful.
When we tried to make restaurant reservations, no matter what time we tried, there was never any space available. And when we were supposed to eat at Naos (the only place available, supposedly), we went past all the other restaurants and there were empty tables.

reviews.author: Eduard Escobar
reviews.text: Very bad service, very hot, the rooms don't cool down, they didn't give me the room I requested even though I had already checked in. I requested an Ocean View Royal Service room and they gave me a different one. The waiters had a very bad attitude. The best thing about it was Norma, my butler, very nice. Aron from the Royal Service area at the pool was also very nice. I will never return to this old hotel. And Lola was there because of IUI Rome when it should have been the other way around.

reviews.author: Reyes Ahijado
reviews.text: It's incredibly expensive. They come up with a scam to get more Mexicans to travel. They lure you in by offering to go to the dolphins and another activity called "Garrafon." They give you a good price, but then they make you go to the Xcaret Hotel. There, they give you free breakfast, show you the facilities, and then offer you memberships for 3 million, 2 million, and 1 million pesos. They really want you to buy them and tell you that if you don't, it's no big deal, but if you don't, they get upset. They claim it's only 90 minutes, but they end up taking up more than half a day. They really badmouth other hotels. Their marketing didn't work on me. I recommend Noir. They offer all this from Terminal 2 of the airport.

reviews.author: Christophe Boudrey
reviews.text: Five stars on the facade, but after the food, staff, attention to customers, rooms (outdated, electrical outlets in room 2), etc... Zero. They're always trying to sell you services (photography, jet skiing). For this price, you're better off going to Club Med Cancun and having a truly enjoyable time.

reviews.author: Roman Rodriguez Nieto
reviews.text: A nice place, but most of the staff were rather unfriendly. There was an incident in the room; hotel staff stole money and refused to take responsibility, so I recommend that if you go there, keep your belongings very safe.

With what this hotel charges, you can find better options or spend 2 or 3 thousand more per night and get a Hard Rock Hotel, which is a sure thing.

reviews.author: Jiaying Yu
reviews.text: I was very excited for my trip to Cancun, this hotel experience ruined my impression. The food is terrible at this hotel. You have to go in person to make reservations at a certain time rather than booking online (they don't offer online booking). So by the time I go make my reservation for the restaurants, it was all full. The only time available was 9pm or after, which is stupid. I went to Royal Solaris Cancun before and they made life easier to make reservation at the website. They had good food and drinks, customer service was great too! This hotel do not have a good customer service, they are not friendly either welcoming. Me and my mom waited so long for our food to arrive to our table, no waiter came to check on us while we're waiting. We were mad because we been eating at the buffet for 3 days straight but couldn't do nothing because all reservations were full. The other hotel I been to before had much better experience than this one, every staff there were very welcoming and happy. This hotel also don't have much activities like the other hotel do, which is making it boring. By 9pm everyone is gone and back to their rooms. Do not recommend and will not return.

reviews.author: Noélly Mercer
reviews.text:
Hello,
I experienced a serious issue during my check-in related to room access, but fortunately, everything was resolved promptly and with great care.

I would like to highlight the outstanding service provided by Francisco. He was extremely professional, kind, and attentive throughout the entire situation. His empathy and commitment to resolving the issue, always emphasizing the team spirit of Paradisus, made all the difference.

Thank you, Paradisus, for turning around my initial impression and making my stay truly enjoyable.

I definitely plan to return to Cancún, and it would be a pleasure to stay at Paradisus again.

The restaurants are excellent, and the service at the pool, breakfast, and all dining venues was impeccable. The food quality was truly exceptional in every detail.

Thank you once again!

reviews.author: Kate Babusciac
reviews.text:
First of all, I want to mention that I’m not a picky vacationer. For me and my 3-year-old daughter, the most important things were the ability to relax on the beach and to have timely access to quality food. Unfortunately, our experience at this resort was extremely disappointing and stressful.

1. Beach Access:
Despite being at an all-inclusive resort, I was told I needed to pay $250 for a cabana because all the beach lounges were “reserved” — even though many were unoccupied. A staff member told me guests start claiming lounges as early as 4 a.m. I was not willing to wake up my toddler that early to compete for a place to relax. That same staff member then offered to reserve a spot for me — for cash — which felt inappropriate and unprofessional.

2. Dining Issues:
The buffet experience was chaotic and unsanitary. The food selection was poor, and the conditions were far from clean. We waited 40 minutes in line just to be seated — again, not ideal when trying to keep a young child fed on a schedule.

3. Dinner Reservations:
To have dinner at one of the restaurants, you had to reserve a table — which is a normal policy for all-inclusive resorts. However, I stood in line for one full hour trying to make a reservation, only to be told everything was fully booked for that evening. The only option offered was to pay out-of-pocket at a non-inclusive restaurant. Out of desperation, I went to the steakhouse to avoid another long buffet line and ended up spending $300.

4. Poor Customer Service & Disrespect:
The next day, I went to the front desk to express my concerns and to inform them that I would be leaving the resort. I was shocked at their response. They openly told me they didn’t care because the resort would be closing in a month for remodeling and rebranding. The staff was extremely rude — in front of my child — and made no effort to help or even apologize. Another family standing behind me also tried to cancel their stay and witnessed the entire exchange, including the disrespect and humiliation I experienced.

In the end, I had to book another hotel and leave, losing two days of my vacation — not to mention the emotional distress and migraine caused by this experience. I’ve never encountered such terrible treatment, especially as a single mother traveling with a child in a foreign country. I felt completely unprotected and unsupported.

reviews.author: kwangmi kim
reviews.text:
This hotel was the worst experience ever.

When checking in, they couldn’t find my reservation, and it took two hours to sort it out. Then, when I finally got to my room, it was infested with cockroaches. Within just a few minutes, I caught nine cockroaches, and there were even more that I couldn’t catch.

I went to the lobby to request a room change, but at first, the staff refused. They only agreed after realizing that other guests were watching. I originally paid extra for an ocean view room, but the new room they gave me had nothing but a rooftop view.

It’s unbelievable that a hotel in this day and age would have such a severe cockroach problem. The way the staff handled the situation was also extremely frustrating. On top of that, every single dish at the hotel restaurant was terrible.

I will never stay at this hotel again.

reviews.author: Марта Грицевич
