At breakfast the lady doing the omelette told me I had to wait an additional wait even though I had already waited 25 minutes in line of the omelette line because she couldn't make 2 fried eggs with 2 egg whites.on the other hand Ariel the activity director was stupendous.Carlos and Roberto bartender fabulous. reviews.author: Rey Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Really shocked by all of the reviews of good food. As seasoned travelers,  we didn’t know what half of the dishes even were. The quality was far from a 5 star ! If you want good food please go elsewhere because this is just not it. We stayed at the Gran Fiesta Americana last year in the hotel zone, & the food there was impeccable. The restaurants here & the buffet are filled with bread/desserts and LACK real quality food.

The hotel doesn’t take concerns/complaints seriously. We had an issue with our transportation & they were not accommodating or remorseful. We’ve been to Cancun many times and have experienced real 5 star service at other resorts in the hotel zone. The people were sweet & the hotel grounds were decent but that’s all they have going for them. Everything is an up charge, the rooms are small and the AC did not work. You’ll be much happier staying elsewhere.

reviews.author: Nathan Guenther
reviews.text:
We had high hopes for Paradisus Cancun as we were celebrating our honeymoon, but this turned out to be the worst resort we’ve ever been to. For $4,000 per person for 10 days, we expected a true luxury experience, but this resort fell far short.

Even with the “all-inclusive” package, there are hidden costs everywhere. Want a beach or poolside bed? Be prepared to pay $255 USD, which is outrageous. Breakfast after 9 am? You’ll be waiting in a 30-minute line for a table. If you want to book a reservation for a restaurant other than the buffet, have fun waiting 45 minutes just to do so.

The staff generally seemed bothered when we asked them to do their job. Our coffee maker was broken, and even after requesting a replacement, it never showed up. The mini fridge in our room was hot because it wasn’t even plugged in, and we had to call multiple times to get it restocked.

If you’re not a morning person, good luck getting a chair by the pool. You’ll end up laying on the cement. As someone with a bad back, this left me in pain all day with no way to enjoy myself. There’s absolutely no entertainment at this resort. The shows start at 8 pm but only last 45 minutes to an hour, and there is minimal seating available. If you don’t get there by 7 pm, you’ll have to stand for the whole show. After that, there’s nothing to do. The bars all close at 11 pm, so if you’re looking for a good time, this isn’t the place. This resort feels more suited for older people who don’t mind the lack of activities.

To top it off, we asked for a nice bottle of champagne to celebrate our honeymoon, but they brought us a cheap $9 bottle—hardly what you’d expect for a “luxury” resort.

This place doesn’t come close to offering the care or quality you’ll find at a RIU resort. In all my years of traveling, I’ve never wanted to go home so badly. I wouldn’t recommend Paradisus Cancun to my worst enemy. Save your money and avoid this place at all costs.

reviews.author: Laiba Motiwala
reviews.text: First time staying here and while there are lovely amenities and great employees at the restaurants and coffee bars, the guest services and front desk are quite unhelpful. We had an issue in our two rooms with AC and they did not help until 2 days into our stay. Then, we had a situation with a lizard in one of our rooms. Not only did they take forever coming up to help us and not only did we have to call them twice and then finally go in person to get them to have someone take care of it, they showed no care. Further, when we called for a room change after the lizard was nowhere to be seen, they did not respond for quite a long time. The guest service here has been unprofessionally late to the point of inconveniencing us greatly. Won’t be booking my next stay here.

reviews.author: Jaclyn Terakita
reviews.text:
I’ll start by saying most of the staff were amazing and the aesthetics of the lobby were impressive. I will also say I have reached out to the hotel (Melia) about my concerns/complaints and they were not apologetic or sympathetic with their response, which is partly the reason for my 1/5 rating.

1. Outdated rooms, broken phones, door handles and multiple missed replenishments of the bottled water and mini fridge items. We had to ask 3 separate days for refills and they blamed us for having the “do not disturb” sign on our door.. which we didn’t because we didn’t even have a sign to put out.

2. Dining options- minimal for such a large resort and you cannot make reservations. Very inconvenient for larger groups and families with kids. Buffet was good. Nespresso bar was open throughout the day/night which was nice.

3. Trip hazards and noise disruptions - if you must go here do not book early December, they host Ember Shores music festival so the whole week they were setting up massive stages, with scaffolding being put up until 2am. Trip hazards everywhere from all the audio equipment, took away pool loungers and restricted areas which was very frustrating as we paid for a relaxing vacation.

The staff (minus the front desk staff) was one of the only good things about this resort.  Overall, the outdated rooms, lack of dining options and experience with check in made the trip frustrating and I would not recommend this resort to others.

reviews.author: Eldridge DuFauchard
reviews.text:
This hotel is awesome! The service is outstanding, the food is delicious, the beach is really nice, and the employees were very friendly except for one. Below is the reason for one star:
We were at the hotel for a 8 day stay. We had issues checking in and it took about 3-4 hours to check in because they stated they didn't receive our payment. Finally they found it, and let us check in.
On check out, again the guy at the front desk who wasn't friendly whatsoever and had a bad attitude, again told us our payment hadn't been received and we cannot leave the hotel!! Like they were gonna hold us hostage and our flight left in 3 hours. We went back and forth with this non-empathetic employee for over an hour,  and he insisted we cannot leave the hotel until payment is received.
Then finally, just as our transportation to the airport was about to leave us stranded, they found the payment on their system.
What incompetence and bad attitude this front desk guy had.
We were there 8 days and they didn't even bother to let us know then that payment wasn't received nor did they do a thorough search for our payment while we were still checked in? And to threaten us at checkout that they weren't going to let us leave? This basically ruined the 8 days with this incompetence and left a really bad taste in our mouths about this experience.
Managers, do your job with competence and when one of your employees threaten a guest, it would be nice for you to step forward and take over. No manager came forth after we requested for one a few times. Therefore, one star for you, but 5 starts for your staff except the front desk!

reviews.text:

First we need to start with the good. The people working here are amazing! The hotel it’s self is beautiful on the inside and from the oceanfront. Housekeeping was great,check in/out good. When calling to get mini fridge restock, great service. Property is beautiful.

While there was so much great, there were some things that made us disappointed. We tried calling the give number for restaurant reservations over 10 times 3 days in a row. reviews.author: Ari Cohen
reviews.text:
Arrived today - after a long day of travel with 2 young children we had the luxury of waiting another hour to check in - then were given the wrong room with the wrong set up. When we requested the correct room we were told no and instead they would just refund the stay and we could go someplace else entirely rather than attempt to give us the right room or accommodate us. That same incorrect room is now leaking in multiple spots, front desk is not helpful at all aside from sending someone with more towels to mop up the leaking water ourselves. Another group in our party were given a dirty room when they arrived. Would give 0 stars if possible, not worth a fraction of the price they charge. A motel 6 is cleaner.

Update - management sent a reply that they would be reaching out, we received a note under our door to come to guest services, we were optimistic. When we went to guest services they said they would have to talk to their supervisor to see what could be done and they would be in contact with us as soon as they heard back - we waited over 24 hours and never heard back... We went to guest services again and had to go through the whole thing again, then were finally offered just a 30 minute jacuzzi time as compensation for all of this, useless. I had hoped to upgrade this review but at this point would probably downgrade it further if anything.

reviews.author: Fiza Ali
reviews.text: Paradisus resort has provided us with an incredibly disappointing experience. Upon arrival, I immediately wanted to leave. Despite booking a reserved adults-only room with Priceline, which included access to various restaurants, the receptionist informed us that only the basic all-inclusive package was available. The room was subpar, and the service was atrocious. We were unable to take advantage of the promised deals to explore the hotel fully. Furthermore, we were charged for an upgrade to an adults-only room that we never received. Despite spending hours speaking with the receptionist and their team, no resolution was reached. They were uncooperative, refusing to let me speak with the manager or provide any assistance. There was no refund offered for the upgrade fee. After spending eight hours on the phone with Priceline, the issue remains unresolved, with no guarantee of a refund. We feel trapped in this hotel with our issues unresolved, which is incredibly frustrating and has ruined our vacation experience. The staff's rudeness and lack of concern for customer comfort only exacerbated the situation. I suspect they are intentionally misleading us, even claiming that we booked through Expedia despite our reservations being made through Priceline. They continue to deny this, even after Priceline confirmed our booking. I strongly advise against staying at this resort if you desire decent service.

reviews.author: Feras
reviews.text:
I don’t understand the high reviews for this place. I went based on that and was highly disappointed. The grounds and location are nice but it kinda stops there. The food is below average. I really believe it is prepared offsite and just reheated on location and recycled into other dishes. Thats how it tastes atleast.  Stale and not fresh. 75% of the staff were nice but the other 25% will ruin it. I had a hostess close the door in my face as I was walking into the buffet restaurant and said “ We close at 4”. Which is true but it wasn’t 4 yet and it’s a little rude to look directly at someone as they are walking in and do that. Would have been more appropriate to let me in and close the door BEHIND me. Plus there were tons of people inside still eating.

I wouldn’t define this as a luxury resort at all. It feels more like a budget cruise, just not sailing.

I hope management sees this, they need major training and refinement. I’d ask for my money back if I could.

Go elsewhere but good luck

reviews.author: Ori
reviews.text:
If u want to torture your self with the worst service, horrible noisy rooms, taste less food and in general a nightmare vacation- book yr vacation here!!!!
Where should I start?
We arrived. Late, at 9 pm,after a long international flight. we were told by rephael we can't eat at the restaurants Bcs we didn't make a reservation!!
Then we're asked for extra fees although we paid upfront and made sure it includes all fees. We asked for a manager, Angie, who was not any help at all.

reviews.author: Nilay Yuce
reviews.text:
Where do I begin? We booked with high hopes and an even higher bill, expecting 5-star luxury. Instead, we got a moldy, chaotic mess that might’ve been funny if we weren’t paying for it.

The Room: A Moldy Disco Party
We paid extra for an "ocean view exclusive room," but what we got was loud music from the activity site below every morning and blaring in-house entertainment every night. The “ocean view” was barely visible behind palm trees, and the room smelled like mold. I half-expected mushrooms to start growing in the corner.

The Food: A Culinary Disaster
1. Reservations – Chaos with a Side of Queue: Want a restaurant reservation? Prepare to stand in line for hours—no online booking, just a sweaty, frustrating mess. We tried five restaurants, and each one was worse than the last. We eventually gave up and settled for the chaotic walk-in buffet.

2. Dietary Restrictions – A Danger Zone: Allergies, religious restrictions, or dietary preferences? Forget it.

Tacos cooked with beef, chicken, and pork on the same grill, zero separation. Cross-contamination was standard.
No clear ingredient labels, making meals a gamble. If you’re vegan, pescatarian, or have a nut allergy, good luck.
I ordered Chilean Basa with risotto and got mystery fish with wheat pretending to be risotto.
3. Quality – When Basic Goes Bad: Pizza? Naan bread with rubbery cheese. Burgers? Cardboard. Chicken wings? Swimming in syrupy sauce. Even my pizza-loving kid couldn’t eat it—twice! Tacos, in Mexico, were a disaster, and even the salad bar felt depressing.

4. Walk-In Buffet – The Hunger Games: The single buffet for 5,000+ guests meant a 20-minute wait for a table, crowded chaos, and food labels hidden behind dishes. Guessing what you were eating was part of the experience—and whether it would kill you was the real gamble.

Entertainment: A Masterclass in Boredom
We expected endless family activities but got poorly planned, single-option events that started late (if at all). Rainy days were especially bleak, with no indoor options for adults. We sat in our damp room wondering why we came.

Night shows? Imagine cramming 5,000 guests into a 30-seat area for a 1-hour snoozefest. If you didn’t stand in the crowd, your only option was sitting outside in the dark, waiting for the noise to end.

Pool & Beach: A Game of Musical Chairs
Unless you woke up at 7 AM, pool chairs were impossible to find. The pool was dirty—my son refused to swim after spotting floating debris. Thankfully, the public beach nearby was pristine, peaceful, and free.

Staff: Trying but Overwhelmed
The staff was kind but clearly understaffed and drowning in requests. They couldn’t keep up with the chaos.

Final Thoughts:
This place doesn’t deserve 5 stars or its insane prices. It’s a logistical nightmare with bad food, poor entertainment, and zero consideration for dietary needs. If you love long lines, loud music, and disappointing food, you’ll love it here. For everyone else: save your money, sanity, and stomach. Never again.

reviews.author: Robyn Tsacoumangos
reviews.text:
This review is for spring break 2024.
I would not book again for spring break with a family. Our kids are fourth grade, six grade and eighth grade & we traveled with some family friends.

I imagine this resort would be wonderful if it were not so crowded at spring break.

The staff were there extremely hard working & most were very kind. They were extremely understaffed, and the hotel was very overbooked - shame on Melia for not staffing this hotel with more employees for busy weeks like spring breaks - the staff were almost panicked with so many people & not enough support. They were definitely overworked & I imagine underpaid for dealing with such hectic long-days.

Never enough shade or lounge chairs, Not many poolside or beach activities for families or kids (beach volleyball happened on one day for only 2 hours… And no Staff was there So some rude people just stayed & would not let others rotate in); the evening shows were hard to find logistically (it would have been so much easier if they just had a amphitheater outside where everyone knew how to get to it & What time it was).  Evening Entertainment was scattered throughout the resort (inside & out; and there are underground conference centers to navigate to find it) hard to find, hard to book, and Our kids were not into it. Last year at the hard rock playa del Carmen they loved all the shows; and they started on time and were easy to find, we would go directly after dinner to the outdoor amphitheater & then call it a night - it was just way easier & a lot more fun.

There were no dinner reservations, which I thought would be great; but ended up in a panic of trying to get into Line by 7:30 PM or else you could not get seated until way later.

There were too many hitches to make it relaxing; and Originally we had a room in the farthest tower, on the sixth floor, it was super far and a very old room. They moved us to a much nicer room (available on our 3rd day), closer to the main building & That was much better, but Moving was a hassle, and it took me 5 trips back-and-forth to the front desk (with their loooong lines) the day of the move to get all of our luggage into our rooms & wristband keys Working for both rooms for my family of 5.

For spring break if you are a family with elementary or Middle school kids/teens - I would suggest taking your $10,000 somewhere else.

reviews.author: Mike Erikson
reviews.text:
NOT an ALL Inclusive - but a SOME Inclusive.  Upgrades anyone?  Lots of Lies, dirty facility, and my personal data was stolen from them!!!
As an international businessman I've traveled millions of miles and stayed at literally hundreds of hotels and this was my worst experience.  We were sold on upgrades and given documented promises (see screenshots) about what we would received and none of it came to fruition other than allowing us to eat at their "steak house" Sal which was terrible.  The included steak was a tiny (maybe 6 oz) sirloin (likely other meat - see pic) that was so chewy.  But when we arrived they rolled out a cart with a tomahawk, ribeye, fillet, waygu, and other lovely cuts.  NONE were included and cost up to $80 each!  Melia sold us on the NITKA which we upgraded to.  My nephew had an even nicer room and didn't pay for the upgrade, we didn't get a private check in, the Mayan blessing or the cruise.  Instead they offered to have a shanty van pick us up and take us to the cenote - NOT the same.  LOTS of bait and switch.  To my many followers - you'll see that most of my reviews are positive, obviously this one is not.

Plus THE BARS CLOSE EARLY!  I believe the pool bar closed at 4pm and all the rest at 9:pm.  This is the earliest of all the resorts I've stayed at.  I had tried to write this review last year but had too much to document and didn't get around to it.  It wasn't until this week when I was contacted by a solicitor that had ALL my travel details (flight, dates, room, quantity of people I traveled with, phone #, email, and more).  I asked Melia if they were with the company and it ends up they weren't.  Meaning MELIA had a data breach of my personal information!  The pool had debris in it, the glass railing had not been cleaned in months (covered in bird poo - see pictures), there was mold in the shower, my slider door would not close (in the NITKA upgrade room see pictures) and the breeze blowing across it was 81db (the volume of a coffee grinder - try sleeping with that) - you can see the daylight in the picture of my room, the light was broken and blinked at night, the safe was broken and beeped all night (they didn't have parts to fix it - see video) they wouldn't put us in another room (even though they had promised us a reserve room (see screenshot), the AC was broken and we spent over 3 hours on 3 separate occasions to wait for maintenance (see video),   There are MUCH better hotels that deliver on their promises and do not bait and switch and do not lose your personal data.  STAY ELSEWHERE!  As you can see I had it in writing - they still didn't honor it.  The only positive thing was it was a lovely location.  You can get this at another resort.  See the other recent ratings and choose wisely.  We had over 20 people the first week of May 2024 and had a wedding here and still got this treatment.

Scroll through the reviews and you will find many others.  IF you choose to ignore these - at least RECORD EVERY conversation you have as they will verbally promise even more and not stand behind that even.  Not that it matters because they will just apologize and act like they cannot do anything.  VERY corrupt hotel, and staff.  I worked at a resort in my teens and 20's and can honestly say they violate almost every good customer service standard.

reviews.author: alfredo nagel
reviews.text: First time in this hotel and I was expecting much more, I'm staying until Saturday and the experience has been very bad, the infrastructure of the hotel is very old for a 5 star hotel, the rooms smell very humid and like someone puked, and when it rains it has water leaks all over the hotel and in the room. Furthermore, the food and the service is not of a 5 star hotel, I asked for a room change and they haven't come to me in 2 days. Please consider other alternatives before this hotel when you come to Cancun.

reviews.author: Josh Kirn
reviews.text:
We picked this hotel due to several reviews stating that the food was great, compared to other all-inclusive hotels where reviews were less favorable regarding the food. I don't know what the other reviewers eat on a daily basis, but the food here was vile, and absolutely ruined the whole experience for us. It made both my wife and I sick. The best food we ate while here was from McDonalds and the convenience store across the boulevard (and it's not close). One of our friends who was with us said that the sushi at the Japanese restaurant wasn't bad (the rest of us aren't fans of sushi so I can't say). I wouldn't do all-inclusive again and certainly wouldn't come here.

Beyond that, the beds and pillows were great. The buildings were cool, and the pool areas were pretty nice. The beach was covered in seaweed, but that seems to be true across all of Cancun. The service was generally good, although the "Reserve" upgrade was virtually worthless - we paid for it due to the promise of guaranteed reservations, and we could hardly get any reservations at any of the cabanas or restaurants even with the extra payment. Skip it.

Not the worst place to stay, if you're skipping the Reserve and eating off-site. I'd suggest just staying elsewhere and not doing all-inclusive.

reviews.author: Nadine A
reviews.text: Very disappointing considering it’s supposedly a luxury resort. Everywhere in the hotel including the rooms were hot. No fans to at least compensate so you’re just sweating constantly. We stayed in the luxury junior suite ocean view and you can see the room was renovated cheaply. The door had cracks all along it. The main place you can find information regarding the hotel and make dinner reservations is in the app but the app wasn’t working the entire 5 days we were at the resort. I had to speak to 3 people at the reception and guest services and spent a few hours trying to get help and no one could resolve. Outside of the app, reservations can only be made from 9-5 pm so I had to wait until the next day to make reservations, which by then there was limited to no availability and we had to eat at the same restaurant twice. The hotel workers are nice and try to be helpful but there seems to be a lot of disorder and misinformation/miscommunication, which limits their helpfulness and becomes very time consuming in resolving anything. The food was okay overall. All of the bakery items were super stale. We were reserve guests so we would have lunch at the palapa, which was good. The Malva buffet was good for breakfast but not good for dinner. Blue agave was good. All other restaurants were hit or miss depending on what you ordered. Overall, this resort is not worth the steep price.

reviews.author: Kathy LaRue
reviews.text: My only bad review: 9/2024 Paradisus trip 2nd after excellent 2018 stay. I highly recommended our group’s Paradisus stay due to 2018 experience but was very embarrassed with 2024 experience because it suffered greatly by comparison. We stayed in 3rd pyramid. Loud 1st floor bar music nightly until 11 pm entertained less than 20-30 occupants but music permeated through pyramid disturbing all that wanted romantic evening or to get offspring to sleep. VERY BAD Paradisus planning. We told Expedia check in staff we didn’t want to be disturbed by noise everyone complained about in Expedia reviews & were assured that our rooms wouldn’t be impacted which was a complete Expedia check in staff FALSEHOOD & MISREPRESENTATION. We endured EVERY night with great displeasure–it was too inconvenient to pack up & move all parties to different rooms. We were isolated in resort 1 day due to rain & watched it pour from ceilings all day. Unenthusiastic staff squeegeed slowly all water that fell & was sometimes 2” deep onto travertine tile–a hazard to all. Mold comes with water & great health hazard to all. Malva buffet food was cold & often unidentifiable concoctions so we would eat elsewhere. All resort restaurants serve breads & pastries that are delivered & frozen until served only to taste like cardboard. Most food would be uneaten due to lack of quality–horrible waste of resources. Waitstaff accommodating for tips but food, rainwater and noise at Paradisus VERY disappointing.

reviews.author: Imad Ikhbeis
reviews.text:
Rating: 1/5

I'm currently staying at this hotel and unfortunately, my experience has been subpar. As a group of four families, we requested to be in the same building during check-in, but were repeatedly refused until I offered to pay extra. To my surprise, they gave me the same room as another couple in our group, but charged me extra per night for the "privilege" of being in the same building.

To make matters worse, when we went to the Java restaurant, we asked to sit together and were again denied. I was so frustrated that I left without eating.

The lack of customer service and flexibility has been disappointing. With four more days left in my stay, I'm not looking forward to seeing how the rest of my experience unfolds. Would not recommend this hotel to others.

reviews.author: Sonya Chopra
reviews.text:
The property is gorgeous but we had some serious problems that are important to note when booking a vacation abroad. We chose to book reserve for an enhanced experience but it was a total waste. Our concierge told us he was quitting soon so had little interest in his job. He never checked on us or provided any added benefit. Also, everything worth having is extra charge regardless of reserve status.

On the way to dinner one night there was a puddle on the floor and i slipped and hit my head very hard on the concrete floor. I also pretty badly injured my knee. It's almost comical that they don't have a single ice pack on the property. We requested a doctor that told me there was nothing they could do and that i should go to the hospital if i felt i needed to.

Many reviews talk about the service at the resort being exceptional which couldn't be further from the truth. Don't get me wrong, there were a few who were great (shoutout to Javier and Mario) but for the most part the supervisors are rude and useless. They didn't even do so much as to check on me after my fall the next morning. In fact, I'm still waiting for an ice pack to be brought to my room for over 2 hours. All in all, i wouldn't recommend coming here if you value your health.

reviews.author: Avani Javer
reviews.text:
If you are looking for the worst all inclusive of your life, I would stay here. This was such a bad hotel that I was excited my vacation was finally over. From the very beginning at check in where it took them an hour to give me my room key to just constant attitude and every request followed by a no, it was a horrible experience.
1. Any time you try to go to a restaurant they say its full but you can see it is half empty.
2. The buffet was very small options and became very redundant which you were forced to eat as all the restaurants were "full".
3. They provide water bottles but if you call for anything like toilet paper or water bottles, it would take any where from 1 to 2 hours to get and or never come. One day I called 4 times to get water bottles and we had 3 people in our rooms and when I asked for 12 bottles for the day as it was now the 4th time calling, they said no we can only give you 6 as they wheel a whole cart of bottles around the hotel.
4. There is actually a time in this all inclusive that there is no food except room service available which I feel like that is not very inclusive like. From 4-6 pm you will find no food anywhere and if you call for room service it is a 1-2 hour wait.
5. All the staff, okay almost all the staff, were unapproachable. When asked for something like can we get a drink, they would roll their eyes and then our drink would come an hour later. We ordered food at the pool and we got only part of the order and never had the waiter come check on us again and we were there for more than 5 hours.
6. Very limited shady areas unless you want to pay to rent a cabana. The hotel is huge and yet they have such a limited number of chairs or shade.
7. Anything you asked for it was an automatic no. I feel like most all inclusives try to accomodate but this one was all rules. only can get stuff for the mini bar between 10-630. If you call at 7 well you out of luck. It was all so bizarre.
8. There was no cleanliness in the food areas. No hand sanitizer or concern for all the guest using the same utensils to get food.

Will never stay here again and will warn all my family and friends about this place. Waste of money and time. Oh and cherry on top, we all got sick and have had stomach issues with diarrhea starting day 2 from this hotel.

reviews.author: Arturo Fernandez
reviews.text:
I would like to start and share my terrible experiences with hotel. We booked 7 nights at this hotel and its was a very bad experience for my family. What we thought it was going to be a heaven  vacation quickly took a big dive!!!BE AWARE!! Rooms are a scam. !!  Website pictures are not near the same.

1. Upon arrival hotel did not give me my 2 queen beds needed that we had upgraded.
2. Went with manager and after 2 days they changed me to other room that was terrible

As you see in the pictures my room was full of mold with a terrible decaying smell. Paint in the room were peeling off. Water leaks..
Also my room had a burning smell coming from the TV outlet.

3. At this point again went to manager and told me he  was going to change In 2 more days.

4. End result they could only find other same room with one king bed not 2 queens. At that point our family lost hope. Management did not fix our situation and ended up staying in the mold room.

This hotel is not near 4.5 stars I would put at a 1 star. Room are very old. Please DONT STAY HERE!!! 👎✋️
5. Customer service got worse when we refuse to buy membership..

6. Please be aware of rooms they are not near the same!!

7. Thanks for the worse stay of my vacation!!!!
Please refund my nightmare I went through!!

reviews.author: J P
reviews.text:
***False Advertisement! DO NOT BOOK!!! ***The rooms are worse than a Motel 6!  The room was filthy, filthy, filthy!!!!!!!!!!!

#1. The bathroom was filthy, and the toilet seat was peeling and dirty. (i.e., see pictures attached)
#2. The bathtub was rough to the touch due to multiple layers of caulking/painting,
#3. The bathtub drain was dirty (i.e., drain was dark brown. Which looked like buildup of dirt/filth)
#4. The tiles in the shower would move. I feel like there is a lot of water trapped in between, and we could have been exposed to breathing in mold.
#5. The sink rim had mold (i.e., black)
#6. The bathroom floors were dirty. (i.e., there was layer of layer of filth behind the bathroom door)
#7. The mirrors had black spots everywhere.
#8. The swimming pool tiles were cracked and not the cleanest pool
9. I found a dead baby roach on one of the hand towels that was in the bathroom.
10. The outlets were horrible.  I had to position my chargers a certain way in order for my phone to charge .
11. There is not an outlet by the bed to charge your phones.
12. The light switches you had to press really hard to turn on and off, and you can see from the picture that it doesn't look very clean or appealing.
13. I do want to point out the beds are 2 "DOUBLE" beds, NOT  2 "Queen" beds like it is for normal resorts and hotels.  I overlooked that detail on the website when booking. Also the beds are very firm. It's not plush at all
14. You only get three free room service during your stay. Any time after that, if you call for room service, there is a surcharge of $5.00 for each time.
15. Ladies the lighting in bathroom and room is horrible. It's all yellow lighting,dull 80's lighting. It's actually gets you feeling depressed being in the room and bathroom.
You will not be able to put on your make-up properly in that horrible lighting.
16. The food is not savory as you would expect from a 5-Star resort. I found myself needing to add salt or whatever sauces I could find to make the food taste better.
17. The tides were a little too rough. So if you have little kids the shoreline where this hotel is might not be the best for you. I have been to other resorts in Cancun where you're able to go paddle boarding etc. on the resort's shoreline due the the tides not being too strong. And it was free and included in the package at those resorts.
18. The resort charges extra if you want to use the cabanas. It's anywhere from $150-$200 to rent a cabana. So it's not really all-inclusive.

******DO NOT BOOK! ******

You will be getting ripped off.  You will not be getting what you paid for at ALL!!!!

I'm not sure where all these positive reviews are coming from cause it's hard for me to believe the reviews are real based on my experience.

I wish I was able to upload videos.

I am in disbelief that no one from Paradisus Management has addressed my review comment here on Google Review but they are responding to all the other reviews.  Makes me wonder if all the other reviewz are fake or paid for. Just wow! I was offered if I take down any negative reviews then only they will provide one night refund for my horrible experience. MELIA hotel management wouldn't just offer a refund just for the horrible experience my children and my family endured during our stay it came with a negotiation of not being able to post any negative reviews based on our experience and I would have to take down this review. Wow!

reviews.author: M A
reviews.text:
Very bad experience at this resort
1- we got food poisoning and stomach virus on the fourth day, food items was moved between restaurants as we noticed that.
2- we did not get the room that we wanted beside upgrading, it was literally on the top of the restaurant were all cooking smell inside of the room.
3- we finally changed rooms and requested to be decorated as it suppose to be a surprise for my wife birthday, we got to the room and we saw a guy blowing the balloons lol  at this point everything is ruined.
4- I was trying to get water when were on the beach, the glasses was dirty and like wedges was stuck to multiple glasses.
5-beach front is not the best due to seaweed and high tide, also no food service on the beach.
6-we have seen people doing not family friendly things on the pool.
7-customer service in not great comparable to the  price requested.
8-my wife found hair in the food twice in the international buffet.
9-concierge guys tried to sell us packages in the hotel million times.
10- they asked us to install their app to follow up hotel activities but the app does not work lol.
11- they dont have towels available on the beach all the time, they will tell you to come back later.
12-room service provides 2 times for free after that they charge you, never heard of that
13-alcohol quality is very bad.

It has been a week since we got back from Cancun, me my pregnant wife and my son are still sick. This is my 6th time being in Cancun and this trip by far was the worse for me and my family.
I recommend to avoid this property by all means.

reviews.author: DINESH GOPAL
reviews.text: We (my wife, our one year old, and myself) stayed here during the Labor day weekend and have to stay it was absolutely a horrible experience. The rooms are dated, concierge (Stelian Sandu) was absent till the last day of our stay, and some of the staff were just rude. While the food at some restaurants were OK, they refused to accommodate our request to take the food that was on our plate back to our room to feed our little one. We requested multiple times that our baby is distracted at the restaurant and will not eat but this fell in deaf ears. Food was ultimately wasted which would’ve been eaten by our little one. Some of the staff though were great and accommodated our request just because they understood the difficulty and empathized with us. The guy who makes the pasta at the Malva restaurant was particularly great and accommodating! Saving grace is the pool and the beach were great. But otherwise we would not visit this resort again. THIS RESORT IS NOT BABY FRIENDLY AT ALL!

reviews.author: H L.
reviews.text:
What was supposed to be a relaxing and exciting vacation with my family quickly turned into us being extremely disappointed with this resort… When we arrived, Norma was at the front desk. Extremely slow. Not attentive. Not helpful. Anytime my husband would ask her a question is was like she was inconvenienced. Check in took forever and it is extremely hot at the check in area. So we had to stand cthere for 30+ minutes sweating because of the incredibly slow service.

Once we got check in we tried to go to our room and our bracelets that they give you to access your rooms weren’t even activated, so we had to go back to the front desk and get them activated.. Should have been done the first time. Again, inattentive employees.

After we finally got in our room, our concierge came to introduce herself. So far she has done nothing for us. Told us none of the restaurants take reservations… Told us she couldn’t help with booking any excursions. Didn’t give any recommendations. Only heard from her maybe twice? I don’t even remember her name because she literally didn’t do anything for us… What’s the point of paying extra for a concierge that literally leaves you to figure out everything yourself.

The pools are cloudy and dirty. And they aren’t even filled all the way up with water… There is also VERY little pool chairs available. Seating outside is very limited and doesn’t match to the amount of guests here.

98% of the staff is rude and inattentive. They seem extremely bothered if you ask for something or need something or they just flat out ignore you and act like you’re not there. This trip has felt like a complete waste of time and money. It’s so disappointing and has been the worst trip to Mexico we have experienced. Don’t waste your money here. There’s plenty of other resorts that are better then this with staff that is actually attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: sher peerbhai
reviews.text:
My son booked us with paradisus Cancun with all inclusive and several upgrades. We got a nice room in the reserved section. Ambience of the resort is good, pools are nice but the room, house keeping and maintenance really needs a major improvement. Food was OK.

Paying an average of more than $500 a night, we expected better.

As we arrived, we noticed several things that were not working properly 1) coffee machine not working properly 2) soap dispenser in the rest room was not working 3) the shower head holder was loose and would not stay in position when you turn on the shower 4) there was a wet broom in our restroom.

Most of the above were attended to immediately but it took 2 days to get the shower fixed after I had to demonstrate to the technician how the shower head  was supposed to stay still when it is turned on and not spray all over.

House keeping - looks like all they do is make the beds and do general cleaning. For the second day, they did not replenish water bottles, the snacks in the mini bar and did not wash the saucer. I am not sure if I should have coffee in the room, unsure if the cups are washed properly.

I have travelled around but this place has been disappointing, due to its services, not facilities.  Also, last night was warm in the room with the AC on. Complained this morning. Wondering when it will get fixed. I still have another 2 days here. Hope I will not have more issues.

New addition

Last night, I noticed a large cockroach in the toilet, running around. Killed it. Will recommend pest control.

reviews.author: KJ Teemo
reviews.text: I noticed a difference between the discount price listed online and the actual price when I made the reservation, so I emailed them but never received a response. Previously, I had inquired about the Family Concierge via email and received a reply, so I responded to that person again, but I didn't get any response this time either. A month later, I followed up again, but still no reply. It's really difficult to communicate with them via email, and it feels like they're deliberately not responding. Their customer service is the worst.

reviews.author: Shireen S
reviews.text:
Pro:
This hotel has a beautiful entrance and aesthetics.

Cons:
- no kids pool, no slide nothing fun for kids
- food is not good or eatable, esp not 5 ⭐️ worth. It all looks great in photos but taste terrible
- if you order room service plan on never getting it on time, I ordered hot milk for my toddler 3 times in one night and NEVER received it
- if you pay for Nikte don’t expect a butler service. WASTE OF MONEY. Chased guest services 5 times to connect me with my personal butler. Never got the service.
- nespresso bar was not the same, they use plant base sweeteners and does not taste like the nespresso boutique
- soda/ juices/ coffee water down
- rooms are so hot we slept with bedsheets only
- beds are not switched with new bedding daily, they just retuck the old one
- towels take 65+ mins to deliver you will be dry by the time they deliver
- requested room service they say yes but never cleaned our room
-bathrooms anywhere besides your rooms do not have hand soaps. I visited 4 bathrooms in different areas and they were never refilled 🤢 I hope the chefs have them in kitchen
- rude guest service (Chris in specific refused to order warm milk to my room for my baby) all he had to do was call room service.
-cockroach in the lobby

All in all do NOT consider staying  here. The hotel was so bad I considered cutting my trip short and going home. You can have a nice looking hotel but with terrible staff and terrible chefs you will have unhappy guest. From the bottom of my heart please spend your hard earned money elsewhere.

reviews.author: C H
reviews.text:
Worst vacation ever.
I ordered a room with king size bed,ocean view. And did not get that. They told me the next day would give the room I expected and still nothing. Then early in the morning we woke up with screaming from the staff protesting outside. Pay your workers right and this would never be an issue. Most of the restaurants are closed and our choices from ALL Inclusive is very limited. The staff is very polite, but this whole resort needs to do better. I am beyond disappointed.

reviews.author: Lewis Chen
reviews.text: It is very rare for me to write a negative review but this trip to Paradisus Cancun was exceptionally terrible, such as their inability to display empathy and their inability to be accommodating. We were presented with circumstances out of our control when some friends had cancelled their trip last minute. We had paid in advance for the trip and can understand that changes are not necessarily possible so last minute such as credits or refunds; however, given these situations, we asked if we could be upgraded since we had paid the trip in full and the management said, there were no rooms available and there was no flexibility at all. We immediately checked the website and there were plenty of upgraded rooms available. In addition, we asked if it would be possible to get some other amenities included to make up for the value of our trip and that, too, was denied without any regard. This just shows the level of "hospitality" that they provide to their patrons, not just experience but throughout our whole stay there, so I can affirm that this is not a one-off situation. Their level of coordination and expertise is sub-par - I will never recommend anyone to stay here. Do yourself a favor and find another place.

reviews.author: Twinkle Mehta
reviews.text:
We arrived on 22nd late at night as our flight was delayed and the front desk guy was super rude . We had paid for a lagoon view and he gave us some room at the back of the hotel and was pathetic. We had to go back with tired kids and then he gave us the lagoon view.. but bathrooms had leakage . We were so frustrated and ultimately upgraded to cran view. Rooms were good and enjoyed our stay.
On our last day again our flight was delayed and since we arrived very late when we came we missed upon our lunch and asked if we could have dinner for kids since flights were delayed and they upright said no.
They all were super rude and not at all accommodating when we had booked two rooms and were a family of 8. They wanted to make money for everything.
It was a low season and they could have easily given us a better room from before itself but they didn’t budge!

Never returning back as was very disappointed!

reviews.author: C N
reviews.text:
Resort looks nice however it’s poorly maintained. It was raining on Sunday 7/28/2024 and the water dripped thru the ceilings. We were on second floor and water was everywhere on the hall. The rain stopped for 8hours now and all we got is a caution wet sign out the door. No one bother to clean it up. The tile floor is slippery. Are they looking for insurance claims?
A party of 8 came to lemon fish to get table. Ximena at the front told us that we have to sit separately 4 and 4. We were ok with it but asked for two table near by each other. She told us no, but the group in front of us got a table together. And yesterday we were here and were able to sit together. I asked her why can’t we be in the same area when there are plenty of open tables and we were there 15 mins after the door open. She told us that is because of the server turn, she has to sit clients based on server area. You can’t accommodate big group in one table that is fine. You can’t even accommodate table close to each other. We come here as a group and we will dine as a group. And you just want to make it harder for us and pick a fight since there were a big group that sat down before us. I wanted to talk to the manager but my group decided not to let Ximena ruin our day.

reviews.author: Eric Sultan
reviews.text:
I am not a huge fan of all inclusive vacations to start with, but the ease and service that make an all inclusive resort worth staying at was completely lacking at Paradisus.  We were promised room locations for our parents, and those rooms didn't even exist.  We spent the first few hours of our trip trying to negotiate suitable rooms to no avail.

We came with our kids, and almost all of the reservations for restaurants were booked, so we had to eat dinners at the buffet.  The food is less than mediocre... at the steakhouse, I had an incredibly tough, totally overcooked steak.

Due to all of the work we have been doing (dealing with rooms), I haven't been able to check out the pools or beach yet.  I assume that they are as good as any in this amazing part of the world, but at this point I am prepared to be dazzled by Paradisus's ability to underwhelm.

reviews.author: Mark Gunther
reviews.text: DO NOT STAY HERE. Absolute worst customer service I have ever received. 400 dollars worth of cologne stolen by an employee from my room. No sense of security and when making a report, the hotel told me to call the Mexican Police… after one of their employees stole from me. How’s that work?

reviews.author: John
reviews.text:
Do not have a wedding at this place!

As a foreigner who loves Cancun, I was foolish enough to trust paradisus to organize my wedding. With all the reviews being somewhat positive, I thought "what could go wrong?". Well let me tell you so you dodge a bullet: after going through the process of selecting a day, paying the first dues, telling the whole family and friends to book their flights and hotels, I haven't heard anything from the wedding department for months! This is ridiculous. They haven't even sent me the link for the payments that need to be made and now we are overdue and most likely will forfeit the wedding. What is wrong with you?

Do not book your wedding here.

This hotel is not 5 stars. You'll be waiting for food, towels and drinks. The rooms are very old and smell like sewer. Overall terrible.

reviews.author: Dario Araiza
reviews.text:
I don’t usually write reviews but here we go. Food was 3.5/10 at best. Most of the food arrived dry or cold. Wait times of over 1 hour at restaurants (including the buffet, even when there were empty tables) and up to 2 hours for room service, mind you, this was at all times, and not during regular rush hour.

Staff was inattentive, most of them couldn't pour water out of a boot if the instructions were on the heel.

Getting something as simple as a water cup or a soda was a gamble to see if you would receive it in less than an hour, if you even did receive it at all. Heaven forbid you ask for a water bottle, because they were “only allowed to bring water cups”, and it seemed like they were only able to give you a refill every 30 minutes. Roof was dripping at least in 2 places per pyramid, never getting fixed in the 5 days I stayed there.

Bartenders (not all) usually ignored you and continued with their normal tasks usually until the 2nd time you called them.

Quality of this hotel has only decreased since the last time I visited, 2 years ago. Even in peak season, the hotel should plan for that. Idk if they were short staffed, which sounds reasonable the way managers treat the staff, but you wouldn’t expect that type of treatment for a supposedly 5 star resort.

For the person writing back to low star reviews, stop copy pasting the same answer with very little changes, even someone thicker than a castle wall could notice that.
1/5

We had to ask for a bottle opener on 3 different nights, because there wasn’t any on the room, and they didn’t even bother to bring it when we asked for it on the phone. Doors don’t slide, and we got a 1 bed room, even when we paid for a 2 bed one. They promised we could change rooms the next day, never happened.

Probably one of the worst hotels in Cancun.

reviews.author: John Beadle (Bugster)
reviews.text: This is a copy of my evaluation in Travel Advisory: First off, we knew that it was a hot time of year to go. This was our second trip to the Paradisus. The last time was when they were named named Gran Melia 12 years ago. What we discovered this time around was that the main building atrium, the elevators, and more are not tempered. Which really would have helped with reprieve from heat. The room was on the top floor which did give us a nice view but the room struggled with getting cool. I know you are saying "well its tough to keep when heat is that high (90 deg F)." As a controls and HVAC professional, true if it was 95 with 100 percent humidity. That was not the case. The filter was the cheapest one a person could have put in, might as well not have one at all therefore make sure you have your Allegra (mold). Next the water was off for the night and it got nasty with the the toilet full. Now read up on this; the food is made in one area, the buffet. All restaurant's get their food within that area and bring it to you for extra service or extra cost. The line gets very long at times. My photo does look like one that's fake but I guarantee that it's real. I can't verify that the expensive steak house, which isn't worth it, gets the food from the buffet but 95% sure it does since we seen one head out of buffet. I have photo's to give example from Italian restaurant. I will review the excursions separate since they were awesome and separate from resort. The Cabana's were great. The service was ok, just think they work them too hard. This is not a place for adult only. Children were everywhere including the swim up bar, not ordering though did see one parent give a infant vodka drink. They also let them take ice cream into the pool...lol. Make sure you have tip money. Really look around before selecting this resort. O and the reason they get a so called green award is the place turns off electricity, no temperature control in atriums, reuse of plastic cups, I say again, they re-use plastic cups and the process for cleaning isn't good. I am sure they do some good. Staff is outstanding. lol.. I am not a bot. Update, Paradisus response stated that I misrepresented. For that, my response is that the truth will set them free.  I observed the kitchen so that my review is valid and sound. Even, their outdoor restaurant Aqua Marine even had a sign to use the Lunch Box with their menu. Why would that be? Well the Lunch Box is next to the Buffet which,  yep has that kitchen. Now, don't repeat this .. they are right about  being efficient. It's not only that but also good business.  I have many photos. Just admit the practice.. its not a bad thing.

reviews.author: Rajesh Reddy
reviews.text:
Stressful experience, been here for one night out of 4 nights stay. Supposed to be relaxed experience with very expensive all inclusive but it is far from relaxing, very stressful. Long lines for breakfast, no reservations available for dinner or for cabanas on the beach / pool. Put me in adults only section while I am here with kids. No proper orientation towards how the resort works. Staff give different answers based on who you ask. Do not recommend to anyone, particularly during holidays. Waste of money, should have used it for something else. Very disappointed and frustrated.

In your response, assuming that we went for breakfast late is a good example of your attitude towards the guests. You are never wrong and it is guests mistake somehow.

reviews.author: Owen Ko
reviews.text: Hotel is dated and small. Food is so so and always the same in the buffet. The food in the restaurants are decent. The beach is filled with seaweeds and the waves are very strong. And the worst of all is the service, the people at check in desk in building 3 to the reception desk in Reserve building 5 have no interest in servicing you with no enthusiasm at all. The bar tender at the pool bar is the worst of all with bad attitude. Overall I would suggest to stay away from this resort.

reviews.author: KY L
reviews.text:
I cannot express how utterly disappointed I am with my stay at Paradisus Cancun. Staying here since Dec 25 has been a nightmare. The sheer audacity of making guests wait 45-120 minutes for check-in and even longer at the restaurants is unforgivable. The chaos doesn’t end there; once seated, you’ll wait an eternity for servers to take your order, only for them to eventually botch it up. Heaven forbid you run out of water because good luck getting a refill.

The swimming pool and beach situation was laughable at best. Repeatedly asking for towels, only to hear the same lame excuse about the guy fetching more, is beyond frustrating.

And to add insult to injury, the room was a disgrace. Sand everywhere, a freezer that was out of order, and sliding doors that felt like they were glued shut. It’s as if cleanliness and maintenance are foreign concepts here.

Having visited the Cancun area numerous times, I’ve never encountered such abysmal service. It’s perplexing how a seasoned hotel like Paradisus can’t handle the influx of guests, especially when they’re gouging prices. Rumor has it, staff morale is so low that many are quitting. I’m not surprised.

This has been, without a doubt, my worst hotel experience. I wish I could give this place minus 5 stars. If you value your time, money, and sanity, steer clear of this establishment. Consider yourself warned.

reviews.author: christopher zarlenga
reviews.text:
The property is amazing, the location is great but the service could be a lot better along with the food as well. Unfortunately, are AC wasn’t working we called the front desk of course no response. The following day I mentioned the AC wasn’t working and I they offered a fan, we took as we try not to be a bother but the last day it was just too much and they sent someone around 10:00pm at night and apparently it was broken. I just wished they would had allowed us to move to another room from the beginning but you pay what you get.

Just got back from the hotel

Dear hotel

I am writing to express my deep disappointment and frustration with my recent stay at your hotel for my honeymoon. Unfortunately, my experience was far from satisfactory, and I feel compelled to share my grievances with you.

To start with, the presence of mold in the bathroom was appalling and unacceptable. The fact that the hotel has not taken proper care of its facilities and cleanliness is a cause for concern, and it poses a severe health hazard to your guests. Furthermore, the inconvenience of having to switch rooms twice due to clogged showers was a significant disruption to our experience.

To make matters worse, we encountered roaches in our room, which was incredibly distressing and uncomfortable. This is simply unacceptable, and it reflects poorly on the hotel's hygiene standards.

Moreover, the customer service we received was nothing short of abysmal. The lack of empathy and responsiveness from the hotel staff was frustrating and only added to our already negative experience. As newlyweds, we were hoping for a memorable and comfortable honeymoon experience, but unfortunately, that was not the case.

I would like to request a refund for my stay, as it did not meet the standards we were promised. I would also like to urge you to take immediate action to address these issues and ensure that they do not happen to any other guests in the future. It is crucial for a hotel to provide exceptional customer service, cleanliness, and maintenance to ensure a positive and memorable experience for its guests.

I hope to hear from you soon with a resolution to this matter

reviews.author: Cindy Sexton
reviews.text:
I refuse to give this resort more than a 1 star for anything even though the location is good. We spent almost 10k on a week vacation here and it was a waste of money. Our vacation was ruined by the poor service, run down rooms, and complete dishonesty when it comes to calling it an “all inclusive”. There are a lot of good reviews which is why we chose it over many others, but there are so many better resorts in Cancun. Here’s a few of our issues we ran into and I’m not even going to list half of them.

Biggest issue!
1. Inclusive is not truly inclusive. Restaurants are by reservation only and rarely are there openings for meals. Our extra charged for concierge wasn’t able to get us reservations for most nights due to no availability. We ate at the buffet most of our stay which had a very poor choice of foods. Drinks have extra charges if you order something like “Red Bull” and they charge $6-$9 a can secretly. A restaurant we went to told us drinks were included and it turned out they charged us $90! The steakhouse they brag about and use as an upsell to the Reserve rooms was not great and we had a cockroach on our table during our dinner. The server helped me kill it after it ran onto my lap and then the floor, but no manager came by or even acknowledged it. We had ordered an $80 “paid for” crab leg and didn’t get to eat it since our appetite was ruined. Thankfully the resort removed the charge when I brought it up at our departure. Bottom line is- this resort is not all inclusive. They nickel and dime you the entire stay.

- Reserve all adults isnt worth the money
- Staff went on strike while we were there and were hostile every day leading up to it
- was supposed to have cabana reservations and it worked out one day of the 7 based on poor communication between staff
- Activities that family planned on were canceled last minute so we couldn’t even participate in them
- Toilet was broken most of our stay
- AC in second room screamed most of the time keeping everyone awake. They moved that group to a room with no working outlets so no one could charge phones unless in the bathroom.
- bugs in restaurants and rooms
- bars and pools close at 7
- most restaurants seemed to be the food from the buffet served by staff
-

reviews.author: Daniel Stein
reviews.text: Stay far away. This resort is horrible. Staff are not helpful. Rooms have terrible views. Restaurants and bars all close early. There’s is also no 24 hr bar or food options other then room service. You have to leave the resort if you want anything. The place feels dead everywhere you go. I have been to Cancun over 20 times and this is by far the worst experience at a all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: Dennis K
reviews.text:
We stayed for 8 days and had the all-inclusive package. I believe May is considered the offseason which we appreciated as the hotel wasn't too crowded. It also meant we had a considerable amount of seaweed on the beach and the waves were strong than expected. We have a toddler so we stayed mainly in the pools so this wasn't too much of a downer for us. For context, we have been to Cancun before so I can draw from that experience and make comparison in my review here.

Food: the Italian restaurant and the seafood one (out by the pool) were ok. The buffet style one was ok also. The Japanese one was substandard. Overall, and compared to my other Cancun visits, the dining experience was not impressive.

Service: Surprisingly, and compared to my other visits, communication in English was more challenging than expected. The front desk and customer service staff were ok but the restaurant and bar staffs were hit or miss. And perhaps it's a hangover from COVID and due to the labour shortage across all regions, the staffs were not as friendly and responsive as I remember from my other visits (all at other resorts). We often had to be nice or tip to get a reasonable level of service in the timely manner.

Finally, this ruined our experience for sure and the main reason for the one star rating, we had a very unpleasant experience at the Lunch Box restaurant where we showed up as the first guests of the evening (with reservation). As I noted above, it's the slower season so it was just us for the first twenty minutes or so. We asked for a highchair as we entered which the hostess confirmed and said it would be brought over shortly. Didn't come for the first 15 minutes or so, therefore, I walked up to the hostess to check on status of the highchair. Her reaction was abominable - she looked over at me, did not react or respond, walked away and spoke to the waiters. It was distasteful and rude, but I returned to my seat - I try to give people benefit of the doubt. Perhaps unsurprisingly, the highchair didn't come for a few more minutes (again it was just us in the restaurant until now), and I asked the hostess again. Same reaction (a stare over, rolling eyes, no response, walk away and speak to others). I mean if that is the type of service you'll be getting at a premium resort, it is a no-thank-you for me. I asked for her name so that I can follow up with her supervisor. What was more baffling was that, during our meal, the supervisor did show up and apologized for not bringing over the highchair in a timely manner. But no apology about the hostess' behavior from the supervisor nor a personal apology from the hostess herself. They were missing the point. I told the supervisor about my experience but I don't think he cared too much. I later followed up with the customer service desk manager to formally lodge my complaint to ensure this is appropriately tended to. For sure I wanted to vent but also wanted to make sure appropriate actions be taken to correct this behavior, attitude, and lack of professional service. The manager was apologetic and promised to follow up internally and said that they would eventually inform me how the complaint was managed and what came about from it, which I appreciated and actually believed in. A day later, I was told that the hostess was engaged and was given a formal warning. However, after numerous attempts to hear the end of it, the staffs have been unresponsive. I followed up even after the trip to give them one last chance to make it (somewhat) right. At this point, I can only assume it was swept under the rug. Anyways, I wanted to make sure those who are interested are informed of what potentially may happen during your visit and what you may experience. I would not recommend Paradisus Cancun to anyone I know.

reviews.author: Dr. Rohan Bhojwani
reviews.text: Our experience at this hotel was worse than being homeless. The temp was 90F and the AC wasn't working, the room service never showed up. We had a power outage, our sink drain and toilet drain both were clogged. We never had a renewal of our refreshments, our shuttle was canceled because of delay in service and we were made to pay for it. They have hidden fees everywhere (ex.charge 10$ for coconut water in an all inclusive package). Tried calling the supervisors, i.e Gabriella from front desk, Rosana from guest services with no communication or recourse. The hotel staff themselves complain of the operational issues faced by them, they were drenching in sweat with no air conditioning. The staff promised that they will process refund of our stay, but nothing happened. Please refund my money, or we shall do a formal report of the pilferage your hotel does.

reviews.author: Jenna Wells
reviews.text: The location was nice and the resort was beautiful but the reason for the 1 star is that we had no AC in our room and we called multiple times and told our concierge that they assured us it would be fixed, we came back and it was not fixed and we continued to ask and nothing was done.  Not having AC in the resort or our room was not enjoyable for a 9 day stay.  Also, when we were leaving they took our stuff out of our room without our knowledge and left it outside for anyone to get into very unpleasant as my purse was there.  The man was very rude about it as well saying he didn’t know where it was and that it was somewhere in the hotel.  It’s like you have my purse with my passport and my wallet.  Not only that I got food posing from the Italian restaurant and was told there was no nurse or anything to help me so i had to go across the street to the pharmacy.  I emailed them after my stay with proof of our complaints and they then told me that it was a lie and that we had texted and said it was good, I showed them our texts and was still told I was lying and that there was nothing they were going to do, not even an apology.  This is very disappointing and not a good way to run a resort.  I have proof of us texting our concierge that it was in fact not okay.  We payed a lot of money to stay there and to be treated that way was totally uncalled for.  TREAT YOUR GUESTS WITH RESPECT.  There is also cockroaches in the reserve so I don’t recommend eating there either.

reviews.author: Na Ni
reviews.text: The check-in process is the worst we’ve ever experienced! We arrived at 2pm and were supposed to check in at 3pm, but they told us the room will be ready within 10 to 15 min at 3:15pm. Then we had to go back and forth between pyramid 1 and 3, but our room didn’t ready until 4:25pm, which is one and a half hour late! We asked for compensation, but they said the only thing they can provide is to let us check out for one and half hour late, which is useless and disappointing. In addition, we booked the room with two beds, but they said only one bed room is available. Ok fine, that I understand. And they promised they can set up the second bed for us. However, the housekeeper didn’t come until 50min later…The housekeeping lady is really really nice and helpful tho, but the front desk is just ridiculous! The star for service is solely for the housekeeping lady.

reviews.author: Ying Ni
reviews.text:
We had unexpected bad experiences with this resort. In general, employees here are very friendly, but one lady from checkin/front desk was not helpful at all. We waited extra time with her to get a room and had to reschedule our activity because of that. Then, we were assigned a room not as we booked and told there is no other room available till 2 days later. She had no answer to most of my questions like common like should we reserve and how we can reserve beach front sunbed. Then when we first got to the room, there was another family inside said the room was mistakenly given to them; then we found out the sink is leaking badly in this room. When we complained to the hotel, they showed no signs of apology, no effort to make things up to us neither. We reserved New Year’s Eve dinner, sit there for one hour without any drink or food. Somehow we got all unlucky scenarios all together here in this resort, pretty much ruined my new year vacation completely!

Updated: we were promised a room to switch in two days. We confirmed in the morning and packed our luggage’s in the morning since we have an excursion trip that day. When we came back from the trip we were told there was no record of us requesting room change. An hour later, we are still waiting at the check in with kids, not getting our room. I couldn’t believe this is a resort cost us $1k/night.

reviews.author: Obaid Khan
reviews.text: BEWARE of fraud! I had a free upgrade available from Melia for my anniversary with them. Front desk guy Rafael at check-in said no rooms were available for free upgrade but offered me a deal on a bigger suite for a fee. They instead did not refund the original booking and double charged me for the rooms! Do not ever agree on upgrade unless its free or they will make you pay twice! I am still fighting with them to refund me the original amount that was charged. No luck yet!

reviews.author: Kim Dinh
reviews.text: Staying here right now Jan 18-23. Staying on the Reserve side. Wanted to order shots but the bartender named Julio would not give us multiple shots to take to our table. He wanted me to pay $30 for the whole bottle. Why would I pay him for the bottle if we are staying for all inclusive. Looks like this guy is trying to make money on the side from us. We all have been tipping everytime we go up to the bar. Everyone that has served us and we have not have an issue with. And the server that was assigned to this area he would not let him serve us.

reviews.author: beka Babakishvili
reviews.text: We are currently staying at the Paradisus Cancun, and so far we’ve been very disappointed. Long lineups for the buffet and cafe, shortage of toppings/salsas at the taco stand near pool, every day no towels available (some guests walk away with several towels - there is no efficient system to make sure all guests are accommodated), lack of waiters (takes a long time to be served and food is left out for long periods of time in lobby/bar/recreational areas. We’ve left our room in the morning and returned late in the afternoon - our room wasn’t cleaned except for water bottle refill (they took a 10 dollar tip meant for the cleaning staff). Also clumps of hair on the exterior dining furniture. We expect a cleaner facility at this resort. Lastly, the entertainment has been underwhelming. For such a large resort - they set up a small stage and seating area. The resort and staff do not seem ready to accommodate all guests at peak season. We hope things will get better, but so far we’ve been struggling to find the positives.

reviews.author: Qixing Tian
reviews.text:
I’ve been Cancun like four times, and this hotel is my worst experience ever. I booked 4 nights for my family trip and today is only the second day, we all already wanna go home. First of all, the front desk was super slowly and not welcoming at all. The check-in process spent more than 40 minutes. Why? Because the front desk spent more than 5 minutes to looking for a scissor to cut our bracelet and talking with her coworkers by the way. She didn’t trying to explain everything except encouraging us to book a SPA service. After we went to the rooms, the rooms were old and didn’t look like a luxury hotel room. And then, they spent around one hour to delivery our luggage even we did talked to them twice and told them it’s emergency because our baby need to eat his food.
For the baby, it also was a big joke. This is a family hotel but it doesn’t welcome little kids at all. They put our room close to a bar, the noise continued until 12am, my baby just COULD NOT SLEEP. omg it’s really a nightmare. Why you put a family to this kind of room? I really don’t understand. And before we went to the hotel, we called them to ask if they can do baby food and they answered yes. Upon we are here we found they don’t know how to make baby food, they even don’t understand what you are saying. We repeated told them no salt no sugar please, and they repeated sent the food super salty.  “No Salt.” Is the two words really hard to understand?
I wish I never come to this hotel, I don’t even know how I spend the rest two days with noise and baby’s crying.
I will never come back to this hotel and I recommend everyone be away from this hotel. Don’t let this hotel ruin your vacation it’s not worth.

reviews.author: Michele Fulmore
reviews.text: Was all fine until you fine cockroaches in your room. No apologies or rush to get it taken care of just feel like a burden to them. Called multiple times spoke to the desk. Nobody puts in notices for the issues. Waiting 3 days for trash bags so I can bag my stuff and not take them home with me. Disgusting.

reviews.author: Suhas Kashyap
reviews.text: While the hotel and rooms are good, we had a terrible experience at Paradisus. In their Blue Agave restaurant, my kid bent down to pick up a towel behind our table when one of the curtains fell on my kid causing a safety issue. It was clearly shoddy work done at the restaurant. The manager came to us, accused my kid of walking all over it (mind you there was NO sign anywhere not to walk). The manager, Ulises threatened us with fines and insisted it’s the fault of whoever was near it. This person didn’t even apologize for the safety issue caused that could’ve hurt my kid. He clearly didn’t care about the safety of customers looking to put blame on them. I’ve been to many resorts around the world and no manager has ever treated customers like the way this person has done. My kids are now hesitant to walk near any walls for the fear something might fall down and be blamed for it. Beware of such managers who might ruin peace of mind and cause unnecessary stress

reviews.author: Valeria Castro
reviews.text:
Definitely not a 5 star hotel as google says, not even 4. If you have high expectations, this hotel isn't for you. *Pros: housekeeping daily, nice beach, but they don't clean the seaweed, and good location.

*Cons: Pools are disgusting, mold on edges and tile creases, puddles of algae water in pool areas, definitely need power washing. Waiters at Malva non-existant after first drinks, and always a long line to get in for breakfast. Cockroaches in rooms and hallways. Can't ask concierge simple questions because they always want to send you to sales on 1st floor wasting your time. Lagoon view rooms run down. Room service is $5 USD delivery fee after 3rd room order. The first 2 are complimentary.

Bottom line, wouldn't come again. They need more staff at restaurants and an obvious renovation and sanitation upgrade.

reviews.author: Christine Cao
reviews.text:
Yikes, run for the hills!

It feels like you're walking through an abandoned strip mall with half the restaurants open and half staffed. Everything is an up charge, so if you've come to take advantage of this "all inclusive" hotel, you'll be disappointed. In order to have dinner, they've requested you make a reservation via the phone in your room. Unfortunately, no one answers the line. You also are not permitted to make a reservation until the day  of. The only way we were able to make any reservations was to go down to guest services to ask why no one was answering their reservation line.

This is also for families, so you'll likely see more children than adults. Just a warning!

You also are not allowed to request alcohol to your room as room service. The only way you can get a beverage is by running down to a restaurant and bringing it back up. It's kind of laughable, you get two beers in the fridge when you arrive, but it's all on you to figure out the rest!

The cabanas are extra, certain restaurants are for higher paying guests, the room service food is something an elementary school child would be served in their school cafeteria. I should have taken a photo of the pizza for this purpose, it's laughable.

Good luck all! There are better options!

reviews.author: Sheree Patel
reviews.text:
Book elsewhere..  We went back and forth with concierge about upgrading our room for 2 months.   Alot of confusing responses. We had made it clear what we wanted.  We upgraded to "The Reserve" for the ease of concierge service and to make this special for our children.  Well, we finally get checked in and get appointed  a gentleman(who is very nice) that tells us everything is booked up until Sunday which is the day we leave.  Can't get in to the restaurants or even book a cabana. Luckily, I found someone when we did early check in at 11am to help us grab some reservations (and that's after asking for help-no one suggested at check in)...if I had waited for concierge  to help book at 3pm when our room was ready then we would be out of luck. I wish the person we emailed with would have mentioned that It would be a good idea to book in advance.  And I was hoping concierge could do something special for the kids like milk and cookies which i read in reviews but he said they don't even offer that anymore.  We were told concierge is best for adults only after we got here.
So far this first day is very disappointing.

reviews.author: Kirolos Gorgie
reviews.text:
We booked Paradisus for a friend's bachelor's. It was one of the worst choices we made on this trip.

Hotel: Floors are slippery and this hotel doesn't know much about safety. They have trees and hanging garden, whoever thought of this decoration idea needs to change his career. It smells bad and makes the place looks ugly and old. Also lots of stairs and steps and lacks of air-conditioning.

Rooms: Your Grandmother's room probably has way better furniture. It was not what we booked. We booked a lagoon view and what we got was a building view. We talked to Guest Services they moved us to another room with what we booked but A/C was not making the room any colder.
