Then we got moved again to a third room that everything looked to be fine, but one of the bed legs were broken, and the toilet sliding door This place is OLD AND NEEDS MAINTENANCE!

Service: Some servers are nice but most of them they serve with attitude. If you're looking for a 5 star servive AVOID this hotel. Hyatt Ziva has 4 stars and it is not even comparable. Room service available 24hrs only 2 times for free. Maybe you won't exceed the 2 times for 24 hrs but when they tod us ths it was just disappointing.

Food: The buffet serves same food everyday and leaves coldcuts from the morning to be served at lunch. 2 restaurants at aditional costs. NO STEAK HOUSE FOR ALL INCLUSIVE.

reviews.author: Krystal Heredia
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars I would. PLEASE STAY AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY!!!!!! I went to Mexico back in August and booked an all inclusive resort with travel to and from the hotel. Upon arriving to Mexico, we followed the instructions to be picked up by the driver. The driver was a no call and no show. We called Melia and Logitravel SEVERAL times and they called the driver SEVERAL times. They were also unable to get a hold of the driver. They told us to go ahead and take the taxi cabs and they would reimburse us once we sent the receipt in. The taxi cab was $150 USD which in itself is robbery. Today months later they are letting me know that the driver was there and they provided a blank email with a "photo" that doesn't show up of the driver being there and saying we were a NO SHOW. Our flight was on time. I have contacted them for MONTHS and today after saying I was going to write a review they said hey we apologize for the inconvenience but you were a no show. WHAAAAAT in the actual gas light scammer company is this??????? STAY FAR AWAY. Please don't go through this robbery, scamming headache.

reviews.author: ryan stout
reviews.text:
First I want to say that I never leave reviews but my experience here was so frustrating that I wanted to tell someone about it.

Initially when I booked this resort(we have stayed at many Meliá hotels in the past) I called immediately to ensure that my two nikte suites would be near one another. I was assured no problem I had put notes in your file it will be fine when you arrive.

Then when I arrive I am told I have to pay for another person since I only booked for 6(which was their error not mine, except I did not check prior to arrival) and they made me pay almost 50% my entire stay for just one person additional.

Then we get our rooms - 1 had no a/c, broken handles for shower and was barely large enough for our items and us. The other room was not stocked with chips, candies, nuts, drinks, bath robes, or slippers. And the rooms were not even on the same floor let alone close to each other.
So I spoke with my concierge who assured me it would be rectified tomorrow and to pack our things so they could move them to the new room.

The next day we were locked out of our room all day so they could move our things, which never happened so I spent 3 hours in the “guest services” area being passed around from supervisor to supervisor with not a single person actually trying to help the situation. I was told many lies about why they were unable to accommodate our family. When I pointed it out they just said… oh no that’s not what they meant. I still would like to speak to a supervisor that would take lying to guest as a serious concern. I was told that they are completely booked - however I was able to look online and see they still had many rooms available including a larger suite so I asked if they could just move us all to that larger suite which they told me no. I then offered to pay for the upgrade and finally got their attention.

The following day I was approached by my concierge to see if I liked the new room, which I had to pay for in order to solve my own problem. Which she sympathized with me but still offered no consideration for.

TLDR this hotel does not care about guests, problems with all 3 rooms we inhabited during our stay. Supervisors and managers will lie to get you out of their hair.

reviews.author: Ashwaq Alhammmami
reviews.text:
Update:
Long story short, we have to get with manger every time we want to make a reservation, such as reserve a cabana (I tried to get one and the lady in charge first she said no availability and all reserved after we talked to the manager guess what!!! There is one available.) same issue happened with restaurant when we try to reserve no availability and all booked, however if you check the restaurant there a lot of tables available. Over all I want book in this resort again and if some one decides to book I don’t recommend you to book The reserve package it’s wasting of time and energy, you better boo normal room and then upgrade at the resort you will get good service.
To be fare, resort is very beautiful it’s humid and hot inside don’t know why, but the customer service is not good at all unless you get with the managers.

I checked in 5-26, and today is my first day to explore the resort… all I can say now is
service is not good everyone give you different rule or directions, And almost everything I try to reserve is booked.
I booked the reserve to get upgraded service, my concierge refused to service me, and Almost the vacation I am trying to enjoy is not going good. I’ll post updates along the trip.

reviews.author: charmaine
reviews.text:
Before arrival, Otium could have been more courteous as I was trying to arrange the offered transportation to the hotel. Unfortunately, and they kept hanging up the phone.

I arrived at Paradisus and waited 30+ minutes to be checked in and rushed through. When I asked for details on the resort, I was told to read the card. The room view I purchased differed from what I received, and they could not accommodate it.

In my room, the toilet ran nonstop, the power went out every morning, and the outlets stopped working, causing the refrigerator to leak. Imagine maintenance coming to your room every day. Housekeeping took items from my room, walked in on me naked without knocking, and just stood there taking a mental picture.

I could not reserve half the restaurants because they were closed for the week. Moreover, finding a spot on the beach was challenging due to people holding places with towels.

The last day, I woke up late. My alarm did not sound because the power went out again! I called guest services, but they never came. I barely made my flight.

I exercised much patience and consideration, but this prompted me to reach out to the guest services manager (ZANNINO, ROSANNA). She rushed through my concerns and promised to make things right and email me. I did not expect to be emailing for two months for what she offered. She never made things right or kept her promises and became verbally abusive, yelling at me over the phone. Because of this, I opted not to return.

Imagine Going Vacation and Paying for Stress and Torture

reviews.author: Brittany
reviews.text:
Recently stayed here (04/14-04/19)

Booked an all inclusive package for 5 days only to get there and given less than five star service. The rooms on their site are not the rooms you’re given. Not even remotely close. My room smelled like mildew or like it previously had water damage. Also seemed as if they threw furniture in a room and called it a day. No pictures on the wall, the lighting was dim and the smell was awful. The best part about my room was literally the bathroom! There was a hot tub on the balcony but it was not cleaned. The mini fridge in my room was broken called to have it replaced but get this… it was replaced with another broken mini fridge that leaked. Their night crew didn’t answer the phone so the line would ring. For all inclusive I found it incredibly ridiculous to have to make dinner reservations if I wanted to eat every night. Otherwise you’d be forced to eat at the buffet and the food was OK. If you didn’t make a reservation by 5pm you’d be SOL and have to get up early the next day hoping you can get in somewhere. Mind you my group arrived a little after 3pm checked in and got our rooms. By the time we learned that we had to make reservations for dinner they were closed and one of the women at the desk was quite rude about informing us of that.

If you’re not one of the people who chooses to upgrade or book what they call the “The reserve” you’re pretty neglected. The gift shops are extremely over priced. This is also a kid friendly resort which is fine but expect to see a lot of families.

You’re only given exclusive access to things If you book the reserve and I’ll bet that’s probably where most of these 5/5 reviews come from because they received better experiences. Even if someone chooses not to upgraded this is still a $$$ resort and guests pay their money for an equal experience if not better. I don’t believe I received that. On top of that the hotel is broken into 5 pyramids. My room was in pyramid 1 the walk alone is crazy. Like someone mentioned in their review it’s literally like walking through an abandoned mall.

Will not be staying again. It was my first time in Cancún and I truly wish I didn’t waste it at Paradisus. This is not to take away from anyone who had an amazing time here but only to share my most recent experience.

reviews.author: H Hana
reviews.text: Worst stay I have ever had in Mexico!  Upon entering the hotel, discovered the entire first floor lobby is under construction, a mess and the noise from the construction ridiculous.  Check in process took forever.  Was finally taken to my room that was 80 degrees (and stayed that temperature my entire stay).  Asked for another room just to be taken to 2 more that were worse!  Made numerous trips to the lobby for help and after each broken promise to be told by the current staff member that the last one had no idea what they were talking about (including being told that by a manager, Alejandro)  You need a reservation for most restaurants that need to be reserved by phone or mobile app (No one ever answered the reservation lines at the given time and the mobile app never worked!) So was never able to eat any where except for the buffet which was terrible.  Second day there Hurricane Grace arrived.  Now you would think a hotel located in a hurricane prone area would have some sort of protection against them right?  Not this hotel!  Wind and rain were literally coming right through the sliding door!  My room was flooded with water for nearly 2 days!!!  The hotels only solution to bring a staff member every few hours to try to soak up the water with towels and being told sorry there is nothing else they can do!  Even the staff trying to clean up couldn't believe the amount of water coming in!!!  And it clearly happened before because you could see rust on everything metal in the room.  Couldn't even change rooms because they were fully booked at that point!  Was told told there would be many activities and shows going on...only happened on 1 night of my 7 night stay.  The only positive notes I can give is that they do have a beautiful beach, nice pool areas and a friendly staff.  Still can’t believe they refused to give any sort of compensation for the terrible experience!  Overall DO NOT GO TO THIS HOTEL!!!  I've stayed at other All-Inclusive resorts in Cancun that were half the price of this one and had so much more of a better experience! :(

reviews.author: B W
reviews.text: Due to the west jet strike we were unable to fly into Cancún, we were also unable to rebook to get there as the hurricane was taking place at the time . WE LITERALLY COULD NOT GET THERE. They charged us for one night due to “cancelling” which we had no choice in. It was $900.00… disgusting customer service. We were going to rebook with them after all of this and try again but definitely not after this atrocious experience -we had a $9000.00 trip booked with them. They lost out on future business because they were NOT willing to help with a situation beyond our control. We booked an expensive room.You should feel ashamed.

reviews.author: gabolopezgil -
reviews.text:
The hotel itself its beautiful but they have a BIG BIG problem with the AC UNITS, its not acceptable that a "5 STARS" hotel as they advertise have several rooms with bad A/C, after the first night and complaining several times we were moved to another room that was a little cooler just because the sun did not hit directly!
We met at least 6 other guests that had the same problem, again impossible to sleep in a room without A/C in a 90 degree weather... Concierge only cares if you buy any of the packages or membership, if not they become rude and of course will not take care of you!!!!  Restaurants would not take reservations, we were not able to get into ANY of them in 4days!!!  DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY  OR TIME HERE!!!!!!!!!!!!   1st time in Cancun and for sure LAST in this "hotel" WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND TO ANYONE

reviews.author: Samar Jain
reviews.text:
Worst 5 star hotel.
- we had to wait 45 minutes to check in.
-There are lines for all food places. We waited 40 minutes in the line to pizza by the pool.
- we waited 2 hours to get into Italian restaurant. Service was bad.
- we waited 1 hour or Mexican restaurant
- service is awful at best
- room service refused to make simple grilled cheese.  “ it’s not on the menu”.   Please stop drums of your service.
- Cabanas are $250.  I’m Cabos at their location
it’s free.
- just not good service overall as compared to their other locations.

I really wanted to love this place as we always stay at paradisus everywhere. But we will never recommend Cancun location.

Day 2:
2.5 hour wait at blue agave to get seated and get basic eggs.  They just don’t have people working.  The ones that was working do not care imo.

Being busy isn’t an excuse.  The resort know months in advance how many guests will be staying and labor shouldn’t be an excuse in Mexico.

You had no problem charging  premium rates for busy season!

reviews.author: Hunter Remer
reviews.text: DO NOT STAY HERE!! Had my Lululemon shorts STOLEN by housekeeping from this property and management named Iliane Medina refuses to replace or reimburse for them. Security even came into my room and searched all my things to make sure I was being honest, violating my privacy. My co-worker also had 2 items Stolen from her room. Also, many of the rooms do not have working air-conditioning or it leaks on the floor. After reading reviews, I see this is common. DO NOT STAY HERE!!

reviews.author: Kevin Koo
reviews.text: Staff stole my passport and money! I left it in my room at 9pm and went out to downtown. The next morning I looked for it and it was missing. They did not explain what to do if the embassy is closed on the weekend and my flight was on Sunday. Security is terrible, my friend had a do not disturb sign in his door handle and house keeping and mini bar staff still tried to enter his room while he was inside. All the buffet had for meat was pork. Looks nice but terrible terrible terrible. The management would not compensate for their incompetence and everyone will try to scam you for your money. Don’t go to this place!

reviews.author: John Doherty
reviews.text:
This place is a renamed old resort that hasn't been updated since I stayed here in early 90s, when  I was young  and poor.  The first room they took us too had extremely old mattresses, with bed bug staining on them. I complained and inly when they noticed that people were listening to me about the bed bugs did  they quickly upgrade us to a nicer room, but it was still very dated but with fairly new mattresses. When we went to eat  at one of their self serve (except for drinks) restaurant they didn't do much. First they tried to make us eat at an other families' table, with three vacant seats. The family complained that they were loosing their privacy, which I totally agreed with them.
They then moved us and he brought us a round of drinks and kids ice cream for the kids after we had eaten. He  then demanded a tip (although this is supposed to be a no tip resort but I do usually tip for awesome service even in these locations). I told him that we just arrived I needed to get change and I would make it up tomorrow. He stormed away mad and I certainly wasn't going to give him $100 bill as a tip.

reviews.author: C D
reviews.text:
The resort itself is ok - dated and beat up but ok… however the food is beyond terrible.
We have been here less than 4hrs - just went to the buffet and it was probably the worst food I’ve ever had. The selection is super bad, food quality is horrible and was cold.
The cocktails, liquor, is bottom of the barrel - not high quality liquor.
Considering we paid almost over 5K per person and there are 4 of us for the week it’s absolutely appalling..
The fridge was broken - replaced. Air conditioning is broke - still have not fixed it, and the sliding glass door was broken - now fixed. Remember we’ve only been here 4 hrs.
I hope to god things improve.
Otherwise, I will only ever visit a Royalton ( amazing btw) again.

reviews.author: Nejla Mahjoub
reviews.text:
I have to say We are having a great time just because we are here with our little daughter and nothing can stop us but as for the hotel goes is very disappointing and the opposite of relaxing;
The bad:
1. The restaurants are way below average
2. You have to wake up at 7 am to make a dinner reservation everyday otherwise you get no good time or any time at all (defeats the purpose of vacation and relaxing specially at an all inclusive resort)
3. Day 2 I got food poisoning at enso restaurant
4. Their shows are posted on one monitor near the concierge which is in another building and about 10min walk from our room, plus the times are sometimes wrong and the locations are not mentioned and also to mention shows do not start on time
5. There is construction in our building and non stop Smell of construction and then they spray all sort of chemicals to make the smell go away!
6. At check in they forgot to give us towel cards and the day we go to the pool we had to beg for towels and when we went to front desk to ask for towel card they tell us we have to wait in check in line!!!! (With absolutely no apologies)
7. The bathroom in our room definitely needs updates and smells like sewage
8. There was some sort of Yucky black stuff coming into the pool today (I will post pictures)
The good;
1. The view is amazing
2. Some waiters are nice and to name one MARTIN from enso has been amazing
3. The baby and kid zone is absolutely great spot with great workshops and activities for kids to play

reviews.author: J Goldie
reviews.text:
DO NOT buy memberships with Melia. They close the resort for renovations and don't tell their members. For the last three years it's rare if you get a person that can answer a question about booking your membership. Then when you request to book your membership they tell you they will get back to you within 72 hours with your confirmation. They NEVER HAVE in three years. We spend weeks on the phone with useless people who can't find anything. After you keep calling and fighting they claim they sent your confirmation it to an email unfortunately it is never your email. Somehow year after year after making sure they have the right email it always goes to a wrong email. Plus your personal information is going to an unknown email. IS THIS A PLOY TO DISCOURAGE YOU FROM USING YOUR TIMESHARE WEEKS?
What happened to this company? This is a nightmare!!!!@@

reviews.author: A'prille F
reviews.text:
Well the Paradisus is a beautiful hotel!!

there were a few issues upon arrival , the check is pretty smooth. However the air didn't work through the entire hotel, and as we were traveling the end of July it was unbearable in the room.

Paradisus customer care was extremely terrible. The reception was continuing to send us maintenance , they stayed 85% of rooms were taken but  why wouldn't we be able to get a new room? Paradisus did nothing to help with change of rooms.

Athwre was one pregnant guest in our room as well. We had to go to the time share to get air and they also asked us to leave, but after asking to stay because of pregnancy they allowed.

The cabana service wasn't great. We barely  had a chance to get our waiter he was no where to be found and was very impatient and brushed  us off when we ordered things.

We also got massages that was a Nightmare , the representative on the beach said that it would be $125 for 50 minute's. Three services were booked and they only gave us one person with a  30, mins  massage
the other with a 40 mins . We felt misled with that.

Further more  The pool was beautiful  , food was amazing and just Beautiful beautiful location and resort located near everything 10 mins away.

Please work on  customer service! We would never book here again because of the hot hotel and Service We received. Which is unfortunate

reviews.author: Eliza Ja
reviews.text: Terrible experience! The hotel is so poorly managed. They gave a different room that I initially booked, no one even try to solve the issue. The food is a bad quality and very limited choices. Dinner time even thought it’s all inclusive you need to make a reservation for every restaurant and when you want to do it they are fully booked. The beach chairs are few yet the hotel has so many people, and they do it just to charge you for available beds. Please do yourself a favor and pick a different hotel. Although it’s nicely design the rooms are in bad conditions( ocean front) not as pictured.

reviews.author: Laticia McKenzie
reviews.text:
The first day we arrived we had issues.  When we checked into our rooms the television was broken.  We called the front desk to inform them and they made my husband do a report as though we shattered the television.  After hours of waiting they finally switched out the television.  The second day the roof in the kids room leaked and flooded the room.  We were not even offered the option to move but they sent someone to clean it up only for it to happen a second time.  Upon checkin we paid to upgrade the room to an ocean view.  We were given the keys to 2 rooms that weren’t even cleaned.  I went back downstairs to reception where I explained the situation and waited another 3 hours for the to clean the room.  I had to ask for a supervisor to actually find out what was taking so long.  The customer service was horrible.  All
Of the the Sodas and beers in the refrigerator was included, however we went 2 days without it being restocked.  I had to call for them to restock it.  They didn’t change sheets and towels daily, which I found very nasty.  I was also racially profiled,   Apparently someone came into the hotel that checked out and security came to me while I was having dinner with my kids to ask my room number & actually told me that someone reentered the room.  The staff were not helpful at all, especially customer service and the check in area.  The morning breakfast staff on the outside was excellent.  The evening staff outside was not so pleasant.  Also there are cabanas that you have to pay for by the pool, for the amount of money we paid to stay here everything should have been all inclusive and it wasn’t.  This is the first time I’ve ever written a bad review and I travel every year 3 times a year with my children.  It was definitely not worth the money at all.  The resort is beautiful but that’s about it.  Everything Else gets 0 stars.  The guy at the checkout Samuel also added to our frustrations, he was also rude as heck.  I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.author: Hannah Jasper
reviews.text:
We just got back from vacation. I have reached out to corporate about something that happened with two of the staff members.
Pros: Beautiful beach, beautiful view, everything is very well kept and clean. Many options to choose from for excursions.

Cons: Only half of the lights in our room worked. The outside latch to the balcony door was gone so it was hard to get back in. The electrical outlet for a hair dryer or other items was coming out of the wall. The food was a big disappointment. It's like your typical cheap hotel food.

I'm unsure if I'm aloud to make this public or not as I have not heard from corporate yet, but it's completely disgusting. While my husband was asleep in the room, I went to the Red Lounge to cut loose and dance. It had been a stressful first few days. I requested a song to the DJ and he said he would play it only if I danced on him. I ended up hanging out with the younger crowd because I sadly felt more safe with the kids there. Eventually, I got tired and ventured off to find my room. That place is so confusing! I got lost and saw a staff member and asked him if he could show me where my room was. DUMB IDEA. He was more than happy to help and when we got to my room I thanked him, opened the door and he grabbed me and kissed me, I vividly remember his tongue making it in my mouth!!! I yelled at him and told him my husband was in the room and he apologized and took off. He was wearing a black uniform with some red on it and had been pushing a cart around for trash or something. I will NEVER go back there. It's sad I felt more safe walking downtown than I did in the parameters of the resort. It makes me sick to my stomach just thinking about it. I was scared to report it because I'm in a country where I don't know who I can trust and obviously staff wasn't trustworthy.  Never, ever again...

reviews.author: Kevin Morris
reviews.text: Not great more like slightly inclusive at best.  Nothing for kids, bars close at 11, no alcohol with room service. Waiting lines for the inclusive lunch buffet??? Upcharges for many items. Don't recommend.

reviews.author: carleighhh
reviews.text: There was a leek in the roof and we called for help and no one came 1 hour and a half later and it started leaking again and we couldn’t shower. Customer service was a “2 hour wait “ but they never came after those two hours, and asking for one shower cloth takes like a 40 minutes to get. They never had a Language option on the tv, so people who don’t speak Spanish couldn’t understand. The the breakfast waiters were great, but the night waiters were not. They didn’t refill our fridge for two days until we had to ask. The top shower leeks when you are trying to use the shower head. They don’t change the sheets everyday, even when it’s obviously dirty. While my family and I where having lunch, two “security guards” came and asked for our room number because “somebody came in and came back out “ and we were confused. They looked very suspicious because they were both stuttering as if they were making something up.

reviews.author: Brenda Gonzalez
reviews.text:
I am 5 months pregnant and recently booked a baby moon to Paradisus in Cancun. After hearing about the ZIKA virus that causes birth defects, we decided to cancel our reservation/ maybe even relocate our stay. Nobody in the Meliá company has been willing to help us, compromise, or even look into resolving this issue with us. Considering how much was spend on this reservation, you would think they’d at least TRY to help. Instead, I’m hung up on, blocked, sent to voicemail.. etc. Paolo was the rudest customer service rep I’ve ever spoken to, and all I asked was to speak with someone who’d actually help me.
Please, do not book here.

reviews.author: James Peeples
reviews.text:
The grounds are simply amazing! Beautiful! The grass and flowers amazing! The view amazing! THE FOOD IS AWFUL! They need to seriously do something about the food! It ruined the entire trip! I am not sure who eats that food!
*update from the response! From the cheesecake to the sushi. Dry dry dry. I could have went to Walmart for better cheesecake and sushi. NOT EVEN JOKING. we tried several restaurants very disappointed after paying 3000 dollars for 4 nights! Hire someone to come in a real cook and taste your foods! You will then see the truth about your foods! You have some serious issues to address in the food side of things! I pray you spend some time and money figuring out the food issues! It would help your hard workers make more tips and better pay for their families! And they wouldn’t have to carry all the food both ways because it did not even get ate! We are telling you go order the fake cheesecake and go order sushi from lemon fish! If you can eat it let us know! I would love to see you eat an entire slice of cheesecake and an entire roll of that sushi with out having any issues. If you want to hear the rest of the complaints like how cabanas outside being 250 dollars to rent. Or listen to a 45 minute meeting for a timeshare called circle to get a free cabana come on do better. 🤦🏻‍♂️. All the cabanas were wide open with no one in them and you still wouldn’t let people use them even with no open free chairs. 🤦🏻‍♂️ Or people leaving towels on chairs and asking your workers to hold seats for them that are first come first serve! If you get up and leave the chairs then they are open! You can’t hold chairs for someone that leaves! If I owned the place I would want someone to tell me! Constructive criticism! Kinda hard to tell people issues when you are not sure which ones are nice and which ones are rude! Again the only thing which was just absolutely stunning we’re the grounds and the pool and the beach! And a few hard workers that had great attitudes! I would start fixing the food that is the most important!

reviews.author: Sofia Machuca
reviews.text: We are circle members and always stay at the paradisus playa del Carmen. We decided to book here expecting the same accommodations and service as the one we always receive from PDC and this resort is far from being there. We doubt we will be coming back…

reviews.author: Stefan Rosinger
reviews.text:
Horrible place. Avoid at all cost! 0 stars

We have been there before in Dec’21. We had initially only ‘Purple’ wristbands we purchased through Costco Travel and wasn’t All Inclusive. Had no access to red-white wine and got upsold on some cheap IPA bottles, all charged extra. After the original room was too noisy (DJ in Building 3) we got a different room where noise level was acceptable, but it was required to upgrade to The Reserve. Even after that we had extra items to pay for. It’s not “all inclusive”, it’s “some stuff is inclusive, but what you would really like you have to pay for”. Horrible. Will not come again.

reviews.author: Arman Amb
reviews.text:
This hotel is not a 5 star hotel, maybe a 2 star hotel if that.

The food sucks, the service is even beyond that, they’re doing construction in the hotel with wood dust everywhere, banging drilling sounds throughout your trip. Nobody warned us about this!

The “suite” is worst than a motel 6, half the things don’t work in there.

My room was flooded, my balcony door wouldn’t open, never got room service when I ordered.

The pool water is below level so it’s not being filtered.

So many issues I just can’t seem to process. Do not stay here! This is a horrible hotel, I would not stay here for FREE. Unfortunately I was part of a wedding or else I would’ve left the first day! Oh and they screwed the wedding up to!

reviews.author: Tomik Boghozian
reviews.text: Hotel is nice. DO NOT go to the presentation they have, they will offer you a bunch of free stuff to do a presentation. Josue gave us false promises and wasted 4 hours of our day, none of the promises were made. I would like to do a huge complaint on Josue, Alberto at the beach, managers Marta and Malu, they embarassed us in front of the whole hotel. Never booking Melia again.

reviews.author: Hi it’s Cii
reviews.text: I went for my birthday and tried to make the most of it. Don’t do the reserve is a waste of money the area is far from everything. the food in the lobby has flies because it’s just left out and it’s under construction there was so any issues they need to fix we had roaches in our room and unfortunately that video was the only one I got on film. It’s a nice property but the need to finish all the leaks and issues.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Dyer
reviews.text:
Honestly, I don't understand how this resort could have so many 5 star reviews.  Granted, we booked this hotel using Melia Vacation Club and not on the Reserve side.  That being said, this review is primarily based on our experience with Melia, as well as some aspects of the hotel itself.

The MVC check-in process was slow as they only had one person working the desk with multiple families checking in.  The original room we received was ocean view, but completely drab and void of any character whatsoever.  A picture of the room cannot be found on any website, including their own.  It was like a bait and switch.  We saw pictures of a Reserve room and then were put in a room that doesn't look like it has had an occupant in 20 years.  All white walls, basic bed, dated bathroom and not clean.  Missing amenities like hair dryer, iron and towels.  It's like they put us in a room that was not prepared, cleaned or serviced for guests.

After complaining, they moved us to another room.  The room was bigger, but was not ocean view.  They said they didn't have any ocean view rooms left and could not accommodate us regardless of our ocean view reservation.

The Melia side of the resort is older and not clean.  The floors are dirty and the rooms as well.  The new room also had a broken safe that you could not lock, no iron, and lights that did not work.

The highlight of this hotel were the cockroaches, which my wife is deathly afraid of.  There was a cockroach in the buffet, dead in the hallway and one that nestled into my wife's makeup bag during the stay.  For this alone, we will never ever stay at this resort again.

Furthermore, the pools are not heated.  The first few days of the trip were raining and the ocean was too rough for young children and the swimming pool was an ice bath.

The food at the buffet isn't bad, but the restaurants are not worth it.

We've stayed at many All-Inclusives across Cancun and Riviera Maya and we can safely say that the Paradisus is one of the worst.  I understand reviews are relative to the individual and their experience staying at these types of resorts, but believe me, there are much much better options.

reviews.author: Shekira Dennis
reviews.text: My stay was absolutely horrific. Please do not spend your time or money here, the rooms, restaurants and service were incredibly subpar. My room looked nothing like what was advertised and reeked of a mildew smell through the ventilation system. I was so uncomfortable that I chose not to stay the night. I requested a taxi and was given a sketchy “taxi service” that was unsafe as the driver had no sense of direction and attempted to charge me a random rate and immediately needed to stop for gas. The restaurants are also incredibly sketchy with random mystery meats that were absolutely gross coupled with terrible customer service. If I could give zero stars here I would, it was really just that bad. I am just glad that I was able to get out of there safely and to another resort…truly  a waste here.

reviews.author: Marysol
reviews.text:
Where to start ... Cancun always was our favorite getaway place for me and my family. My daughter got married at Ocean Coral & Turquesa Hotel in Puerto Morelos Mexico. It was so magical and beautiful. My eldest son decided to get married at the Fiesta Americana Cancun and again they went above and beyond to make their wedding magical. Since the both weddings were amazing my youngest son chose Paradisus for his wedding, assuming he would have the same experience like his siblings. He assumed it would be even more spectacular since this hotel was more expensive and a five-star hotel, but it turned into a nightmare leaving a bitter taste.
WE WERE WRONG. They served completely the wrong meal plate that we chose on the wedding day. They forgot some tables (we thought they already served them) and served the meal very late. Instead of giving the meal of steak and chicken, with pasta and veggies, they served meat with a spoon of potatoes for 1 plate, and chicken with potatoes for the next one. There was not even a choice for guests, they had to eat what they were served. If you asked for chicken instead (the other dish they were serving) they refused to give it to you. Guests were swapping meals with each other at their table. Embarrassing.
The worst part was the wedding card box. It was not given to us at the end of the night. When we went to pick up the box the next day, there was cash missing and some of the card envelopes were open and missing. When we spoke to the manager, Jose, he declined the robbery and he refused to show us the footage, as they have cameras all over the hotel.
They took responsibility for the meal confusion by offering a SPA TREATMENT
after spending $25000 USD for 55 ppl. This is what they offered.. I NEVER FELT SO INSULTED LIKE THAT DAY.
After escalating the matter to a higher level, they offered to refund $800, which we HAVEN'T receive yet
It was a very stressful week … I'm very shocked.
If my first daughter's wedding was like this I would never encourage a destination wedding..
Some other issues…
*Rooms were old and outdated. The floor was stained with shoe spots. I had to take a picture and show the front desk so they would come and clean it.
*The Bath tub was dirty with a ring of mold around the top of it.
*The buffet was very basic. The same standard food everyday. A lot of stew dishes, which seemed to be leftovers from the day before. Long line ups waiting for eggs, as there was only one chef. It felt like a continental buffet, not special at all.
*Very outdated way to make reservations for restaurants. Reservations were very limited. I was only able to make one reservation at 9 PM for the entire week I was there! They make it hard for you so you are forced to eat at the buffet.
*Went to the pool and it looked like someone vomited, we called for assistance it took them one hour to come.
*The beach shower was broken. No water to wash your feet from the sand.
*Hard to get towels for the beach.
* The alcohol drinks were very poor quilty. Definitely not intentional brands.
I have photos of everything  that I mentioned but unfortunately it doesn't  allow me to post.

Paradisus is a 3 star hotel with a lot of improvements needed.. far from 5 stars. YES, there were a few good things but unfortunately all of the bad things overshadow the good..
Bad management, Bad food, Bad wedding. So sad

reviews.author: Mehak Idz
reviews.text:
Such an anti climax hotel. Rooms are so tight and small, they had to get the furniture out to get in the crib. In buffet, the food is same both at lunch and dinner time.  There are numerous plumbing issues, toilet was clogged, sink is now clogged.  When i plugged in the iron, the electric sockets tripped.  Been an hour and still no one came to check. The food at private resturants is also bland and average. Coconut water is extra cost. Room AC is not cooling.
We are spending $600 USD per night, and this is the service we are getting.  So disappointed.
Last time we stayed at dreams sapphire  resort and our experience was so much better. This hotel is more expensive but so anti climax and not worth it.

reviews.author: Sarah Lindquist
reviews.text: Beware of this hotel!! We had a multitude of safety concerns, the first being that a little girl almost drowned there within an hour of our arrival at the pool. Staff not lifeguards knew what to do and it took emergency personnel almost thirty minutes to arrive to respond. Fortunately, she was ok after someone was able to perform mouth to mouth , but no one including the lifeguards had seen her in the pool or knew how long she had been underwater and unconscious. After seeing this entire scene firsthand with our two young children we decided we needed to end our stay early both for the safety of our children but also because of the trauma we had witnessed and being unable to relax or enjoy our stay after that. It’s been over a week and my husband has followed up with them 7 times since we have requested a partial refund for the nights we didn’t stay due to feeling unsafe. He has been disconnected 4 times now and assured that management is “handling it” yet is never allowed to speak with an actual manager despite multiple requests. They continue to avoid his calls and pass him off to their “financial” department which never answers their phone. My husband happens to be a lawyer so unfortunately the next step for us will be to file a lawsuit for our reimbursement that they could have easily granted us instead of delayed and evaded. I would HIGHLY caution anyone considering traveling here about this resort and company’s ethical and moral proceedings and etiquette. We have never been treated as poorly and with less professionalism and compassion as we were At Paradisus Cancún.

reviews.author: Zehra Quadri
reviews.text:
If you can stay somewhere, please do yourself a favor and do it. Save your $ for a resort where you feel welcome instead of trapped. For one, this is an outdated resort- but I could look past that. Before I begin on what made me hate my experience I would like to highlight 1) our concierge was attentive 2) the YHI spa was excellent- Lilian (my spa tech) was probably the only highlight 3) the room was very clean
Now on to the problems.
1) The shampoo/conditioners are in refillable bottles. I felt both were watered down or just downright awful quality. My entire family's hair was feeling damaged after each shower.
2) We paid extra for "The Reserve" experience. Now we've stayed at other hotels/resorts before and when you pay this extra fee- you are PAMPERED! Not here. Once we entered the resort, instead of walking us to the special "reserve" side, someone at the front gave us half sleepy instructions on how to find our way to the special side. Nothing special once we made it there either, three men behind the check in counter- all look distracted, bored and just want to get people away. Which brings me to my third point
3) The staff! this was by far the most drained out, bored and unfriendly staff in general. I heard other guests talk about this too. They have a "you're on your own buddy" attitude. Not room service- that was always on time and on point but at other resorts, the staff feels like family by the time you leave- they make you feel so welcome. The staff can really make or break the environment. At Paradisus, they break the environment. They will be standing starting at walls but don't smile and look very unhappy. The gentleman who serves ice cream was rolling his eyes at kids. Also, at this "kid-friendly" resort they were usually out of the whopping 4 flavors they offered with terribly generic tasting toppings
4) I have never gone to a 5 star Resort to find NOTHING in the room upon arrival. At our other resort, the staff left cute dessert on our dresser daily. Here, not even on the first day did we receive anything special
5) our mini bar and snacks were not stocked after the first day- you had to keep calling for basic things like water
6) This is not a hotel problem but it does matter if you're going there to "relax" but the beach space for the # of guests this hotel has to host is a joke. The beach is a crammed 0.5 mile spread ....its the location, its squeezed next to other resorts. It didn't matter what time you went, it was so packed there was hardly space to sit. The Cabana cost was $200 per day - and if you didn't get that you are pretty screwed with not many seating options
7) For" entertainment" they have music blasting until midnight in the middle of the hotel lobby. We didn't see any beautiful performances or variety. Just different singers each night.
8) They only have two pools- one for adults one for family.
9) You will be pushed to attend an onsite meeting - probably to sell timeshare, but we just avoided it at all costs

There's a lot that made this trip a regret- which is not something I say lightly. But it was a lot of money spent on an incredibly underwhelming trip. We have stayed at another resort and EVERY SINGLE thing from the people, to the pools, the variety of entertainment to the service....impeccable! I never write reviews but wanted to save time (and money) for anyone I can.

reviews.author: Joanna
reviews.text:
Terrible! Can’t believe it is a five-star hotel!  I just stayed 4 nights but there were problems every day! Plus, Loud AC,aged furniture, lobby party till 11 pm . Here is the list: D1: upgraded to reserve room but the butler let us waited for 2 hours . We found a used fossil by last customer . D2: bathroom ceiling is leaking at 10 pm , reception recommended us wait in room just for repair . We have to bring our luggage to the lobby and directly ask for a change room and it’s almost 11 pm. D3 : The cleaning lady did not come during the daytime. And left dirty towels in the bathroom after we called the cleaning service at 10pm. D4: the MOST Ridiculous !The other family opened our door with their digital key while our family members were taking a nap. At least they saw stuff in the room, so they stopped walking in! But everyone was shocked! Based on the above facts,  we’ve contacted customer services several times, been told  have never reported to them by different staff. They were trying (pretending )to help us. Until the last day when we checked out, the service manger told us will meet us before leave, other staff answered us he will be here later but 5 fives mins later, said he’ll be here afternoon. Only then did we ask to call the manager. He showed up in the next few mins. This hotel ‘s service is a cheating game! Please don’t reply to never showing on your records! It’s not the truth! Family! Never ever stay here and screw up your vacation! Obviously, it's not worth paying 700 a night ！ ！！
Update after the Owner’s replay: I sent email the day after(4/17)  I checked out ( because no one gave me answer when we were in hotel , even been told they will fix it  and apologizes ). Didn’t get any reply yet.
They do nothing but talk.

reviews.author: Junaid Syed
reviews.text: We went to the steak restaurant. The service was poor. Steak was so tough that I couldn’t eat it. The person waiting on us so rude. I have been coming to Cancun for the last 20 years and never had an experience of waiter behave so rudely as well as his manager. First and last time in this hotel. I stayed here because my friend was staying here. They’re a lot better all inclusive hotels in Cancun. Consider other hotels.

reviews.author: Deivi Grullon
reviews.text:
Paradisus passed from be my favorite hotel in Cancun to the worst. This was my worst experience in Cancun in the last 10 years. The Melia group need to put more attention to this property because for my the architecture of this hotel is the most beautiful in Cancun because represent the Mayan culture with its pyramids.

* They are a lot of leaks around the hallways
* The rooms are a bit outdated.
* The facilities in the room are old, the doors did not feel safe because it doesn’t have any door latch for when you sleep.
* They do not have a simple stuff like a coffee maker in the rooms.
* The Wi-Fi does not reach the beach.
* On the beach the waiter just focus in the VIP area if you are outside of this place you must look for your drinks and food.
* In the pool I found an exposed wire that can be so dangerous for the guest.
* In the pool you could tell from afar that it needs water.
* The water in the pool was extremely dirty, the water was very cloudy, apparently the filter does not work or they have not replaced it for a long time.
* I never saw someone testing the water condition something that need to be done a least twice a day.
* They do not have enough chairs for the number of guests in the pools. If you want you can rent a bed for a ridiculous price of $250.00 dollars per day.
* The pool have mosses around the edge.
* Bathroom faucets are loose.
* In the shower ceiling was mold.
* In the bathroom they only place 3 towels knowing that the reservation was for 4 people.
* The towels are quite old.
* Reading lamps in bed do not stay in position.
* The mini bar was never refilled in my lodging at Paradisus.
* Some of the people was rude and looks like the are tired.

reviews.author: Latitia Andrews
reviews.text:
ROBBED BY A CLEANER IN A 5 STAR RESORT

I stayed here with my partner who has been to this hotel previously first few days great service is amazing and so is the hotel, friendly staff and they would do anything to please you here. As we was packing our bags on the last day I realised that money had gone out of my bag and the only person who had been in our room was a cleaner - this ruined my whole stay this is somewhere I would of potentially gone back to in the future however now I will not return - I reported this to the hotel who then said they would investigate this I have not heard anything back they also didn’t seem shocked that money was taken from my bag so this must be a recurring issue in the hotel not something you expect in a 5 star resort !!! Extremely disappointed

reviews.author: patty mata
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel, horrible service and experience,
We had 5 room in the Reserve area, and when arrive only 2 where available, and the money was not reimbursed. Dint even think of paying extra for this service of you have kids with you not worth it at all since pool and restaurant that is exclusive for this is onky adults and rooms have a glass showers
First night we arrive at 7 by the time check in it was 9, one person helping us, we had no reservation for any restaurant so only walk in was buffet and tacos, we decided for the tacos and it took 2 hours for them to serve us, only one cooker fir all the people their.
3rd day my daughter in law was missing money form her belongings she fought she misplace it, 4th day she was missing $100 more. Same day at 7:30 pm someone when inside their room without knocking and when ask who it was since she was in the shower they just said do you need towels. I reported all this and till now I have had no resolution, once we check out they offer a free upgrade for next time we stayed at the location, which I decline since it will not be a next time!
Oh almost forgot one of the reserved bedrooms we got was so hot that we where sweeting at bight next morning as for a room change and they said it was not possible that they will fix the ac maintenance went but I did not see a big change they said that the ac was working well, bit I would enter the other room and it was so much colder than mine, they just help us with 2 fans.
Receptionist, and management is horrible,
Other staff like pool waiters and cookers where super friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Dennis
reviews.text:
This was the first leg of our 2 1/2 week trip to Mexico. WE really wanted to like this place. I stayed at Melia Levels Dominican Republic years ago and had left with a good experience.

Angela was great help and an absolute gem at the Front desk!
The air freshener burns out noses through our masks, the daily noise and dust  from renovations in the main building each day.
The buffet food was not fit for human consumption.  Out of everything, the corn soup and mashed potatoes were the best part. At night time I would see the Mc Donald's sign from across the street craving for a decent meal.

Although I noticed no one would tip during our stay.
We tipped all of our servers $3 usd at buffets and $5 usd at the restaurants.
Which honestly felt like it didn't make a difference to the staff, and it felt more like I was tipping out of charity than good service.

The search for beach towels and chairs felt like were were in some pay as you go resort. You have to search and hunt for available beach chairs.
The beach was horrible, you cannot walk 3to 4 feet into the water,  all shards of seashells.
The rooms were old not renovated does not have a smart TV
Stay clear of this place if you expect quality and service.

reviews.author: Madelyn
reviews.text:
I have never in my life experienced such a poorly run property. We ended up switching resorts after the first night because of how horrendous everything was. The check-in took 7+ hours where they tried to nickel and dime us and charge us twice for our reservation. At first they wouldn't even let us wait inside the lobby and forced us to wait on the curb without allowing us to have any food or water. Double check everything they are charging you for because they will try to scam you out of every penny. We stayed one night, and the food was average but the drinks were horrendous. Not one bit of alcohol and the margaritas were blue for some unknown  reason.

DO NOT STAY HERE. We ended up leaving after 1 night because the staff was so unkind and not helpful at all. They wouldn't even address us after we pointed out the inconsistencies in our billing and literally ignored our group. We walked over the hotel next door and it was a 180 and we ended up having a phenomenal vacation there.

reviews.author: Kevin Sharpe
reviews.text: Having stayed in Cancun a number of times at other hotels, I would definitely not recommend this hotel or Hotels.ca. In fact, I will not be using either again. The first night at the hotel I spent most of it arguing with both Hotels.ca and Paradisus, as they both accused each other of having a “no refund” policy. I had merely wanted to add an additional person onto the all-inclusive plan at the Hotels.ca rate of $130 total. I was told by the hotel that the only options I had were to either pay $200 per night or cancel my reservation and rebook – forfeiting my entire payment. After 3.5 hours dealing with both the hotel manager and Hotels.ca, I finally gave up and paid the “special” rate of $150 per night. After refusing to stay in the room they provided (right above the bar), we were moved to an “upgraded” room with a Jacuzzi tub on the balcony and a king bed. If I had to rate the room, I’d say it was pretty similar to what you’d find at a 2 star back home. The mirror in the bathroom was in need of repainting, the towel rack listed to one side, water kept seeping into our bathroom from underneath the walls, and every time we used the Jacuzzi the power would go out and we would have to call maintenance to come up and get it back on. The other issues were more minor irritants that I would not have expected from a supposed 5-star resort, such as leaking roofs that required staff to place towels on the floors, a "stocked mini-bar" consisting of 2 bags of plain chips and the only all-inclusive wine being a house Chardonnay. For the overall price there are far better hotels to stay at in Cancun.

reviews.author: Brooke Ray
reviews.text: By far the worst "all-inclusive" resort I've ever stayed at. First of all the rooms that are advertised online are not the rooms at the actual resort. (Might be different for the reserve guests). If you are not a reserve guest, don't even bother booking a stay at this resort. My room reeked of a foul smell. I didn't even get the double bedroom that I asked for when I made the reservation. The night crew doesn't answer the phone. The list goes on, but these are my top 3 reasons why this is the worst resort I've ever stayed at.

reviews.author: Mike Zeitlin
reviews.text: Horrible Horrible!!!! DO NOT GO HERE.. lets start off when you come in you have to wait 20-30 min to be serviced then once you are booked they pass you off to an associate ( sales person  ) who befriends you explain you they lay out and subtly lets you know certain places in an all inclusive are off limits or will cost you $$$ to eat it or visit next go to your suite that looks nothing like the photos it is much older than the photos and the ac sounds like your in a factory continue your way to the buffet  and you will have sub par quality food and big selection but nothing to write home about if you booked the restaurant (they are mostly empty but they require reservation ) you will sit down look at the menu make a request to change something from the menu and they will let you know you will have to ------PAY (in an all inclusive ) continue your way to the beach sit in beach bed and they will demand $180 wait in an all inclusive you have to pay  they have zero activities they have zero customer service they ask for tips ever turn you take and the icing is the associate whom we will now refer to as a sales person follows you until you relent and agree to see a presentation for their scam time share program they will offer you a discount at the spa that is over priced for this specific reason to use a bargaining tool   they will not stop to bother you and chase you and ruin your vacation their "spa" has a hot bath that measures no higher than 65 degrees Fahrenheit and the employee tells us that management knows and does not want to fix it.....

reviews.author: W. G. Chapman
reviews.text:
My husband and I were so disappointed! We were used to the 5 star service and food of Cancún resorts and hotels that we have visited through the years.

This is NOT one of them!

The actual resort was beautiful in all public areas, but everything else was lacking.
The first day of our arrival, we walked into our ocean view Royal Service room to find it already occupied. We were then moved to another “ocean view room” that had views of shrubs and pool cabanas. The air conditioning did not work and the room and common area intermittently smelled of raw sewage. The two wash clothes in the room were never replaced by housekeeping and the coffee, tea, and waters were only replaced once in a 5 day stay.. We had two coffee cups that were never replaced after use, but they did rinse one and leave it next to our bathroom sink.We came back into  our room one day to find our TV setting preference of language changed from English to Spanish.
The absolute worst thing was the food. I literally spat food out due to how awful it tasted. We had omelettes that were both burnt and ice cold. Cheesecake that tasted like a wax display, and pizza that made school cafeteria food seem gourmet. We finally found out that they could make French fries and could slice cheese. We bought packaged crackers (the Buffett only had soggy, stale crackers), picked up some sliced cheese and made meals of cheese and crackers.
My husband and I are in our 50’s and have never in our lives been served such awful food. We are not picky or high maintenance people, but I believe prisoners are served better food.
I would never recommend this resort.

reviews.author: martin ma
reviews.text:
Well, hotels looks good when I fist came in but then I found out it's below my expectation.

1. Going back to google reviews, I also believe hotel is paying for good reviews, do look at the down reviews that are real.

2. My room smells bad and could not find what caused the problem.

3. Food is okay but not too much choices, hard to get reservations for the time you want.

4. Beach and pools are very good.

reviews.author: Anum Mithani
reviews.text:
We come to Mexico often and have stayed at several resorts and undertand 5 star luxury. I am absolutely clueless as to how this resort can be considered 5 star. I would say 3.5-4 max. For many reasons:

- The food is like HORRIBLE. Like really, really bad.
- Cheap liquor, no don Julio, don’t even have the good stuff available
- not kid friendly what so ever. The kids were bored within the first 2 hours.
- the hotel is a boiling room. There is no AC in any of the areas and the lobby is a closed lobby so no ocean breeze either. I was literally sweating bullets even at night
- no on site club/disco. It was just down
- they nickel and dime you for everything in every way. Room service is only free first two times. Then there is a charge. There are many other ways they charge
- service is sub par.
- beach had seaweed. The better water is on the top of 7 near Hyatt Ziva.
- AC in the room barely works.
- the buffet is not labeled, no one knows what anything is.
- it’s difficult to get reservations at the restaurants
- ocean front dining options are very few. Not a good beach front restaurant while you swim.
- it’s so hard to find water bottles. Only in the lobby and bars.
- we had a bug climbing on our seat at the restaurant.
- absolutely NOTHING for kids…
- terrible variety and quality at the buffet
- no slippers or robes in the room
- nothing to do very few activities and amenities
- no towel service upon arrival
- people are not walking around and serving you throughout the resort.

Pros
- the balcony was nice
- the hotel is very zen and has beautiful greenery and is designed aesthetically.

There are SO many better resorts. I’m not sure why anyone but book This unless it’s way cheaper which it isn’t. They have no competitive advantage and nothing great about it. Not sure why anyone would stay her e.

After our first night, we happily left the resort. Paid more to stay somewhere else but it was worth every penny. Every minute we were at this resort we were just like WHAT? This sucks. I feel bad for those that stay there.

reviews.author: Irine Thomas
reviews.text: Worst experience at the restaurant “Lunch Box”. Me and my husband took the reservation at 9pm and there was NOT any rules mentioned in any place. When we got there a staff named Salma were rude and insulted us by bringing up the dress code. Where you guys says the dress code ??? Our whole day got spoiled and aggravated. The manger was helpless and didn’t give us any options to have our dinner. We had to skip the dinner. Not recommend to anyone and beware of rude attitude from the staff.

reviews.author: Ladan Amin
reviews.text:
First of all, Hotel was under reconstruction therefore it was very noisy all day long from 8 am to 8 pm! which also caused dusty and dirty air in the hotel. We did not receive any notice about that otherwise we would modify our booking. Because of this situation we tried to spend all day outside.
Moreover, my husband and I booked a room with an ocean view and a single king bed but what we got was two separate twin beds which was extremely annoying. I asked reception to change the room even with a lagoon view and more quiet room but apparently they did not have any available room! In general the staff were not helpful at all!

reviews.author: christine riccardi
reviews.text:
Dilapidated hotel with the worst customer service. The most outdated rooms from 1990 and food was exceptionally low quality. I own two Meliá timeshares and one of them is here at the paradisus Cancun.  I actually upgraded to the Reserve and was staying with a friend to celebrate her birthday. I have been completely embarrassed.  Our room had no air conditioning. The Reserve check in with Manuel was the rudest person there. Unhelpful. Unfriendly. Wasted four hours waiting to find a room with air conditioning.
Went to have dinner at 5 pm hoping room would cool off. Completely empty but without a reservation they refused to seat us at The Lunch Box.
Buffet has overcooked meats loaded in sauces and super tough and chewy.
Marisol put me in a room for one night but never showed up to let me in.
Spent day two of vacation looking at other rooms and never spent one night in The Reserve after spending $835 additional on top of my membership fees and the all inclusive fee of $1000 for two people. Complete and total rip off.  Butler did NOTHING for all that money. Unable to get dinner reservations through him. Never responded to our group chat.  Promised everything and supplied nothing.
Our room never had waters or sodas added to the refrigerator. Never had snacks.  Once we left Tower 5 they never helped again.
The metal in the bathrooms is corroded and dated. Furniture is broken. We didn’t even have a coffee maker.
The second floor hallway had a huge leak from ceiling with a garbage trolley trying to catch the water. Everyone slipped in the huge puddle on the floor. Someone dripped chocolate ice cream up three flights of stairs Monday and it’s still there Thursday.  Filthy. Will never upgrade to Circle.
I e been here before and cannot believe how bad the employees are. I stayed at Meliá Playa del Carmen in March and cannot believe it is the same brand.
Paradisus Cancun has fallen into disrepair and subpar quality. I only wish I could get a refund to this embarrassment.

reviews.author: D Jones
reviews.text: Me, my husband and THREE children arrived here looking forward to a fun filled vacation which turned our being a LITERAL NIGHTMARE!! Honestly, it was so bad that to type all of it would be reliving it all over again. Just see the pictures and imagine the NIGHTMARE of having 5 tired people who flew in from Chicago and opened the hotel room door to THIS!! This was disputed and heavily documented and I STILL HAD TO PAY THE ROOM CHARGES since they moved us TWO DIFFERENT TIMES AND WE ENDED UP IN A ONE BEDROOM- THOUGH I PAID FOR A 2 BEDROOM SUITE FOR FIVE PEOPLE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Mario Rapo
reviews.text: First impressions of this resort were as follows. Great looking resort many amenities etc... Upon arriving we where greeted by our butler however they told us that there was a problem with our reservation. Because we had purchased Royal service and had a child apparently children are not allowed to that section. Moved us to family concierge and told us that we would have to pay extra, Mind you we spent about $5,000 for 5 nights for 3 people we requested an ocean view. They assured us they would out us in a great room, no problem. We arrived at the first room it had no ocean view the beds where stained, bathroom was in terrible condition and our view was only the rear of a building. After arguing for about an hour or so they had put us in a partial ocean view family concierge. However the service is not up to par. Food is not that special considering half the items are frozen and not even fresh. Drinks are watered down too to the point where there is no alcohol. When there is rain the whole hotel pretty much gets flooded. Overall very dissatisfied and overly priced resort for nothing. Terrible experience if i could give it 0 stars i would!!

reviews.author: Jeff wallen
reviews.text: I went with a work trip for me. It seemed as though every time I booked a tour I came back to the room to find things missing. Even out of the safe that was lost. $1200 in cash was missing, my cell phone, other items as well as even our perfume and cologne. I believe security was responsible. I made a report and sent letters and nothing in response. I had to wait for security to rummage through my room three times and each time I knew it was them. Because they were the only ones that have the key to the safe. I believe the tour booking people were in on it with security. Each night we went somewhere different was when things were missing as if they knew. Nothing has been done and I spoke to others while there that have the same things happening to them.

reviews.author: Eun Ha
reviews.text: This is our second time at Paradisus Cancun, and I have to say I am disappointed. We checked in yesterday after a long day of traveling. I think it may have taken a hour; the check in agent and her supervisor gave me a hard time about an upgrade I had verified with the hotel before we arrived. After they verified the upgrade, she asked if we would be needing the room all day because the “upgraded” room would be near construction from 9 to 5. At this point I was exhausted and my son had woken up from his short nap crying. I gave up on the upgrade and asked her for a room. She placed us in an “ocean view” room right next to the door where we can see guests go back and forth between the hotel and the pool. I wonder if our original room would have given us more privacy. What horrible customer service. It didn’t help that our dinner at Bana last night was pretty bad. We like visiting Cancun, and luckily there are many other hotel options. I don’t think we will be back here again.

reviews.author: Bao Hoang
reviews.text: I stayed here for ember shores music festival early December for my birthday. I paid a $200 deposit and was given a deposit receipt that was to be returned at checkout to receive my deposit back. I returned the receipt at checkout and was told 3-5 business days to receive my deposit. I never received my deposit back and tried to contact Paradisus but they were no help. I filed a dispute with my bank and now Paradisus is trying to argue that I was never supposed to receive my deposit back. Very poor service. Would definitely not recommend going here. I’ve had other festival goers going through the same experience

reviews.author: Yasmin Alsmadi
reviews.text: CURRENTLY staying at this resort and in all honesty it’s not worth the money. We originally was supposed to go to Moonpalace but changed it last minute because of everyone “hyping” this resort. Tip: if you pay extra to stay at The Reserve make sure ur room is on the top floor. Only a small part of it is Lagoon view. Because of the lay out, you don’t really pay for the view unless you’re lucky. Some rooms also do not have a door closing off the bathroom so you cannot open the front door without someone seeing into the glass shower. That’s another thing the bathroom is in the corner with a large window. If it’s a family staying in the room then you can not shower comfortably Bc u can literally see the person in the shower. The food honestly wasn’t that great and not many options. Requested multiple times for extra amenities and I had to speak to a supervisor for them to respond finally. All in all I would never come back to this resort. Should’ve used the money towards something more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Juan V
reviews.text:
My trip to this resort started from bad to worst. I never review unless it was an amazing experience or quite the opposite, as the latter is the case. I booked my trip thru my credit card rewards site (which I always do and never had a problem). I received email confirmation of my stay for a luxury junior suite for 5 guest (my wife and 3 children), yet when I arrived at the hotel to check in, they only showed 1 regular room for 2 adults. I went back and forth with them for 4 hours!!! At the end of it, I had enough and I had to pay for a new reservation for 5 guest for an additional $300. They honestly just gave me a small basic room with a street view. Definitely NOT what I paid for initially. They tried to switch blame to my credit card service but the issue was with their reservation department. They tried calling them but no one picked up.

While in the hotel, the food was subpar in the restaurants, reservations took a long time although their Concierge did try to help as much as she could. They have an additional charge for a cabana, and for their steak house. They really should remove the "all-inclusive" they claim.

And whoever was the genius that design the entertainment stage in the middle of the hotel with super loud speakers should be fire immediately! Super loud in the rooms when you're trying to sleep. I stayed last year in their Playa del Carmen hotel and enjoyed that stay, I was expecting better from their cancun location but sadly not the case. I WILL never stay with them again.

1 star for hotel upkeep. The beach was infested with seaweed as well, other cancun hotels have much better up keep in their beach. Also, it took them 30 min and 2 calls to their front desk to get extra sheets and pillows. Needless to say but I'm super disappointed at the current stay... and I still have 2 days left in my stay.  SMDH!

reviews.author: Matilda Beqiri
reviews.text: There were definitely pros and cons!                 Pros: the resort is beautiful, food and the waiting staff were very good! Cons: the rooms were very old and dirty! They only dusted the tv stand, but the closet door and bathroom door was covered in dust! The bathroom sink was plugged all our stay. We had to call every day to bring us drinking water, and we stayed there for two weeks! We bought something in the inside stores, but they don’t accept dollars, so they told us to either pay with pesos or charge it to the room! We charge it to the room without knowing that we had to pay extra for not paying it on time! So, something that costed $15, we ended up paying $37! Also, my baby got sick, and when I asked in the middle of the night about the doctor, they said that the doctor comes at 9am. When we saw the doctor, she said that they have a doctor 24/7  in the resort!

reviews.author: S
reviews.text:
Worst all inclusive resort I’ve stayed, least friendly staff, and overpriced for what’s available. The food is awful unless you make a reservation, which none of the staff seems to be on the same page about. Also, check in process was a nightmare. We were there for a festival but had to house friends of ours in rooms that WE paid for just so they had a place to sleep because of the resort’s incompetence. More of a spring break hotel than a Mexican resort. While I do believe the quality of the stay was tainted by the arrival of the festival, we stayed extra days beforehand and we’re equally unimpressed. Would not recommend this resort to ANYONE.

EDIT: The replier wants to make it seem like nothing was brought to anyone’s attention. The staff was well aware of the problems and neither the event staff nor the hotel staff seemed to care and continued to lead everyone on with borderline lies and no updates. Also it takes a simple stay at almost any other resort in the Playa/ Cancun area to realize that this is no more than a glorified hotel. Better service, better food, more options, nicer staff, etc. The list goes on. Again, we stayed before the festival multiple days also and it was also absolutely nothing to write home about.

reviews.author: Miriam Mickel
reviews.text: The resort was NICE! The views were so awesome. I enjoyed my stay at paradisus cancun for the most part. However, one bad apple does spoil the entire bunch. We stayed May 31-June 5. The cooks that were at Sunset Grill on that Monday and Tuesday were very MEAN! I did not get their names however, I did get the name of the drink server who was also mean. He would not ask us if we wanted anything to drink. He skipped over us every time. His name was Luis. He was an older guy. He made us feel like we were "different" especially watching him ask other people what drinks they wanted. My kids should never have had to experienced that! I don't care what "kind of person" the sunset grill cooks and drink server preferred to wait on. The cooks were not nice at all! When we asked for food (wings) they would tell us that we could not get any. The last time I checked, we paid for an all inclusive vacation so why where we denied food? The resort was great! If it wasn't for these two incidents, I would give the resort all 5 stars.

reviews.author: tanya vi
reviews.text: This is one of the worst hotels I’ve ever stayed. Wanting peace and quiet we asked for a quiet room multiple times, emphasizing that it’s our ONLY request. We checked in at about 5pm, checked the room (it was quiet) and guess what?  At 9pm some weird concert started right under our windows with MARCHING band and screaming. Imagine listening to repeating drum roll for 2 hours. I went back to the receptionist (it was the same one that checked us in) and she pretended we never asked for a quiet room... people here don’t give a heck about your comfort. On top of that food is just terrible, everything is greasy, unhealthy and over sweetened. And when they gave us door keys they didn’t work after 10 tries, so we had to run back to the reception, then back to the room (receptionist claimed we didn’t use the key right, that’s why it wasn’t working), then wait for the “technician” to fix the door lock for us (still standing with our language near the room) for 25 minutes...

reviews.author: K W
reviews.text:
We are here now and had $$$ stolen from our safe. Trying not to let it ruin our vacation but they are doing nothing to compensate us. Very upsetting, we have been melia club members for 20 years, typically go to Dominican Republic and never had any problems.we made a hand written report to security personell and then spent days chasing down a response .
Sadly the resort is beautiful , the staff is excellent. So we are not happy to have to make this review. We are vacation club members and after securites "investigation" was complete , it was basically decided ," oh well ".
The door jam in room 1214 is damaged and you can tell it's been forced in the past. Even after showing this they still claimed they couldn't reimburse us . They gave spa credits in the amounts of $100 not nearly the $450 that was stolen.
Most of the $$ stolen would have gone out as tips !! .
We will update as we continue to hold paradisus , sol melia and their vacation club accountable . The rest of our stay I carried our important documents , Nikon camera and anything important w us in a backpack . To be clear , we are not drama people and have NEVER. Made a theft claim in our 30 years of

reviews.author: Katie N.
reviews.text:
I'm writing this review with the intention to let other up-coming guests to learn my lessons so they have a more pleasant vacation. We paid for the highest package (Reserve) but what we received is absolutely not what we paid for.
1. They promised you butler services but you don't see him/her unless you ask for them. So don't wait, ask for them right away at the check in desk. Many rooms in my group never met their butlers. You mostly need the butler to book restaurant reservations for you because you cannot book it through their app. Most of the time there is no reservation available on the app. If it does, there are only 2 or 3 seats available. If you go in a group, it is very hard for you to dine together. What's the point of traveling together but cannot dine together? You can try to call the reservation line to book but you don't have a record of it. (You have evidence if booking through the app or texting butlers.) The reservation representative booked a reservation for my aunt and uncle but when they went to the restaurant, the restaurant didn't have their reservation, and my aunt couldn't prove it to them. So my aunt and uncle had to leave to eat at the buffet. My aunt was so upset because on top of that, they hadn't been able to dine together with us. Things like this can totally ruin your vacation, which you paid high price for. Restaurant managers should accommodate guests who tell you that they have a reservation. I'm sure this doesn't happen a lot.
2. Some adult families in our group who were also Reserve guests wanted to stay in building 5 (Reserve building) but no room was available. They asked for building 4, also no room was available. They ended up in the noisy and a lot of traffic building 3. Paradisus should check back on their guests if they are still wanting to stay in building 5 when rooms are available.
3. Food is OK, not great. There were a few dishes that were too salty. Mixed drink is pretty plain and hit and miss. I only see one restaurant that is great, which is the La Palapa, but this restaurant is only for breakfast and lunch and for Reserve adults only. We cannot take much advantage of it because we have our kids with us. Be careful when you're eating sushi and drinking water. Half of our group got diarrhea from eating at ENSO. You need to buy diarrhea medicine from their store, the front desk doesn't have anything for you. They have a medical office but the doctor will charge you $100-200/visit.
