Oh, and there's a sign saying you can only use the pool until 8 pm, which I think is unnecessary, especially since there was loud music playing until late at night.

reviews.author: Lucia Mendizabal
reviews.text:
3-Star Hotel
I spent a week at Paradisus Cancun, and while it was a pleasant stay, I expected much more.
Positive points: The food quality is very good, the Nespresso bar, the beach, and the service from the bar staff and Uriel!
Negative points:
1- Any drink or cocktail is served in PLASTIC cups. A hotel of this category shouldn't serve a margarita or a tequila shot in a plastic cup... Furthermore, the drinks are of poor quality, mostly domestic brands, and some are even homemade and kept in jugs.

2- An exaggeratedly tipping-dependent culture. They even "indirectly" asked for tips, and if you don't give them one, the treatment changes drastically and becomes very unfriendly.

3- Don't go with children. We went with 13-year-olds who weren't even allowed in many of the hotel's public areas, even though they were with their parents. It was a family trip, and because of this, we had to stay separated or go straight back to our room since they weren't allowed in.

4- The rooms were nice, but we had problems with the bathroom (which, despite complaining, was repaired several days later), and the minibar wasn't restocked every day, only every other day if we were lucky.

As constructive criticism, I'd like to add that it's a shame you can't make reservations for dinner at the restaurants. We were with a large group, and it would have been much more convenient (for them and for us) to have been able to reserve a table for everyone together in advance for each dinner.

reviews.author: Ralu Chavez
reviews.text:
I honestly don't know what to say exactly. I had very high expectations, but once we got here, everything changed.
The only good thing was the doctor, who helped us a lot when our son got sick.
The restaurant staff, if you don't give them tips, they won't even bother you. The food is far inferior to all the hotels we've been to before. You can barely find anything to eat at the buffet. We liked the food at La Capella and Agua Marina, as well as the pizza next to the pool. We also liked the tacos al pastor and the tequila at Blue Agave.
The jacuzzi on the terrace of our room didn't work, but at least we used it as a mini-pool for our son.
They say it's a family hotel, but they don't have slides or things for children in the pool. Also, tonight I went with my son to see the children's show, and at the end, the lady shared candy with the kids, but when she got to mine, the candy was gone, and my son was sad. The lady didn't even apologize and didn't come back to get him anything. Anyway!
Not to mention the negatives, I liked the cleanliness and the fact that they always brought us water for the mini-fridge in the room.
If we're ever going back to Cancun, it definitely won't be at this hotel!

reviews.author: Catalina Nicole Amoruso Ribera
reviews.text: The staff got angry if you didn't tip them. The electricity was quite unreliable, and the power went out once. The hotel itself was very nice, and I had no other problems. A very good vacation! 🥳

reviews.author: Edgar Israel Gutierrez Palomares
reviews.text:
This is my second time at this hotel. The first time was great; I was given a remodeled room and the service was excellent. But two years later, when I returned, it was the complete opposite. I was assigned an old room with outdated furniture and a bathroom.

On the other hand, the reception staff's service leaves much to be desired. They have a terrible attitude; from the moment you arrive, they greet you rudely, are arrogant, and don't even look you in the eye. They're not very communicative, and I got the impression they don't like receiving domestic tourists. Honestly, with that attitude, I have no desire to return to this hotel.

The good things I will acknowledge are: the food is very good, both at the buffet and in the specialty restaurants; the waiters are very attentive and always ready to provide good service. I especially want to commend Atilano, Martín, Fernando, and Orlando. The hotel beach is nice, with plenty of lounge chairs and umbrellas; the bars in the pool area are good, and there are waiters on the beach.

reviews.author: Natalia Erazo Ruiz
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice; the pools, restaurants, beach, and staff are excellent.

I have to mention a few things:
1. Upon check-in, we were given a room with two double beds facing a large, dark wall, even though we had reserved a king-size bed with a lake view. We told the receptionist that this wasn't our reservation, and she replied that even if we booked the room type we paid for, it wouldn't be the one we received. We made this reservation two months in advance.

2. The room cleaning service was disappointing. On two occasions, they didn't clean the room (it wasn't so much about cleaning, but about providing fresh towels and clean sheets). I had to call to have them come, something that had never happened to me before, and I've been to Cancun several times on all-inclusive trips.

3. Room service includes food, but you have to pay between $5 and $6 after the third order delivered to your room, so it's not fully included, and you have to call to have the dishes picked up, but sometimes they didn't come.

reviews.author: Marcela Pantoja
reviews.text: Good location, nice beach, but they need to significantly improve the quality and flavor of their food and drinks. Plus, you pay for an all-inclusive package, and when you use the facilities, you realize it's not all-inclusive and you have to pay extra to use certain areas, certain services, and even certain lounge chairs. There was a long line to get into the buffet; we didn't even get a seat at one of the included restaurants. Having a membership here doesn't guarantee you any benefits. I think it ends up being more expensive, and you realize it's expensive compared to the service you receive.

reviews.author: Luis Alberto Martínez
reviews.text:
The reception staff lacks much training.

They don't remove the sargassum from the beach. It's very annoying to swim in it...

The waiters in the restaurants are very attentive and friendly... the ones at the pool... there are very few and they take a long time to bring drinks...

The quality of the restaurants has dropped; the only notable thing is the Sante restaurant, which offers VIP service. And the SAL restaurant.

The buffet food is very bland, and the chilaquiles are very sour... the eggs are unsalted...

It's only worth staying at this hotel with a room in the Reserve or Nikté category.

reviews.author: Andrés Wehrle
reviews.text: Unfortunately, I didn't receive the level of service I'm used to from Meliá hotels. The food selection was very limited, and at breakfast, it took a long time to replenish the bread, cheese, fruit, and other items. What saved my stay were the spectacular service from Ramiro at the Malva Restaurant and from Cristian, Karina, and Gladys at the Ginger sports bar. On the negative side, I must highlight the very poor service and treatment I received from Ian at the Ginger bar.

reviews.author: Selma Alva
reviews.text: The service offered is completely uncompensated for the price. Waiters are either inattentive or rude, the minibar isn't restocked, and there's a clear bias towards foreign products. The food is nothing special and sometimes lacks flavor. The hotel is old and would appreciate some improvements, such as electrical outlets in the rooms or better door locks. The only good things were the decently equipped gym and the use of wristbands as room keys.

reviews.author: Graciela Gomez
reviews.text: If you're traveling in a group and don't plan on leaving the hotel, it's a good option. If your plan is to relax and enjoy personalized service, go somewhere else. This hotel caters to large crowds, with lots of people around, pool activities, children having fun, and large families. It's not worth going out since it's all-inclusive, so if you want to explore, look for a breakfast-only hotel. The service is good. The room is somewhat outdated, and only one of the cell phone charging outlets worked.

reviews.author: Claudia Bernal
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, our room had a clogged shower and cockroaches.
The rest of the facilities are good, with a nice view and several pools. The sea was very choppy, so we preferred to stay in the pool. The waiters' service was good. Breakfast didn't offer much variety; they had more sweet than savory options.

reviews.author: Poliana Coelho
reviews.text:
We've already been to another one of the same line, in Punta Cana, and it was flawless.
This one in Cancun, being a 5-star hotel, leaves much to be desired. From bathroom problems in the rooms to an elevator that fell with people inside!
The food wasn't great either. Plus, they were constantly standing in front of the pools offering excursions.

But the pools are great and the staff are very friendly.

reviews.author: ivan gonzalez
reviews.text:
The rooms are generally okay, but they feel outdated. There was a leak in the toilet that they supposedly fixed, but it kept happening. They no longer provide shampoo and bar soap, and they don't offer the complimentary goodnight greetings. The organization is poor, or there's bad communication, because when I arrived at the first room they gave me, they were painting it, and they gave me another one that hadn't been cleaned yet.
The buffet was mostly vegetables (about 80%), and the stews they had were very salty.
The service from some of the waiters was very, very bad; they had a terrible attitude. The pool had bits of trash floating in it—not a lot, but there were papers, leaves, and other debris. Oh, and please be careful with those who offer you a complimentary family photo, because in the end, the package they put together costs 9,000 pesos, and if you don't buy it, they get very rude. It's worth mentioning that the photos are very nice, but that's not the way to sell.

reviews.author: Fernando Mattera
reviews.text:
For the price of a single room (around $375 USD), the hotel could offer more and better services.

First of all, the buffet restaurant serves the exact same meals every day, and I'd give it a 6 out of 10, when it should be at least 8 or 9.
The waiters serve you listlessly and always with the clear objective of getting a tip, whether it's for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even just a drink. A clear example was that I stayed for 10 days, and every time I ordered juice in a specific glass for breakfast, they gave it to me in a much smaller one, even though I clearly specified the size. Inside, I was thinking, "Don't worry, I'll tip you anyway," but no. Furthermore, when they realize from your tone of voice that you're Argentinian, they treat you with a peculiar contempt: they hate you, but they can't say it outright. If that hatred stems from the fact that they can never beat us at the national team level in the World Cup, work on that. It's not our fault. In fact, for us, Mexico is just another rival, but the hatred in the air is more than evident… guys, I went because the company invited me. Honestly, if you want me to pay out of my own pocket, get your act together.
The only good thing is the artificial paradise that is Cancún. Goodbye forever.

reviews.author: Tony Ng
reviews.text:
My wife and I decided to stay at the Paradisus Cancun because of an attractive offer, but our experience revealed some issues to consider. Although the architecture reflects luxury, we discovered aesthetic problems, such as damaged walls, mold, and areas in urgent need of renovation.

Service varied among employees, lacking consistency and showing signs of overwork. We would like to highlight Rosana from customer service, who resolved a crucial issue. However, other interactions were less satisfactory, including a negative experience with a customer service representative.

The quality of the food in the restaurants did not match the aesthetics. The lack of flavor and preparation of the dishes contrasted sharply with the visual presentation. Furthermore, the process of getting a table was inconvenient, with no reservation system and long waits.

The pool showed signs of neglect, and the daily struggle for beach chairs highlighted the hotel's lack of control over this problem. Service, while acceptable at the pool, was slow on the beach, where a single waiter was insufficient to cover the entire area.

In summary, the Paradisus Cancun, despite its potential, needs substantial improvements to meet the expectations of a five-star hotel. We recommend an immediate renovation, better staff training, implementation of a reservation system, addressing the issue of beach chairs, and increasing beach staff. The decision to return will depend on future improvements and competitive pricing.

reviews.author: luis pedraza
reviews.text: I went to a conference and the hotel had poor communication with the travel agency. I was overcharged, and the manager never showed up even though I requested him. The person who checked me in and made me pay extra never contacted me again to explain the problem. In the end, I managed to get a refund through the agency. We had to tip at the entrance of each restaurant to receive good service. Although it's all-inclusive, I recommend bringing cash to incentivize the staff, especially in restaurants. We tried to book a parasail, but there was no communication between the hotel and the provider, so we didn't go. The food was good, the beach was very nice, the pool was good, the drinks were good, we saw some very expensive off-menu items, the view was spectacular, the rooms were comfortable, but the bathroom was dark and old. I suggest setting aside money for extras and tipping before receiving service. The price was reasonable.

reviews.author: Agustin Carbo
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and the beach is dreamy. The water is crystal clear. However, the hotel facilities and staff are inadequate for the number of guests. For example, if you go down after 9:30 am, you probably won't find a lounge chair on the beach or by the pool. I find this unacceptable. We spent two days with towels on the floor.

reviews.author: Vitor Gambassi
reviews.text: The hotel is quite impressive, with enormous ceilings and decor and structure reminiscent of cenotes. Everything is well-maintained, and the room is spacious and always very clean. The hotel is very close to the beach, as are the pool and some restaurants, making life much easier for those who are there to relax. The drinks are almost all top-notch, very good, and with very well-made cocktails. However, the food is quite weak. In every restaurant we ate at, something always went wrong, whether it was the food taking too long to arrive, being cold, or even bad (sometimes all of these things happened at once). The food was the hotel's weak point, a very weak point. One of the restaurants was under renovation, so they divided the breakfast and buffet among other, much weaker restaurants. On the last day, the restaurant opened, and we noticed the absurd difference it made, as it was truly much better than the others. This restaurant renovation was a rip-off, without any benefit to the customer who stayed there during that time. I do not recommend it because of this. We also had problems with the travel agency located in the hotel, OTIUM; we do not recommend them and ended up with a loss of $60. The hotel should look into this.

reviews.author: PDO Secretary
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay with our family (w/ young kids!). Facilities were beautiful and clean! Staff were very friendly and helpful. The highlight of our stay was our concierge, Fernanda, she was absolutely amazing and so helpful. She made our stay feel effortless and was so on top of things which made a big impact on our experience. She was in regular communication and easy to connect with, let us know of resort happenings daily, made all of our dinner reservations ahead of time, reserved us cabanas, set up a special welcome and later a birthday delivery for my husband, took care of everything related to our lagoon sunset cruise, and made sure we were taken care of completely from beginning to end. Our overall experience would not compare without her! She was so easy to communicate with and we saw her daily around the hotel. THANK YOU Fernanda, you're the best!
Some opportunity for growth in the resort: not all of our friends had the same experience. Some of us were given welcome drinks upon arrival, others were not. Our concierge was fantastic, but our friends had the opposite experience and no service from their concierge. Some of us were given a coupon booklet for things around the resort, and others were not. Would be nice for consistent experience for all. The food could also be elevated. We tried most of the restaurants and buffet and it was okay but nothing too great, seems like a lot of the same basic food. We also wished we could take stuff to go and eat @ the pool

reviews.author: Kristina Kamber
reviews.text:
Recently returned from a 5 day stay at the Paradisus Cancun. Upon arriving, we were checked in by Omar who was fast, efficient and very friendly, and greeted with a nice cold signature beverage.

The rooms are great, extremely clean and no issues with any amenities in the room. The beds were comfortable and everything met my expectations.

The grounds are extremely well maintained, from the lobby to the bars to the hallways, the staff were constantly cleaning to ensure a well manicured and clean resort.

We mostly stayed at the kiddie pool, it was warm and clean and  I think a good size for kids 8 and under . During our 5 day stay, there was one activity that my kids participated in and enjoyed. There was always ample seating.

The first day we arrived, we got to the pool snack bar closer to closing time so they didn’t have all the normal options available, we opted for fries and wings and pizza and it did the trick. The main buffet was less desirable the first night we arrived, the foods lacked flavoured ( not what you expect from Mexican cuisine) and it felt like there were more sides vs mains. The buffet later redeemed itself throughout the week with a great variety of fresh foods

I love that no reservations were needed for the al la carte, we tried th Mexican, the Mediterranean and Italian and had a great experience at all of them.

From the poolside staff to the waitstaff, everyone was great. I’m glad we went when it was a little on the quiet side to funny enjoy this resort.

While we didn’t go to the beach , there was very little seaweed and always palapa and beds available.

Overall great resort and look forward to returning

reviews.author: Daryel Rodrigues
reviews.text:
The hotel stay was very enjoyable overall. Guests who book Adult only accommodations get access to a private area, including the pool, lounge spaces, and cabanas, which is a nice perk. Dinner reservations are required, and wait times can be quite long, so it’s best to plan ahead.
The staff were consistently friendly, always smiling, and very helpful. The entire property was well-maintained and kept clean at all times. Service is generally good, though tipping does seem to make a noticeable difference in the level of attention you receive.
Overall, I had a great experience and enjoyed my stay.

reviews.author: Prissi Travels
reviews.text:
Great location, across the street from the Rosa Negra restaurants. Up the street from many clubs.

The hotel was was recently renovated. Rooms are comfy, beach is nice and wide but there was a bit of seaweed, which is normal this time of year. The pool was nice.

I was underwhelmed with the food. Ate at the Asian fusion restaurant and the buffet, and Italian - nothing was delicious. Friends stared the steak house was good, but there was an extra charge.

The resort just opened back up, so maybe the chef needs a few months to get his groove.

reviews.author: Chantal Alain
reviews.text: This place was great expect the resort wasn’t ready and prepared for all the people! Rooms were clean and nice but a bit small. Food was mediocre. But my favourite part of this resort was the manager at the SAL steakhouse  , manager Daniel was excellent and the waiter ignacio. Everything was  well prepared and food was amazing . If it was up to me Daniel would be running the whole resort because he was the only one managing excellently . Buffet was not good and they couldn’t keep up with the people and food , definitely go to the steakhouse it’s worth it !

reviews.author: Shruti Jajodia
reviews.text:
I went with my family and it was our first time in paradisus as well as in Cancun. The hotel is good with good views and lot of places to relax in. The concierge is very helpful. I would like to name Liza for helping us a lot. But the tour operator that they have, Otium tours, is really bad. They have half information with respect to tours. We took the Chichen classic with valladolid as a place to visit. But after boarding the bus, we got to know that Valladolid is not included. Upon asking to compensate, they are making all kind of excuses not to compensate it. Mr  Mauricio from Otium tours has been very rude with us. We are extremely unhappy with this service by Otium.

The thing we loved the most was their restaurants who customised food as per our requirement. We being vegetarians, Kao restaurant provided us with one of the delicious dinner with wontons, noodles, sushi, pizza and dumplings. Marco - the chef, Teresita and Ardiana for their out of the way service. Also Gastro Hall did give us a good service.

The room service was a late back. Had to call three to four times just to get water bottles and coffee mate.. yet they did not provide with the coffee mate.

Overall, had a good experience in the hotel.

reviews.author: Andy Farrell
reviews.text: Great location, service and food was acceptable. Hope you don't mind a hot and humid room because the air conditioning was worthless. Yes, I did bring it to management's attention to no avail. It averaged 96 degrees each day with 98% relative humidity. Good luck sleeping folks. Your call.

reviews.author: Skyler Cain
reviews.text: We have had such a great time! Roger, Melvin, Fernando the chef at the Italian restaurant and Andres at the bar were so nice and great! Made our stay so much better

reviews.author: Rich F
reviews.text: One of the better restaurants at the resorts. We were served by Edgar who was great. Made a great effort in his communication with us. The service was timely and professional.

reviews.author: Angeli Dela Cerna
reviews.text:
We stayed for 5 days at the 6th floor of Pyramid 3 which is the central location of the hotel. Our room was spotless everyday and the interior of the hotel looks relaxing and modern. After you’re done with the check in, make sure you download the Melia app to know the activities, events, room service, restaurant menus & opening time. Book dinner reservations right aways for 3 days as booth only opens 9am-4pm. If you arrive later like us, you can try walking in at any restaurants if they have available slot or go to Gastro Hall (buffet) as it doesn't need reservation. As for lunch, you can walk in anywhere as long as it’s open. For excursions, there is an Aquaworld booth near the pool area of the hotel. There building is just located outside the building across the street. If you want to go out, in downtown or mall. Ask the receptionist to book a taxi. for uber, you have to go out the building or ride a bus (R1 or R2) no need to cross the street.

Service: 10/10
Our family (4 adults+1 kid) loved going to Twe12lvet (coffee shop & ice cream shop) because of the Alejandro, Rosalia and Perla. They were always accommodating, hardworking, greets us all the time and smiles a lot even though they’re busy going back & forth in coffee station and ice cream station. We always say that the Twe12lvet is our comfort/happy place especially Alejandro, who takes time to have a quick chat with us. Special mention to Anna at the shack as well, she took care of us for 2 days. We always look for her if we are in the poolside. She’s so sweet, updates us all the time if we need something else and talks to us too.

Check in: 3/10
Check in was frustrating. We arrived at the hotel at around 3pm and it took us around an hour for the check in process. You can just see the staff going in & out of the door behind them. No staff is guiding the guests in line so even if you arrive first, you wont be catered right away, you have to guess where to line up and hope that the receptionist is fast in doing the checkin process. If only there’s no pillar blocking the left side of the counter, we would know who is available.

Restaurant: 10/10
Overall I enjoyed the food so much. We tried everything except SAL & Zesty. All the restaurants have different menus for lunch and dinner. All of the food and the staff were great. Exceptional service from Melvin of Capella and Omar from Vibra. Anna from the shack and Alejandro, Rosalia and Perla from the Twe12lvet.

Noise level: 5/10
We are the 6th floor and from our room we can still hear people outside. May be from the bar area at the 2nd floor.

reviews.author: Heidi Achin
reviews.text: Gerardo, Francisco, Sefirino, and Armando in the buffet area are fantastic!!   Such a great experience with the workers.  They made all the difference in our stay.

reviews.author: And Rew
reviews.text:
This was our second time family vacation at Paradisus. First time, everything was great, it made us return to the hotel. However the return wasn’t as great.
• Key points: booking a dinner reservation became a bit of a struggle, very limited options.
•AquaMarina was ok compared to the first time.
•Flora was a disappointment - restaurant wasn’t even full, 20 min wait for green salad, 40min wait for the main course(2 slices of duck + salmon steak), waitress brought the food for adults before kids, how can you eat when your children don’t have the dishes. Another 15 min wait for plain pasta and an order of meatballs. Food was ok.
•Waitress left while I was talking to her, never took dessert orders and ignored us until we just left.
• Minibar wasn’t restocked for 2 days until I called the front desk, instead of restocking they cleaned the room again.

Front desk, concierges, bell boys, other hotel staff are still great, doing their best.
Loved the place but probably won’t return.

reviews.author: Nyl Pope
reviews.text: The good:  Overall staff was excellent.  Our concierge Miguel and Omar did a great job.  Enjoyed our beach servers Francisco, Guardencio and Rodrigo --  At night Luz.  All made our stay very enjoyable.  Overall food was very good.  Lemon Fish was our favorite.  Pools and beach were excellent other than the usual problem of not enough chairs.  The bad:  Really not that bad, but the overall maintenance seemed to be lacking a bit especially in our room.

reviews.author: Olive
reviews.text:
Loved it!
The service was amazing, the photographer, the bartenders, the waitresses everything! The beach was spectacular, it was gorgeous. The rooms had food and drinks including which instantly hooked my kiddos. The food was okay, the drinks were AMAZING though.  Variety of food was kind of an issue because my daughter is picky but she did like everything she got. Agua marina was our favorite restaurant by far. Overall this was a great experience and I would come back.

reviews.author: Kelly Mazzola
reviews.text:
Flora restaurant Cynthia and Anabel were excellent. their service was very attentive for our large group of 14. They kept our beverages full and were very prompt in clearing plates and serving us. We celebrated a birthday.

Capella restaurant for our large group was also very great service. we celebrated my daughter’s graduation, and the restaurant even helped us decorate before the guests came.

The Agua Marina service at that restaurant at the property was slow and not attentive. We were not happy with the service at that restaurant. We had five young kids and waited at least 30 minutes after our entrées were done before they would come back to take our order for dessert. that is the only reason I am giving four stars instead of five stars.

A room was very nice, but my only complaint is the outdoor pool side cabana beds was 255 and almost empty. They should have reduced the price for dynamic pricing to keep them full.

reviews.author: Suzie Chung
reviews.text: Service is great due to our fantastic server Abraham. He was very friendly to my Korean speaking family. Some foods were great while a couple items were hit or miss like the ramen (smaller than expected). Great atmosphere due to decor of restaurant. Altogether a great experience

reviews.author: Georgie Varkki
reviews.text:
Some of the hotel rooms hadn’t been renovated, but we were fortunate enough to upgrade to a renovated one. Andreas at the check-in was friendly and attentive to our concerns, helping us out. Jorge at Blue Agave was an exceptional server who took the time to guide us through the extensive menu. Jesus from Capella was also friendly and provided us with some fantastic cocktail recommendations.

I’m sure this is a common issue at other resorts, but finding a chair on the beach or by the pool was almost impossible. Guests were claiming them as early as 4 am. I wish the hotel had a system where if a chair was left alone for more than 30 minutes, it would be given to the next guest waiting. We saw many chairs empty with people’s belongings from 9 am, and individuals would arrive by 1 pm.

Food Ranking:
1) Capella
2) Blue Agave
3) Lemon Fish
4) Aqua Marina
5) Cielo

The popup taco, churro, and paella stations were amazing.

In my opinion, the breakfast room service was better than the buffet.
Buffet for lunch was pretty good.
But for dinner it’s better to eat at the restaurant.

reviews.author: Natalie Burks
reviews.text: We had a really fun week here at Paradisus, such a beautiful resort and friendly helpful staff that treats you very kindly. We had a room on the family side and had a few problems the bathroom door didn’t lock and the shower head pressure was weak. The food was very good and the best part was Gerardo Michel in the buffet he was very sweet and always greeted us and knew what we wanted. On the 4th day we upgraded to the adults side and it was worth it. The room was way better and it was nice to be able to have a bali bed the  service was great and we had an amazing stay after we moved to the reserve

reviews.author: Matt Edmundson
reviews.text: Good Service at the restaurants. Not many people speaking English fluently who work here. Poor rooming at the main section 1-4 for our Family. Reserve section we were moved to was outstanding. Balcony’s are spacious and all give beautiful views. Armando was a standout server in Blue Agave and Atilano was well too. The pool bar has plenty of options. Outstanding views outside from the pool, overlooking the teal ocean, tiki huts, bars, and palm trees. About to start a 1 Year renovation starting in May 2025

reviews.author: Michael Chiu
reviews.text:
Rooms are dated in the first pyramid. We had to complain due to mold and the degradation of the room, for example the fan was swinging off the ceiling as many mounts were off the roof and the towel rack was not screwed into the wall. Pyramid 1 was also the farthest away and took 10-15min walk with our baby.

They addressed our concerns by moving us into pyramid 3 and it was much better. The room was updated and the convenience of its location was central to the whole resort including all the restaurants. It was a much desired change.

Service has been great. We were disappointed at first being left without service at one of the restaurants but the next night, Armando at Blue Agave turned out whole mood around. He was very helpful, very entertaining, and his service was excellent.

The restaurants are much better than the buffet. Reservation based.

Location is good with the beach. Convenient from the airport with the shuttle. Only 20 minutes. It is definitely one of those places where you have to get up in the morning to occupy spaces for the pool and the beach.

The rooms need to be updated but the staff here are very accommodating to your concerns and in the end, know how to make things right.

EDIT: I would also like to highlight that Rommel with guest services and Ignacio at Sal Steak House helped to provide an exceptional customer service experience for myself and my family. Thank you to you both for creating exceptional experiences.

reviews.author: Nathan Blische
reviews.text: Karina,Javier and Carlos radios from ginger 2 provided amazing service during my stay. Buffet food oftentimes was cold. Restaurants were great. I’d like to see more seating options by the pool and beach as the seating was very scarce.

reviews.author: Elif Erman
reviews.text: Irina & May were incredible staff that took care of us the entire time! They both made sure we had everything we needed & they checked in on us constantly. Their poolside service was excellent & they truly made our trip so relaxing & convenient. Their work ethic is the absolute best! Thank you to both Irina & May! We can’t say enough positive things about the two of you!

reviews.author: Travis Burdette
reviews.text:
We had an overall great stay at Paradisus Cancun. We stayed in the adults only reserve section and made sure to take full advantage of the all inclusive benefits. We ate so much food and enjoyed poolside service with a drink in our hands at almost all times, mainly thanks to Yamil and Oscar.

Our concierge, Enrique, was attentive, accommodating, and always available. He did his very best to get the reservations at the restaurants and times we requested and sent us our daily activities each morning. He also booked us a poolside cabana for our last two days and made sure to get us the sunset cruise on Saturday.

Three issues we ran into:

1. Our original room was incorrect. They had my wife and I in a room with a double bed that was not an ocean view. Nevertheless, they made up for it by switching our room the next morning that matched our intended reservation.

2. When we arrived to the hotel, we were fortunate that Enrique had booked dinner reservations for us but a lot of days and times were already booked. I am not sure how this happens when booking the restaurants ourselves prior to arrival is not an option.

3.  Our pickup at the airport was not readily available which meant we had to wait for about an hour to get a ride to the hotel, through their transportation provider, Otium.

Still yet, the people, the service from the staff, and the hotel itself made it a very nice stay. We would definitely come back to Paradisus in the future.

reviews.author: Ariane Nicole
reviews.text:
Highly recommend The Reserve at the Paradisus Cancun for adults. Quiet and serene place and our Reserve concierge Rosanna was amazing - very kind and prompt.

Capella, Jose Cahun was great. Lemon Fish, Malva, Blue Agave, Sal - all the staff were wonderful.

I would come back here again. Beautiful hotel, beautiful beach and wonderful service.

8.5/10

reviews.author: Jay Lee
reviews.text: We’re at the Paradisus for the fifth year. I have to say that things have gone downhill and the consensus is that it’s mostly due to the impending closure for renovations. But there are a few people who are still making it worthwhile. Roberto at the pool provides amazing service throughout the day. Alejandro at the coffee bar is always upbeat and ready with our order. And Amyrani is invaluable in helping us with our dinner reservations. We’re hoping for an overall improved experience when the resort reopens.

reviews.author: Sherry Borucki
reviews.text: We had an amazing vacation in the reserve section’The service was great and the hotel was beautiful. The beach was amazing and we had a great time jumping in the waves! It was some of the most beautiful water we’ve ever seen! The rooms themselves are nice, but the air conditioning was an issue. Thankfully, we had an awesome concierge, George, who was able to help us navigate the air issues and get us reassigned to a room with working air. I cannot say enough good things about George, he is top-notch and the best concierge we’ve ever had!  Overall, we had a wonderful time at this hotel and plan to return in the future!

reviews.author: Marcela Brandao
reviews.text: Special shout-out to Dani who led us in activities at the Reserve side. He was personable and made our time together very fun. I was amazed at his facility with various languages and how he managed to keep that same good energy with everyone.

reviews.author: sahana emerge
reviews.text: This was our first time in an all inclusive resort. The booking was easy and we opted for a family concierge for a extra price. A week before we landed we got an option to book our sun set cruise. The restaurant reservations booking would happen only after we check-in. We checked into the resort early and hotel room was available only at 3pm that day. However our luggage was held in a near by storage area. The resort is fully covered with pothos hanging all over. The reception staff is courteous but felt they lacked communication skills. We had a guy assigned as part of family concierge by name Daniel. He pinged us after 4pm to ask us what restaurant reservations we wanted. Most of the restaurants weren't available so that really pissed us off. He never made an attempt to get this issue sorted. As part of all inclusive we were promised of certain things and most of them were booked. I had to complain about this guy to his superiors. Getting Bali Bed for one day near pool was more challenging. His superior Emmanuel was friendly and got us one bed finally. The food was pretty basic for vegetarians. "Flora" was good but rest were just below average food. The tacos were good. I wish there were more continental options like Thai, Indian, Mede terrain and Chinese. What I loved was the classes that happened near "The Reserve". Although meant for customers who booked "The Reserve", the staff encouraged anyone interested in doing such activities. I attended "Guacamole", "Salsa" n "Salsa Dance" making classes with Sayani was amazing. Margarita making was fun with Nestor. Ceramic Painting and making dream catchers was entertaining. The silent party one night was unique with headphones on the beach. I wish the beach was more accessible. The beach was filled with sea weeds and so close to the benches. The rooms are dated, bathroom doors and balcony doors needed a heavy muscle to move. We opted for a ocean facing room. The mini bar was stacked each day with beer, drinks, snacks. They sent me a bottle of wine and cake as we were celebrating my birthday. The sunset cruise was awesome with a saxophone artist playing live through out 2 hour cruise. The cruise staff offered us cocktails n juices. The vegetarian sandwich was yummy. The Sauna, Steam and Jacuzzi was rejuvenating.  The resort arranged for a Mexican show one night with Mexican food and dances from different parts. I really felt resort tried its best to please the residents. I felt they overbooked so the restaurants and few of these unique activities was hard to get appointments. They will be closed for a year for major renovations.

reviews.author: Maya Colucci
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Hotel and had the pleasure of experiencing the exceptional service at the pool bar, thanks to Roberto and Manuel. From the moment we arrived, their attention to detail and warm hospitality truly stood out.

Roberto’s expertise in mixology was evident with every drink he prepared. Each cocktail was not only delicious but also beautifully presented, showcasing his skill and passion for his craft. He took the time to understand our preferences and consistently delivered beverages that exceeded our expectations.

Manuel complemented Roberto’s efforts with his attentive and friendly service. He ensured that our needs were met promptly, always with a smile and a genuine desire to enhance our experience. Whether it was providing fresh towels, suggesting new drinks to try, or simply engaging in pleasant conversation, Manuel’s dedication was remarkable.

Their teamwork and professionalism created an inviting and enjoyable atmosphere at the pool bar. It’s clear that Roberto and Manuel take great pride in their work, and their commitment to providing top-notch service made our stay at Paradisus Cancun even more memorable.

I highly recommend visiting the pool bar at Paradisus Cancun and experiencing the outstanding service provided by Roberto and Manuel. They truly go above and beyond to ensure every guest has a fantastic time. We can’t wait to return and enjoy their hospitality again!

reviews.author: Aaron P
reviews.text:
Resort location - 4 stars.  Beautiful views of the ocean.
Rooms - 3 stars.  Would be great if they offered two queen size beds versus doubles.  Would be nice if the planters weren't there on the balconies so you could have a better direct view of the ocean.  My wife and I had to sleep in separate beds.  I specially asked the front desk receptionist for a king size bed (I made a note of that online when booking too).  It seemed like she didn't listen, I noticed she was on the phone in a text chat while checking us in.  We had planned to share a king size bed and have my wife's mother sleep on the couch / pull out bed (we booked 3 people in our room).
Service - 2 stars,  this is directly a rating of the wait staff at most of the restaurants.  The wait staff seemed to have a "tolerate the guest" attitude and didn't have a genuine friendly attitude.  One example - the hostess that worked at Cielo restaurant would give dirty looks and wasn't friendly and you could tell she didn't like the guests.  Most wait staff had a chip on their shoulders and were annoyed with guests (tolorate the guest attitude). They tried to hide that fact but their true feelings showed through in facial expressions and actions.  I highly recommend any guest staying here to visit Fred's Seafood that is located across the street from the Marriott. It's a short 5-10 minute walk down the street. The food,  ambiance and service their is top tier.  Compare their service and overall quality (food + wait staff) with Paradisus and you'll see exactly what I mean.

Overall my family and I had a good experience at the resort. If we decide to return to cancun we will certainly give another resort (all inclusive or not all inclusive) a try.

I included a photo of the beach and my view from an ocean facing balcony room.

reviews.author: Star AV
reviews.text:
As our trip was within a week of Paradisus closing for their year long remodel, we expected things might not be perfect.
The rooms are definitely in need of rehab, but were fine for our stay in the Reserve.

Positives:
Paradisus staff was wonderful. We tipped a lot, because we felt their service deserved it. Note: Tipping is not required and I did not ever feel pressed to tip.

Property location is wonderful and interior is great (see photos)

As far as any negatives:
The food presentation was great, but the taste fell into the "Edible but just ok". Everyone in our group did not feel any of the food "wowed" us. Hopefully the remodel will include improvements in the food taste quality.

Another negative was the constant pushing to checkout the Circle program. I said we were not interested. If it would have stopped there, I might have checked it out. But the young lady (who I will not name, as she was just doin her job), kept seeking us out, to the point that I now have a negative view of a program I now know nothing about. So my advice to Melia- ask clients once, maybe offer literature and maybe coupons for the freebees for listening, noting they are redeemable at Circle presentation. And then let your guests enjoy their trip versus constantly pushing upgrades around every corner.

If I were to pick top eats it would be Lemon Fish. I do have to note that all the restaurant staff that we engaged with at Malva, Sal, Blue Agava, Cielo, Cappella, Sante, Reserve Atrium and Agua Marina, were all welcoming and friendly.

All the Paradisus staff, from housekeeping, restaurants, bars & everywhere on the property were friendly and helpful. They seemed to be pretty happy considering they were going to be out of a job in 7 days due to the remodel. All said they would be happy to come back if they were not working elsewhere.

"David" the Reserve pool concierge was definitely a highlight. He always had a Bali Bed for us and gave us info on how to get around Cancun. Very professional and personable.

For the price we paid through Expedia which included airfare, I am very happy with the service and trip value we received.

Cancun was wonderful, love their bus system (fast and fun) and friendly attitude of the locals everywhere we went: Isla Mujeres, Market28 and Senior Frogs

reviews.author: Sah Shy (Sasha)
reviews.text:
We stayed 3 nights at this all inclusive resort.
Things I liked about this resort....
1. Not located in hotel zona but away from the tourist
2. Sunset cruise and Mexican show
3. Guacamole, Salsa, Salsa dancing classes
4. Sayani, Nestor, Junior were fun and entertaining
5. Patricia is calm and very focussed, Emmanuel was friendly
and accomodating
6. Blue Agave tacos are great for vegetarians
7. Flora restaturant has vegetarian menu, include more options
8. Loved the concept of bracelet key into the rooms
Things which I did not like about...
1. The vegetarian options were good but lacked quality at Malva
2. More continental vegetarian food options would be better
3. Our conceirge guy "Daniel" was not actively persuing our reservations. He was not motivated to impress us.
4. Bathroom and Balcony doors were heavy, need an upgrade
5. Not easy to reserve restaurants, bali bed. Don't overbook and disappoint you other guests
6. The snack bar has just coffee and desserts, pls have tacos and salsa available through out.
7. Malva is nice concept but have different continental food. The oatmeal that was served was horrible.

reviews.author: charlotte collins
reviews.text:
Overall this was an amazing honeymoon trip and i would come back, i believe it is getting renovated next year which will likely solve many of our issues. The room we were in is dated, most the plugs don't work, the hot tub didnt work was dirty had no plug. the mini fridge being part of the package is meant to be filled daily in our 10 day stay it was filled on arrival and one day without us calling and asking. The service around the pools is completely dependant on where you are sat, some are amazing and some seem to intentionally avoid English speaking people even with our Spanish attempts. The food well that is next level! Absolutely incredible i haven't had one bad meal! If you aren't in the adult only section cabanas are not include and are a steep $255 a day! But there is lots of space around the pool with shade. I would think maybe a system to ensure people get space. It says no reserving spaces around the pool but if you don't you are not getting a bed as lots of people do.
Most of the staff are absolutely incredible and make the experience and make jokes with you. You will be constantly spoken to, to buy extra things and experiences and become part of the melia club. This is a very steep price and out of most British people's price ranges they offered us the lowest membership of $21,000 for two years.... the benefits seem very good but at no way would you get over your money back or money back in my opinion. Honestly though it was a beautiful location and very happy we choose here for our honeymoon.

reviews.author: Jess KG
reviews.text:
Had the beef and lamb dinner dishes and they were both amazing. Our server Alfredo was also very attentive. It felt like a higher end experience because of his service.

Highly recommend the dinner!

reviews.author: Cheryl S
reviews.text: Our time at Paradisus was made so much better by the coffee bar which was pretty much open the whole day. Richer and Alex were our morning baristas and they absolutely made our day better by greeting us  and remembering our coffee orders!

reviews.author: Annmarie “Annie” Altenhofen
reviews.text:
Melia Paradisus was a wonderful stay in Cancun for our family.   This has been,  hands down,  the best all-inclusive for food quality and service.  It's hard to choose a favorite restaurant, but Flora ranks up there at the top.   Our waitress,  Cynthia, did a fabulous job recommending dishes and expertly timing our food so that we weren't rushed or looking for our next selection.
The rooms are clean if not in need of a few updates (I'm looking at you TP holder and lack of plugs bedside)  but we spent most of our time around the pool, so it's hard to complain with the climate. It's a nice choice,  but needs a few improvements - online reservations for restaurants (or have more than one person making them to avoid the line), more loungers poolside, public bathrooms on every floor and plates at the coffee shop.  Overall a solid choice.

reviews.author: X L
reviews.text:
Loved the experience during Christmas 2024 overall. However, even we are at the main building with ocean view, room is older, and sink does not drain well. One day had no hot water, our Family Concierge had to report and got it fixed.

Family Concierge is helpful, but limited. Booked things for us, but not going above and beyond as I expected, met once then communicated on Whatsapp. However, we are in busy season and we got what we can I guess. The only complaint on that service is the special check-in and out lounge, has super slow service. We have waited 30 mins before another family checked in, and no one else can help us due to an empty table. Went there few times during our stay, not many employees there to help.

Overall, there are many good sides of the resort. Good staff, quick service, amazing FOOD! Really better taste than other resorts we have tried, especially the soups!!! Ocean is wavy, so not suitable for kids, but beautiful water. Btw, kids pool does not have slides.

All in all, very happy about the experience. Not a massive hotel, so easy to get to restaurants and ocean, and pools.

reviews.author: Sophie Ashcraft
reviews.text: Food is super good and staff is amazing

reviews.author: Trina Sandler
reviews.text: The rooms are beautiful and kept very clean. The food has been very good aside from breakfast that is hit or miss. The facilities are beautiful but the pools could use some updating and the bathrooms are not conveniently located. It would be nice to have a swim up bar in the Reserve. The service can be hit or miss but there has been some excellent service from some of the staff, specifically Joel at Sante, and the bartender at the main pool, Jesus. I would also recommend some music and more fun activities at the main pool.

reviews.author: Terri Peters
reviews.text:
Just spent a week at the Paradisus Cancún Resort and it was amazing!!!
The food was so good!  The Sal’s steakhouse was our favorite by far!  From the garlic butter to the melt in your mouth steak and Alaskan crab, it was nothing short delicious!   There were so many amazing restaurants it was hard to fit them all in!!!
The staff made our stay completely memorable and enjoyable!   Tony, our concierge helped us with all of our reservations answered all of our questions and checked in with us daily!  At the pool, David and Victor helped us with Bali Beds, supplied us with rafts and boogie boards.
Yamil and Jacob were the best most servers.  They were attentive and kept our drinks full and brought lunch everyday!   The activities weee so fun- the Spanish lessons, fruit carving, and so many other things helped make our stay so enjoyable!!!!
Thanks so much!   And I think we will be back next year!!!!

reviews.author: Emily Chakera
reviews.text:
- Food is delicious. Especially the taco and Japanese fusion. Atilano  at the taco/Blue Agave restaurant and Daniel at Lemon Fish. The beach is wide and clean and the towels are plentiful. The pools are easily accessible from our room. Excited to try the other restaurants.
- Laura and Javier serving at the pool deck and beach are very friendly and helpful. And the young man at the Pizza Hut works so hard!!
- our room is cleaned very well every day but I’ll say that it definitely needs renovating which is the only part of our trip that is a negative.
- grounds and overall building are beautiful but it’s a big resort so if you are not very mobile, yes there are ramps and elevators but it’s spread out
A great vacation!

reviews.author: finlay Mallen
reviews.text:
Big shout out to Danny and Sinthia from the entertainment team who have made our time here great !  They get everyone involved in the activities and are very good at building friendships with people staying in the resort. They are very good at what they do !!

Jorge , Didier , Flor and Baltazar from the bar and serving team have also been amazing ,serving nice cold drinks all day and working hard in the hot weather doing long hours to make customers happy and stay hydrated!.

Lastly a gentleman from the guest service team has looked after us after a initial complaint we had with our room, he complimented us with a lovely steak dinner as it was my 21st birthday and also decorated and set up a cake, balloons and a bottle of fizz in our room which was a lovely touch. This man was very caring and considerate towards us and made us feel valued after a bad experience we had with a member of staff from reception.

Would definitely recommend and come back here!

reviews.author: Karan Bhanushali
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time with Paradisus Cancun. The very next day of our vacation my wife and I said the same words " we are coming back here". Great experience with our 3 year old and friends. Staff is great. I'll start with manager of Malva - Edier, what a guy, greeted every one with love and care, shows you how much respect their work and your time. There was a slight inconvenience which I won't be mentioning here and it was an unintentional one, but Edier took the service to next level and compensated with his personal attention and time and also some other non monetary (complimentary resort service) compensation which I will not mention. Till his last day he messaged me on my phone post working hours to ask me if I needed anything as I was leaving that day. Thank you Edier from myself and my family. Second name - Romeo, the property/hospitality manager. There was some technical issues with room which I addressed to a few few people and said it was being worked on and it caused a major inconvenience to us. Post 24 hours I went to service desk and Rommel was there whom I addressed the issue to and he made sure not only I that I get a better room but also complemented for the inconvenience (again non monitory as it was an resort service). Great guy with care for his job and his tourists. Never said I am busy or asked me to go to someone else. Listened to me carefully and took appropriate actions. Thank you very much Rommel, I hope I get to see you again.
Regarding resort- it's an amazing place. You will not want to step out,  I did not wanted to come back. Staff greets you with a smile Everytime they bump into you. Room service is quick and 24 hrs. Beach is accessible within 20 steps from the door of resort, pools and family area are great too. My family was safe and enjoyed a lot. Clean -9/10, food 8/10, service 8/10.
Constrictive feedback - kids area was missing. My kid was bored for sometime as there were no water slides or entertainment for them.
Post 11 there is no bar open so no night life for young couples.
Pool area needs some more accommodations as lounge seats are limited.
Shuttles /golf carts till main gate for outside travel should be arranged.
Having said all this, I am for sure going here again for my next all inclusive. Mr.Edier and Mr.Rommel thank you again for everything.

reviews.author: Manish Dhawan (Da-One)
reviews.text:
Stayed for 5 nights at Paradisus over Christmas week. Rooms were ok. Not 5 star caliber (was at Breathless Punta Cana few months ago). Water leaking from the faucet-wall area. One day of no warm water.

Property beautiful but very crowded as all restaurants in small area. Long lines daily to get into buffet. Had to stand in a long line to book dinner reservations. But got all reservations as I was in line at 9:30 for 10 am start of bookings!

Best part of stay was food. It was very good everywhere be it buffet or specialty restaurants. I had heard very good things about Lemon Fresh restaurant (Japanese Peruvian) but disappointed with sushi. Rest good. We love seafood and it was everywhere and cooked very well. Loved Aguamarina, Cielo and Capella. Cielo is authentic Mexican and best.

Would book adults only resorts next time. They have an adults only section called Reserve which was practically dead. Saw no one in their pools any time. Pool space small.  Have to get up early, 6 am if you expect to find a good spot on beach or poolside as all get taken very very early!! And folks may not even show up all day. Frustrating.

Staff very nice and always helpful. Everyone did an excellent job making you feel at home. Overall, every Mexican we met, we found them to be very nice and humble. They always appreciate if you speak in Spanish.

My two Adult kids did scuba diving from Aquaworld (they have a place from where they solicit business). This was their first time. It included 1 hour of lesson- Instructor Raphael was fantastic and an expert. Their whole experience was excellent.

reviews.author: derek freeman
reviews.text:
This review is with the understanding that the hotel was at 100% capacity.

Upon check in we were taken to a “VIP” check in experience and waiting for 20 minutes to get checked in.

Bell staff was friendly and efficient
Transition and introduction never happened and was very frustrating.
Room was very nice - no room upgrade offered or was I able to pay more for a better room. No late check out approved regardless of Expedia highlighting a late check out.

Our concierge finally connected with us after going and asking the front desk how to make reservations. Mario then tried very hard to get two and was only able to get late dinner reservations due to capacity. (Would have been nice to know you must make reservation by 4pm)

In addition pool cabanas were all booked and it was very competitive to get lounge chairs together. Adults only Reserve side.

Beach was incredible and clean.

Staff we had help with during our stay.
Sante- Josue- very helpful and provided local suggestions
Gabriella - went out of her way to get anything we were looking for.
Jacob - extremely nice and worked very hard to make our pool days very fun.

Reserve bar-
Luis- ( best dirty banana in Cancun)brought the energy and made the bar vibe very fun and provided a great energy to the pool. Alejandro - was very efficient and worked perfectly with Luis.
Valeria - worked as hard as anyway that I saw and always had a smile. All three said several times they love their jobs that made our conversations more enjoyable.

Reserve coffee bar- Julio- was always friendly and did a great job managing very loud customers while still being professional to others in line.

Check in - isaac didn’t help layout how reservations worked and didn’t seem to set the team up for success.

Mario… reactive and was limited in helping due to occupancy .”possibly due to capacity” we had a short stay and it seemed like those with longer stays already had most of the reservations and there was not much room to accommodate a shorter stay.

David at the pool cabana station(reserve)- went out of his way to find a last minute reservation for us to enjoy one day at a cabana. He  also was beyond helpful and brought a great energy to the pool that lacked vibes with no music.
Victor was very helpful and their team did a great job - it was fun to learn about daisy and Venus at the pool.

Sante staff was incredible and their food was very good. Huevos rancheros and French toast were the highlights for us.

Sal steak house was our best meal with their tar tar and carrot soup being the winners of the evening. Francisco was very professional.

The buffet was incredible and very easy to access with a ton of options and seating.

Lemon fish was the worst of our experience of the trip. Two of our main entrees never came out after waiting for a 930 dinner reservation this was terrible. We left after waiting an hour for our main courses.

Agua marina restaurant was okay with both our meals having the same sauce base that didn’t show much variety. Slow due to high volume.

Wish we checked out kanna and the secluded seating.

We spent most of our time on the reserve side and the staff was all next level.

The reason we gave this 3.5-4 stars is due to the check in experience and the 5am wake up to get pool seating. Dinner reservations after 830 didn’t fit our schedule but they were our only options. Lemon fish was a massive let down allowing us to walk out of the restaurant at close to 11 with only reaching an appetizer.

Other than that we would like to go back and would look to stay longer to allow for more booking options. This was our first all inclusive and it was a good value just struggled with the competition to book literally anything.

reviews.author: Ant Josh
reviews.text: I've been to many resorts and this one is above average. The food is pretty good, which is a big concern for me. Many selections to choose from in the buffet. There are plenty of snack bars by the pool, even a restaurant. Drinks are non-stop! They even have a poolside paella bar once a day for fresh seafood. I did feel like it was a hit or miss with the staff friendliness. The coffee shop guy was definitely rude on multiple occasions. The restaurants are nice and have pretty good selections. The views are great from the oceanide rooms. The rooms are a bit dated and "regular". I stayed in a Jr suite* we did see a good amount of roaches in the mexican restaurant and the buffet seating area.

reviews.author: Nancy Ruvalcaba
reviews.text:
The beach and food was great, the entertainment options were great, the staff was friendly. The beach was nice and clean, but waves were a bit aggressive in early December. I will say that the beach/pool lounging chair system needs to be improved. I have stayed at Paradisus Los Cabos and Paradisus Dominican Republic and they both have a system where they give you a card for a towel and you have to return the towel to get the card back. Here at Paradisus Cancun, you can get as many towels and basically reserve as many chairs at the beach and the pool at the same time. My family and I had a hard time finding beach/pool lounging chairs even though many were not being used all day because they had a towel and it was hard to tell if people were currently using them or if they had left for the day and were not coming back. Many people had to sit on the sand when there were many available chairs that were not used all day but had a towel on them. Mixed drinks on the beach taste watered down but the drinks poolside and bars were ok. I noticed there was a lot of cosmetic repairs needed around the resort and signage that needs to be implemented. If you get lost, you have to ask around but there is not much signage at this resort compared to their other 2 locations I have been to which was disappointing. The pool also did not have signage of how deep the pool was so that was tricky. Good resort, but has some kinks to work through.
I also wanted to mention that Nestor the outdoor entertainment host is a gem. He knows how to work a crowd especially during Movie Trivia.

reviews.author: Adam Marcionek
reviews.text: The grounds, the rooms and the staff were all delightful.  Everyone was so friendly and accommodating.  Personally, the food didn't live up to my expectations which is why I give it 4 stars. But part of that was I was there with a conference and the majority of the time the food was provided to us buffet style.

reviews.author: Alexandre Contreras
reviews.text:
Non-Reserve, with 2 kids (8 and 10)

HOTEL - Beautiful and clean. The main pyramid is simply stunning at night. The complex is big and you can get lost at first while navigating the pyramids, but you'll find your way eventually.

ROOM - I have a basic room in Pyramid 4. It's definitely outdated. The room is on the side of the pyramid, so my view is the other pyramid, which sucks a bit, but you can stil see the ocean. While outdated, the room is fine, nothing to complain.

POOL - The non-Reserve pool is huge, but the bar, DJ and activities are specifically on one end of the pool. It's very nice and clean. Beautiful view as well. Available chairs are hard to find.

BEACH - Very nice beach, beautiful water. Right next to the resort, literally a 30 seconds walk from the pool. Again, chairs are hard to find.

RESTAURANTS - The food at restaurants is very good, the buffet is great as well (definitely not out of this world, but very decent). However, the fact that you have to line up every day to make a reservation for restaurants is incredibly archaic, and I don't understand why guests can't make their reservations online. Lining up every day for 20 minutes to make a reservation is "not very 2025".

ROOM SERVICE - Somewhat varied and large menu for room service. We tried breakfast, and was amazing. It was quick, hot and well presented. I believe you have 3 free calls, then it's 6 USD.

ENTERTAINMENT - Pretty much inexistant.

GYM - Old equipment, but has pretty much everything you need for a decent workout. Pretty large and spacious as well.

KIDS ACTIVITIES - There is a Kidsdom, but it seems to be tailored for younger children. Basically you leave your kids there for a period of time, and you pick them up later. It would feel like punishment if I did that to a 8 and 10 year old. Otherwise, there is nothing really specific for kids.

STAFF - All of them have been super friendly, nothing to complain.

reviews.author: Jack LA.
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at this resort! The service was absolutely impeccable and everyone worked extra hard to make sure we had a fantastic time. The outside pool was very fun and the servers out there were so friendly and kind, it elevated the entire experience. Timoteo was the BEST and he had extremely good customer service and made amazing mojitos! Didi was also amazing outside. The food inside the resort was fantastic and we had no complaints at any of the restaurants! Highly recommend Cielo for larger groups, ask for Lucas he was great! It rained a lot while we were here, but that did not diminish our experience by much. The spa was a lovely experience and Lucero did an excellent job. My only critique of this location would be that due to the rain, there was a lot of flooding in the hallways and in some of our rooms as well. Housekeeping did a great job mopping up the floor and putting down towels to help dry up and they did so in a timely manner. Overall I would recommend this location to anyone looking for a nice and relaxing family vacation.

reviews.author: Melissa Kabachia
reviews.text:
Jorge at Lemon Fish is the ultimate waiter. Kind, efficient, and helped us to pick the most delicious dishes from the menu. The chefs Marcos y Karen, many, many thanks for a delicious first dinner at Paradisus Cancun. Muchos Gracias!

I’d also like to thank Laura for her wonderful service and attention during our day at the cabana. So kind and attentive. My husband and I were well cared for.

We also dined at Cielo the last night of our trip. Melvin was amazing! Extraordinary service for a delicious meal. We cannot thank Melvin enough for a beautiful experience! Thank you for making the last night of our trip in Cancun one to remember.

reviews.author: Kevin Armstrong
reviews.text: I will admit that I read many of the reviews on here prior to our trip…and I had some concerns about how our group of 80 people would find the experience.  I was pleasantly surprised and satisfied by our stay at Paradisus.  There are many things that I do believe can be improved upon…like, the lack of availability for dinner reservations, the overall quality of the food in Malva (the buffet) and the fact that the bars close at Midnight on property. But, I chose to give high marks for effort when I saw how hard the staff worked to make sure our experience was exceptional. Huge thanks to Marcela (events) and Enrique (food and beverage manager) for making our group dinner a spectacular event last night.  Also, Alejandro went above and beyond to get my wife strawberries (and he even added chocolate on the side) when the buffet ran low.  Our room was very nice.  The air conditioning worked well in ours (I had read many comments about this).  The pools were great…and that mattered more than I thought it would because the ocean was very rough (rip current).  One really cool thing was that the hotel setup viewing areas for the World Cup and we got to enjoy these matches with people from various countries.  That was a whole lot of fun.  Overall, the staff at Paradisus was exceptional.  I travel a lot, and I would say that you get out of a trip what you put into it.  Yes, it’s “All Inclusive”…but, tip well and your service will be fantastic.  Thank you, Paradisus for providing a memorable week for our group.

reviews.author: Gaby Hajjar Architect
reviews.text:
Love the place amazing staff amazing food ' resto réservations hard to get .
Problem with Algiers smell ..

reviews.author: M Lo
reviews.text:
My mom and I just got back from vacation in Cancun. We stayed at Paradisus hotel and loved most of our experience.  We loved the staff. From security, bell boy, entertainment staff concierge, waiters, Spa staff. Everyone was very kind and attentive to us! To name a few that i can recall Abraham, Victor, Gisell, Alejandra,  Valentina and wish I could remember other names, but I can't.  Everyone was great! I also loved the nightly entertainment.

The hotel looked very luxurious from the moment our van turned to their grounds when dropping us from the airport. Security has a very tight management of who goes in and out. Even keeping count of how many go in and out. That made us feel so safe.

The ambience of the hotel made me feel serene and at peace since there were so many green areas and water running like fountains. So many different spots to take pictures in.

The restaurant experience was great as well. Malva, Aqua Marine, Sante were delicious. The only one I didn't care for was Flora. They didn't have many options in the menu, unless you wanted to pay extra. We only went for 6 days so didn't have time to try the rest.

Now for the part that wasn't the greatest was our first room. We asked for a change of room and they did. The second room was so much better, but it had a leak in the wall in the bathroom.  It didn't affect us much so we didn't complain any longer being that it was a lot better than the 1st room.  I do know they will be closing the hotel for renovations this may. So hopefully it'll be much better afterwards.

To all the Staff Thank you so much! You made our trip memorable !

reviews.author: Joti B
reviews.text:
Visited as a family with two children March 9-14th and had a great time! The hotel is only 15 minutes away from the airport making it a seamless commute.

PROS:

We booked through Expedia and were able to check-in a private lounge which made it comfortable and convenient. The resort overall is great for families with children and couples. There were many restaurants to choose from. I would recommend making the reservations the day you arrive to ensure you get your picks. The restaurants we really enjoyed included Lemon Fish  which was Sushi and Japanese inspired food and Capella which was Italian cuisine. This was the consensus we received from the reviews and guests visiting. The buffet was also pleasant. We preferred eating breakfast at the buffet and lunch at Masi’s Pizza which is poolside. Room service was also good. The amenities were top notch and providing many areas to lounge and enjoy time with your loved ones with a great view. Coffee is a must when I travel and the Nespresso bar did not disappoint! The beach was extremely clean and water was crystal blue. I also liked that there were not vendors trying to sell you services every other minute. The gym and tennis court are also great!

CONS:

As mentioned in previous reviews the rooms are outdated. They will be closed for 1 year in a few months and I’m assuming they will be updating the rooms. In addition, you have to wake up at 6 am to hold beach chairs and pool chairs for yourself and loved ones, as after 7 am they are not available. We encountered a rude waiter at Capella restaurant on March 10th at 9pm. Otherwise, service was great!

Overall, our group of 7 had a great time! I would recommend requesting a room in pyramid 4 if you are travelling with kids as this was a central location to everything!

reviews.author: Anh-Tuan Le
reviews.text:
Had a great experience overall at the resort.
Staff and service were amazing.
The food is a hit or miss, but I highly recommend Lemon Fish.
The beach is pretty and clean, but the water is a little too rough to swim in

reviews.author: Debbie Block
reviews.text:
The check in was easy.  I am a RCI member and there was a separate check in. The service around the pool was great, especially Laura. We selected to use the all inclusive benefits and she knew what we wanted and thought ahead and brought us drinks, ice and other items (French fries) without asking. The pina coladas were delicious!

It was wonderful sitting around the pool and going back and forth between the beach and the pool. The chair situation around the pool was inadequate. Luckily we had people in our group that got up early enough to get chairs (530 to 6am). The weekend was especially busy. I would recommend a floaty for the pool. The whole pool is about 5 feet deep and walking on your tip toes all the time can be uncomfortable. The swim up bar was fun. It was a great way to meet people. Carlos made the best drinks.

The view out the main door walking out to the beach side is amazing. The water is all shades of beautiful blues!! The sand is great. Soft, white and not hot. The entrance into the ocean is a little tricky right in front of the resort. But, if you go down the beach a little (to the right) it is an easier entrance into the water. The waves are fun to play in.

The restaurants and buffet were good. As a gluten free person the labeling and choices were not adequate. Every meal was a challenge in communication for choices and staff understanding what gluten free was. Made things uncomfortable for everyone in our group.

We were in a 2 bedroom. One bedroom had a loud air conditioning unit. Hot tub was not usable. Old, water trickled out, and the tub was dirty. We didn't use it. The beds were very comfortable.

reviews.author: Kerry Earl
reviews.text: What a great place! Staff was so wonderful and cheerful.  We could not have asked for better people to spend 5 days with. Food was delicious, but on the buffet many times food that was meant to be hot was not. All the great food gave us an opportunity to try food we would not usually eat. Golf course was fun but was difficult to find which hole was next. We just played the the next one we could find. It was a little close to the road but a fun little  par 3. We were directly across from Aqua World so we could walk to our excursions.  Very convenient.  As for the room, the view was fantastic! Beds were quite soft compared to our extra firm mattress at home. There was a step going into the bathroom that caused a few stubbed toes and getting into the shower was a little sketchy. The tub was quite deep and not sunk in, so you had a giant step. There was also no fan in the bathroom so you had to leave the door open to let the steam out. Lights were a little confusing. Overall, we loved it and absolutely plan to return.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Gray
reviews.text:
We have a 10 & 12 year old and stayed using the Family Concierge option.

Staff: All the staff is amazing and they work really hard to meet your needs and keep the resort looking good. We had a butler assigned to us, LALO and he was awesome. I could text him anytime with something we needed or questions. He kept me posted on the status of our room as well because we got there pretty early. Overall all the staff is super nice and accommodating. Make sure you tip!!

Family Concierge: I recommend getting this if you can. We had a personal butler, ocean view family master suite room. The Aqua Marina restaurant was only available to us during breakfast so we didn’t have to wait in the buffet. Nobody used this option either so we got personal attention for breakfast! They dropped off a bottle of champagne and cookies one night.  Also you get one of the Bali beds by the pool for a full day.

Room: Our room was very nice, loved that we had 2 balconies. They brought in an extra bed for my daughter and my son slept on the sofa bed. Was nice to have the separation from the kids at night! The cleaning staff did a good job cleaning it as well.

Food: The kids loved the buffet for lunchtime. Our favorite restaurant was Capella. We didn’t eat at all the restaurants because the kids loved the buffet so much. They enjoyed there was something different everyday. Ordered dessert via room service and it was okay, just wasn’t very cold. Also the Nespresso cafe was awesome, the guys working there does a really good job! One big negative was my husband got sick after eating at Lemon Fish.

Pool: Was a bit confused on the chair situation at first but was told if you put a personal item on the chair then it is saved. I learned to get up around 6:30am and put some stuff down there. The towels are kind of hidden, the closest place is where aquaworld tries to sell you trips which was annoying. The pool bar was really nice and fun. We enjoyed sitting in the pool with some drinks! The pool does get really warm toward the end of the day. Another complaint is there are no bathrooms near the pool at all so you know people are peeing in there.

Beach: same situation with the pool if you want chairs and a shade tree get down there early and save your spot. Bonus you can catch a beautiful sunrise! The water was breathtaking with the colors, was our favorite part! The staff does bring drinks and food around as well.

Store: The store is super expensive, like $40 for a bottle of sunscreen! So bring lots with you!

Activities: they had Karoke and some other fun stuff my kids were too cool to partake in. They did get to play on a VR headset and they enjoyed that. On Friday night they had a festival with a bunch of food and vendors which was very cool. There was also a mariachi band that we really enjoyed! Was a perfect end to our trip!

reviews.author: Hattie Hodge
reviews.text:
The food was wonderful, but Miguel made the experience perfect
He brought us drinks all evening. Let us try all the food and brought us so many fun things.
The food is wonderful, fresh seafood, and great sushi but Miguel makes it an amazing experience. Make sure you try the salmon, the beef skewers, or the green aguachiles

reviews.author: isabel escudero
reviews.text:
